review_text: I received a sample of this product and hoped that it would be an improvement on my current eye treatment product. Sadly, it wasn’t. I saw no effect whatsoever and it was though I wasn’t using any product at all. I’m glad to return to my go-to eye product.
help with puffy under eyes and darkness.
Second tube I love it especially after micro needling. It is very soothing and reduces my redness, I would recommend to sensitive skinned people like me.

Goopy mess, and the pump barely works. Maybe the full size is better, but the mini feels like it should be a free sample. Very hard to use and makes a mess around the mouth of the tube. Too little to tell much result.
The best eye cream ever!

I wanted to love this product so bad, unfortunately it did not fair well with my skin type. I think this is better suited for people without acne. It clogged my pores and caused white heads all over my forehead and cheeks. It did make the rest of my face very moisturized though, baby soft. My dry patches healed from it but not worth the tiny bumps. I was so hopeful since this is an all natural moisturizer.

I don’t normally give 5 stars but this really deserves it. My skin is acne pron, sensitive, and combo. This clears my pores without drying me out which is amazing for my combo skin! I can actually leave this on for the full amount of time without feeling any burning. it’s helped my acne out more than any other product has! Im truly in shock over how amazing this product is. I wake up and feel like if I went out, my skin would look decently without foundation.I had gotten a small sample and in just 2 weeks my face was better than ive had in years, masks always make my acne worse, burn me, or dry my face out leaving dry patches for days.  with the miracle this pulled off I bought a full size jar and use 3 days apart.

Algenist is a genius in cleansing mask. I have used the PERFECT Clarifying Pore Corrector Mask before and I loved it. Now I found this one and never disappointed me. My skin feel soft and nice after using. Very convenient to use, no more extra step.

I tried this serum for only ten days and I’m completely blown away with the results! From the first night I tried it,  I was really impressed with how smooth and radiant my skin looked.  As a 47 year young woman, it’s hard to maintain smooth skin texture,  this serum helped to bring it back to life! My skin looks brighter and fresher looking,  makeup goes on smoother too, I love it! The serum is light and doesn’t pill up under my moisturizer and makeup,  it also didn’t clog my pores. It’s full of skin loving antioxidants including alguronic acid, niacinamide , chlorine, and ergothioneine formulated to help protect the skin barrier against pollutants. It’s simply phenomenal and I would recommend it to everyone, especially those with dull uneven skintone! I recieved this complimentary sample to try, all opinions are my own.

Sorry Algenist. Im a big fan of all the other products ive used, but this one just needs more moisture. Im sure in time it may help with crows feet but i couldnt make it more than 2 weeks as it dried me out even more than I was. Looked worse. Need some hyaluronic acid in here or something. 3/4 of a jar left, and just cant use it :(

I received a packet sample of this and mixed it with my Dr Jart Ceramiden cream the other night. (I have super dry skin and needed more hydration.) I woke up the next day with bumps and white heads all over my face. I did not change anything else in my routine so I know it was this product. This product was not calming for me and I would recommend that people are cautious with this product.

I’m so impressed with this new product. My husband and I will be fighting over it! He saw the improvement  and started using it. We both have oily skin and it was wonderful improvement...no greasy after feeling. We were glowing and texture and tone improved.  Have to make this permanent staple in my routine. If you like liquid collagen this will amaze you as well.
This amazing eye cream will treat every concerns you may have “360around the eye“ a genius treatment for your eyes
Amazing product! If you’re looking for something to lighten your dark spots super fast, then try this! It works miracles!

I was stunned when this took down the redness from my rosacea and kept it down for most of the week.  Before using the mask, I hadn’t had mostly flesh colored cheeks without the aid of foundation in over a year.
i love this product!

I have scarring from acne, and after just one use my scars have lightened up significantly! I loved the way the product felt on my skin while massaging it and I cant wait to see what a month of use will do!

I just finished the sample size of this and I can tell I will need to buy the full size. It’s definitely a nice thick cream, but not so much that I wouldn’t want to wear it in warm weather. I didn’t notice much difference on my skins’ redness, but it definitely felt softer in the morning. The price is pretty steep, but a little goes a long way.
After using the product regularly I can find a difference in my under eyes. The dark circles are now less dark! I will definitely keep using it
I feel like it doesn’t do anything at all. I bought it because of the good reviews but was disappointed with the results. Wish I could return it.

This is my first review for any product, I just don’t do them. But I felt like I had to leave one for this because I would literally have a near panic attack if they ever stopped making it. It’s hands down the best neck cream I’ve ever used and I’ve tried several high end brands since I entered my 40s. It feels luxurious and soothing when applied. It’s especially helpful right now post chin lipo 2 weeks ago.I like to use a facial spray (like Evian or Caudalie very lightly just prior to use to seal in the moisture of this cream twice daily). It’s incredibly moisturizing and has a very light and clean fragrance (I’m very sensitive to fragrance normally and a lot of neck creams smell way too strong unfortunately). The scent doesn’t stick around because it’s so light which is also nice for others that are sensitive too. It’s definitely a holy grail product for me and I started to notice great improvement in the softness and some firmness after several days of consistent use AM & PM (I’ve been using it for over a year now though and will never go without it). I also love applying to my chest, it’s made great changes there as well. Can’t say enough about how much youth, elasticity (and even clarity on my chest) has improved. However, don’t expect a miracle for firmness. The peptides in the product definitely help but it won’t give you a neck lift or make it feel tight.

I’m 45 and have been using eye creams since my early 20s. I have fair skin and have always been religious about sunscreen but nonetheless have had crow’s feet for sometime. No eye cream has never done much other than keep the area hydrated. This product has made a dramatic difference in the skin around my eyes. I’m a little crinkly when I smile (like most humans) but at rest there are not even fine lines. I’m writing this review as I purchase my second container. I also use the Algenist anti-aging oil (gold bottle).

I loooooove this stuff.  A year or so ago I noticed that my eye around my crease was kind of drooping so I picked up this stuff and it’s right back where it was supposed to be!  It took a little time but I use it once a day at night and I’m not having any issues

This cream gave me results in two weeks. I have dry/sensitive eye area concerns with early signs of aging. I have noticed a visible difference in the brightness of the area’s tone and also firmness. The skin absolutely appears strengthened, especially right where my eye area meets the height of my cheekbones. This product is also very rich without being heavy, no signs of millia and cleared up extra dry patches under brows. I will repurchase this item.

It isn’t really a cream--it’s more of a balm. You really only need a very, very tiny amount. I used too much and noticed some white bumps forming under my eyes. I primarily purchased this in hopes that it would hydrate and help any forming wrinkles, but I think this product is too rich for my skin type (combination) and my age.

I have been using this eye cream for about five years. I’m 27, so started around 22. The area around my eyes is the only place where my age doesn’t show at all (I get lines on my forehead and around my mouth, especially when tired). It truly works. I love the texture, it’s a little crepe-y. I tend not to like products that are too watery. I also feel like I literally cannot use my concealer without this as the base. Makeup goes on much more smoothly and doesn’t dry out that delicate skin.

Read the reviews and was very hyped for it. But sadly after finally finishing almost all the bottle, I saw no improvements. I didn’t mind the tingle too much and even tried leaving on for longer than recommended. There are definitely better products out there for this price point.

This really does protect the skin. It left my skin more radiant and it helped heal scaring. I had a lot less breakouts while I used this, as well. If you use too much, it does get sticky and will roll off and/or cause your makeup to roll off. Be sure not to overdo it. Like all their products (in my opinion), a little goes a long way. I did see a change and improvement in the overall health of my skin. The first time I tried it, I did feel a slight warming sensation. After that, I didn’t feel it as much. The packaging also looks amazing. All in all, I would recommend this.

I have seen improvement in the texture on the skin around my eyes. I love the product! The packaging is not great. The product comes in a pot, but is too thick to “grab” with your fingertip. You need a tiny spatula, which is doesn’t come with.

Love love love this product. I have a toddler and also bartend at night so i average about 5hrs of sleep sometimes less on weekends and my undereye area was looking rough. I purchased this product as an impulse buy while at sephora and I’m so glad I did. Started seeing results within a week. Visibly reduced lines and major improvement to under eye bags. I was using face masks every weekend but since purchasing this product have not needed to. I wake up looking refreshed and even feel confident enough to go out without the usual layers of concealer I was using. It does have a pearlescent hue to it so I would not recommend wearing it under make up. I use it evernight before bed.

I would give this product 5 stars but for $70, it should last more than 4 weeks. I’m 30 years old and have pretty good skin and almost no wrinkles so I don’t know if it’s worth purchasing again. I feel like the special size sample last longer.

Well I LOVE the texture the second it hits my skin, and the few times I’ve gotten it into my waterline I’ve never felt any stinging, which is great. However one morning after a week of putting this on day/night my mother asked if I was stoned -- baffled, I asked why she said that, and she said that my eyes looked “unusually small“. After looking in the mirror, I noticed that the skin around my eyes was pulled so tight I looked like I was perpetually squinting. So, does this tighten the skin around the eyes? Absolutely! But unless you have bad crows feet, maybe avoid this product.

Absolutely love especially my skin is sensitive, I feel calming, soft and moisturizer, I have a lot of redness and dryness near the nose and almost completely removed, the lines of my face are less visible. I feel it helps my face fight the cold weather and it feels fresh ... I really liked this test ... I want to buy the large version to continue using it.

I’ve switched from the algensit vitamin c to the AA barrier as it works well both morning and night. Am: to help with environmental damage such as pollution and sun (live in sf). PM: to sooth the redness when used with a retinol.  My skin is brighter and more even in tone.

I have been using Shisedo Beneficials Eye Cream but knew i needed to switch as soon as I felt this on my skin in the store. Only one drop makes my skin feel like silk. It is pricy but by using one drop in the morning and evening it should last a long time.

I was lucky to receive this peel in a trial size version in exchange for my honest review.I really enjoyed this treatment! Slight tingle on application, which I actually enjoy since I can feel it working, but feeling doesn’t last long.  Immediately after use my skin felt very clean and soft to the touch. I really saw an overall brightening difference the next morning! After 10 day, 3 consistent uses I really saw a positive change in my complexion, especially in regards to brightening and dark spots. i think i will end up purchasing the full size i enjoyed it so much!
Made my skin feel soft, smooth, & supple. I felt refreshed & revived!
Love the way this cream makes my eyes feel!!

I have only been using this for a couple of week so I have only noticed the moisturizing effects of this product.. This product is super thick, like a paste consistency. My skin is dry, so after I wash my face I need to put a moisturizer on afterwards. This eye cream is very hydrating. For me, it does not crease my makeup or create a “cakey“ look. This product will probably be too heavy for oiler skin or in weather that is hot and humid. It doesn’t wow me, but it works enough for me to be satisfied with it.

I went through the whole container & I still don’t know what it did to my skin. I have combination skin & I use Curology to treat my acne. The description made it seem like the swiss army knife of masks - promises to tackle wrinkles, hydration, pores, microbiome, etc. but I don’t think it lives up to its promise. I bought this in the middle of summer when the heat & humidity makes my pores huge & my skin feel icky at the end of the day. I was hoping the clay would draw out impurities, help my pores & balance my skin, but results were.. meh. I much prefer Kiehl’s Rare Earth Deep Pore Cleansing Mask.

This has been a game changer in my skincare routine. Received a small sample, noticed a pretty immediate difference in elasticity and texture, and now I’ve purchased the full-sized bottle because I just don’t want to go without it! My skin looks visibly brighter

I love this eye serum. My under eyes are very dry, have dark circles and very prone to age me. After using Algenist POWER for 2 months, I see a noticeable difference.  There is less dryness, dark circles are lessened and my eyes simply look better.  I have tried dozens of under eye creams, from cheap to very expensive, and this is probably the best.

This peel is nice (and tingly, which I love!), but I didn’t see a noticeable difference on the hyperpigmentation on my face. When I first put the product on my face, it did make it a bit red, so I definitely reacted to the peel (people with sensitive skin, be aware!) But again, I didn’t see an overall improvement on the discoloration from the acne on my face. It did however brighten my skin overall, which is a plus!
My experience was this product worked better as a facecream. It was too heavy, yet not very emollient.

Ever since incorporating this into my skincare routine I have noticed my skin is much smoother, and more hydrated feeling and looking. I took off a star though because the scent is terrible, smells like chemicals, however it doesn’t linger long and my normally sensitive skin hasn’t had any negative reaction to it.
I don’t know if this works because I had to wash it off my face because the smell was so foul and offensive.

I received a sample of this from Sephora and it exceeded my expectations!  I am in my 50s and suffer from eczema and get allergic reactions on my face especially around my eyes and mouth.  I have to be careful what I use on my skin.  Since I have used Algenist Collagen before I was excited to try this.  The lotion was easy to put on over my face serum and my skin soaked it right in.  Left my skin feeling very smooth.  I didn’t have to put moisturizer on, I felt that it was enough but did so anyway and no problems whatsoever.  So happy to have found a calming product with collagen in it that we need as we age.  Good job Algenist, I will be buying the full size definitely!!!!

I rarely write reviews but this is one of best products I have used for my eyesI am 56 & the wrinkles are starting below the eyes, this really helps, even with the eyelids I can tell a difference. Definitely worth the cost
It’s kind of an average moisturizer ... nothing especial

Despite trying numerous products to help with my combination-dehydrated skin nothing has helped as much as this peel has. I’ve only used this 3 times in the last 2 weeks but my skin is brighter, plumper and more even-toned. Add a little Genius Liquid Collagen and my skin is healthier (and more hydrated!) than it’s been in years. Worth every penny!

I had a sample to try before Christmas. Before I had some redness and a few fine lines especially around my eyes. On day 10, the redness was not as noticeable but in the area around my eyes was not puffy and the lines not as noticeable. My skin looked great and I looked less tired!

This is only one of four eye creams that I can use, as I am so sensitive. I am also extremely dry and this is one of the only eye creams that hydrates me. Great for plumping, Brightening, de-puffing, and hydration.

I tried this product for about a week and the first few days were great! I definitely saw a difference on the lines around my mouth and forehead. I however had to return it because it made my face break out after a few days (something which rarely happens). If you are considering it, i would definitely purchase it and see how it goes. Not everyones skin reacts the same.

Im 30 so i only have very fine lines so it’s not like this product had a lot of work to do. In 3 weeks it didn’t do anything as far as diminishing wrinkles at all. As a moisturizer it’s ok. The smell is not nice.

Great eye cream. I definitely see some help with fine lines and puffiness. My darkness is less. It wears well under concealer.  It’s pretty emollient, a little goes a long way(like half a grain of rice per eye). Probably lasted me close to 6 months using it both day and night.

Definitely recommend testing or sampling this product before splurging on the full size. I have sensitive skin, but use many intense serums and active ingredients in my skincare routine. Unfortunately the AA Barrier Serum caused major breakouts. So disappointed, I really wanted to love this serum. I absolutely love Algenist’s Advanced Retinol Serum.
Love this moisturizer. Doesn’t contain hyaluronic acid which I am allergic to. Provides great moisture for my dehydrated face.
Love this stuff. Contains retinol which is why I purchased it but it’s also gentle on my skin. I didn’t break out at all and I noticed smoother skin almost immediately.

I was super excited to get a mini trial size since I have been looking for an alternative to my Lancôme Genifique which I like for my skin barrier. I definitely recommend trying a sample of this if you are sensitive to smell. Cons: The smell was overwhelming, almost smelled like glue. Usually I am not the sensitive to smells but this was too much. Pro: I like how the serum dried fast, it made my skin soft, and it work well with other products. I took one star due to the smell, I just couldn’t get over it.

I used it for the first time today ( it was a gift with purchase ) . I used it as directed and it gave me soft skin after rinsing it off. I’m glad that Algenist created this mask! The color changes from green to white. It rinses off very well with running water and keeps the skin flora equilibrated ( there are 8 different strains of skin loving bacteria that live on our skin FYI, I learned about these bacteria when I was a pharmacy student a while back but I forgot their names ). I will buy the full size when I finish my GWP! I store it in the refrigerator because of the probiotics it contains and to maintain its freshness.
I have dry skin and rosacea and it’s extremely sensitive. Everything makes me break out. However this product has definitely calmed my skin down! Will continue to buy!
Meh. Just okay. I don’t love the scent, and haven’t really noticed a difference in my skin’s appearance.

I’ve been using Algenist Complete Eye Renewal Balm for the past three years, which I really liked. However, with the appearance of more fine lines and what looks to be the first sign of crow’s feet, I decided to upgrade to the Genius eye cream. The result was, however, a little disappointing.
First of all, I didn’t notice any significant improvement (unlike when I first started with the Complete Eye Renewal balm) within the first 2 weeks of use. Secondly, this eye cream comes in a weird texture that’s between a cream and a gel. It’s really hard to break down. I don’t know why this is the case.
I’ll stick with the Complete Eye renewal cream for the future...
I got the sample. It is absorbed very well if you put moisturizer afterwards. The smell is so bad, it’s not pleasant. I give three stars for the horrible smell and its price that is very high.
This is the only product that has helped with my rosacea flare up this year.
Amazing under eye serum -  a little goes a long way!

I picked this serum as a free sample with my order. It smells terrible, like acetone, I don’t know what’s in it but it gave me a headache. Also it feels sticky even after drying. Burns my sensitive acne-prone skin. I would never use buy or use this.
I really think this is helping my skin stay as wrinkle free as possible. I use it with Algenist cream sir up.

I got this product as a 10-day sample. It helped with my smile lines, but it didn’t do anything for the really deep lines on my forehead and the worry line between my eyebrows.Despite all of this, I totally fell in love with this moisturizer! No overpowering smell, absorbs quickly, and the consistency of the moisturizer wasn’t super thick. Best of all, though, was the way it made my face feel incredibly moisturized all day. I’m totally in love with it! However, I will not be purchasing it because I don’t make enough money to justify spending $100 on facial moisturizer.

The beauty advisor at Sephora used this on me during a mini facial and I just had to get it. This product contains pre and probiotics to balance your skin. It has a clay like consistency, spreads on green, and as you are smoothing it on your skin, the color changes to a peachy pink which activates the products’ magic. I have this as part of a multi-mask in areas that need TLC, so I use it on my forehead, cheeks and chin which are areas that show signs of hyperpigmentation, mild acne, and dryness. Although I did not sense a glow after using this product, my skin did indeed feel smooth, soft and tingling clean. Just don’t forget to follow up with a moisturizer.

i got this just as something fun/spa-like to do in the evening while visiting in-laws (fun color change, looks silly, good for all skin types). worked great for this purpose, then totally forgot about it (i have a pretty intense/well-researched skin care regimen already, and never thought of a clay mask as something i particularly needed-- skin’s already pretty dry.)fast-forward a few months, i just found it at the bottom of a drawer and added it in last night for fun. wake up this morning, and a dozen or so EXTREMELY STUBBORN tiny little white heads that i’ve been trying to get rid of for months are almost totally gone! (several months of good BHAs hadn’t helped at all.) anyway, it may be that (m)any clay products would have had this effect, i have no idea. but whether to clay general or algenist in particular, i’m so grateful! i’ve used some good stuff over the years, but i’ve never had a skin problem literally solved overnight. wish i’d snapped a before pic!

I have finally found a product that has vitamin C, is good for your skin and works! I have dark spots and could not find a product that would deliver results. This product will give you immediate results. It is easy to use and feels so soothing on my skin. After just one week, I saw even skin tone, my dark spots are fading and I am getting compliments on my skin. I have been following a skincare routine for a while and have never received so many compliments. I am so happy to find a product like this!
This cream is very moisturizing however did nothing for the redness on my face. I was really excited to use and pretty disappointed that my skin looks pretty much the same.

Finally an eye serum I can use twice a day. It goes on wonderfully and perfect under night cream, moisturizer, and concealer. Doesn’t irritate my eyes. One pump is plenty for both eyes. After using it for the past month I’m definitely noticing a difference in the skin around my eyes and my fine lines are less noticeable.

After reading the other reviewers experience with swollen eyes, I have to validate the same experience. I used this product along with the prebiotic face mask on and off for a few weeks. During that time, there were mornings where I looked 20 years older and my eyes were so swollen that I could not leave the house. I suspected it was the sunscreen and discontinued. Never again did I have that severity of an issue.

All hype no delivery.. Was so excited to try this eye cream I am a 45 year old female.. I do not have sensitive skin. I applied just a Tadd to under my eye area and I begin to swell, burn, itch. I had to wash it off my eyes.. I purchase I cream that I love that I use faithfully every day this one for $76 you heard it here do not waste your money it’s all hype!!!!

First, why isn’t anyone talking about the finish?  This serum does what it claims, AND leaves an amazing soft, smooth, matte finish. I’m convinced it makes my skin look less red when I apply it. I used to use it only at night, now I use it during the day and it works just as wonderfully!  Oh, I almost missed the point of the review. I’m in my 40’s, obsessed with skin care and makeup, and I’ve been using this serum consistently for years (the old formula before this one). No one believes I’m in my 40’s and this is a big part of the reason!Finally, the only difference I found between this new and the old formulation is a little bit of fine glitter. I’m still a long time devotee!
I recently received a sample of this product with another purchase. It was so smooth and moisturizing that I will definitely be putting on my wish list!
It is amazing when a product actually delivers. I saw reduced fine lines and even moisture. Awesome.
Even better than the original, love that this one is vegan! Best product for oily skin and acne / anti-aging all in one. I use it everyday.

I received this product at the perfect time when my skin was acting up with red/textured spots all over which isn’t typical for me. This product has a thick texture but really sinks into skin so it doesn’t feel heavy at all. It completely eliminated the texture from the red spots and although they didn’t completely disappear, after two weeks they’re significantly less noticeable. Excited to see the continued results from this with more use!
Like it so far.  Have only had it for a month so we’ll have to wait

I’m 49, concerned about fine lines & wrinkles. I’m a product junky & have tried it all from expensive to cheap, to Botox, fillers, various facials. THIS is a fantastic product! Love the texture & feel. Worth the money! I would buy it again

I’ve always loved Algenist but this moisturizer is absolutely amazing! It melts into my skin, drinks it up like water! So silky smooth and after ten days of using it I can’t believe the results, less dark spots, less wrinkles and a beautiful glow. My skin is dry but not anymore. I would actually pay three times the price. I will never be without this. Love ya Algenist and Sephora

So happy!! I have rosacea, went to Sephora the other day and the lady recommended this for me to use and gave me a sample of the cream to use with this. I’ve used three times so far and let me tell you, I haven’t seen my skin tone look so even and redness was gone until I used this product! I love it, going back for the full size of the cream too to use along with it :)
Great serum for sensitive skin.  Noticeable difference.  I use it with moisturizer and really love the effect.

I’ve used this for about a month and didn’t notice any positive results.  Instead, I began seeing lines underneath my eyes that I haven’t seen before.  Also, the product does not absorb well at all.  By the morning, I can actually brush off some of the product off like eraser bits.
This has a weird texture that is not absorbed into the eye area easily. Kind of a clumpy gel cream. Will not purchase again

I use this with their renewal balm and my fine lines are gone. To be honest I wasn’t sure at first if it was the eye cream, but after a few months of use I know this works. I am in airplanes all the time and between the dryness and lack of any kind of sleep routine it can take its toll, but this wiped away all those little lines and restored some moisture.

I received a trial size on my last order and love it. This is a rich, creamy formula, texture almost like a butter. Between flu season, the cold outside and dry heat inside, I’ve been using this on the dry patches around my nose and under my lower lip and have noticed a difference. Irritation vanishes, skin stays hydrated, less redness and my sensitive skin has not reacted negatively. I used this product as the video suggested - more as a spot treatment rather than overall cream, and it is perfect.

I’ve been using this as s neck cream for a week or so and I am LOVING it. After patting my essence into my neck, I follow with the Estée Lauder night repair serum and top it off with this neck cream. The results are wonderful. I’m only 24 with no obvious issues with my neck or décolleté so I didn’t think I really needed a neck cream until I started using it. I can now say that my neck looks firm, there’s been a slight improvement in my wrinkles (who knew I had neck wrinkles?! I didn’t until they started to soften lol) and my skin feels and looks smoother. I’m hooked. It’s spendy, but I’m positive it’s worth it.
Best moisturizer and I’ve tried a lot. My skin is super dry. This keeps me hydrated. I’ve notice after two months my fine lines have diminished.

I’ve been using this 2x - week for 3 weeks now and I love it. Almost every dark spot that I had (and there were a lot) when I purchased this product have gone away. The really deep ones that reoccur in the same spots though, haveOnly faded slightly. If you get frequent acne, like daily, but they aren’t super deep then I 100% recommend. Take it from someone who has horrible acne, but not cystic and scars that take forever to go away without treatment. (Also for me, it’s the only mask that hasn’t dried my skin out). And I see some complaints about the pump, if you spread with a face roller you’ll only need 1 pump but I like to do 2.

Liked the idea of combining skincare steps in one product however it was a bit disappointing. Leaves a white cast  slightly stings eyes  and would like a higher spf. Its a little too greasy for someone with combo to oily skin.

This stuff is the bomb. I have very dry aging skin. This is the perfect addition to my skincare routine, especially in the winter. I put it on before my moisturize and voila! My face feels more supple and less like a mask. It’s really good stuff.

I got a tester of it, and let me tell you it was the best peeling mask. It is so gentle on the skin and doesn’t cause irritation, redness, or dryness if you use other strong products like BHAs, PHAs, or retinol. I personally enjoyed the scent and found that it was very cooling. Looking forward to purchase the full size.

I needed a product for my irritated, dry, flaky skin for winter months and bought this product about a month ago. It has done wonders for my skin which is glowing and no longer irritated. The redness and flaking is gone. A holy grail product that I will repurchase

excellent product and excellent under makeup and you dont get the watery eyes like some eye creams give u. worth the money in my opinion and i tried tons and tons of eye creams even more pricey than this one and they dont work like this one does.

I love this eye cream. It lifts and illuminates are eyes beautifully. I enjoy doing little experiments like using one eye cream on my right eye and another on my left. Algenist’s elevate has out performed other Algenist eye creams without fail. I also prefer it over Tatcha and Eminence (spa brand in same price range).  This is one product I’ll keep using. At least until I find something that outperforms it.
Always searching for a eye serum for aging skin, tried 3Lab and a lot of expensive brands, so far this one get the job done and price is reasonable.

I have acne prone skin, so even the area under/around my eyes can develop tiny bumps with the wrong eye cream. This one was gentle and effective at moisturizing and doing great under my makeup (no cakey effect), but I have to admit I don’t see any improvement in the fine laugh lines I have. For the price of the eye cream, you’d hope it would do a better job at “plumping“ those lines out than it does. That’s why I’m giving it 3 stars. Even though I bought it specifically because it did 2 things that I needed that all other eye creams I tried couldn’t deliver on, its overall value isn’t that great because it doesn’t do what I would say it a major claim of the product (anti-aging). So for those of you looking for a true anti-aging eye cream, I’d probably find a cheaper alternative.
I never thought at 44 the crows feet could actually disappear but they have! Absorbs in very nice.
I love this product, but like everyone else, the dispenser is AWFUL. It really needs to be redone, especially if they’re going to charge so much.

I received packet samples of this directly from the brand and recently brought them along to a tropical vacation. I didn’t pack many serums or moisturizers besides my usuals which can still mess with my skin depending on body/weather conditions, i think this was the key to not having burnt, red, dry, flaky skin.Normally from extreme sun or hot vacations, I’ll get clogged pores from all the sunscreen, then dryness and sensitivity. My skin was great on this trip! It didn’t seem so stressed. Foundation free! After 30  hours of travel and super extreme sun conditions, I used this twice a day after my serums and before my oil. I still have some samples left and I’ll be testing them out now that I’m back in cold and dry weather conditions. My skin usually gets red/flushed from health issues I think and sometimes too much acid use, so I’m excited and hopeful for this product. I’m also a fan of the liquid collagen. I’m skeptical if these collagen products ever really work, but all I know my skin is calm, and I’ve tried A LOT OF samples, green anti-redness serums, moisturizing/healing repair creams, I always needed to layer more. I’ll keep testing this one.

I have a weepy eye. The salty water really drys out that particular eye and both are dry within the aging process anyway. (I’m 57)  This cream gives all day moisture I can feel to the touch. I let it soak in as much as I can and find I can apply makeup over it’s slightly tacky feel. It’s a little grabby, if that makes sense, and the makeup doesn’t slip and slide off. I just use a light touch during application. I will buy again.

This is honestly one of the best face masks I’ve ever tried. I’ve only used it twice and I’m already seeing results. My skin looks smoother, and my skin’s texture seems more evened out. The product feels very smooth on the skin, and the best part is that it changes color once you massage it into your skin! (from blue to pink!)  I thought that was really fun and after a couple of minutes I could tell it was going to be one of my favorite face masks.

I just used the sample and I would hands down drop $70 on this. Wow. Best eye cream Ive ever used in my life. A little goes a long way, so this bottle will last you a looong time. The formula is so light and gentle. The skin around my eyes has never felt so soft. My dark circles just EVAPORATED, yall.  My bags are GONE. WHERE did my wrinkles go?I am only in my 20s so it just got rid of some fine lines. But wow, just wow. Its going to do something for you.

Love love love this product. Received a few samples and used all of them and have repurchased them mini multiple times!! Love putting this under eyes, forehead and t-zone, this product has made my under eye bags nonexistent! Thank me later!

This product is truly amazing. I got two samples from previous Sephora orders and then bought the product. I have oily to combination skin. When I first used the sample packet, I had several hormonal/ stress cystic acne spots along my lower jawline on both sides.  There were two bigger, more painful bumps on my right side.  I did my normal skin care routine and used the genius collagen calming relief instead of my regular nighttime cream.  When I woke up, my acne was noticeably less red and the bumps were smaller. My skin felt softer and more smooth. I was super impressed. I used my second sample the next night, only using half the packet (a lot of product in the packet and a little goes along way), had the same results again. The acne was again less painful and red then when I had gone to bed. I do have some cheek redness that didn’t appear to be reduced by the cream at that time or in uses since then.  However the fact that it made my painful cystic acne better overnight makes up for it.  The cream is thick while still feeling light on your finger tips. It feels very smooth when applying it to your face and you can almost feel your skin drink it in. My skin will breakout if a product is too heavy for it/ doesn’t like a product and I haven’t had any issues. A little truly goes a long way so I would use a pea sized amount for the face and neck and add more if needed.

This product is SO AMAZING!! it has completely changed my under eye area and the lid too. It is never irritating, so hydrating and firming, and makes my makeup go on so much smoother. It also has considerably helped my stubborn dark under eye circles. I can’t say enough about this product. I love it!

Love this mask. It really does seem to calm and balance the skin. I love the idea of the mask rejuvenating the skin biome. Who knows if that’s actually happening... but there are immediate results. No outbreaks after and quick use. No sitting around for 25 minutes waiting for it to dry.
The product is not very emollient at all. It has a very weird consistency and does not hydrate the eye area. Very disappointing.

I’d been experimenting with eye creams for awhile - tried Clinique and Korres without luck. This stuff is great. I’m almost 52 and the area around my eyes is visibly smoother. I want to use on upper lid but haven’t done that yet. I’m very pleased with this.

So I purchased this after having a facial at Sephora. If you haven’t done that yet, you need to! Out of all the products used, this product was the suggested buy because it’s supposed to keep you hydrated throughout the day. I highly recommend this for dry and sensitive skin
Nice quick and gentle mask. It changes colour when you rub it in. Skin feels fresh and happy and velvety after.

Made absolutely no difference for me. I decided not to return and kept using in case I will start seeing results after continuous use, but that didn’t happen.
This product is just lovely. And I am picky about my masks! I got a sample and will be buying a full size! I have combination skin.

This anti-aging eye cream has done nothing to improve anything about my eyes, and I’ve been using it for about 3 months. About the only thing I like is the texture of the cream. Extremely overpriced for a mediocre product.

This eye serum did mot work for me. The first two uses it seemed fine -no changes but no issues. The last time I used it I woke up the next morning to puffy irritated eyes. My under eyes looked worse!

This stuff is magic. I’ve been using it for 3 weeks in combination with Korres Greek Yogurt cleanser and my skin is so happy. I struggle with redness across the cheeks, combination skin, and frequent small acne clusters. I’m very pleased with this purchase.

Don’t feel anything on my face. Perhaps I’m too used to prescription retinoids? I have dry and thin skin, this one makes my skin feel damaged after using, it might be great for oily skin.

This is in a very tiny jar, but no need to worry! A little goes a LONG way. You barely need any product to cover your whole face. ALOT less than regular clay masks I use. This is a breeze to wash away. It left my face so soft afterwards too! I also like that it’s quick. Only 5 minutes!
Repurchased this about 6 times now. Only thing that helps calm the rosacea on my nose and cheeks. Highly recommend!

Received a sample of this product and could not believe my neck! In one day I saw a difference. I take good care of my skin, but, I am older and sagging occurs. Wish I could get it in a smaller portion so I could order today. Will save up and order.
I have been using this for a few weeks now and my eyes actually look worse! Glad it works for some of you but, stuff you get at drug stores are just as good
I received a sample and am in love with this product!  I have very red cheeks, nose and chin and after two days it has really help calm my skin down.

This is very fast absorbing, hydrating and brightening. It doesn’t feel sticky after applying and is not heavy under concealer. It reduces fine lines and my not-very-dark dark circles have lightened by about 50% in 2 weeks!

I have extremely dry and reactive sensitive skin, so even as I’m looking for ways to soothe it and soften the effects of aging, I’m always worried about making things worse through irritation. This smells like algae or fish but I don’t think it’s too overwhelming. I have extremely dry skin and found it to not help with that issue. I like the way this product makes my skin feel and look right after using it and the days that follow. It helps my acne clear up and brightens the overall look of my face. Glad I took the chance and bought it. Wonderful mask. It doesn’t dry down into hard clay texture, it remains fairly tacky and comfortable. WOW absolutely AMAZING! I’m 32 and my skin has been acting up.. texture, pores,fine lines. I felt like nothing I was doing was helping. I appreciate you!!!!! xoxoxo
This peel is actually pretty strong - feels more like a burn than a tingle at times!

I had a chance to buy this during a weekly wow, and I wish I bought two! My face feels really nice and plump when I use this moisturizer. The product is nice and thick but blends on my face so well. I wish I could do 3.5 because it is better than 3 but not a 4 in my opinion. I feel like it does not do enough for my skin. I also have tried a TON of masks and I feel this is kinda meh

I am so excited they came out with this product. as soon as I put it on it felt like silk. it hydrated my skin and after a few days I saw a less puffy and brighter under eye. I have extremely dry slim and it helped my conceal

I love this product for balancing my acne-prone skin and for brightening it. I let the mask absorb completely and then gently rinse it off. I notice immediate brightening to my skin. For added benefit, I use a probiotic moisturizer right after for a synergic effect with this product and get rid of any bad, acne-causing bacteria. I’ll be using this product for as long as they make it.

Hands down the most effective moisturizer I’ve ever used (in terms of visibly seeing results). I have lots of sun damage and redness, always wearing foundation to cover it up - this cream has made me love my skin without the foundation
It has helped some in reducing puffiness but I’m still looking for a better product.

I used this primarily on my mouth/nose area as apart of the 10day trial, since I get red and dry during the winter. I liked it, but think for me the Algenist genius face moisturizer and Genius collagen combination is a better morning routine and genius sleeping collagen at night. I DO like this for the sensitivity I have on the skin on my chest/collar bone area, and would use it for that definitely.

I love how innovative this product is by using plant derived Vitamin C. I wanted to try this product with hopes that it would help with some stubborn dark spots. I use this as daytime moisturizer. It really does smooth my skin. I accidentally discover that I don’t need to use primer when using this. Sometime I don’t even wear concealer when having this on. Highly highly recommend! Oh I received this as a gratis from Sephora but once it runs out, I will replenish it for sure.
This product was very effective for me. It gave me a brighter, more even complexion yet it did not dry-out or irritate my skin. I use this product once a week for a skin pick-me-up. Highly recommend!

I absolutely love what this serum does for my skin! Not only does it add a good dose of hydration, it also makes my skin look so smooth without wearing foundation or powder! It adds a healthy glow, while calming redness. The texture doesn’t fight with any moisturizer or oil that I layer on top. My skin is happy, plump and protected from pollutants.

Well, Algenist has done it again. I’m a big fan of the line in general and use many of their products on an everyday basis, including Complete Eye Renewal Balm, Genius Cream and Regenerative Anti-Aging Moisturizer. I was given a 10 day trial of the AA Barrier Serum and I was so excited to try it. I go into every new beauty product situation discerningly, even with brands I love just to try and manage expectations, so I was ready for anything. After a week and a half of using the product every morning I was extremely impressed with the noticeable difference. I don’t really care for items that don’t absolutely wow me and that can be hard given the litany of underperforming products out there, but this serum delivers. I’ve noticed some other reviewers commenting on the smell and although I wouldn’t describe it as a great smell it dissipates almost immediately and given the results I can absolutely deal with 5 seconds of a less than wonderful aroma. Definitely worth it!!!
This is probably one of the best moisturizers I’ve used, leaves my skin feeling amazing and renewed. Definitely a product that you will love and can’t stop using.

I don’t know why I broke out from this, as the serum and Genius line work great, but I did. I’m glad I got the 10-day sample promo and didn’t pay, even though Sephora’s return policy is outstanding. Too bad. Love Algenist.

Love this eye serum! I have dry skin, am in my late 40s, and have serious under eye circles. This serum is fantastic! Does it eliminate my under eye circles? I do pat a bit of my face moisturizer over top, as I need a lot of hydration, but when I forget to do that, I find this serum is pretty darn moisturizing on its own. I have sensitive skin, but I’ve had zero issues with this product. Highly recommend it!

After 3 uses of this peel I have noticed great improvement. I have very dry, sensitive and acne prone skin and this didn’t bother me at all. The scent wasn’t my favorite but it didn’t bother my skin at all. The texture is almost like honey, but was easy to apply. It helped quite a bit with my post inflammatory redness and pigmentation and overall texture. Highly recommend!

got a deluxe sample of this and was excited to try it but it burns! it burns went i put it on and made my eyes water like crazy. tried it a couple times just to make sure it was in fact this making my eyes burn/water. i gave it to my mother.

Beautiful blue color. Lovely consistency. Gives a nice cooling effect to the skin. Very aesthetically pleasing to use. The first time I used it, I saw no difference. Deflates eye bags!!! Praying the low ratings don’t get this discontinued because it’s essential to me. No other product has made my eye bags flatten. I only really put it there. LOVEEE

I wanted this to help with wrinkles and under eye darkness. It seemed to work to help puffiness. But it wore off about 1 hour later. It wasn’t hydrating enough to last the day. I’m sure if I had waited the 10 days, I may have saw a difference. Also, there was a slight burning sensation.

I never write reviews, but I’m getting ready to order my 3rd jar of this cream, and Its one of the few products I’ve repurchased.  It melts into my undereye and keeps me hydrated.  I also put it on my lids.  Love this stuff!

Love, love, love this product. I don’t say this often, but Algenist’s Power Advanced Eye serum has MADE. A. DIFFERENCE. in my eye discoloration!  It’s also helped with lines, but for me, the most significant improvement has been in the reduction of dark circles -- and I’m certainly not getting any more sleep!

Using this product since 12/2020. I have a lot of redness and super sensitive skin. This did nothing for my redness and actually gave me bumps on cheeks. I believe it’s too heavy for my skin seems to have caused congestion.

Maybe just a bad batch?
This product has become my holy grail serum. i used this for 10 days in a row and i am amazed at how even, smooth and hydrated my skin is!

I love this product~great for fighting Hyperpigmentation! You are getting those dark spots triggered by, sun let alone heat~this may be the thing for you to try. Every time I use it, it calms things down and I am not sure what it is doing but really resets your face to before that big bloom and better!

I have been using this for a 10 day trial and really do enjoy the creamy texture and soothing effect it provides. The scent is subtle. I often gravitate towards products to help with redness so will definitely be repurchasing.

I have Lupus so I have to be really careful of what I put on my skin. When my skin is really irritated I put this calming relief cream on. There must be 5,263 eye creams on the market, and I have tried probably half of them. (Little exaggeration). But seriously, this eye cream actually does what it claims to do. At 38, I take care of my skin in a preventative way, and have since my early 20’s. My efforts have paid off and my fingers are crossed they continue to.  As I age, my concerns and products I use to treat them change. After not getting the results I really wanted from my previous brand, I switched to Algenist. I can always count on their skin care, so I figured I cannot go wrong with this eye cream. I was right. I have been using this at night for 10 months now. Within two months, my skin tightened up under my eyes, and the little smile lines became less deep. Results don’t happen overnight, they take time and application. After 10 months, my eyes are bright, firm, yet soft and not tight looking. I look like 24 year old me. This cream tends to have a spongy texture, so post-moisturizer, I rub a small dollop between my ring fingers to warm it up so it spreads evenly. I sleep pretty darn good at night even if my eye cream is hard at work.

I got a deluxe sample of this last year and within two weeks of using it my hereditary eye wrinkles were MUCH less noticeable. This didn’t do anything for my dark circles but made my fine lines disappear. 

I tried switching it up to the Sheseido wrinkle eye cream because it’s a little cheaper and has such good reviews but within a month of using that one my wrinkles looked worse then ever! It’s like it actually dried out my under eye area. 

Back to this cream I go. Yes it’s a very thick consistency and you have to work a little harder to get it to sink in but you seriously need the SMALLEST amount. The other reviewers that were saying this balled up were using too much product.
I returned this. Using this left my eyes with a burning feeling. I tried using less, making sure that I wasn’t getting it in my eyes and nothing helped.

I was super nervous trying this because I read the reviews about bad experiences with sensitive skin, but this was wonderful. Cooling effect, wasn’t too drying and didn’t leave me super tight. It has done nothing for me. The sales person at the local Sephora really sold it to me but I really don’t see or feel a difference. Meh

I’m 57, with oily skin, and I’ve been using this (along with an Algenist serum) for a few months now, and I have to say my skin looks better than it has in a long time. My 27 year old daughter has also been using it, and has had people remark on how smooth and pretty her complexion looks, so I’d recommend it for younger and older skin!

I’m a two year Rouge member and I’ve never bothered to write a review until this product. I cannot praise it enough. I’ve used a great many masks in my time, of any and all variety, but nothing leaves my skin with such immediate results. This mask causes my skins texture to appear completely changed! I say appear because I know products can’t actually do that- you can’t actually shrink a pore or change your epidermis... but by the skincare gods above I swear my skin has never looked smoother, fuller, or brighter. 30 years old, always been blessed with clear skin, but this bad boy makes me feel like I’m in high school again ; )

I received this in a sample pack and was hooked the moment I used it. I am 48 and have dry skin with fine lines. I haven’t used it enough to comment on the plumping of skin and diminished fine lines, but I can say it is A GREAT moisturizer. It has a feel I can’t really describe, it just feels good on my skin and really helped with the texture and dryness. I never noticed a smell. I will say the price made me gasp, but I am going to shell out the money because I think this stuff is the bomb.
I noticed a difference within one day, the skin around the eye is noticeably firmer and brighter.  Very gentle to my sensitive skin. Best I’ve tried so far. A bit pricey, but worth it.

I’ve used this mask over the course of two weeks. I got a sample with my last purchase, and I’m so so pleased with the results! It’s gentle, and has a calming creamy clay like texture, yet it doesn’t dry down in the normal clay fashion(ie. tight and dry). The color changing aspect is a nice touch, and makes me feel like the mask is actually doing something for my skin (which it is). I’ve used the mask four times now and here is what I have noticed. Use one: smoother skin, smaller pores, less redness Use two: supple and smooth skin, diminished fine lines, less congestion in my cheeks, and no redness. Use three: baby soft skin, a subtle glow, no fine lines, no redness, lighter acne scaring, less congestion in nose and cheeks, pretty much zero pores. Use four: my face feels like a baby’s butt, my cheeks are completely clear, my nose still has blackheads but I do have extremely tiny pores so I wasn’t expecting them to completely go away, my face is brighter and looks healthy (my friend’s mom said it looked porcelain), my acne scars are almost completely faded, and the stress line I always have on my forehead is gone (unless I forget to moisturize). In summation it is a wonderful product. The texture is lovely, the scent is like a cucumber/spa product (very light), it’s excellent for sensitive skin, and does exactly what it says it is going to do. Note: my skin is the the dryer side of combination skin, I have extremely tiny pores and very elastic skin due to a collagen condition that I have (EDS), I’m 17, and I used two other new products while testing this out. One was a pH balancing cleaner, and the other was an origins overnight hydrating mask. I also rarely have breakouts, but when I do they’re near my eyebrows, cheeks, and under my mouth (though I only got one to two tiny blemishes on my left cheek while using this).

Algenist sent over a 10-day supply of their AA Barrier Serum for me to try. I honestly did not expect to see results after my first night using the serum. I woke up to smoother and supple skin. I could not stop touching my face in the middle of the night. Over the course of the 10 days I could tell my skin looked  brighter and more even. I can’t imagine what continued use would do. I’ll gladly pay more for glass. Second, AB uses safe and clean ingredients. Go ahead and download the Yuka app, pay the $8/year so you can search for products, then search for this serum. My combo rosacea-prone skin has fallen in love with the Augustinus Bader Ultimate Soothing Cream. My skin can be sensitive/finicky, and at times, I get eczema flareups. I also struggle with hormonal acne here & there (but maskne has been the main culprit the last couple yrs). The calming power of this cream is unlike any skincare product I’ve ever used. It squashed almost every issue I was having in a short amount of time.I didn’t realize how badly my skin needed a rest from a lactic acid treatment in my routine until I first applied the cream. Its consistency is very thick, and I was concerned it might be too heavy. I am thrilled that the soothing cream has been the perfect fit, as it absorbs exceptionally well & isn’t greasy!As my skin was dehydrated, and practically DRANK the moisture in, I thought a 2nd application might be needed in a few hrs. Instead, my skin stayed calmed, hydrated, and balanced.I scaled down my skincare routine majorly to see what the soothing cream was capable of. I kept my double cleanse, a lil lactic acid when maskne arose, and brightening eye cream here & there. It’s a bit mind blowing how relaxed and supple my skin feels and looks when using the soothing cream day & night. My pores seem smaller, my skin barrier is MUCH stronger, and my redness is noticeably diminished.AB products are vegan, eco-conscious, and sustainable; and the glass packaging has an effortlessly luxurious yet understated feel. Almost as if they know the science and brains behind their patented TFC8® technology speaks for itself. (As do the results.)The AB website mentions the soothing cream can be used in addition to other AB products. I’ve also tried AB’s Cleansing Gel & The Cream, and loved how supple & radiant they made my skin! Both would pair well with the soothing cream. If pairing, I’d likely mostly use the soothing cream at night, on flareups, and in cooler months. The R.O.I. for AB skincare, and in particular the soothing cream, is high.

Buy a stamping device versus a rolling device. They don’t get caught in your hair or break off hair follicules. Also make sure you are using the correct needle length for scalp, 1.5mm. I’ve really been having trouble in this regard, so I’m delighted to find a moisturizer that uses squalane instead. Now, recently I got hold of a benzoil peroxide cream that, unlike the usual stuff you get over the counter, was twice the concentrate (which I did not know at the time). Bought the mini to try it out, and found it quite nice (i have dry skin). I bought it for a specific dry patch to help it and it was okay. I wouldn’t buy it again for dry winter skin but for a daily moisturizer, I quite like it. I found the smell to be a bit weirdly scented personally too.

This mist feels amazing after a good cleanse, I use it every day twice a day before my moisturizer. This along with the moisturizer, my skin feels so refreshed and hydrated. My skin has never looked or felt better and I’ve tried a number of things. I love this brand!
Less oily option compared to smashbox primer water, IMO.

I am not usually a fan of rose bcs of other disliked products but this Oil is Amazing! It is not syrupy like drunk elephant (which I also like) so my skin soaks it up even better. I love this set for travel!  3 of my all time favorite products are in this - the vitamin c rose oil, the eye cream, and the resurfacing night serum. Wow! I absolutely LOVE this product!! I tried it, it’s amazing even with my sensitive skin. I literally bought the full size bundle. Highly recommend for fabulous skin on your 40’s!!

This is cooling and soothing, I don’t feel it does much other than feel nice though. Its not heavily scented. I feel that the mist is too fine and you need to spray it too many times to feel like you have enough on your face. I used this mist after coming back from vacation and it was useful in hydrating my skin again.
My mister came defective out of the package but other than that its decent but no wow factor.

This is a fantastic set to try Biossance products. The eye cream is my holy grail, it’s thick and absorbs great into the skin. This is similar to the Tatcha ingredients in their mist, but the price is much better. I would say that the misting is not quite as fine as the Tatcha. It’s very good for setting powder on the under eyes.

My skin has been graced by these products for almost two years and has SAVED MY SKIN! I was using argan oil based products for a while... When my face started getting so dry, and started flaking, leaving red irritated spots around my inner cheeks around my nose. I made the switch and I’m so glad I did!!! The squalane oil in Biossance’s products rehydrated and helped balance and heal all of the redness, no more flaking, ALL GLOW! This set is a must have for anyone that wants to try a new skin care line, as a gift for a friend/loved one, or you just need your favorites in a smaller, travel-size!

This is my go-to winter moisturizer, am & pm. It’s hydrating enough and definitely provides that dermal repair. Suscreen from any brand wears we’ll overtop. In the summer, it’s too much! This is still part of my life this summer. Btw: I have dry skin, mild rosacea, and sensitive skin.

I really liked both of the products in this set, and I’ve repurchased multiple times! The value of this box is better than the full sizes for sure. Would give no stars if i could, the smell is horrid i had to try and not breath while trying it out. Horrendous

This has a really nice long fine mist that I wanted to love. I really cannot get past the smell of this. I have to hold my breath when I’m rubbing it in, until the smell dissipates. Disappointing as a result

I love incorporating a mist or essence into my regimen. This one is great — it’s lightly fragranced but not enough to be uncomfortable inhaling (some are overpowering and make me feel like I’m choking). This feels great and hydrating.

Really had a hard time finding the right facial mist for my skin type. Most do almost nothing while some leave me with a super wet look.This is perfect I spray my face until moist and pat it in until absorbed.10/10

This is now my normal routine. The rose oil doesn’t seem to absorb quite as well so I use it at night. The eye cream makes me look more awake even when I don’t sleep well. The moisturizer is perfect. I gift the eye cream to my friends as well.

Love these products (and this amazing brand). Finally I feel like my skin looks and feels hydrated and healthy! The texture is and tone is more even as well. Biossance for the win (as usual am I right?!)!!!
I use this after I get out of the shower and before I begin my beauty routine. Scent is nice and refreshing and it feels great on my skin. Would buy again!

This contains Squalane which is shark liver! Sharks are being slaughtered every 3 mins for things like this. There are so much more products we can use that are cruelty free and don’t contain any animals. Without these creatures our whole ocean ecosystem is ruined!

This is a great set if you are considering Biossance products -- or, if like me, you already love them and want a set of travel-size products.  I use the full size of each of these products daily (along with the dark spot serum) and have noticed a considerable improvement in my skin tone, texture, and sun spots.
It did nothing I really don’t get the excitement ., the bottle is Cute enough about it.

read the reviews and totally thought the smell people were describing could be overlooked, so i bought it anyway. it really does smell like sour milk and feet. definitely going to return it after one use i’m disgusted
The omega cream is a literal HG moisturizer and I am loving the lactic acid serum. The rose oil is nice and doesn’t seem to break me out like other oils have.

A wonderful introduction to the Biossance brand! These products have truly made a difference in my skin within a month’s time. The lactic acid exfoliator leaves your skin flawless after one overnight use! The only issue I have is that some products have a very strong smell like the moisturizer. What people say is true, it smells like a mix of cheese and olives which is weird because it’s squalane derived from sugarcane. Otherwise, I definitely recommend this for someone getting into the skincare basics!
I would curse. That’s how bad the smell is. The rose one though is very nice!! This is not a good gift.

I LOVE this little set!! Completely worth the price to try some great products. I don’t mind the smell of the moisturizer I don’t think it really smells like anything. I wish full sizes of each product were just a little bit cheaper because I feel like I can only buy one at a time, but overall, a great little set!!
absolutely in love! makes my skin glowy and hydrated.

Cannot rave enough about the Biossance lineThis set is a great starter for anyone but I’ll share my daily for those want that deeper,I’ll share my routine, note I’m 51 and have fairly combo skin living in So Cal and have been using for a few years trying different combinations.  This is now my favorite after having used the copper in am at first and switched to evening about 2 months ago  Am Oil cleanser Toner Peptid eye  Phyto Ret Probiotic gel Squalane oil  Pm Oil cleanser Marine algae eye Copper Lactic Rose oil   Once a week I use the glycolic renewal mask

Definitely a new favorite! The smell is delightful and refreshing. I’ve noticed a significant difference in my skin using Biossance in general. The toning spray has helped with the moister in my skin and i love to use to set my makeup, for a dewy look.
I love the products in this kit. I have super dry skin. And after using this I have glowing dewy skin! Love it!

this mist is the missing piece of my daily complexion arsenal i didn’t know i needed. a spritz of this over my primer slightly sheers out my bb and cc creams to blend seamlessly resulting in thinner layers of product - which make for an overall better look. i also like to use this after i set my face as it creates a glass skin “chok chok“ look that all the Kpop idols have: dewy and glowing without being an oil slick. i never want to be caught without having this product within an arm’s reach.
Love it. The scent, the glow, the finish is all lovely. For an oil it doesn’t have a greasy finish and soaks straight into the skin.
Definitely does the work, great moisturizer, no oily or random dry spots (i have combination skin) but smells weird, no pleasant, i wanna love it, but I’m weak to smells

Total game changer. I have acne scars and uneven skin tone. This totally changed my skin. Lactic acid and eye cream is amazing. Rose oil can be bit thick for oily skin people but it didn’t break me out. Moisturiser is nice for night use to have plump skin in morning. Overall loved it.

I’m not picky about face mists because I don’t feel like I’ve come across one thats made me rethink face mists altogether. The ingredients don’t seem terrible, overall I enjoy using this face mist, and I will repurchase this face mist. What I liked the most about this set is definitely the eye cream, second the omega repair cream.

Super disappointed with this oil given the price and reviews. I don’t have sensitive skin but this made me break out. It also just sits atop your skin and didn’t really do anything for me. I have a 10 dollar bottle of jojoba oil from Amazon that outperformed this product by a lot.
I love face mists in general, but don’t think this one is worth the price. Didn’t really do anything for me and the mister is only okay in my opinion.
The products are okay, honestly only used the moisturizer. The value is okay but I think they could replace the oil with another sample product.
These products BURNS! Rose oil, moisturizer- all of it. My face was red/burning/itching within 10 minutes of application and I do not have sensitive skin.
I love these products, and will most likely buy the full size once I run out, decent amount of product in the samples. definitely worth the price. The vitamin C oil is to dieee for

Nice fine mist and it absorbs into my skin easily. Not as hydrating as I’d like. most hydrating mist I’ve ever used!

I love this product so much! I was scared to try it at first because the last time I tried using Vitamin C it completely broke me out. But this didn’t! It leave my skin glowing and plump + ready for make up. I’d say this is worth it! (All Biossance’s priduct is worth it!)
This product is life changing! A must have in your skincare regimen✨

I got this as a sample but will absolutely be sticking up with a full size!

Is this set hydrating? Yes. Does it do anything else? No. To top it off, my husband said my side of the bed smelled like a towel that had been used too long- that smell of mold or mildew. This stuff has really helped me skin after coming off of tretinoin, but I am sad because the full sizes are so much more money!

I was very skeptical to try this because a few months ago I tried the 100% Sugarcane Squalene oil and it didn’t go well for me. I feel like this product is also just okay. I didn’t think it was very hydrating and didn’t repurchase.

but I do. I got this as a splurge during the VIB sale, and it’s the most moisturizing mist EVER. My skin is notably smoother after a week of consistent use. My new fav hydrating facial spray! i love the spray it gives. a very gentle mist light as air. i love the way my skin looks renewed and hydrated after i use this. i use this with and without makeup, makes my makeup look fresh when i use it and my skin just looks very supple, fresh and hydrated. spray this all the time while at work under dry air. love that its alcohol free too!

EXCELLENT. It hydrates my skin and really helps plump up my dry skin through out the day. Very good product.Great ingredients list, reasonable price.

I have wanted to try this line for months. I finally made it into the store and found this perfect “let’s try it“ pack. Was disappointed in the sizing, but loved the product! All in all, it was a good way to introduce me to a product that I will buy individually in the future.

I picked this up after seeing a you tuber…when I tell you I have been super pleased with this purchase. I love every item that comes in the set. I have purchased other products as well…I will be purchasing the full size. #winner

Those geniuses at biossance have bewildered me again. I got this on a whim because I have their plant based retinol and vitamin c and rose serum... and this stuff is just ethereal on the skin. Was shocked to see my makeup after a good spritzing.
Wonderful product! It leaves my skin hydrated and glowing with a slight pink tint to it. Love it!
Just recently bought this and I will say that the night serum had a funky smell and started to separate but overall my face felt very soft and smooth in the morning idk if I’d recommend or buy.
I shouldn’t jump to conclusions at this time, since I’ve only had.these products a few days. I think I will end up using them in addition,or alternating with my other staples, (maybe use the oil!!)

i looooooove this set it made my skin look the best it ever has. you have to try

Really brings impurities to the surface. Leaves my skin glowing. New must have. Only issue is how hard the cap was to get on and off, so I just threw that part away.
I love it! Go ahead and buy this oil! When I use it at night the next day in the morning my skin is so clear and glowing

This product absolutely works, if you use it as I describe below. The problem with any product that volumizes is that almost no one will know how to use it. Therefore, the reviews are mediocre, and then few people use it, and it eventually gets discontinued. I noticed results in about 1.5 weeks. I came here specifically to leave a review, knowing before I came that they would be awful, in hopes to educate people and thereby keep this wonderful cream in production.How to use it:You must use this or other volumizing product to *contour*. Meaning, you do not use it all over your face, but in specific areas that you want to plump. If you use it all over, you will not notice much of an effect. In fact, this could be counter productive in making you look bloated.I’m using this solely on the hollow areas under my eyes, my upper cheeks, a bit on my neck, forehead, and the back of my hands. Depending on where you have volume/fat loss, you may also use it on your temples, tops of feet, around elbows/knees. Look at younger photos of yourself to see where you have lost volume. Watch videos of doctors explaining fillers and look at before/after photos of fillers to see where to apply.I dab on a small amount it after my serums and before my facial cream. My pores are prone to clogging, but I haven’t had a problem with this. Maybe because I’m using it sparingly, and only in areas where it’s needed.Within about 1-2 weeks of use, I noticed those areas where I had used it were more filled out and looked more plump and youthful.I highly suspect this effect from this product is temporary (it’s based on peptides, which work quickly but are temporary in my experience). I have used Volufiline, which is a permanent topical that regrows your fat. It does work (again, contour with it as described above), but it does a certain amount and then no more. This Clinique cream gives me just that bit extra. I believe I look 5 years younger since starting this.
