I am 30, with VERY sensitive skin (strong sacylic acid concentrations actually burn my skin) and anti-aging has become a concern. So I figured why not add this. I’ve been using it once a day for almost a month, and I haven’t even had my normal hormonal breakout. So I am impressed. This seems to be thing thing that pushed my routine over the edge. Love it.

Really not impressed. Feels extremely greasy to the point that it’s unbearable, even when putting a very small amount on the face. Doesn’t really moisturize much for such a heavy cream, I definitely prefer the gel texture over this, as it’s WAY less greasy.

I really wanted to like this since I’m looking for a good mineral sunscreen. Sadly, this isn’t for my skin and the AM products I use (alpha arbutin, azelaic acid and moisturizer). No matter how much time I take between products, it leaves me with a white caste and lots of pilling. I tried substituting each of my products out of my routine to figure out if a specific product was the problem; the only thing that worked was putting only moisturizer on my face.

I purchased this cartridge and three others 6 months ago when they were released because I love the ideal of just a tab of serum with a great moisturizer to use twice a day and you don’t have to open up another bottle! I’m doing a review on two of these cartridges. The blue one I thought I’d have the best hope for. I have uneven skin texture and with the concentrations of alpha and lactic acids I thought wow ok. Every morning and evening I wash my skin and use the jelly moisturizer with this cartridge or the tired skin one or the brightening one and layer a cream moisturizer over it. My pores are much smaller, but my skin texture isn’t that much improved. I will say I was really and very opposed to taurine added to these cartridges, but I did purchase the tired skin/orange pump and that one I have seen noticeable results! I am half way threw all my bottles but one and I would say I would keep using theses for daily use. I would recommend for more immediate results bump up your exfoliation if you hold onto dead skin cells like I do and to help the active ingredients to sink in better and to also use spf everyday!

I recently ran out of my go-to drugstore face wash and used a travel size of this foaming face cleanser. What a find! I use this with just my hands and it leaves your face feeling hydrated, clean and glowing. I have acne-prone skin and I felt like after a few days of using this that my face was clearing up, had no additional break-outs, and had the perfect texture. I quickly ordered the full size version of this product. I typically don’t splurge that much on face wash, but after using this I couldn’t go back.
I have used so many different products for my skin, this brand is the ONLY brand that I can see results!

I was looking for something matte to mix with my cc cream for the summer when I start to get a bit of colour on my ghostly white self. There is absolutely no shimmer and dries to a matte finish so it’s perfect for all over the face to make a lighter foundation work for the summer. It’s a beautiful bronze colour, not orange at all. You definitely have to mix it with something (i.e. a liquid base) like the instructions say and you have to work fast as it sets quickly but it blends very well before it sets.

I’m so bummed! I love this product, and have seen great improvement in my skin tone/texture...but I don’t know if it is worth this new price. I bought it for about 20% less only a few weeks ago. I don’t know why they raised the price to so much more than their other serums, please go back Clinique!

I received a sample of this and I’m not a fan. It goes on smoothly but left my face shiny.(I may have used too much) I wore it to the pool and once I was in the water it stung my eyes pretty bad so I wouldn’t recommend it for exercising or swimming.

I liked the free sample and purchased a larger size. Used this serum twice a day and in about six weeks, noticed my skin actually looked and felt smoother. On my dry skin, this works better than anything I’ve tried in the last 10 years.

I’m giving it a 4 because of the price but wow! I feel like I really need a pump and a half to cover my face. I’ve been using it morning and night; my skin feels so soft and I can totally see things evening out! Will buy again!

It’s great for oily skin. Glides on easily. It’s getting 4 stars, because it isn’t quite invisible. Granted, the white cast is lighter compared to others, but still visible. It can work well under makeup, maybe even be used a primer.

I used a sample of this, and though it smells amazing and felt so good as I massaged it on my skin, after I washed it off my skin felt unpleasantly tight, like a stretched out snare drum. If you want that pore-clenching feeling, this would be a good go-to, but I would rather my skin feel smooth and satiny. Not worth the price, my combination skin was unthrilled.

I was given a sample of this product to try and review. It is great for oily or combination skin. I have combination skin and this kind of moisturizer is perfect for me. It melts into the skin and doesn’t leave an oily residue. It leaves me feeling refreshed. It brings moisture to my face all day.

The past 10 years my skincare routine hasn’t changed much. I’ve been a lifetime user of Clinique and every time I stray from the brand my skin freaks out. Wanting to switch things up, I added this to my routine and I was completely surprised. My skin completely changed for the better. The texture got better, evened slightly and my skin glowed! I will always use a serum from now on.

Been using this nightly since it came out. I have oily skin and I started using retinA a year ago and my skin did not tolerate it. I’ve gotten more used to it but I still get dry patches from the retinA. If you use it, then you know what I’m talking about. I’ve tried so many heavy moisturizers to help my skin recover. The problem is that my skin is naturally oily and my foundation won’t last a normal 8 hours. But my skin gets so dry throughout the night from retinA. So bc I’m oily and prone to breakouts I really don’t get along with moisturizers. But this one is so rich and thick, it really feels like it’s sinking in and protecting my skin, yet does NOT break me out. It’s crazy it can do both. So hard to find. I use it all over my face and then apply retinA on top. I use this as a barrier and nightly moisturizer. Sometimes I try others and keep coming back to this, especially for the cold half of the year in PNW. This has been a life saver and I hope they never discontinue it. It doesn’t contain alcohol and the fragrance isn’t very notable. Nothing irritates my skin. Even when my skin is dry and raw from retinA this stuff still doesn’t even burn or irritate. That’s how I know it’s great. Very hard to find a soothing and hydrating moisturizer like this. I think just about anyone could use this at night. I feel like it’s a bit too heavy for daytime use, unless ur skin is super dry maybe.

@clinique #moisture surge    I tried this as a trial from Influenster.   It made my skin feel refreshed and glowing.  I also used it for my dry elbows. In a day, they felt great!    I would definitely buy this product .

This glides on like silk and in two weeks nearly every blemish is now gone. I think I am in love.I am a bit of a product junkie. I try one thing here and another there. Typically my skin is okay, not perfect, a handful of pimples, but not bad, so i can get away with it while I look for something I love. Two months ago my skin exploded in reaction to a new medication. Worst zits of my life; they hurt down to the bone and were angry and red. Nothing solved it. I was at my wits end. I switched medication again and while I stopped getting new breakouts, the old ones wouldn’t go away. I have been using this for a couple weeks now and almost all the breakouts are gone. I may never switch serums again.

I decided a while ago to up my skincare routine, I’m looking at 30 and wanted to start preventive measure: I have been using this product for the past 3 weeks, day and night. I wear it after I moisturize taking special attention to the areas prone to lines/creasing. My skin is so smooth, I love the spf protection, a line that I was watching is less prominent, and it doesn’t make my face feel oily after applying. Give a few minutes to absorb before putting on makeup!

This is probably one of the most disappointing products in terms of the size. It is so ridiculous how much you pay for basically a sample of some thing that needs to be used in large quantities. So disappointing. Besides that the formula isn’t too bad but you do need to rub it in a lot to remove any white cast.

In my late teens/early twenties I developed horrible cystic acne that left me with deep scars and discoloration in my cheeks. I purchased this hoping it would help with that texture and it did! After the first use my skin was so soft and pretty smooth when I woke up. After 3 weeks of use there’s virtually no redness and my texture has smoothed out significantly. I’m excited to keep using it. It has pretty much no smell and I personally love how it feels.

Got this in a set and love it! I don’t have the sonic brush but even using my fingers, it was super foamy. This cleanser really cleaned my pores and made them look smaller. Leaves a squeaky clean feeling but also leaves the skin super soft
This cream is really great - it leaves my face feeling silky smooth and have seen difference in a natural radiance within the last week. Highly recommend for all skin types (i’m combination oily)
It really makes a difference in the texture and feel of my skin. Velvety comes to mind.

I loved the old formulation of Turnaround Concentrate, but this new one just doesn’t seem to work the same for me. It sits on top of my skin and doesn’t absorb, making my face feel slick and oily. I’ve tried using it just at night to see if it absorbs better, but no luck. Sorry Clinique, not impressed with this product.

This is the time I really want them to add some fragrance into the jar. This one has a plastic smell, texture is lightweight sunscreen (not oily but a bit greasy), stays on face the whole day and cannot be washed away by just water. Cannot comment on the line smoothing effect since I haven’t used it very frequently (because of the smell).One star added because it did not get my skin condition worse, probably meaning it is doing something.

The price was quite a bit lower than the product I’ve been using, so I thought I’d give this one a shot. I’ve been using it for about 3 weeks and now beginning to see results. My pores are appearing less noticeable and my skin seems to have a “glow“ without looking oily. My foundation also seems to be lasting longer without reapplying loose powder throughout the day. I will definitely purchase again! A little goes a long way, so bottle should last for awhile.

Leave it up to Clinique to “fix“ what is not broken. The original version was actually gentle with quality ingredients. I have used it religiously for years. I guess quality has to be cut somewhere, and cheaper ingredients are used in this version. A boatload of witch hazel and whatnot. Corners are cut, but so are loyal customers.

I’m not sure if my skin has gotten drier, or if the formula has been changed so much that it just doesn’t moisturize as well as the old one. I loved the old Moisture Surge Intense, and a 75ml jar would last for several months (in upstate NY where winters are long and very cold). I feel like I’m using a lot more of the new product, but still my skin feels dry and more sensitive. Clinique - please bring back the old formula!

Bring back the old formula. I LOVED the moisture surge 72 hours. It made my skin felt hydrated right after but after they changed the formula, this one doesn’t feel as hydrated and feels filmy on my skin. Will return it
The best moisturizer if you have dry or dehydrated skin. It’s the 72 hour one!!!
Creamy, gentle for skin and nice scent. Great basic face cleanser.

I’ve tried several different cleansers with my Clarisonic the last 3 years. Three of those have been Clinique products - the mild cleanser from the 3-step system, the blue gel cleanser, and this one. I received a free full size tube of this during a promo on the Clinique website.I like Clinique products. I’ve used them on & off since my teens and have never had a problem with a product. I can’t seem to resist the occasional temptation to try something new from other lines, but I always gravitate back to Clinique. They just work and for a more reasonable price than most.All three of the cleansers I’ve used from this line, with my Clarisonic, have worked well. The big selling point for me with this particular product is that it rinses very clean and in rapid time. The other two cleansers leave a bit of a slip to the skin that I don’t like or need. The drawback is that is has a very odd smell that really hits me as I’m rinsing. It bothered me enough that it was going to be a deal breaker if it lingered or I had to use a second product to remove the smell. Thankfully, it dissipated for me in a matter of minutes.Satisfaction with this particular cleanser is going to depend on what skin type you are and whether you can tolerate a few minutes of an unpleasant smell in exchange for squeaky clean & super fast rinsing. If your skin type is very dry, you may miss the softening benefits of some of their other cleansers. I have very oily, though aging, skin and I like how clean my skin feels after using this cleanser.
I haven’t really tried this serum for lines but it works so well for my combination skin! When using this serum on a pimple it will be gone within a day or two.
I had high hopes for this product but I didn’t find it cleared up my acne prone skin as I had wished. I loved other clinique skin products but I found this product did not do much for me at all.
Love it ! my sun spots are slowly going away hoping with the next bottle they are completely gone

I am experiencing a new kind of acne - they say it comes with age. I have tried several other products (well known names) with salicylic acid. I have been using it for two weeks (a sample I received). I do think it is helping and now going to buy it.

It’s not the worst sunscreen out there, but it’s far from the best. I got this as a sample & I’ve been trying to finish it for what seems like forever. It does leave a nice finish on your skin and I appreciate that it’s tinted which is good for those of us that don’t have fair skin (+1 star for that). However, it’s really greasy & feels more like makeup. It’s also super hard to blend– I had to dab it into the skin or it would pill up and make my skin look like it was peeling. Given that you need to reapply sunscreen throughout the day I would not recommend this product as it would be too heavy. Definitely not something I want to wear under a mask.

I received this product along with the face mask and moisturizer and just recently started to use it. I have so far been using it once a day followed by theMoisturizing Gel. So far there has been no dramatic difference, although my skin feels softer. I have sensitive skin and one of the main reasons I decided to try this product is because of the Clinic brand. I have only had positive results while using Clinic products.
I received the sample version. Will be purchasing the full one.
It cleans my face and makes it super soft, love it!

I saw this new product from Clinique and thought I would give it a try. I have acne scars along my jaw line which I have been trying to get rid of but it seems to take forever with different products. Very frustrating! I also liked that it’s supposed to help fight future dark spot/Hyperpigmentation. I have been using this for a week with Dr. Sturm “Night Serum” and wow! The red in my acne scars that light in just 6 days by 50%. When I would do my foundation I would have to put several layers of concealer on my red spots and this week I hardly have to add any! I’m super impressed and can’t wait to see how they look in a month! Highly recommend!

Perfect way to sample some of Clinique’s best products. I’m dedicated to the Moisture Surge line, but this allows you to try some of the classics as well. Highly recommend if you’re considering trying a new skin care line!

Great product for darkening my foundation so I don’t have to buy new foundation when my my face gets a bit of color for the summer. It doesn’t seem like there are a lot of products like this but that’s ok since I think this works well! You don’t need to use a lot for it to be effective.

Both my husband & I started  to have acne sprouts on our foreheads at different times. I initially got it for him & it didn’t work at all! Then I got a few acne & I started using it twice a day & it didnt do anything at all! What a waste!
This product worked immediately at a reasonable price from the first night I used it the next morning my skin felt more radiant.
I can’t not live without this. My skin is smooth and stays clear. With a Clarisonic this is magic. Please never discontinue this whole line is my life!

I absolutely adore Clinique’s Turnaround Concentrate Radiance Renewer. Putting it on feels like pure silk on my skin, and using it under the Turnaround Night Moisturizer only intensifies the results. My skin instantly looked brighter and more even. I used to feel like I needed a bb cream (at the very least) every day to even out my skin tone, but now I don’t even have to wear makeup! Thank you Clinique!
BEST CLEANSER!!! This stuff is magic. It removes all my make up. Waterproof liner and mascara too!! Also I struggle with dry skin... and this stuff does NOT strip the moisture off my skin.

What an amazing product! This is definitely a holy grail product. I have tried so many expensive products that have incredible claims, but really do nothing for the skin. This is a product that everyone should try! I use half of a container each time, mixing it in my hand with a few drops of water into a paste and then put it all over my face and neck. I’ll leave it on my face for an hour or so and then wash it off with a face cloth and rinse with water. I’ll end up with extremely soft smooth, skin and it definitely looks more radiant with time. I have only been using this for about a week, but I can’t wait to see the results over a month period and I will definitely buy again! It’s helped with dry skin, uneven skin tone and acne scarring! Love Love love this product!! Definitely worth what it costs!

This is slightly less thick and creamy than the previous formula, which is mostly good since it doesn’t feel heavy. Just as moisturizing. Helps with a good moisture barrier when I do wear makeup and doesnt make my skin too greasy.
A Sephora worker suggested this product to me. It did not make any difference. Like I did not use the product at all. Not satisfied...

I was disappointed in this product. I got the moisturizing base with anti texture serum and it’s so light weight it doesn’t moisturize well at all. The two formulas don’t blend well together and sit on top of the skin for a long time which makes it annoying as a first step under makeup. Also it has a tendency to break me out. Love the concept but ultimately not worth it.
Great for those of us with dry skin, specially during the winter months.  However, I’m taking off 1 star for being such a low SPF.  Wish product was a higher SPF than 15.

This product really does exfoliate and leave a brighter complexion after even the first couple of days! It doesn’t overly dry the skin. I love the way my skin looks and feels after a dose. Only reason I give it a 4 star is because of the packaging can get annoying.
This stuff did absolutely nothing to improve my dark spots. No bueno.

Purchased a full size of this 2 months ago and have been using it 2 times a day as directed. I noticed a difference in the texture of my skin after the first few days. Two months later and I have a more even skin tone and texture with just a few acne scars still persisting.  It makes my skin SO soft and doesn’t have any scent to it. Staple in my skin care now!
I bought this after buying the scrub brush (recommended by my dermatologist). It is a very clean feel & definitely gets off all of the makeup. But, I do not see how it helps with pimples.

Great product for acne prone skin. I received the sample size and I’m in love. My skin has improved tremendously. It’s effective, didn’t dry out my skin and left it soft. I will definitely be purchasing it in the future.

Purchased and forgot I had these. Started using them this week and I have to say, wow!! My skin is looking brighter already. I have some hyper-pigmentation on my forehead and a couple of darker spots, and it seems to be lessening them already. Very easy to use, like that it’s pre-portioned out so you don’t run the risk of using too much product. I previously used the fresh squeeze serum they have and was like, meh, it’s ok. But I’m thinking about purchasing and using it while I’m using the wash to enhance the results! If it keeps working, I will repurchase.

Then enter clinique acne solutions acne & line correcting serum. This absorbs so incredibly well. 2-3 drops go a long way. I apply it directly to my face. After having used it along with me routine skin care over 6+ months, my skin has been clearer than ever!!!! Can’t live without it. Clinique best not discontinue this product. I’ll go CRAY.
My skin is really oily!!! Keeps my acne away but leaves me hydrated! Love! On my second bottle.

I got this product as a sample and omg it’s amazing!! I be always loved Clinique for skin care so this is perfect! The sunscreen is very blendable and has a slight tint! Pair it under Huda’s wishful jelly moisturizer and thank me later!!
i like this serum. It lays nice under a moisturizer however don’t expect anything life changing.
Had to grab it! Great value and it has been a long term favorite. It is gentle and non-irritating to the eyes.
Been using this on my cheek sunspots and haven’t seen a difference while the bottle is almost gone

This product is great to be used with a sonic cleaner, a la clairisonic or clinique cleaning brush. The smell is great and it foams wonderfully?I don’t know why the previous people reviewed it so terribly. I have v oily skin, so maybe that’s why this works so well for me.

My mother purchased it and she was amazed with this cream. She wanted me to tried it and I did. I used my face roller after I applied it and I liked it very much. I don’t know if it worked any miracles for my skin but it did exactly what it advertises and I would purchase it again.

I recently starting using Clinique skincare products after a friend suggested I give them a try. This was the first product I tried and I’m addicted to it - it makes my skin so soft and so bright. I started using it over the summer and have received tons of compliments on my skin since.

I have tried a couple serums to improve radiance and skin tone. This is so far the only one that has produced noticeable results for my face!I just finished a bottle of Caudalie Vinoperfect Radiance serum which is very highly rated and recommended by Sephora employees. This is terrible. Why replace a perfect product? Please bring back the City Block Sheer SPF 25!

I didn’t think I’d like it so much..but after using it for half a month, I think I will repurchase it. It’s a silicone based serum that supposed to exfoliate to make your skin glow. I love this product. I just started using it last month and am already seeing a difference in my skin tone. I like that it is not scented and doesn’t cause me outbreaks with my sensitive skin. I use it am and pm . the pump is cool with the two sides and product color. I highly recommend it.

I’m entirely confused by the reviews claiming this cream is heavily scented. I’m super sensitive to smells and this to me definitely does not qualify as overly-fragrant by any means. i wanted to love this soo much but it broke me out even more... i am acne prone and i have sensitive skin

This is the best! With lots of hydrating and drinking water all day, my daily routine is: Fresh Soy Cleanser for makeup remover and then the Clinique Cleansing Gel to fight off blackheads and blemishes, then finish it off with vitamin E oil all over- my face has never looked this good!! I used to buy several of this product from Clinique official website. I’ve used it for more than 2 years and I know what it should be like. Been using this product for four weeks and it is fading my 3 dark marks from pimples that I popped and they darkened. Every week it looks better. By the time i finish the bottle the dark marks will be gone! I am black and it works on dark skin.

The best face sunscreen there is. Got a bad face sunburn in Australia that has made very sensitive to all face sunscreen but this one. Can wear easily under make up and no greasy residue. It’s staple for me.

I habe dry sensitive skin and got this after an esthetician recommended it. It makes for a great final step after cleansing at the end of the day and I also use it on lazy mornings instead of washing my face.

I really love it, it does become transparent on the skin and does not leave a white cast, I mix it with my moisturizer and its glides on perfectly and soaks in nicely! Plus its rated a 2 on the EGW app and its a mineral sunscreen which is amazing for your skin! Will repurchase.

I got a sample of this and had to purchase the full size. This really works and is much less expensive than comparable products. I started adding the retinol drops last month and I’m pleased with the results!

I used this product for years. I have often been complimented on my complexion- took it on faith that clinique was performing as promised. However, I no longer perceive the same effects. I decided to try this since it got such great reviews, but it did not work out for me. It made my skin really dry and flaky. I’m not sure if it’s supposed to do that, but needless to say, I took it back. I will stick to my Clinique repairwear serum instead.
this is the first mineral sunscreen that I (tan indian woman) has ever loved!!!! this goes on clear, is so dewy and hydrating. I looooove this. thank you for making it tan skin friendly.

I have used Turnaround Concentrate for a long time. I think this is one of the best things Clinque makes. I use this every night before I go to bed. I think it is a great product.
I LOVE this cleanser. It is the only acne cleanser I’ve ever used that doesn’t dry out my skin. I’ve been using this for about 3 months now and my face has never looked better.
I love this stuff. I needed a good sunscreen to wear under my makeup and this is it. It’s thin and non-greasy.

I’m very disappointed by this product. I started using it before I got a pimple that had left me with some hyperpigmentation... I want to like Clinique products - unfortunately every single product I have ever used from them I either see no results or my skin negatively reacts. If you want to save our oceans, don’t buy this product or ANY product that contains squalene. If it is plant-based squalene it is okay. But if they do not specify it, it is most likely from sharks. Extracting squalene from sharks is very violent and even illegal in some countries and states. If you buy products that contain squalene, you are contributing to the shark fin trade and shark cruelty. There are 100 million sharks killed each year, and if we keep using products like this, there won’t be many sharks left to kill. Furthermore, do you want to rub shark liver oil on your face??? Just a helpful note for anyone confused about this moisturizer containing squalANE and being touted as an oil-free moisturizer. SqualANE is actually technically a hydrocarbon solution derived by hydrogenation of squalENE, which is typically sourced from olives or sugar cane these days. We refer to it as an oil because it is oil-like/oil-behaving. It is a derivative of squalene, which naturally occurs in our own sebum, and diminishes with the aging process. SqualANE is extremely stable unlike squalENE, which oxides very easily. It is also much lighter than squalene.So, rest assured, this moisturizer is indeed oil-free in the true sense.

I purchased this elsewhere because it was on sale, but I figured I’d review it here because there are still no reviews. I have very fair, acne-prone, oily skin (sometimes dehydrated from Tretinoin), with mild rosacea. My skin can also be somewhat sensitive. That being said, this sunscreen doesn’t irritate my skin or break me out at all. It’s not greasy at all and doesn’t make me oily. It has a nice, light scent, no white cast, and sinks in quickly. It also has a really pretty pearlescent effect on the skin that is lovely on no makeup days (It looks nice on my fair skin, but I can’t speak to how this will look on darker skin tones). Also, the bottle is absolutely adorable. I haven’t worn this under makeup, so I can’t speak to pilling in that regard, but it hasn’t pilled overtop of my skincare. I plan on using this for days when I’m not wearing makeup so that I can get the full effect of the pearly sheen. The only things I wish were different are the price (so expensive for the amount to be used daily) and the level of spf (I wish it was more like 40-50 spf because I’m super fair skinned and on Retin-A). This definitely isn’t going to be for everyone because sunscreen, and skincare in general, is so personal. However, I’m really enjoying it and would suggest you give it a shot if you’re on the fence.

This night cream is incredible! I had a lot of closed comedones on my forehead and this cleared them up in a matter of weeks. Reading some of these reviews, it’s clear that there might be some misconceptions about this moisturizer:1. This is a retinol product! Retinol products produce turnover in the top layer of skin cells, and clear clogged pores. When those nasty things unclog from your pores, they’re pushed up through the pore and form a blemish. It’s entirely possible that when you start using this product you might experience a purge period where you break out more than you normally might. This is temporary and is just a sign that the retinol is doing it’s job. As with all retinoids, be sure to wear SPF during the day and avoid any harsh AHA/BHA’s or physical exfoliants. 2. This is a night cream so it’s much heavier than anything you might be used to with daily moisturizers. It’s incredibly thick, and a little bit of product goes a long way. Either warm it up in your hands before applying, or apply it over a serum. If you apply it straight out of the jar and onto dry skin, you’re going to use too much product trying to drag it around your face, and will end up with a sticky mess.I worked in cosmetics for several years and have tried tons of skincare. This is the best night cream I’ve found. I hardly ever re-buy once I’m done with a product, but you can bet I always get a new jar of Magic Night Moisturizer. It lasts a really long time, and the results are incredible. Paired with CT’s Magic Cream during the day, you can’t go wrong!

WARNING: This product contains squalene. Squalene is made from shark liver oil. I checked the ingredients and it doesn’t say cruelty free. Extracting squalene from sharks is very violent and even illegal in some countries and states. If you buy products that contain squalene, you are contributing to the shark fin trade and shark cruelty. This helps very minimally, and it works on water retention puffiness, not allergy puffiness or other types of inflammation. You’re going to first want to find your triggers, second sleep on elevated pillows, or a beauty pillow to reduce puffiness. Sleep is first regulate your sleeping schedule is number one, then reduce salt intake, look at diet, take diuretics on weekends, get active and move your body to drain the water. Next, start icing, ice your face and eyes and you will see a big change in the morning. Also try to do a face soak in ice cubes, cold water, and green tea leaves, then try a de puffing massage, also try do a warm compress with salt on eyes. If you still see minimal results, try RF machine once a week, or a facial tool like a roller, non Jade, the double knob silver roller that works really well. Also, take allergy pills if needed, dieuretics, once a week, zinc, and get enough pottasium, and eat less high glycemic foods. See a doctor if you think you have chronic edema or underlying conditions. If that fails, then try this. The eye serum is great. The mask is pretty expensive and didn’t last me more than three months. The eye serum doesn’t work for everyone though however it’s one of the few upper eyelid serums out there. Again as I said: - Facial massage - Icing face with ice/cold water - Find triggers and take allergy pills/vitamins - reduce salt intake and regulate sleep and get beauty pillow - Increase physical activity - See a doctor if all else fails

would consider as a nighttime moisturizer, felt like it was really absorbed by the skin. also layered with other serums

This product has been a lifesaver in the dry winter months. My skin is incredibly oily already so when a coworker recommended I give the Lotus Oil a try, I was incredibly skeptical. However, one sample and I was hooked. My skin is very prone to acne and is very sensitive, but this oil has toned down the acne-caused redness. Additionally, it also calms down any breakouts I get. It doesn’t erradicate them, but it does prevent them and calm them down a little. Overall, this oil is amazing for long-term moisturizing and skin improvement. I only wish it wouldn’t be so pricy! But only using 4 drops at night, it lasts awhile.

After years of using harsh products to deal with oiliness, large pores, breakouts, and scarring/discoloration, it was very counterintuitive for me to try an oil. But I had seen this one featured somewhere, and thought why not? I’m so glad I did! After the first use at night, I woke up with all of the above issues much more under control. With continued use, I feel like I have different skin! Tone has completely evened out, oiliness is balanced (my skin glows, no longer shines - trust me, there is a difference!). Most notably perhaps, my pores have disappeared. This is a claim I never expect to come true, but I was shocked that after the first few days of use, they had vanished, and left behind firmer and more tightened skin. I use this mostly at night (though it’s fine to use in the day - it’s that versatile) over an exfoliating toner. Unlike the popular “dry“ oils, I feel this absorbs completely info your skin and does not just sit on its surface, making it slick.

My favourite lip oil - I loooove the applicator brush, it’s so cushiony! I have smelled samples of all of the other ones (except pitaya) and didn’t think they had a nice fragrance. The raspberry is really great in my opinion!

I’ve tried absolutely every moisturizer and oil that Sephora offers and nothing makes my face feel and look the way this oil does! I am combination skin, oily tzone, acne prone, and always in the sun daily! However, my face looks really good, clear and glowing since using this oil. Give it a try!

I really like this face oil although the scent is pretty strong. I’ve only tried one other face oil before this one, and kind of feel like Blue Orchid doesn’t quite compare. This might also be because it is slowly working its magic and I need to give it more time. I’ve had this oil for about a month now and do feel like my skin feels more “healthy“ and glowy! I would still recommend it because this oil doesn’t make you FEEL oily. If you’ve tried thicker oils, you’ll know what I mean!

Absolutely love this oil, it does exactly what it’s supposed to do. I use it every night over my moisturizer. I highly recommend this to anyone who is dry or combo skin leaning dry. As a licensed esthetician, I would have to say this is by far one of my favorite and most effective facial oils. It does have an earthy smell, I personally don’t mind it.

I first used the Lotus oil in 2014 or so, however, during a move it unfortunately broke (blame my careless ex-bf then) and I was also broke and never bought a new one to replace it.  Fast-forward to me being financially stable and remembering how much of a gem this Clarins item was... I FINALLY re-ordered again.  Haha.  The scent isn’t exactly as I remembered, but definitely not bothersome.  I will continue to use with hope my glow from this product will return xo

This oil sat on top of my skin - it never absorbed into my skin. I used it in So. Cal when the weather was very low humidity hoping it would keep my skin moisturized. All I got from it was a lot of bumps and breakouts. Do NOT use this product if you have sensitive skin. I’m still trying to clear up my skin. Smells strange too... Greasy...

As recommended by a Sephora beauty consultant, I pat this oil on my cheeks and around the orbital area AFTER applying all products and makeup and then lay a tissue over application to absorb excess. What I have is the “glow“ so often advertised by other products, but have never achieved. The real test...after a full day of teaching 8th graders, I don’t look exhausted! Still glowing!!

took my skin a week to get used todidn’t cause bad breakouts. actually did the opposite- calmed my skin, helped bring moisture back into my face.the smell was pretty strong when I first used it, I honestly wasn’t sure if I could get over it..  it is an “orchid“ smell, it doesn’t smell bad!! but Im so happy I got usedto it! I have a super strong sense of smell! Its so worth the $ less is more. its lasted me so long, would no doubt and will repurchase highly recommend for dry sensitive skinbrings a glow
Works instantaneously and lasts all day long. I couldn’t have survived this brutal winter without it.
Got this as a sample with my Sephora reward points and was disappointed. Very thick, not very good for daily use

I have dry to combo dry skin. The typical T zone is oily. I use Tarte Pure Maracuja Oil all over my face and throat and it works great but thought I would give this a try. My nose is the worst offender for being oily.My eyes are sensitive to strong odors. They burn and water if fragrance in facial products are over the top and I found this product was. The scent reminds me of Pledge Lemon Furniture Polish. I can use a number of products on my T-Zone without any problems whatsoever but not this one. I gave it three stars because I think there’s too much perfume for a product of this type, especially because the scent doesn’t evaporate quickly.

I have very dehydrated skin and this oil is amazing. I live in a dry climate and use it under my moisturizer day and night. My skin is also sensitive and prone to redness/rosacea. Many products really inflame it (especially scented ones) but this does not. Love it!

I wanted to try the new formula & packaging from Clarins since the old ones are my favourite (more than the Dipr). I don’t know if it’s just me, but these feel a lot lighter & not in a good way. I prefer the old ones for sure
too watery and bad pour design, I really miss the Extra-Comfort toning lotion Clarins discontinued, I liked its thicker consistency and it made my skin feel good.
It smells amazing.... it leaves my skin feeling super soft all day. Doesn’t feel clogged up like most moisturizers with spf usually do. A must!

I tried Nude, Jose Maran, Laura Mercier, etc and never bought a second bottle.  However, once I started on Clarins face oil, I was hooked. I’ve been using Clarins face oil for about ten years. First, I used Lotus when I had combination/oily skin and a few years ago I switched to Blue Orchid as my skin became drier. I’m in my early 50’s and look like I’m 40. No lie. By using a good face oil and sunscreen, you will look much younger.

I have big pores and a lot of oil, and tried Sunday Riley U.F.O. which didn’t really do much for me. This stuff, however, is a dang miracle. It’s made my skin less oily, and much more glowy. This is going to be a lifelong product for me.
I use this oil at night. It’s wonderful for sensitive skin, specially if you have some rosacea like I do.

Even though this product is quite expensive, I have to say that it has saved my face. In fact, every fall and winter, eczema comes back onto my chin. This time, my skin has never been so beautiful... eczema gone in 2 days! I will repurchase; my new favorite <3

I have very oily skin, and I mean oily.
This smelled quite good, a little strong though. This oily does not get absorbed quickly, at least on my skin, it did not.  Also, unfortunately, too heavy for me, made me broke out so bad.
I love the smell of the strawberry lip comfort oil and how it feels on my lips. It feels very moisturizing too. Will definitely buy again and buy other scents. It is very comforting for me.

I get really dry and flaky during the winter time and while on accutane, this got 10x worse. But this helped me soooo much. I would wake up with less flakiness. The smell of it I initially didn’t like but I got used to it and don’t really notice it anymore.

Love this so much. I have breakout prone, combination skin, so finding a good moisturizer with sunscreen is tough for me. This is incredible. It absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling baby soft. No breakouts, no greasy feeling. I highly recommend it! And it smells lovely, unlike a lot of other moisturizers with sunscreen.

I love this smell! A couple of drops at night adds nice moisture to my face. It doesn’t clog my pores of break me out which is a plus. I could rub this all over my body. I really love this oil. But I have oil hoarding issues.
I just adore the scent of this skin cream. Very moisturizing, but doesn’t feel greasy. One of the less expensive moisturizers too.
LOVE this product, the bottle lasts a long time and I use twice a day.   My 39 years young skin has never looked better.  Wears well under makeup too

I love this Clarins double serum! I’ve used it before and it lasted for months! My skin feels so soft and hydrated after use and my makeup goes on great.  Buying the bundle packs with samples is a great way to try other products.

I was introduced to this product a few years ago from an aesthetician at shoppers who just had time to try do a whole regimen on me (which I bought all of) and this was a game changer. Apparently my skin type is very dry and sensitive. I never knew I had such dry skin and that I should incorporate an oil such as this in my routine. My skin felt better, I received compliments on my skin and I enjoyed this part the most of my regimen...I love the smell too! Recently I took a break from using it because I found a hydrating cream that was soothing alone and being summer the oil takes a bit longer to settle in. Lately, I started noticing the finest lines starting around my eyes and thought maybe I should start using this again, and I’ve noticed improvement! Super hydrating and all natural. Love this stuff! Also it’ a fair price, and you only need like 2 tiny drops. It lasts a long time.

Picked this up after I finished my Hydrating Toning Lotion (which I LOVED). It didn’t have any reviews but Clarins has never disappointed me, so I bought it. This toner has a lovely light scent and gentle texture, a little thinner than the hydrating lotion, but thicker than a watery toner. The dispenser is nice because it makes sure you don’t use too much of the product (which I either apply with a cotton pad or with clean fingers). I use this every morning after cleansing and it’s perfect.

I wasn’t sure about putting an oil on my face, but I tried it and love it. I like to use it on my face after a shower so it soaks into my skin. Very refreshing,and my skin is soft not greasy in the morning.

I received a deluxe sample of this and tried it on the dry skin on the back of my hand. While it doesn’t feel at all greasy it LOOKS greasy and as another reviewer said appears to have a shimmery quality that isn’t noticeable just looking at the cream itself. I probably will not even attempt this on my face. I have enough of a challenge with my skin and the shine while using highlighters without making it more of a challenge with this lotion will just stick with what is working for me and use this as an arm and hand moisturizer if i can get past the very strong grandmotherly like scent of it.

This oil is perfect for winters in the Chicago area. I use it after I cleanse my face in the evening. It absorbs quickly and just a little goes a long way. Never causes a breakout and smells citrus like. I love the idea of it being 100 percent pure plant extracts. I wake up with super soft skin in the morning.

I’ve been using this product for about 1y now. I’m almost done with my 1st bottle. So, after daily use for almost 1y, I’ve seen zero results. My face is still oily - it did not seem to control any of the oiliness, independent on the season. The ONLY thing I noticed was that, during the winter, even after a full week of skiing, my skin wasn’t dry. I’d use 1-2 extra drops of this oil (total 4-5 drops) before bed and my skin would be alright in the morning.So, if you have combination/oily skin, this product will do nothing for you. But it’s glamorous.

I’m fifty years old with dry skin but still prone to breakouts. I have been using this morning and night for about a month and I am so grateful for this product. My skin is not dry anymore because of this cleanser, but it doesn’t cause acne. To me that’s a miracle! I also love using it cuz it smells lovely and the texture is luxuriously creamy when spread on facexmixed with water. I never tried the old discontinued cleanser so I can’t comment on the comparison and why some reviewers are angry about that. I just know that this cleanser is perfect for my skin and has taken away my dryness without causing breakouts.

I bought this after reading reviews about how this is some sort of miracle treatment for oily skin....unfortunately this did absolutely nothing for my oily skin. I had high hopes as other Clarins products have worked well, but this oil really only served as a fragrance oil for me. When I put it on I still needed to use a moisturizer because my skin felt very dry.When I purchased the product, the Sephora salesperson said she uses it on her cuticles to soften them, so I thought that might be a better way to use the oil, but sadly it still was not moisturizing enough. Maybe it works well for other skin types, but this did nothing for my oily skin.

I think it’s a pretty good lip oil. Is it my favorite?! No.  But, it’s not horrible. It isn’t sticky, very much an oil texture. Doesn’t last long at all. May be a good match up for those who wear lipstick and later over. I prefer the Dior Lip oil due to the lasting effect and more moisturizing.
This crème is my favorite if all one.  I have been using it for over 6 years.  I love what it does to my skin.

I am so pleasantly surprised at how well this oil works. My skin has never been terrible, but I usually have at least 2-3 pimples on my face at a time and they can get pretty noticeable. Also, my skin tone is just not cute without makeup because I usually have a lot of little red dots on my face that are like mini acne I guess. NOT AFTER THIS WEEK! Literally all my skin problems have gone away after using this oil for only a week. This review might be premature since its been such a short amount of time, but I can say with full confidence that it has never looked this good. It’s important to note that I use this with Clarins Iris toner so the combo might help a lot as well.

i received a trial size of this somewhere along the way, i used it for the first time yesterday and was surprised. first i was confused at the texture, it comes out looking like a moisturizer or cream, i wondered if i had grabbed the wrong product. I double checked it was the cleanser! The small was pleasant, floral but light i really really liked it! When i lathered it up i didn’t get any foaming, it just kind of turned into a watery paste BUT it cleaned my face really well! All of the oil from my face was gone and it left my skin feeling hydrated and clean, not stripped and uncomfortable like other cleansers I’ve tried. Also, usually new products break me out and it hasn’t so far, really enjoying this and will update if anything changes!

pretty decent oil with heavy flowery smell. i didn’t do anything on my face. i used it double of times on my hand and legs worked better. for the results i think it worth half a price and i did use most of the bottle.

I have combination skin and I hate oily stuff. This is by far the ONLY jar that I have used up and enjoyed! Smells so nice  and my face does not look oily when I wake up in the morning. Highly recommend to those who wants a good cream but don’t want to suffer from the texture.

This oil is amazing. The smell is so unique and delicious but it is how well it works, with leaving my dry skin so dewy, silky, and doesn’t break me out. Absorbs so well and feels so great. A little goes a long way.

I honestly didn’t expect to loce this product as much as I do. I thought it would be thick, sticky and would keep running out of my lip line... and it doesn’t do any of these things. It’s luxurious feeling, has a surprisingly good lasting power and fully hydrates my lip. I would constantly reapply if it weren’t for the good lasting power! Also smells amazing and is colourless on the lip.

I have a very oily skin, and this not only makes it supple soft but keeps it moisturizers and more importantly matte!!!!!!!! I used it in winter, it was great. I’m using it in summer, still great. I will never go back to anything else and will repurchase this forever.

I’ve been using this product for about 10 months now and I’m really disappointed. The original formula was so much nicer, this one does contain alcohol even though it claims to be alcohol free. It is much more of a drying formula versus the original which left my skin so soft, really disappointed they discontinued it.

Great moisturizer, part of my daily routine. Does not leave a greasy residue and I enjoy the smell. I am not sure how effective it is against fine lines but it moisturizes really well and has SPF in it, which is a plus!

One of my all time favourite lip oils. It’s extremely hydrating and glossy on the lips. It’s also very sheer in terms of colour (which I really like as I find it looks more natural), yet gives the lips a slight pinkish hue that’s absolutely stunning. It smells pleasantly sweet like fruity candy, which I really adore, however I would beware if you’re sensitive to scents or looking for something unscented, and is very thin in consistency. The texture isn’t bothersome or even that detectable when it’s on, and it looks absolutely stunning without feeling too heavy. It truly is one of my favourite products.

I really wanted to love it since it becomes viral previously, and as the advertisement, it supposes to repair the lips. I had a high expectation for this product as much as my demand. However, after putting it on my lips, it dries out within 10 minutes and leaves my lips flaky. I had to return it right away. Still, the color looks natural and that’s the only thing I love about this product. I prefer the one that just has been launched by Patricia is better and the price is comparable.

I am shocked by the price of this product. I got it as a GWP, so I didn’t know the cost. This just goes to show that sometimes the price does not reflect quality. Maybe it has to do with my skins “special“ needs, (I am a woman of color), but I found this to be underwhelming in general. My skin had little dry spots near my nose and mouth when I woke up. Basically- there are sooooo many great night creams on the market.. I suggest you pick another. And I am really surprised by the great reviews and high stars. I was totally unimpressed.
Smells great. Leaves skin feeling smooth and hydrated. Would buy again

I love this oil! I was a little hesitant at first because anytime you switch to a new product there’s a risk, and the other reviews mentioned a strong patchouli scent. I don’t hate patchouli, but I’m not in love with it, so I was unsure how I would like this oil. Honestly though, the scent is present but not overwhelming, and after the first day I found myself really liking it. It’s a relaxing smell and actually I find my fiance and friends frequently tell me now that I smell really good when I’m not wearing perfume, just the oil.It’s also really moisturizing and makes my face feel smooth and plump. I have combination skin and it hydrates both my oily and dry areas beautifully. I haven’t noticed any special glow, but it feels wonderful and I seriously only use 3 small drops on my whole face. The bottle is going to last forever (wonderful for the price) and it’s supremely hydrating now that dry winter air is already starting to mess with my skin. Overall I highly recommend it!
I received this product as a sample, the smell is a very strong perfume scent.  I cannot wait to get it off my face. I cannot speak to to the efficacy since the smell is so offensive.
my new go to lip product!! im obsessed with it! its super glossy and hydrating i keep using it instead of my lip balm when my lips are dry! and it smells sooo good
Love this oil! Works well mixed with a moisturizer to add additional hydration during the dryer months. I also love the smell, but it doesn’t linger if you are sensitive to scents.

I am 39 y.o, with combination type of skin, some signs of aging. This cream really does it’s job. I notice my skin is looking better, it’s plumped and radiant. The texture of cream is thick and rich, so you need a small amount for face and neck. Will definitely re-purchase.

This multi-tasking oil is safe even for problematic skin. I have stubborn break-outs when I’m stressed and due to hormonal fluctuations. Before this one, I have never found any one product that has so completely helped. For me, this product heals it all! During the few weeks I’ve used it, I have been completely clear--no recurring break-outs! I’m excited to see if it really is preventative over time.

Was challenged by a sales rep to try the product for 3 weeks since according to Clarins 3 weeks is what you need to change your skin with this oil. I was reassured that this was a dry oil and will not break out my skin. I stuck by this product for 3 weeks through constant breakouts every single day thinking i was ’purging’. Great that it works for other people but i will not recommend for acne-prone skin. I have combination-normal skin with hormonal acne that’s been under control.

I love this so much! It smells like raspberries and shortcake but it doesn’t have a taste at all thankfully! I use this in the daytime instead of lip balms, lip gloss and lipstick and it’s amazing. In the night I use the laneige lip mask. These two products helped my lips go from chapped and crusty to so smooth and soft!
Feels good on my skin. I like that it noticeably  has sunscreen in it. It is sometimes a bit too heavy for me so not something I feel like using everyday.

This cream is amazing! Works very well, I have an oily t-zone and combination skin but it works so amazingly well! It’s also wonderful being able to save a step since the SPF is already incorporated. Cant recommend enough!

Got a deluxe sample with an order, and I’m pleasantly surprised. The lotion goes on smooth, and is absorbed quickly. Does not look or feel oily at all. In the morning my skin looks fantastic. After only a few nights of use I’m not sure if there is a visible difference but my skin is definitely softer to the touch! I also enjoy the scent, it is a more mature fragrance (reminds me of my grandmother actually) but is definitely feminine and gentle, albeit a strong scent. Not recommended for someone with perfume allergies or skin that is sensitive to fragrance, I would assume. Otherwise I think it’s a fantastic product and there is a high possibility that I will purchase the full size
So so good. Smells nice and feels great on my lips but doesn’t last too long.

I was so excited when I received this product in the mail from Influenster to give my honest review.  I live in Florida and have been looking for a product that hydrates while leaving my skin feeling refreshed whole maintaining my natural glow, I’ve found it ! This also smells great. I’d definitely recommend.

My mom has always been a Clarins face oil fanatic, and I jumped on the bandwagon a bit reluctantly-- I couldn’t imagine why one would ever want their face slathered in oil. HOWEVER, this product saved my life going to a humongous college during the brutal winter months. I know this is really a nighttime product, but two to three drops of this in the winter mornings under my sunscreen and moisturizer made for a dream. My skin was soft, glowy, glassy, and so plump during the winter months.
It works well as a moisturizer but not not unlike some other brands I have used in the past. Not sure if it’s worth the price.

I have been using Clarins day cream for 7 years now and am obsessed with it. I have dry skin and it feels moisturized all day. It has a pleasant smell and protects me from the sun. Definitely recommend.

This is a wonderful face cream! Gentle, lovely scent (smells like peonies to me). Feels so smooth going on. Sinks in right away. I have very sensitive skin and I have never had any sort of reaction from it. My skin feels so soft after using it.  I love that it has SPF in it already which is so important and if you forget to put on some sun protection then you at least have a decent amount in this product. I am a huge Clarins fan as their products are of very high quality. This along with the Double Serum and the Cottonseed foaming cleanser are some of my favorite skin care items that I really miss when I’m out of them.

This product is AMAZING! I only used it 3 times but my skin feels tight, firm, and my wrinkles diminished. This product does what it says it would do. The price is a lot but I would repurchase this product again!

The product formula was changed from the cottonseed cleanser. Huge mistake. The original face wash was incredible. I used it for about least six years. Do not buy this to replace that formula. This new one smells weird, has a grainy texture, and just overall makes my skin feel gross.
This is the best night cream I’ve ever had! Not greasy and I really love the smell! When I wake up in the morning my face is smooth and fresh looking..Will next try the Day cream. Amazing!!!
this cream smells great and leaves my skin baby soft.  does wonders!

I got this oil in earlier this week and tried it for the first time. I like that it absorbs well and doesn’t leave your skin feeling oily. You really only need 3-5 drops of this stuff. What I’m not a big fan of, however, is the smell. I read the reviews and the pros outweighed the cons so I thought I’d try it out. To me, it really is not that pleasant. Not really something I want to smell all day. I like fragrances that are subtle and feminine and this was not that for me. 
I can see why people choose this product. It really does leave your skin soft and again, not oily (I have dry and oily spots) but I just can’t get over the smell. Sadly I’ll be looking for another face oil.

I was so excited to try this product and was really disappointed. My skin is quite sensitive as well as acne-prone and oily (t-zone). This night cream did nothing for me. The redness and irritation remained, and I think, got a bit worse. I used it for just under a month with no visible improvements. The smell is super strong and I didn’t like it. It’s also quite thick and when I woke up in the morning my face felt super greasy. It was a relief to wash it off!

Not sure if it was just my skin but, I did not see a noticeable difference in my skin. I have rather sensitive acne prone skin and I used this product consistently for a good two months and just felt my skin getting more irritated. I may try it again in the summer time but, until then I’m going to pass on it.In general though I like that it absorbed well into my skin and did not leave me greasy looking. Also, I thought the smell was a bit strange at first (kind of herb-like) but, I really came to like the scent. It also does feel nice on the skin but was not as moisturizing as I was hoping.
This oil is fab for oily skin; I have enough oil on my face to fuel a Hess truck, and this calms it down a LOT! It smells great too. SMALL issue I have is how finicky the dropper is, but that’s it.

She gives me that healthy moisturized glow without feeling shiny or oily. I hadn’t found an spf moisturizer I loved until now because they usually sit on the skin rather than nicely absorb. But I was pleasantly surprised by her. I’d even use this at night too. Kiehls ultra facial cream was my previous go to. But I think I’ll make the switch

This has made me break out even more and on top of that I can’t stand the smell. It smells so bad that I throw up! Definitely do not recommend for sensitive skin with acne prone. Lotus oil is so much better and well worth it than this one!

Super short back story- when I was in my teens, my mother worked for Clarins and of course got all kinds of stuff deeply discounted. In my 20s she no longer worked there and I realized that I could not afford all of the Clarins stuff I had been buying with her discount and had to pick and choose. Back then the Lotus Oil was the only thing I continued to buy at full price. Over a decade later, I’m still buying the Lotus Oil. I have combination acne prone skin. The Lotus Oil feels so good- heavy but in a nice way. It keeps my break outs to a minimum and makes my face feel smooth and hydrated. I love this stuff and will always re-purchase!

I first tried this several years ago as a gift with purchase and fell in love. As I have combo skin I didnt really want to use an oil but it saved my skin in the winter months. I use several drops on cleansed skin let it soak in for a few hours then do my nightime routine, serum, moisturizer etc, no greasiness all dry patches are gone within a couple of uses. My secret to soft baby skin all winter long, cheaper than LUna oil and in my opinion, better. Its been around for years for a reason people.

This oil is amazing!! I have very dry, very sensitive, allergy prone skin. It is IMPOSSIBLE for me to find a moisturizer that won’t cause a major reaction on my face. After a ton of research and trying almost everything else, I landed on this product, and I’m so mad I didn’t find it sooner!!!I have a pretty bad reaction on my face that’s taken the better part of 7 months to heal up, after a week of this oil all the bumps, lumps and texture (allergic reaction) I had were completely gone, my skin was flat and smooth, and the redness had reduced by 50%. It’s been almost 3 weeks since I started this oil and my redness is almost completely cleared!! And this product actually tightened up my pores which I honestly didn’t expect.Because my skin is VERY dry I use this morning and night, but most people should stick to nightly use as it is a heavy oil. My skin is dry enough that I can wear this under makeup without issue. Also the fragrance (lavender) is very strong, usually smells don’t bother me but this one is very potent.I HIGHLY recommend this product as a moisturizer or skin soother for those of us with very very sensitive skin!!!! I don’t know how I went so long without it!!

I have oily-combo skin, and it’s been hard finding a night cream that’s not too oily or not moisturizing enough which is usually the case with some oil-free moisturizers out there. I’m 37 years old with age spots, acne scars and a few fine lines that are beginning to show. This one has the right amount of moisture for my skin but can’t tell if the anti-aging properties are working yet. I do add a couple drops of Peter Thomas Roth retinol serum to it and sometimes a drop of Tarte Maracuja oil for added moisture if needed. I’ve been using this for about 6 weeks and will continue to as long as it doesn’t break me out. It is scented but not too heavily.
I have used a couple bottles of this and LOVED it. While I like trying new products out I also miss using this oil very much. Moisturizing and therapeutic

This is my new favourite night cream. I have been using the multi-active day for a few months now and love it - finally cracked this open and I also love it. It goes on nicely, makes my skin look great and I like the smell. I can see this being a staple for me for a long time.

I used the multi active early wrinkle correcting cream for almost 2 years before they reformulated the product into this. I am pretty disappointed, the EWCC was thick and very moisturizing for my chronically dry skin. I went to buy a new jar and found out this was what they came up with. It is lightweight and moisturizing but I find myself having to reapply multiple times a day. There is a light fragrance but doesn’t irritate my skin at all. I still really enjoy the texture of this cream I just wish it was thicker so it would last longer. Maybe once I find a night cream that is more repairing this will work better. I don’t understand the concept of the peeling cream so I was very curious when I got this product. I’ve been using it for a week, and it’s a nice cream that’s moisturizing for hot summer days without clogging my pores. I like the texture a lot and the fluffiness of this. I used this spf for about a year along with a full Dr. Sturm skincare routine. It was effective, and I learned there is a knack to applying it to avoiding the pilling noted by other reviewers: your skin needs to be really hydrated. I found that when my skin was on the drier side, sun drops were really hard to apply. The product pilled and just wouldn’t sink in. But when my skin was hydrated and supple, it sunk right in and meshed beautifully with my skincare and under makeup. On the one hand, I liked realizing how much more hydrated my skin needed to be…on the other, our skin goes through phases and we doing want something as important and routine as our daily spf to be difficult to apply. Another trick when it did pill (which is something I do for any product that won’t sink in Shaun) is to spray a facial mist over the skin and then massage everything in. Works every time! There’s that hydration factor again I guess. Lastly: be aware that the regulations surrounding skincare filters are different in the US than in Europe, and the formulation for this spf is different here in the states. Sturm products are made in Germany, and my guess is they haven’t just perfected the formula for the US version. In summary, if your skin is generally well hydrated and especially if you have a Sturm routine, I think these drops are great because they can blend so beautifully and look very dewy on the skin. But there are so many amazing spf’s these days where you may get more bang for your buck. And since getting pregnant and now breastfeeding, I can’t even use this one anymore and have switched to mineral sunscreens by Tatcha and Odacité which both perform beautifully.

This line is for the global elite. If you do not earn top 1% wages, move on. Let me explain why. I see reviews in which people state they only use the serum around areas with fine lines, or they only use a few drops, so “a little goes a long way.” The problem, and this is completely evidence based, is that Sturm has chosen dropped packaging. Which means that the product must be used within 90 days, or it will oxidize and lose potency. Please research the process of oxidation in skincare. All skincare should be in air tight containers to prevent oxidation. The best brands are. I’ve personally reached out to brands I wanted to love and challenged them on their packaging. One very popular brand blatantly lied to me and insisted that their products did not oxidize, which is just not true or possible. All chemical compounds (i.e everything) exposed to light and air will be altered and lose potency. Save your money unless you can afford to go through the entire bottle in 90 days. Go see a dermatologist and get a five dollar tretinoin prescription and use a nice moisturizer over it. I gave the product three stars. It’s a nice product. Her products are generally nice. I personally love her toner and use it every day. To the person who complained about Phenoxyethanol: it’s in almost every product on the market. It’s a germicidal preservative. If it wasn’t in products they would be even more prohibitively expensive because they wouldn’t be shelf stable and thus companies could not scale product and keep back stock. It’s a well researched ingredient and it’s safe.

I see reviews in which people state they only use the serum around areas with fine lines, or they only use a few drops, so “a little goes a long way.” The problem, and this is completely evidence based, is that Sturm has chosen dropped packaging. Which means that the product must be used within 90 days, or it will oxidize and lose potency. Please research the process of oxidation in skincare. All skincare should be in air tight containers to prevent oxidation. The best brands are. I’ve personally reached out to brands I wanted to love and challenged them on their packaging. One very popular brand blatantly lied to me and insisted that their products did not oxidize, which is just not true or possible. All chemical compounds (i.e everything) exposed to light and air will be altered and lose potency. Save your money unless you can afford to go through the entire bottle in 90 days. Go see a dermatologist and get a five dollar tretinoin prescription and use a nice moisturizer over it. I gave the product three stars. It’s a nice product. Her products are generally nice. I personally love her toner and use it every day. To the person who complained about Phenoxyethanol: it’s in almost every product on the market. It’s a germicidal preservative. If it wasn’t in products they would be even more prohibitively expensive because they wouldn’t be shelf stable and thus companies could not scale product and keep back stock. It’s a well researched ingredient and it’s safe.

Personally, I think this is probably the best serum in the market for addressing issues related to dryness.

My current favorite daytime moisturizer. I love that it doubles as a serum and moisturizer in one, but that it is light, oil-free, and non-comedogenic. I also appreciate the pump bottle and easy application.

I have been a huge fan of Dr Jart for years. There isn’t a product I’ve tried that wasn’t amazing. The patches are a LOT smaller than I expected them to be, so I was more than a little skeptical. The “microneedle“ part is about the size of an eraser head. I fully plan on trying out the other microneedle patches and hopefully love them just as much. If I had a complaint, it would be to make some larger patches for people that have a few spots close together. And for Influenster to send me that luxe foundation.

I read a lot of reviews for this product before I tried it. I was scared to try it for the longest time because I hadn’t had a lot of experience with retinol. I had used SR Luna Oil and also a moisturizer with a small amount of a retinoid in it, but that’s it. I read a lot of reviews of people saying it turned their face red and made their skin peel off and basically ruined their skin. The first time I used this I mixed half a pea size amount into their Lala Retro Whipped Cream along with 1 drop of their Marula Oil. *Always avoiding the eye area.* I did that once a week for a few weeks. I gradually worked up to using the full pea sized amount mixed with the Lala & Marula Oil. I am now going to start using it two times a week instead of just once a week. After a couple weeks of that I then plan to gradually use less and less Lala until I can put on the A-Pash by itself under the moisturizer. You might say that I’m being way too cautious and I don’t need to do it this way, but....I have had BEAUTIFUL RESULTS so far using this product. I keep asking myself why didn’t I start sooner? My skin looks so much smoother and my pores look smaller. I know they can’t actually get smaller, but they look smaller and tighter. My overall skin tone is more even. And I notice old acne scars are fading. I have had no irritation. No peeling. No breakouts. Nothing. I have normal to dry skin. The only thing I will say is that I had the tiniest bit of dryness around my nose when first starting out. I made sure to moisturize around my nose well. I pressed a couple drops of their Marula Oil around my nostrils. And the dryness went away within a few days. Other than that, I am having great results with this product. This is now one of MY FAVE PRODUCTS from Drunk Elephant. 4/5 stars because the full size is pricey. However, you only need the smallest amount for each application and if you use it once or twice a week, the tube/bottle will last you a long time so I think it’s worth it.

Most of the people here seem familiar with retinol and have made everything clear but I just want to clarify a few things and offer a few tips. 1) this is one of the best otc retinol products I’ve seen and most of the negative reviews are due to retinol itself, not this specific product. 2) don’t think that bc you don’t have sensitive skin, you can jump right into retinol np. 3) don’t let that scare you off as retinol is the best anti aging product we have to date. Just keep a few things in mind: To start, go very low and slow. The ordinary has some great products to start slowly, with small amounts, clean ingredients and great prices. Start with .2% retinol in squalene, then when you are comfortable with that, start using .5% retinol in squalene. (Studies show that this is a sufficient dosage to treat photoaging etc so no need to even go higher if you’re nervous or uncomfortable..but if you like you can then move up to 1% retinol in squalene and so on.) Now all this will certainly help and prevent the most drastic of the side effects, but make no mistake...if your retinol is working, your skin will get dry, even flaky and it will absolutely be photosensitive. To counteract these symptoms as much as you can there are a few things to remember; Obviously, use a high spf during the days and apply moisturizer before and after your retinol at first, (preferably one with HA) for additional help, try also try applying hydrocortisone and aloe. (I LOVE Loli’s blueberry and aloe moisturizer for this & for an addition pro, they’re an environmentally friendly and socially conscientious co.) Also, skip all exfoliants and acids, particularly for the first month or two, and use a very gentle cleanser. If you feel your skin is simply too sensitive or you don’t want to deal with becoming accustomed to it, but would still like some of the effects, try hpr instead, which shouldn’t irritate your skin. The ordinary’s granactive retinoid 2% in squalene is a good place to start.

While wonderful on their own or mixed with more compatible ingredients, lactic acid and Acetyl Hexapeptide 8 are NOT compatible. Due to the vast difference in pH (lactic acid acid having a pH of 3.6- 3.8, Acetyl Hexapeptide 8 having a pH of 6-7) they cancel each other out, rendering them both useless. I’m guessing any positive results are coming from other products used in a regimen (using many myself I know it can be difficult to tell what’s actually working) or is a placebo effect; the power of belief is a real thing and when you pay this much for a product, you want to believe it works. If you don’t believe me, look it up for yourself- even if you have the money to throw away, you’re much better off using a product that actually works in place of this.

I’ve owned the original Luna Mini (still going strong since 2014) and tried the full size Luna 2, and the Luna Mini 3 is the best of the bunch. The longer bristles really do make a difference, and feel so much softer than the 1 and 2 (but the drawback is that the longer bristles trap more dead skin cells and water droplets). I also prefer the mini size, because it fits the contours of the face better and I never found the anti-aging mode on the full size to be effective. I decided to upgrade from the original because over time, I felt like the original bristles weren’t flexible enough. And as my skincare routine got more advanced, the original wasn’t doing anything extra for my skin that I couldn’t achieve with actives. The Luna Mini 3 fixes those issues and complements my current skincare routine. My skin is more smooth, my makeup applies nicer, and I feel like my pores are less clogged.However, the app is awful. It has a bad user interface and frequent connectivity issues. The app is required for selecting intensity (0-12) and duration (60s-120s). There’s also a quicker Glow boost mode that is intensity 12-16 and 30 seconds long. It’s annoying if I want to change things up depending on how my skin is feeling that day, but I don’t want to bother fiddling with my phone just to be able to wash my face. Another annoyance is that the duration is a minimum of 60 seconds, but I usually like to do less. I have to hold onto the power button for ~5 seconds before it will turn off. On the original Luna, power off was instant. The reviews for the full sized Luna 3 say it’s not possible to turn off manually,..it’s probably because people are confused about how to turn it off.Pics compare the original Luna mini (teal) to the Luna 3 mini (black). The Luna 3’s bristles cover a bigger surface area, and the shape is more ergonomic.

I’m going to give it to you straight in this review as a big skincare enthusiast who wants you to buy the right products for YOU.I am a huge believer in microneedling, but with stipulations (that this device meets, more on that later). However I don’t think it is something every last person needs. Microneedling the right way is a pricey treatment, and it is for: *hyperpigmentation*. It has anti aging benefits, but so does LED (one time cost via home devices.) It’s the wrong system entirely for acne (go with benzoyl peroxide/retinoids). But for stubborn scars and/or age spots - nothing beats microneedling. Nothing.Here’s the deal with this device: they did it right. Dermarollers are an unsafe system; proper microneedling involves disposable needles.As such, this system is more pricey. Far less pricey than in-office ($20/treatment after the initial purchase), but still an investment. FaceGym also threw me a curveball with the vibration aspect. At first I went “but why?” However, as someone who has used more standard microneedling-I quickly discovered that this aspect makes for a far more enjoyable experience. I expected more pain for no more gain, but I appreciate the vibrations now that I’ve used it. It helped me get into the groove better so to speak.As for the liquid aspect. Tbh it could work better. It’s a little tricky to get it to come out evenly, and there’s always liquid left behind. This aspect could be improved, although I get the principle of widening channels within your skin for greater absorption. Nice idea, execution is 4 stars. In complete fairness, this is true with every similar device I’ve tried.Does it lead to results? Yes. Overnight, I see improved radiance - every single time. In several years of microneedling, I can personally attest to the reduction in hyperpigmentation.My tip is: use this once weekly, thoroughly treating your skin. More than that isn’t really necessary IMHO. $80 a month, and the results WILL be worth it
