It is very gentle and smooth, but I’m still not too sure how effective it really is. It is really good at removing obvious makeup/dirt/impurities from the previous night if there’s any remaining, but you don’t get that “squeaky clean“ feeling that you would get from a product like the Kiehl’s cleanser. That said, it is kind of nice that this product feels almost moisturizing, as opposed to drying, since some cleansers feel that way on the skin! It has a very subtle but nice rose scent, so it’s technically not fragrance-free, but I read in the ingredients that the fragrance is “under 1% and formulated without Acetaldehyde, Acetone, Acetonitrile, Benzalkonium chloride, BPA, EDTA, Methylene chloride, PTFE, PFOA“, so it shouldn’t be overwhelming to most people. Additionally, I have to give props to how this product is Clean at Sephora, cruelty-free, vegan, and formulated without sulfates SLS and SLES - I’m very glad how Sephora has made an effort to bring in more clean beauty products/brands - especially such a mainstream one like Glossier!All in all, a 6oz bottle of this cleanser lasted me just under a year, which is really good considering I used two pumps of this 1-2 times a day. It’s not the cheapest cleanser at $19, but I would say if you’re looking for a gentle cleanser that feels soft on the skin, I would splurge on this. Firstly, this 1oz bottle is adorable, with minimalist aesthetic packaging, a cute baby-blueish liquid in a clear glass bottle, and a tiny dropper. But don’t let the size of this product fool you - it is effective with only 3-4 drops per day, so this bottle has lasted me for over a year! In comparison, I’ve tried The Ordinary’s Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum (which is a quarter of the price), and I think that that product also works quite well for redness, blemishes, and general skin-tone care, but it leaves a kind of sticky feeling on my skin. I recently received a bottle of Equilibrium Resurfacing Retinoid Treatment complimentary from Hourglass Cosmetics in exchange for my honest review, and this has my skin looking 10 years younger.Hourglass Cosmetics’ Equilibrium Resurfacing Retinoid Treatment is a skincare product that claims to improve the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles, and uneven texture. The masks come in a jar pictured and are stacked in the hyaluronic serum. To keep the gel masks soaked, they’re pressed into the serum with a disk that sits above it. This holds a handy little of plastic tweezer for picking up the masks (I loved this detail, it was so cute/useful - pictured). The masks themself are clear gel with glitter on the inside (don’t worry the glitter isn’t free floating) and are unscented. They’re decently hydrating and I’d highly recommend if you’re looking to incorporate a relaxing little treat to your self care routine. Overall, keep in mind that they simply hydrate and aren’t chalked full of other nutrients that more expensive eye masks may include. However, if the process of using masks is something that you enjoy and feels like a treat/is relaxing - these masks are absolutely perfect. Ok wow. I love this brand so much. Obviously had to try this one out. I only left on for an hour and WOW flawless dark tan. No regrets on this purchase! ✔️

this is great for me. I’m not a self tan pro so I use this pro often on the tops of my feet. I tend to be heavy handed there.

I know this type of product sounds silly and not necessary, but let me tell you it has absolutely made my tan not only darker, even and amazing, if also makes it stay on much longer than usual and that was with another brand’s mousse used. This product does not work for me at all. I thought maybe it was because of an interaction with the rest of my skincare routine so I sprayed it on my wrist everyday for a week to try and literally nothing happened.

The best self-tanner I have ever used. It isn’t a mist as much as a spray dye to the oils in it. I wake up every morning I use it looking naturally tan. As a former Sephora cast member, I have used only one self tanner that I loved more

I love this!it’s very multi purpose! I absolutely love this product that i received as a gift! I love how the tan is a water based tan and i love the mister bottle and how easy it is to use for someone who might just learning how to fake tan!

Simple to apply (I bought the applicator mitt from the same brand) with no offensive smell, or stickiness while it sat on my skin. I found the final results looked natural, and my skin was moisturized.

I’m guessing the peptide complex would be the various oils they list, also halfway down the ingredients list. While I did receive this as a #freeproduct through #trywithtopbox, I don’t blindly write glowing reviews of products unless I truly loved them. The real disclaimer I need to include is that I’m a huge Laneige fan – everything of theirs that I have used has turned out to be amazing. It might just be that my skin is the right fit for their product line, but I have never been disappointed (the water sleeping mask, lip sleeping mask, vitamin C cream, to name my regulars). Not surprisingly, this eye cream was great for me as well. It’s very lightly fragranced - I know that some people may not like that in their skincare - but it didn’t bother me, was a very lovely scent (particularly as I was using this at bedtime), and didn’t cause any adverse reactions. The consistency is on par with their other Water Bank products – very lightweight and almost gel-like, so it absorbs very quickly, which is much appreciated during the hot and sticky summer months. It’s always difficult to say whether skincare really works – my eyes did seem less puffy in the mornings, but I think I’d need a rougher night in order to truly gauge its efficacy. Given that I always use an eye cream in the evening anyway I’d have no issue sticking with this one in the long-run. I’ve come to trust Laneige and the fact that this contains hyaluronic acid is definitely a plus – even if I can’t see immediate, overnight results, it’s still important to keep that area moisturized and taken care of, even as just preventative care. Bonus points for the very cute and aesthetically pleasing packaging. It’s silly, but this looks Instagram-worthy sitting on the vanity. Also, as with all of Laneige’s products, a small spatula is included for hygienic purposes (big fan of this approach).

Love it! I can’t stress how important spf is! It’s the best anti aging product for your skin.. I don’t like the oily feel of some other spf products but this product is not oily or dry it’s not chalky it feels so nice on the skin! It’s a product I will defiantly be restocking

I have dry and sensitive sky and have tried various sunscreens over the years but have never found one that didn’t make my skin dry or leave my skin feeling irritated. This went on smooth and absorbed quickly into my skin, feels light and smells great. A life changer for me!

This is the perfect take your makeup off water cleanser. At first I was skeptical about it I have previously used the Gariner micellar water cleanser and it didn’t do much for me and felt like I still had to rinse again just to get the remainder of my makeup off. But I went ahead and took a chance with La Mer and so glad I did I purchased the smaller size first which is $50 and I am loving it a little goes a long way and I no longer need to over rinse my face just to take off my makeup this doesn’t it all for me. The small bottle lasted me about 4 months and will definitely be repurchasing to the larger size. Pricey but worth it.

Disappointed.... after being recommended this by a friend I was not aware of the formulation change.... after I had gotten it, i went home washed my face and put it on.... it was sticky and just sat on top of my skin... so i called her and told her my experience, she then came over and tried the one i had purchased and was shocked and said it was nothing like the one she has at home, so i thought maybe i just bought a defective one....but nope.... sad... if it was the old formulation I would definitely be buying it.

I absolutely love this moisturizer...i hate that its so expensive but I do see why it is... im 50 and my skin looks like I’m 30....its because of this la mer cool cream.  my skin is combo/oily and I’m hooked ..

I love the light weight feel of this moisturizer and I like the scent too. It does have a fragrance to it so take note of that. It feels very rich and moisturizing while being light at the same time. I received it gifted by La Mer.
For the price it was a huge disappointment.   Worked like any moisturizer.   Not worth it’s price.
My holy grail moisturizer! I absolutely love this stuff, the original is a little thick feeling for me but this one makes me feel refreshed, hydrated, and calms my sensitive skin right away!
Outstanding toner. I’ve tried several toners and keep coming back to this. Hydrated my skin well. Love the smell.

I didn’t like it at first, but now I am in love! This moisturizer makes my skin hydrated, increasing the elasticity of skin. Pigmentation eventually go away. I bought this set for restocking during the Sephora Spring Sale. Great saving! You don’t need to use a lot cause it will make your skin greasy and you will need to rub it between your hands to melt/warm up the cream until it’s translucent color then press it on your face. If you rub for a while but still see it turning white, that means you take more product than you need. A little goes a long way. It is expensive but it will last you for a long time. I would say to give it a try if you can afford it.

I personally like the eye concentrate and have been using that one for a long time. Recently I’ve tried this eye balm because of the harsh dye winter air, but found it to have a similar effect with the eye concentrate. The texture is thicker, yes, but it’ll fade away right after you put it on. However it’s still a luxury eye treatment for those dry eyes. I just personally think the eye concern has a better smell and texture.
A liquidy consistency that gives you a beautiful “glass skin“ finish. It feels refreshing and non-greasy. Most importantly it deters UV rays, so it is the ultimate anti-aging product.
All you need is one drop and this thing loads up your face with moisture. It works good alone or with the la mer moisturizing cream. Great for dry skin or skin that needs repair.

Very moisturizing finish with a gentle fragrance like all La Mer products. It’s a light cream but not sticky. Tried this after trying and loving the original moisturizer. I didn’t think would make a difference but it’s really good - no white cast, no shiny residue, absorbed without leaving that powdery feeling. Love it just not the price tag

I really hate to say it, but sunscreen is disgusting if you don’t use it up within 6 months (turns a weird color, starts to smell, feels really greasy). It’s luxurious, fluid and light if it’s a new bottle. Perhaps good for dry skin, but for oily skin I personally prefer physical sun blocks rather than chemical for a myriad of reasons.

What a luxe cream! I have really been loving using this moisturizer. My skin feels so hydrated and plumped. Also it’s not greasy or oily. I love the texture and find that I keep reaching for this one.

I use the the treatment lotion daily with serums and creams this mask is a beautiful addition to give that extra surge of hydration and radiance. It is fully saturated and hugs the face perfectly, allowing all the benefits of this treatment to be absorbed.  Mask itself is soft, flexible and feels cool on your face. I do this mask once a month, (I alternate btw the lamer firming, Brightening and revitalizing mask during the week). I find this sheet mask more useful during the colder drier months when skin needs more hydration. It is pricer but on par for lamer, being it actually gives results and is way less expensive then a salon treatment i feel it’s a great purchase. Skin is left smooth, hydrated and looks more radiant.

Honestly, when I got this lotion, I used it and went “meh,” set it aside and forgot about it. As far as lotions go, it wasn’t bad but it wasn’t great either. One day, after being out in the sun sans sunscreen I came home to really dry, irritated, peeling skin. I tried several different lotions to no avail and then suddenly remembered the La Mer. Surprisingly, this lotion really calmed everything down overnight. So... if you happen to have particularly sensitive skin or if you’re unlucky enough to have an allergy aloe (and you have extra money to burn) this lotion might be up your alley.
I *love* this serum! It’s lightweight and absorbs into your skin super quickly, so it feels effective (as compared to other serums, which leave a sticky feeling or layer on your face).
I’m really surprised that this has such glowing reviews. I ordered it based on the reviews
Best micellar water available, takes all makeup, dirt and pollutants out of your skin and leaves it so clean, the big bottle is worth it you can’t go wrong with this

It feels really nice! A rich, barely scented, luxurious moisturizer for sure. It soaked into my skin quickly but the moisture didn’t leave. My skin felt incredible for hours! If you can comfortably spend the money on this, I would highly recommend! If not, that’s okay too, there’s plenty of more affordable moisturizers out there.

I have sensitive skin and rosacea and I use this cream nightly to just sooth my skin and it’s great for that. I had a reaction to a face mask one night and my rosacea flared up and started burning, I applied this several times and the reaction went down almost immediately. I’m also acne prone and the gel version has never caused me to breakout. I don’t like the prices of the La Mer products or how strong their fragrance is, but it has been a lifesaver for me many times. I’d recommend trying it or getting samples first if you can just because of the price and everyone’s skin is unique.

Beautiful texture and long lasting hydration. The texture is so creamy, it spreads easily, a little bit could go a loooong way. You don’t need a regular amount of the product to cover your entire face. It also absorbs easily and doesn’t leave a greasy finish. It also made my skin softer than usual. The scent is nice but I personally prefer products that used on mud face to have a less strong scent for my sensitive nose. Overall this is such a pleasant face cream to try!

Amazing product! I can definitely feel how my skin has much improved since starting to use this La mer moisturizer soft cream. it goes on super lightweight, feels nice on my skin - not sticky, no oily or shiny skin after applying. Just nice, super soft & moisturized skin. This has been my salvation during this winter and I do plan to keep using this cream year round. Super pleased with it!

First time trying LA MER & omg it works so good. I use it at night at wake up with the best skin. My skin is feeling and get better daily. I will be restocking soon & trying out more from this line. One pump is a dime size so it does last a long time for the price.
This is the most amazing tonic. I feel instant satisfaction every time I use it. My skin feels soft and plump. One of my favorite parts of my regimen. Will continue to repurchase!

I’m 42 with dry skin. This sunscreen is a must have for me. Doesn’t burn my eyes. Lasted all day at a windy, cold track meet. My skin was protected. This is a must have for aging skin in harsh climates.

I wish this cream wasn’t so expensive because my skin loves it. I purchased it a few months ago when a large department store had a 25% sale on beauty products.A little goes a long way and the gel texture glides on so effortlessly. My skin is combination/sensitive and acne prone, but this has not caused me to breakout. The smell is light and fresh. I highly recommend.

Without hesitation I’ll say I’m sad that I didn’t get a bigger jar to sample because I actually liked this moisturizer. The packaging was the cutest with a little bag as well so I was excited. My skin absorbed this light weight moisturizer in a heart beat so if you like water based moisturizer this would work well. I did however compare it to my cetaphil which actually tingles on my face after using my glycolic acid face wash but the La mer actually didn’t irritate my skin at all. This la mer does have a small fragrant smell but it isn’t long lasting. This didn’t sit on top of my skin but it was still moisturizing. I’d definitely recommend this

At first, I laughed at the reviews of people claiming this made their skin breakout. However, after ~45 days of use (while I loved the texture, smell, and feeling of the cream after applying) my skin quickly became more oily and I began noticing acne like I was a teenager again. In the week or so since switching this out of my routine, that acne has disappeared. I love La Mer, but this product just doesn’t work with my skin.

perfection!  The perfect packable bottle size, great dispensing AND it lasts so long!  I’ve been using a single bottle on my face daily for 5 months and it’s still not out!  The product itself is also 5 stars- absorbs quickly, a great makeup base and does not irritate my skin.

I love this cleanser.  I use it each morning in the shower with a Mia brush.  The cleanser produces a gentle foam/lather and has a clean and fresh scent.  I am now 60 and have been using it for several years.  I am so glad that Sephora started carrying this brand!

This is gifted by La Mer. This is the most hydrating moisturize I have ever tried. A little bit really does go a long way and will last a long time. It makes my skin feel very light and hydrated. I use this morning and night and it’s the perfect addition to my skin care routine.
One of my FAVORITE La Mer products!!My face becomes flooded with moisture and so hydrated & well....revitalized!I always feel like I have had 8+ hrs. of sleep after using this mask.

I am very happy with this oil, despite the steep price tag. It’s quick absorbing, used alone or in addition to a moisturizer. I use it a few drops for my face and neck morning and night. I even used it on a healing burn which helped to reduce redness and speed up healing. Just another plus. I’ve used kiehls oil previously and this one is much lighter on your skin.

This is my first time using La Mer products I am not to impressed it’s a okay moisturizer, it has a nice texture and i It give you a finishing  Matte that is good for oily skins also this moisturizer improves the appearance of the pores . But I think you can find a better option out there doing the same

I’ve tried both this and The Eye Concentrate -- and I couldn’t really tell a difference between the two apart from the texture of the cream itself. Both produce a visible improvement in fine lines and texture. Both smooth and soften and moisturize all day and feel wonderful. Both are good for calming and balancing my sensitive, oily skin. Neither did much for my dark circles.

Both jars lasted a RIDICULOUSLY long time, since you only need to use a tiny tiny bit (this helps offset the price tag!), but I got slightly more longevity out of one jar of The Eye Balm Intense (16 months vs 15 for the Concentrate; I didn’t use the silly “applicator“ for either one, just used my fingers). Otherwise, though, I really don’t think there’s a difference. Buy the Intense if you like a thick, rich-feeling cream, and the Concentrate if you like a cool, slick, gel-like cream.

Wow! All I can say! My eyes looked sooooo much better after one use! No crepeness or oily feeling. This is an amazing product. I’ve tried a few and the regenerating cream is to die for! Everything looks younger and firmer! I will be purchasing full sizes soon!

okay, it’s good. i’m not super happy with it because i got this as a sample, and usually samples are a full-size product, and they sent me two dollhouse sized tiny, tiny samples with like 2 uses inside. it’s good, but i’m mad i’m not getting enough out of it.

First of all let me just say that I have pretty oily skin so I think I’m crazy for even ordering this. The first time I tried it was during an extra oily day (it was new and I wanted to try it!) and I could probably fry an egg on my forehead. No surprise there, honestly. I used it for the second time after having a few too many drinks and my skin was pretty dry and crepey and this stuff is a miracle. I feel like it cleaned all the junk from my skin and moisturizer it just enough. The third time was a more normal day (somewhat oily but not hormonal oily) and it made my skin soft and moisturized. I didn’t add any extra moisturizer after using it. I could see how it is a holy grail for dry and combo skin, but even oily skin can benefit from this especially on those dehydrated mornings! Really like it and I reccomend anybody try it if it’s got your interest!
All I can say is WOW!!!! I’ve never used anything like this. This is truly amazing!!! It makes your skin so glowy and soft.

La mer gifted me the new moisturizing soft cream and after a few uses I can say that the product is actually very soft. Looks and feel luxurious however it’s not quite moisturizing it stays on for a minute then feels like nothing is on your skin. Depends on the amount use or the way you use it will leave a white finish. It’s a nice luxurious skincare product to add to your skincare shelf but you would be using it often than what should because it does not give a consistent moisture.

I’ve been using this for years, the only one that works for my dry and sensitive face, it’s quite expensive but last me for a year or so I also used lamer moisturizer. I recommend this product if you’re willing to pay more money

I didn’t think I would have enough product to leave a review but a little does go a long way! The price tag is $$$ but honestly after using it for two weeks, I think it might be worth it. I don’t want to run out :) this is complimentary from La Mer.

It’s so expensive but so worth it! I enjoy using this exfoliator since I have really sensitive skin. I’ve used so many different exfoliators and none of them are as good as this one. It always leaves my skin so beautiful and I have oily skin.

I like this gel lotion so much more than the cream. I had to use the cream only at night because it was so thick and greasy! It was a good night cream, but I can’t imagine people are wearing it during the day. It’s far too greasy to put makeup over it, and I usually don’t wear makeup to work, so my face just looked oily. This gel lotion is not oily at all, but it’s definitely thick enough to be super hydrating and last all day! Plus, makeup goes on nicely over it.

I got a small sample size so it’s really hard to tell if irresolute reverse aging As a moisturizer it is decent , I didn’t notice anything major than any other drugstore moisturizer wouldn’t do It’s a no for me
The most wonderful oil scrub. Makes your skin feel soft and smooth. I want to use it every day! A little goes a long way, so it does last a long time. Will definitely continue to purchase.

Do I like it?, YES. Do I love it?, No, Would I purchase this again?, NO. Would I recommend? The sample size yes.This isn’t a bad Cleanser. BUT, even for a travel/sample/small size whatever you want to call this 1oz, it’s expensive! $25 for this tiny bottle! It’s SUPER small so beware. I couldn’t get over how small the tube was, and the cleanser itself is not a miracle or holy grail cleanser, therefore I couldn’t see myself paying $95 for the larger/full size. The cleanser however, did cleanse my skin good without leaving it tight, stripped or dry. It actually left my skin smooth and feeling hydrated. The scent didn’t smell luxurious or anything but it wasn’t bad. It’s like a fresh, light, green Irish spring soap kind of smell, and I expected more from La Mer as far as that. It did have a great lather/foam to it, and a little bit goes a long way. Good enough for me not to return this, but I won’t repurchase it and can’t say I will recommend this over something else first.

After trying various toners, I was fortunate enough to give this stuff a try and wow was I ever impressed. This toner with a high-quality cotton pad takes off all the junk at the end of the day, has a clean/fresh scent, and is overall an incredible toner that is worth the price and investment. It’s a privilege to be able to afford La Mer, however I truly believe if you can afford this product and are having a hard time finding a toner you find works for you, give it a shot. On La Mer’s site, they sell a bottle that’s half the size for half the price. I recommend starting there if you aren’t sure about making the investment into the 100ml bottle.Overall, this stuff does exactly what a good toner should. Adding this to my routine made a dramatic change in how oily my skin is, helped reduce acne, and helped prep my skin for absorbing moisturizer. Couldn’t be happier as usual with La Mer. If you’re looking for new products to add to your routine, consider this, Ordinary Hyaluronic Acid, Belif Eye Cream/Moisturizer and Slip Silk Pillowcase so that your nighttime routine products don’t run off onto your pillowcase. Sephora and having a skin care routine truly changed my life. More men should invest in their skin and themselves. It’s 2021 and it’s time we stop stigmatizing men’s skincare and start promoting healthy activities such as this. Thank you La Mer, Sephora, and all the other brands that helped enhance my looks and make me more confident as a result of having good skin.

So far my skin looks supple and hydrated. Lately my skin has been looking like it needs a boost. I realized what it was needing is hydration. I have this cream a shot and it’s looking much better. I need like it was the pick em up my skin needed.

I received 3 free samples of this, so I was able to use enough of the product to comfortably comment on it. On the positive side, it does look very nice and glowing on your face, its very comfortable and not oily or greasy, it has a great consistency to it, and it spreads out easily over your whole face with about half of a dime sized amount. Unfortunately, I haven’t seen any improvement in my skin’s texture, minor wrinkles, or overall appearance whatsoever. It is nice to wear, and feels good on, but there is NOTHING about this product that anyone should be paying $200 for 0.5 oz. Plus, the instructions say to use it AT LEAST twice daily, which is sort of a big commitment for me personally, and also depletes your product twice as fast. I think this is one of those cases of a well known, luxury brand, overpricing a product because it seems reasonable for the type of product for that brand, but this is absolutely not worth $200 per 15 mL. I would probably pay $100 for it, but I definitely won’t pay $200. I’m so glad I got those samples, because I’d been eyeing it for awhile, and I’m very happy I didn’t waste my money on an only average serum. My advice is to wait until you have a $100 rouge reward, or they have one of their big discount events, if you just have to have this one. It’s way overpriced!

I received the La Mer 1oz cleanser as a sample. I am almost done. I will say a little goes a very long way. I let it sit on my face just a little before rinsing it off. I’ve enjoyed it. It does not leave my skin dry, itchy, etc. I have dry skin, it does not leave my skin tight. My skin actually feels hydrated. I like the cleanser. Im not sure if I’ll rebuy it for $95, but it’s possible I may make my boyfriend buy it :) Long story short, it’s cool but not a must have like their moisturizer and eye cream.

used it last night after receiving it. la mer does not disappoint. my skin felt baby soft after my entire routine with this product in it and although its pricy, i consider approximately $6 a good addition to a at home spa night once in a while. especially in quarantine.
this clogged my pores very badly after a week of usage, wanted to love it....but will try something else...and cheaper

This makes my pores feel so refined and they actually look much smaller. I love the way my face feels so moisturized and soft after using this. I can’t even lie, I do enjoy using this almost daily lol. I dont care about the price. This is def a staple piece

I received this as a deluxe sample and was excited because I have always  wanted to try La Mer products. I LOVE this moisturizer! It leaves my skin feeling so smooth and soft, and I have found I don’t even need to use a face primer before applying my foundation when I use this. I have acne-prone skin, and this has not caused me to break out. I use it very sparingly, because a little is all you need, and also because I’m trying to make it last as long as possible because this product does not fit into my budget!

Really good moisturizer, leaves my skin super soft and hydrated. I feel like my skin loves this formula. I’ve been using it for two weeks and haven’t noticed much change in fine lines but I have to give it more time. For the price tag I’m not sure it’s worth it, but nonetheless it’s a good product if you want to splurge.

One of the best cleanser. Light green color and smells really fresh. Highly recommended if you have the money to spent. An alternative of this cleaner would be Omorovizca cleanser (slightly cheaper). My face is not dry after wash and feels really clean after washing.

La Mer’s moisturizing soft cream feels so luxurious on my skin. It is very light-weight and applies nicely. Keep in mind, a little definitely goes a long way! I love using this after completing my skincare routine during the day and at night. My skin immediately feels more hydrated and plump. I absolutely love this cream and cannot recommend it enough!

I love this gloss, a 5-star product but lost a star because of the price! I love this gloss, which to me, has been a gloss but turns into a liquid lip balm. I feel like it does some good to your lips! Even after the gloss has faded, my lips are left with softness, healthy looking and the mint flavour from the beginning changed into a slight sweetness. No tingly feeling nor burning. I have not seen any plumping either. I would really describe it as a glossy liquid lipbalm. Plus the packaging is so luxe! I would buy this again but during the VIB sales! I truly recommend! Hope this helps!

As a long time La Mer fan I was so excited to try the new soft cream and boy does it impress. I love how little I have to use and how light weight the cream is for how well it moisturizes. So happy I tried the soft cream! Gifted by La Mer

This product was gifted to me by La Mer.  What I first initially liked about this product is how light weight  the texture of the cream is, I used a small amount and I was able to cover my whole face and neck area so a little goes a long way with this product.  After I used it my skin looked plumped and fresh.

I have been using this product for about 2 weeks now. It is very creamy and luxurious. I do feel like i’m at a spa whenever I apply it. I particularly like it before doing my makeup as it gives me a flawless base. Wish it didn’t contain fragrance.

This La Mer cream has a very strong floral scent that you often get from those old-school soaps. The scent dissipates quickly, so I don’t find it a problem at all. Some strong scents do give me a headache, but this isn’t too bad. I get why it’s called Soft Cream because the texture is indeed quite soft, melty, and very moisturizing on the skin. A little goes a long way, and it is a good expensive moisturizer! I would absolutely love to own a full-size or the whole routine one day. I think that’s the only way to properly review La Mer as a brand. *This was a sample, and it’s gifted by La Mer.

La Mer sent me a tiny sample sized jar of this and I’m shocked by some of the bad reviews. I have combo skin that’s prone to breakouts, and within a week of using this product, my skin was more moisturized, soft, and most of the acne on my cheeks dissapeared. The price is crazy, but so far after trying many different moisturizers, this is the only one that works for me.
I absolutely love this !!! I struggle finding good moisturizer that work with my combination skin type. This worked well with my other skincare and also made my makeup last longer throughout the day.
One of my favorite cleansing foams. It leaves no residue and doesn’t dry out my skin after each use.I use this foam and chantecaille foam alternatively.

I love it. It did not clog pores, does not irritate the skin, it’s pluming. So why 3 stars? It has identical ingredients from a discontinued SPF 50 Estee Lauder Advanced Day Wear Multi Protection. Upon trying La Mer SPF, it feels and smell the same as Estee Lauder, it has the same green color, same consistency. Guess what…turns put the ingredients….identical! Till last few ingredients. La Mer is an Estee Lauder Company. The Estee Lauder was $40. No comments.

I used La Mer about 15 years ago.  I gave it up due to the expense.  But here I am, in my late 50s, looking for different skin care.  I’ve always used decent products, but thought… this might be the time to take the leap.  I used Sephora points to get several sample kits.  And immediately fell in love with the brand again.  It led me to dial in the appropriate products.  I felt I needed a day lotion/cream but so often products leave me oily looking mid day or my foundation has rubbed off. This was recommended and wow, do I love it.  Absorbs quickly.  It keeps me hydrated during the day.  It works well with other products that I use… some times I use a primer, but often just foundation, etc.  This goes a long, long ways. I use one pump in the AM.  I use heavier night products.  The original cream is really too rich for me, so I’ve been using Soft…which is also a really terrific product, as is The Concentrate.  Worth the money, but I do look for gift with purchase, or the Sephora loyalty discounts when I purchase.
Amazing !! Super hydrating skin looks and feels fantastic after using this product
it burns and stings my eyes. is it eucalyptus probaly? But its too hars to remove make  up around the eyes. Very strong scent too

VERY tempted to get a full sized product after trying this product from a free sample! Have only used this cream at night for about 2 weeks, but a little goes a long way and I think I’ve only used about a third of my super mini sample. I have an extremely oily t-zone, and this product has helped visibly control oiliness during the day even though i only use it at night. It has also visibly evened out my skin tone! Dropped one star for the price tag, but if they come out with a value set during the holidays then I would definitely buy the full size!

I was skeptical at first because I had tried other La Mer products wihtout any difference. I had tried the mini version of this first and It felt great and I thought I was noticing some firming. So I bought the full size. I have to agree that the packaging of so much thick resin/ acrylic of the tub is grossly un eco friendly as well as misleading. They should do something about that. But I have really noticed a difference in the tone and firmness of my face. I’m 50 and even though I don’t feel so old, I’m starting to see the signs and wiht this I see a difference in my cheeks and jawline for sure. I use it about 3-4 days out of the week and I leave it on instead of wiping it off. Definetly looking ot keep wiht this product.

I am so excited that I was gifted by La Mer the new moisturizing soft cream! I love how light weight the cream feels on my skin. A little definitely goes a long way! My skin already feels plumper and healthier. I will continue to use this cream to achieve the ageless look I have always wanted.

I have been wanting to try this cream for so long! I have combination skin but a mainly oily on the T zone and dry on the outer areas of my face. One thing to know is a tiny bit goes a long way with this cream. The scent is so beautiful, the formula is light weight and melts into your skin yet it is so hydrating! I continued with a primer and light makeup for a quick put together look. So far I love how soft my skin looks and not greasy. I tried this also as a night cream, it is the perfect addition! My skin looked so dewy and healthy the next morning!

I am very disappointed in this product. I read mixed reviews and really wanted to love it. I don’t mind spending a lot of money on something that works great. I do like that it goes on nicely ... not greasy but light. It is extremely expensive and it did nothing to improve the appearance of the area around my eyes. I just turned 50 and have nice skin in general but noticed some eye puffiness. I have used this product for several months and have not noticed any improvement around my eyes.

This is a nice cream for underneath makeup, but a little too thick for everyday use without makeup. My skin is more oily & it definitely did not agree with my skin when I was not wearing makeup but underneath a matte foundation it was beautiful and made my skin look so smooth!

Definitely an investment product, but it lasts so long. Just like the other La Mer products. I purchased in April, and I am not running low yet. Tip: I use it as a serum and leave it on. I never rinse it off until I wash my face again. I double cleanse twice a day.

I am in love with LA Mer products and own many.  I wanted this to work SO badly but alas it did not. Not only did it do nothing good I actually reacted to it somehow causing super dry crepey patches that were definitely caused by this product.  Could just be my skin but I don’t normally react to anything.   Returned.
The product was in fact effective to an extent however the smell was absolutely atrocious. It smells so sour, I almost thought I was given an expired product but no.

Received a free sample size with my purchase and I think i am going to have to give it to spend on a full size bottle. I am super oily around my T zone and I felt like this cream went on so smooth and made it feel nice and soft. A little going a long way. I definitely like.
So hydrating. Dries quickly. Doesn’t cause clogged pores and makes a difference

I simply adore this sunscreen. It’s worth every absurdly-expensive penny. It spreads and absorbs so smoothly, it feels more like a serum than a sun cream. It’s not greasy, nor matte, but it does make my makeup look beautiful and natural (especially when paired with the Smashbox Primerizer). I have naturally dry skin, but love powder and use it heavily and regularly, but these products (individually and together) keep my makeup looking perfect, smooth, natural, and bright.

I had received a sample of this a while ago, used it and then tucked it away, forgotten. I was so excited when I saw it and couldn’t remember why I stopped using it. I used it one night, woke up the next day with a few small bumps (odd for my skin, but I didn’t attribute it to this). The next night I used it again and woke up with a forehead scattered with tiny whiteheads. I NEVER breakout like that, ever. Also, my skin rarely reacts to new things, so for this La Mer gel cream to make me breakout out so badly, I can’t help but to recommend you just stay away from this one.

This cream is lovely! It’s so moisturizing and it sits very well under makeup- makes my makeup look very dewy and not dry. I would definitely recommend giving it a try, I’ve been loving it so far!!!!!

I love this serum.  I wear this on low humidity days and days when my skin feels tight/dry.  This makes me skin look fab: dewy, moisturized, glowy.  I love this serum so much.  I wash my face every other day with the la mer oil exfoliator (which is also amazing) then apply the la mer treatment lotion, la mer revitalizing hydrating serum, then top off with la mer creme de la mer moisturizing cream.

This mask is incredible, better than sk, it is so hydrating and repairing.  There is tons of product it’s so juicy you can use the excess for a couple of days after.  I have sensitive, acne prone skin and had no issues.

It tastes so good I have to stop myself from licking it all off my lips at once. It adds the glossiness without feeling like your lips are suffocating in wax, and the cool tingle it gives is borderline addictive. Thank you, la mer, for ruining the other peasant lip glosses for me.

I love this cool gel cream. I pat this on my face on top of my serum(s). The next morning my skin is bright, hydrated and soft without looking oily. I must say that I only use this as my overnight moisturizer, and use as needed in the daytime under my sunscreen.

I adore this cleansing foam for morning skin care routines. Firstly, the simple packaging and bottle speaks to La Mer’s incredible marketing team. However the real beauty is in the product itself. A turquoise blue cream comes out of the bottle and smells incredible, almost musky and certainly more on the unisex side of things as if reminded me on a good Tom Ford cologne. This stuff has instant results, feels amazing on the skin and within a week I noticed acne reduction, tighter skin, smaller pores and overall I just felt like I was glowing based off my complexion from my new routine. Very much a product that can and should be used by both men and women. Saving up for the famous La Mer Moisturizer and Eye Cream next as I would like to see what a purely La Mer product routine would do for my skin. Incredible stuff and would recommend trying the smaller bottle first at an amazing price point of $35 for a company known to be at the top of the food chain for beauty products.

My mother got two 6.7 oz bottles of this stuff as GWP for a fairly enormous La Mer haul and passed them on to me as she does not use micellar water. I use this in the mornings in lieu of cleansing probably half of the days as over cleansing really dries out my skin. This works quite well, doesn’t dry me out and is very gentle - does not sting at all. Overall, I think it’s a very effective product. It is, however, like all other La Mer products very fragranced. While I do not have any fragrance sensitivities,  I’ve found that I do particularly enjoy the experience of using things that are very heavily scented, so especially for the price of his micellar water, I will not be purchasing after I use up my stash.

holy crap this sheet mask is amazing! I have super dry skin and keep it hydrated. I went to Arizona (dry air) for a week and came home with dry patches and acne all over my face. I popped this on my face and my skin had never felt so hydrated in my life!! it saved my skin and brought it back to normal, even better than normal! i hope they keep selling the individual sheets I will always buy as a treat!!
I have sensitive skin and don’t do good with sunblocks! This feels Amazing, will definitely keep on repurchasing it for life❤

This is a great toner.  It makes my skin feel fresh and I just find it pleasant to use.  I’m taking a star off because it is so expensive and I’m not sure the price is justified when there are many good toners out there for less than half the price however I do love La Mer and wanted to give it a try.

I ordered the new cool gel cream in the mini (half ounce) size. I’ve only used it a few times, and so far can’t tell much difference between this and the prior formula. I do think I like the old one better though. I agree with other reviewers, why reformulate the gel cream? But he’s a big advantage the new formula has:  you can get it in a smaller size jar! Two ounces was just to big for a jar formulation, too expensive to spring for in one payment, and hard to travel with--especially since the jar, while nice not to be plastic, is so heavy.I do wish La Mer would bring back the old gel cream forumla and offer it in the smaller sizes like they do this one.

Great product, my skin feels so moisturized after and the product is so creamy and light on my face. I’ve been using it for about two weeks and I feel like my face is glowing the whole day and moisturized. I also like that it’s pretty high quality clean ingredients

It’s not just the name, the mask moisturizes , tightens and just make my face looks fresher and younger. This is the one for me that makes my skin baby bottom soft, I love it. It was my first La Mer purchase but wasn’t my last, my skin care routine is now almost entirely La Mer and my skin is healthier at 61 then it was at 26.  It is worth the cost for something that gives me such great results.

I received this lotion as a gift from Lamer. Here are my thoughts: I love all of Lamer products and as you know they all have a unique fragrance to them. This lotion also has an enticing fragrance which is amazing. This makes my skin feel softer and smoother instantly. I use it everyday.

I liked this cream a lot. It smells luxurious like a hotel or spa, which I loved. The texture was great and does feel cooling. However, I don’t understand the massive price point. I do like it a lot but not sure why it’s so $$$

Gifted By La Mer. I also love how thick this goes on yet easily it is absorbed. I have super dry skin so i love how thick it is but sinks in right away without leaving a tacky feeling. Its great under makeup as well.

Yes it’s a very expensive cream but the results are amazing. I have been using it for a few months and it hydrates my skin so well. It doesn’t leave a sticky feeling on your face. Highly recommended this product.
love it. it can create nice foam without using foaming net. I love all la mer products

Got a trial size of this and was so excited because I love luxury beauty. Let me start by saying I NEVER, EVER breakout. So I read the breakout reviews and thought “bummer for people with acne prone skin”. I have never seen so much acne on my skin as I did after using this for a couple days. So disappointing but at least now I won’t ever be tempted to waste a huge wad of cash on it!

Someone once told me, “your eyes will be the first part of your face to begin aging.“ Well, thanks to this product I can safely say that I have the eyes of my 20-year-old self (I’m 33 and addicted to smiling). I love this one at night as a splurge and tend to use the Illuminating gel in the morning as it’s lighter, but I do think if you apply properly this wouldn’t go too badly under makeup. It’s rich, but not stiff or waxy so it can easily be applied around the eye. I also find it helps with dark circles, although I know it’s not supposed to (this one is for puffy girls and The Eye Concentrate is for those who need to brighten up). I find this one does the trick for me on both counts, but my circles were never extreme.

Honestly, I think this product is pretty good! The scent is very nice. I like how hydrating the product is and how moisturized my skin feels after using it! My first time using La Mer. It definitely lives up to the luxury hype!

I received a sample and was super excited because I heard great things about this cream. One of the things I love about it is that it has a very light texture, absorbs very well, and hydrated my skin all day.

I was gifted by from La Mer. I love this moisturizing cream! If it wasn’t so pricey, this would be the only lotion that i would ever buy. It is so light weight but really helps my dry winter skin. It goes on nicely and sits under my makeup well. I use at night and in the morning. Also a little goes a long way, so thankfully it can last a decent amount of time!

While the La Mer products are on the pricey side, I am convinced they are worth it. I just turned 59 (for the first time) and my skin looks much younger. After using this mask, my skin always feels brighter and softer, with pores and fine lines reduced.
This is a rather expensive way to soften skin. I’m not convinced it does much more than the La Mer cream alone does. The jar itself is only 40% product and 60% plastic, which is truly eco unfriendly.

Finally tried this and I am really impressed.  My face woke up this morning really red and hot to the touch (I have sensitive skin and rosacea).  I tried a normal calming, hydrating mask and fully expected my skin to behave.  Nope.  So I finally tried one of these masks I bought to see if it would work.  It says to leave on for eight minutes, but I left in on for 15 and when I took it off, it had completely soothed and knocked out the redness and irritation.  It literally felt like an ice pack on my entire face!    When it says there’s a full ounce of the treatment lotion in the mask, they aren’t kidding.  Felt SO good and was such a nice treat.  I am hooked!

This moisture cream is so very soft on my skin when applied. I got immediate result of silky smooth skin. I love how a little goes a long way and my skin doesn’t feel oily. I also soaks in and gives an amazing healthy glow to the skin. It is a little spendy but it definitely last awhile.
100% worth the money. huge difference in my fine lines and dryness. amazing product.

This moisturizer is so nice! It feels light weight but also very moisturizing! I also do feel like you don’t have to use much for your entire face which is nice because it’ll make a tub go a long way! Overall made my skin feel soft, look smooth, and moisturized This was gifted to me!

My first LA MER product …totally love the results of this exfoliator.  Gentle exfoliation while skin is left soft and very smooth.  I will be trying a few more LA MER products based upon the results of this one.  Maybe the LA MER hype has validity to it!

I use this at night to remove all my makeup before washing with the La Mer cleansing Foam. This water removes all my makeup, even eyeliner and mascara. I have starting using this instead of makeup wipes. I find that it is a little oily so I do not use in the morning. I can see myself using this on long flights to refresh my face As well. Love this.
My face felt really fresh and clean after washing my face with it, probably my favorite cleanser.

I’ve been using this for years and it does improve the overall eye area. The eye area is less puffy and it diminishes the looks of wrinkles. However, it does not provide enough moisture during drier months. So I do use a thicker eye cream(Fresh Ancienne) during the drier months. Hence, the 4 stars instead of 5.
Sunscreen and primer in one. This is one of the few sunscreens that doesn’t break me out and works great under makeup. Yes, it’s expensive but you get 1/2 ounce more compared to Dior sunscreen

elegant sunscreen, gives a beautiful glow and doesn’t feel thick or cause breakouts.  I’ve tried Anthelios and Neutragena which my dermatologist recommends but I find them very creamy. This doubles as a moisturizer for daytime. Will purchase again.
Cherish yourself, amazing mask, not sticky, absorb every quick! Buy it buy it buy it!!! You won’t regret, expensive but worth it!

One of the best moisturizer I’ve used so far! My skin feels hydrated and fantastic! Yes this is expensive but trust me it’s worth every penny! It smells delicious and love the consistency, so thick and creamy!!
I love this cleanser.  A small amount goes a long way.  I have sensitive skin and had ZERO problems using this cleanser.  It is sheer perfection in my book.
It clogged my pores.  I tried it for several days thinking it may have been a different product, but I know for sure it was this product.

The texture of this moisturizer is quite lovely- I wasn’t given enough to truly see the effects and if it changes my skin in anyway but it absorbed nicely and wears well under makeup. The smell however is very unpleasant. It reminds me of a heavily scented cold cream. Something my grandmother would have smothered herself in, in the 90’s, maybe that’s what they were going for. I would rather have a light fragrance or none at all, it’s strong enough to make me not want to use it which is a shame.

I was so excited to get his as a sample with my purchase.. DO NOT USE IT!! Within 10 minutes had dermatitis and it created breakouts.. I typically only get breakouts when I eat a lot of sugar and or on occasion. I don’t have very sensitive skin. This product really didn’t even give my skin enough moisture.

I wanted so much that I liked and this product worked but it was not so, I do not doubt that hydrate but compared to “Murad water gel or Belif aqua bomb” that have worked great on my skin combined, a week of using them I see favorable changes  and they don’t add oil to my skin and this one did.  Sadly it doesn’t work for me :(  :(

May just not be made for me. In the recent years, my skin has turned from dry and oily to normal (not dry, not oily, just very balanced) probably from all the great skincare I’ve invested in the recent years. When I used this, it made my foundation look dry and oily again! I use the La mer foundation and La mer Treatment primer and LOVE both, so thought I’d try this.. but it made the la mer foundation just sit on top, look powdery and after 2 hours I was so oily! Next day I had 3 tiny red bumps on my face, irritation maybe? I waited awhile to let it dry down on my skin, but it still had a sticky finish. Going to stick with my Korean and sk2 toners.

If I could give this product a 0 I would. It is way overpriced for something that does nothing but make your face look puffy. So disappointed in Sephora for not allowing me to return such an expensive product!

I am OBSESSED with the la mer moisturizer. It is truly worth every penny. It left my skin feeling soft, clean, and moisturized and when i woke up the next morning my skin was bright and smooth. I highly recommend this product

No difference after using, the texture was not bad, but basic on the high price, two star is a maximum. BTW I am a 28 dry to combination skin, there was about 5 uses in a mini bottle, in order to see some result i used a lot every time.

When they say that a little bit of their products goes a very long way, they really do mean it.  I love the fragrance scent this lotion has, and it makes my skin feel so moisturized and loved. Definitely will be repurchasing

La Mer is such an iconic brand and this soft cream doesn’t disappoint! It sinks right in and leaves skin feeling velvety soft! It has the same scent as their other products! I prefer this to the original creme as you don’t have to warm it up and it’s easier to apply. My skin feels so nice when using!

This is a great product. I like using it in the winter months when the air is dry. Most cleansers seem to strip my skin of all moisture; however, this one has the opposite effect. After using this, my face feels amazingly clean with leaving a dry and tight feeling.

I have dry, sensitive skin. I only exfoliate once a week as it tends to aggravate my skin, causing redness and irritation. The serum has definitely calmed the redness and inflammation just as it promises to do. In the past few years I have tried over a dozen different serums. This is the only one that instantly and consistently calms my middle age skin. It has minimized lines on my forehead, making them less visible. It also imparts a soft, almost velvety texture to the skin. If you have dry or sensitive skin that is prone to inflammation or other irritation, then in my opinion it is definitely worth the cost. I’m on my second bottle!

If you have oily/acne prone skin，you might wanna give it a try. I use it at night as a night time moisturizer, it really helps keep my skin hydrated while not being too oily. It does not break me out either. This is by far my favorite gel cream. Will repurchase!

La Mer’s Lotion, which is less expensive, will hydrate you way better than this will. This lacked results and Sephora’s oils hydrated my skin just as well. Get the water-based lotion to start regime. Skip this one.

if you are looking for an honest review.. look no further!!!-I’ve always been a huge cleanser person. I tend to not buy skincare that is too harsh so i stick with my masks, cleansers and moisturizers and I’ve always known about the brand La Mer. Unfortunately, I am too broke to actually buy something full size but when I recently got some money out of sheer blindness I bought the mini for this cleansing foam just to try it out and I will say with much confidence, that you will not regret it. The smell is so so so amazing so if you are really into fragrance you will love this! I smells and feels so luxurious like you are being pampered at a spa :) A little goes a long way but from how often I use this because of how good it is, I might invest for the bigger size. If you have oily/combo skin this is a must!!! A little pricey but well worth it. Overall excellent, you get what you pay for and it did its job and did it well!!! Would recommend <333

A little goes a LONG way with this cream!  It is lightweight with lasting hydration, unlike other lightweight creams that I’ve tried. It took my skin from dry to moisturized and SO SOFT.  My skin actually held the moisture from this cream. I received this as a gift and will definitely repurchase!!

I received this product as a present for my birthday and I am absolutely in love with this product, I use this to remove my make up and my skin feels clean and calm after using this. I know this product is really pricey but because of this, I bought the La Mer soft cream and let me tell you this product is life changing, make sure you apply it on your finger tips and then warm it up on your hands and then lightly press onto your face. Your skin feels perfect not too dry and not too oily, your skin feels super clean and calm and my skin has never looked better! As for the cleansing micellar water, from the looks of my bottle im guessing it will last me for 6 weeks because i use it once daily.
I’ve never been a big toner user, until now!!! I’m so happy with my skin’s overall look and feel after adding this to my routine.
Little goes a long way!  it smells amazing and i like the way my skin feels after!

Perfect for my combination aging skin! I have tried so many luxury face cleansers and this has been the best cleanser by far. I would not use it if you have dry skin though! My skin is prone to hormonal acne and this has completely transformed the texture of my skin. A little goes a long way - it is highly concentrated so I use a pea sized amount on my PMD wand.
I love this product and everything about it! It’s smooth, shiny, natural and smells like mint. Definitely will buy again. Hey, those complaining about the price? Well, it is Lamer!

This is, by far, my favorite formula yet! I’ve been a fan of the Treatment Lotion and Eye Balm Intense for years. I honestly don’t know why I never tested the moisturizers before. This is so silky and luxurious, which really enhances the user experience. In terms of benefits, I do feel like the blend of Miracle Broth, Shea, and plant oils keep my skin feeling hydrated and have soothed my inflammation. I’m acne-prone, so I can’t use this every night, but it’s phenomenal for special occasions or when I want to pamper myself.

I’m a huge fan or La Mer products and enjoyed using this product. It goes on smooth and my skin feels much more hydrated when applied. I do feel like I need to use a bit more than anticipated and it is pricey but worth it. Great for the fall when the weather gets a bit colder and my skin feels like it could use the extra hydration.

As I get older, I wanted to pay more attention to my skin. About a year ago, I bought three La mer products.  Cleanser, treatment lotion and moisturizing cream. I read so many raving reviews and I really wanted to love them. But I couldn’t .  They are ok but I can find similar products which are 1/10 of the price. I had to constantly remind myself how much I paid to motivate myself to use the products before they expire..after a year of trying, I just gave up on them.. if you can, try to get the samples before committing to full sizes.

I’d give it no stars if I could.  Does absolutely NOTHING!  After reading the reviews, I thought I’d splurge and give it a try.  Those reviews must have been written by sales reps. Don’t waste your money!

This has become my new favorite from Lamer.  I did like the other gel formula better, but it was discontinued.  This one works just as well, and my skin still looks good for my age, I am 38 years old but I am always told I look much younger than I am.  I credit the Lamer brand for my skin.  I have dry skin and this works perfect for me.  I also feel like this gel formula last longer than the soft cream or the OJ creme de lamer.
My go to lip balm. Totally worth the money.

I received this product complimentary from La Mer. I’ll be honest I’d probably never afford this on my own due to the high price tag. It’s supposed to help hydrate and moisturize, while keeping wrinkles at bay. The sample is too small to tell.

I realized I was not using this correctly...I witnessed amazing results when I had a fresh, clean face and applied it before bed.  I woke up and virtually all of my lines around my eyes seem filled it and I had a new plumpness in my skin around my eyes.  Pretty incredible.  The thickness of the cream settled into my skin and my make up applied beautifully, like a primer.  I washed my face but spared my eyes.

This La Mer cream was nice for my skin, but I think it would be best suited from my dry-dehydrated skin in the spring/summer time. It goes on light and hydrates, but being in cold/windy temperatures of the city I just needed a little bit more nourishment. This product was giftd by La Mer in exchange for my honest review.

This product is amazing! I never write reviews but I had to for this one.. I was suffering from a case of winter skin care blues, I applied this for 10 min tissued of the excess and followed up with the la mer rich creme and went to bed! Woke up with the softest most glowing skin ever.. highly recommend!

I love all lamer products the are so good and makes me feel glamorous. So good for dehydrated skin it gives me the glow that I love and smells great! It’s part of my daily routine and my skin feel luxurious you can feel de quality of the product on your skin!
After one use, the result is visible! The pores get smaller and skin gets soft and firmer. Amazing result!! Can’t live without
Very gentle so wont sting your eyes. Skin  doesnt feel like coated or casted with some chemical at all. I go back use this product once in a while because of the high price for sunscreen

J’ai beaucoup de produits la Mer et habituellement, je les trouve très performants mais celui ci ne m’a pas renversé..je pourrais employer un autre produit moins cher qui donnerait le même résultat...
This is awesome bc once it’s on, you can’t even tell. There is no greasy or chalky residue. It fully absorbs into the skin and leaves nothing behind. And there is no awful smell either! It’s perfect!
WORTH EVERY PENNY. Saw a major difference after about a week of using, giving my skin a new glow & helped dull, uneven texture parts of my face.

La Mer is well known for it’s highend skincare products as well as it’s wonderful glowing benefits that help refresh your skin. This was my first La Mer purchase and yes, it is expensive. For only 1.7oz of product, this face sunscreen is $95. A bit of an investment there BUT it’s good. It’s my holy grail sunscreen for my skincare routine. I used to use the Shiseido broad spectrum wet force suncreen lotion but the lotion was too wet for me and I wanted something more cream based, so I tried La Mer. The products smells amazing and the oroduct itself is not too wet and loose, as in it’s a cream but it’s not that thick(?) It’s a good balance between a lotion and a cream sunscreen and the product itself gives you an amazing radiant, glowing finish with also some hydrating benefits. SPF 50 is also a really good protecting factor and not many sunscreens have their factor up to SPF 50. If you don’t use sunscreen, PLEASE start using it! Suncreen doesn’t just help protect your skin from UV rays and prevent skin cancer but it also gives you amazing skincare factors and protects you from natural, harmful lighting as well. Must have for a sunscreen and highly recommended.
very good product ..it makes my skin look so fresh and clean...
I bought into the hype and purchased this.  It smells like soap, and left my skin feeling dry and tight.  Absolutely not worth the money.  Invest in a good retinol instead!
WOW WOW WOW ! J’adore ce nettoyant, oui il est dispendieux , mais je me sens tellement propre de la figure une fois que je fini de l’utiliser ! Lol
Works much better than other brands I’ve purchased. Really lifts up oil, makeup and even removes waterproof eye liner.

All my life I have promised myself this cream when I could afford it. I finally bought it about 6 months ago but am disappointed. It has not done anything for my skin and I think it caused some breakouts. Also the whole rubbing it between your fingers thing  is way too much work- I don’t have time for all that! I have dry skin so I thought this would be great but it didn’t even make my skin feel super moisturizer.

I’ve been using the classic La Mer moisturizing cream for awhile and find it very hydrating and do minimize pore efficiently. This lotion is def NOT as performative as the classic cream version like it claims. It does absorb fast and does not leave any shine like the classic cream but it has also lost the magic power of La Mer. In general, works as a day cream but not worth the price.

If you have tried La Mer‘ slip balm this is exactly the sameas the lip balm. It has the same minty flavor and it doesn’t do much at all. It’s not a volumizing treatment either. It’s sheer and it doesn’t worth the price.
super cooling on the skin. improved my skins texture and was not greasy or sticky. i also loved the smell. i can tell it has quality ingredients by how calming it is on my skin.

I have used La Mer for like two years and recently switched to Cle De Peau. Not because the cream and serum is bad, your skin will get tired of the same skincare product that you have been using. Among all La Mer products, I’d say this one is the most useless one. NOT WORTH IT!!!! I have very dry and sensitive skin, this toner literarily does nothing...... And it smells a little weird to me..... I would suggest the cream and also the treatment lotion, but don’t spend that much money on this toner!

It lathers up very well and I find my face squeaky clean after using it. However, my skin did feel a bit tight after using it. It does smell kind of like liquid hand soap as a couple of people had mentioned, but the scent isn’t bad nor does it bother me. Don’t think that’s a bad thing, but I’m assuming the issue is that they would prefer a better scent given the price point. I bought the mini and I’m glad I did as I wouldn’t buy it again. Sephora carries other foaming cleansers that perform better at a better price.

I’ve never been wowed by any La Mer skincare product...until now! I used this mask every night for 3 consecutive nights until my trial sized tube finished. The first night I applied for just 10 minutes and wiped away the excess with a cotton pad, which to be honest was not that much as my skin seemed to have absorbed it all. Instantly I noticed my complexion looked more radiant and rested.For the next 2 nights I applied overnight and let it sink in and work its magic. Not only was there a brighter tone to look forward to in the morning but my skin looked more plumped and it glowed.The mask didn’t extend past that point as I’d used it all up, and maybe that’s a good thing as I was starting to get some small bumps (quite common for me if I use a silicone containing product on consecutive days). The breakout could also have been down to the Eucalyptus oil or Spearmint ingredients. If I was to purchase the full size I would definitely have to stick to twice per week applications at most...despite how tempting it can be to use more often when your skin ends up looking this good! Bottom line is: if your skin isn’t sensitive, it’s worth giving this a try. The trial size is good for at least 3 applications, could easily be stretched to four. I applied this every night right after cleansing and then topped with the La Mer eye balm. After going through 2 bottles I decided not to repurchase. I thought I would have seen some difference, but fact of the matter is that there was no difference in how my eye area looked.

Cream goes on very smooth. You can barely notice that you have it on. Very lightweight. Not sure if I notice many improvements but it is an eye cream not a procedure. I am loyal to la mer and I have been for the past 5 years. Hoping this pays off 30 years from now!

I liked it. I have very dry skin. This worked very well for me. I use it in conjunction with oil. Oil first then La Mer cream. Both work best if you use it immediate after washing face, while it’s still damp. You only need a tiny bit, especially with the oil. It is dewy, isn’t that what us older women need? I got several months out of this tiny jar. Now I can not speak as to whether or not it’s better than another product of this price range. I figured at the price for a regular size jar, it must be good. I can say, no more dry flakes on my face. I am buying some PURE to see how it compares.

I really enjoy a gel cream, and La Mer delivers luxury wise! A little bit of this product goes a long way. It is definitely something you do not want to put too much of on your skin. The scent is very nice. The gel cream makes my skin feel very hydrated and moisturized and I really like it!

This product has a very strong scent. It smells nice but it is overwhelming. I also find it a bit harsh on the skin. I have used Chanel démaquillant yeux intense for years and for some reason decided to switch it up this time. I bought this to use as an eye make up remover after using Chanel la mousse as a face wash. I regret my decision, especially for the price point.

Ok, I got a free trial size of this. I was so happy about it because I always wondered what $300 moisturizer feels like. Well, I’m impressed. I hate that I love it. I can’t shell out $350 for 2oz of moisturizer but I may just have to find a way!

La Mer is a classic, iconic brand and you really feel like you’re spoiling yourself and the smell is wonderful. But it doesn’t justify the exorbitant price for me! I feel like it’s overpriced to the point it is to make it exclusive and bougie and I’m kind of uncomfortable with that messaging. Skincare should not be like that, it’s already expensive and confusing as it is, and I bought La Mer products before I started reading ingredient lists and understood how they/my skin work. Anyway, the ingredients are fairly basic, so a lot of other moisturizers contain them, and you can easily dupe this cream. You’re honestly just paying for the experience to use this exclusive magic cream.

This micellar water is perfect for removing excess build up from sweat, sun screen, and a long day at the beach without inflaming  sun burnt skin.  Infact it helps to soothe and cool down even the most irritated skin. Perfect for use after shaving!  Hands down a great way to clean your face!  Expensive but worth it!

The La Mer moisturizing cream is the best in the game!! I tried it once and have been in love with it ever since. It’s perfect alone or before your makeup routine. I have dry skin so this cream leaves my skin feeling perfectly hydrated. It has a light clean scent and it doesn’t feel thick upon application. Seriously my favorite cream!!

La Mer is my favorite skincare line.  It’s my HG!  I can’t tell you how excited I was that Sephora was finally carrying it.  I’ve been using the line for 20 years.  When I started using it, there was one place you could buy it & the ladies at the department store would snicker & whisper whenever I was in buying it.  Finally, someone spoke up & asked me what I was doing buying La Mer products, since it was for “old people“ & I was 24... I told them that:
A. It was Hollywood’s best kept secret (living in LA)
B. I wanted to start early, so when I got “old“ it wouldn’t show.. 
Well, fast forward 20 years & EVERY TIME I order a glass of wine or a margarita, I get carded!  I got ID’d this week buying Sudafed.  Where are those ladies now?  I really want to find them. lol!

As far as the La Mer “The Moisturizing Soft Lotion“ it’s my go-to, every morning after I wash my face & use my serum & I put it on.  Never fails.  It’s got the scent of the original Creme de la Mer, (natural beachy scent), it’s so smooth & hydrating.  It gives me an instant glow!  I remember once that my cleaning lady asked why my face was always so “glowy“ in the morning.. The soft lotion is the answer.  If you have oily skin, I think this would be really heavy first thing in the morning &/or underneath makeup.  But, dry-normal will benefit.  The cream itself gives your skin a translucent effect.  It’s beautiful.  I never break out from it or any other La Mer product.  I would suggest using the Gel version of the Creme de la Mer or the Perfecting Treatment  (not sold yet at Sephora) as a moisturizer in the morning/primer. Those would be my 2 recommendations if you have oily prone skin.  This might be too much to handle.  

I’ve been layering the Perfecting Treatment over my moisturizers both in the morning (Soft Lotion) & night (Creme de la Mer).  It adds such a nice smooth look under makeup during the day & helps seal up the products & acts as a conductor, allowing everything to sink into the skin more effectively, at night.  

Another use for the Moisturizing Soft Lotion is to use it in place of Creme de la Mer, as your moisturizer at night in the summertime.  To me, it’s just a much lighter, creamier version of the original creme.  If using it at night, I think ALL skin types would benefit!

I highly recommend the entire line.  If possible, find those pre-made kits, to try things out for a few weeks to see how your skin will respond & what exactly will work for you before buying full sizes.  They’re available at high-end department stores.  But, chances are you’ll fall in love.  I haven’t had any complaints from anyone I recommended it to, over the years.  

The most important thing I can say is: nothing works overnight.  (although your skin will feel great quickly), you may not see visual differences right away, give it time!  Also, with all of the La Mer products, a little goes a LONG way.. Some of my products last 6 months.  Make sure you speak to a Sales Associate who’s been trained with La Mer products.  The application techniques can make all the difference!  

Here’s to your best skin ever in 2017!! XOXO

This moisturizing matte lotion from La Mer is super lightweight and is great for my combination skin. I tend to get oily in the t zone, so that’s where I concentrated this product when I applied it underneath makeup. While it’s definitely on the pricier side, a little does go a very long way, so I think this can last you for a long time!
At first I was not a fan, it felt greasy and had a very strong scent. But I can’t deny the amazing results. My skin is softer and smoother. I’ve come to love it.

This cream is very soft, I’d say pillow soft. A little goes a long way. I put 4 dots of the cream on my face. It’s lightweight and has a light scent to it, you can’t smell it once applied. After cleansing the skin and letting it air dry my skin is slightly tight and definitely needs hydration. After applying this cream my face feels hydrated and supple. It also has a slight glow to it. The cream is beautiful!

I bought this for my daughter. She loves it. She said it gives just the right volume to her lips. They don’t look unnatural. She also said it keeps her lips moisturized all day. Once again, it’s pricey but worth the quality.

This lotion is great. It was my very first product from the brand, and I liked it. I would give this one 4 out of star for the reason that my skin felt slightly irritated as it was absorbing the product because of some of the ingredients.

Doesn’t deserve the hype. For a $95 product, this sunscreen has nothing special.The ingredients are generic. I’m surprised that this fluid actually contains oxybenzone - red flag! The rest of the ingredients are ones you can find in ANY broad spectrum sunscreen: avobenzone, homosalate and octisalate. I could see why this has good reviews - it just has a nice thin texture and the consistency allows it to be worn daily with/without makeup. But honestly, with the ingredients of a chemical sunscreen, that’s really not hard to find. Like I said, nothing special. why would I pay almost 100 for the most basic ingredients found in ANY drugstore sunscreen?Also - it irritated the surroundings of my eyes even after I applied carefully. Stung my skin. Save your cash. Get a better deal EASILY.
Tooooooooo oily not recommended for oily skin type. I got breakout everytime after I wear it

I have received a sample of the cream. And it feels soo good. I have a combination skin, but need to moisturize it and it’s always a problem. La mer cream felt like having the right consistency   Perfect clean feeling after with no greasiness or heaviness on my skin

I absolutely love this moisturizer. Best I’ve ever used, and I’ve tried every brand imaginable. It’s light, makes your skin soft, and has never made my acne prone skin breakout. I use this with the Treatment Lotion and actually get compliments on my skin now. Highly recommend!

A little goes a long way with this light weight moisturizer. After a long day, I did my skincare routine and used a small amount of the moisturizer and my skin was glistening so beautifully! I would totally recommend.

Very smooth and makes me glowy. It is very hydrating and very light in texture. I love that the little goes a long way. Literally in love with the products and will be definitely buying it again in the future.

I’m 42 combo in the T-zone and dry everywhere else , acne prone, sensitive skin and a avid,prescribed by my derm, tretin user for a few years now. I absolutely love this product. I have been using it only for a couple of days and I noticed how smooth my skin feels like, my skin also feels super soft and refreshed after using it. Can’t wait to try more products from this brand because I loved this one!

It soaks right in and leaves my skin soft and soothed. It was worth every penny, and I plan to keep using it in the future.

I love La Mer products. I have several of their items in my skincare routine. I thought I’d give this cleanser a try even though I think the cost is outrageous for a cleanser.
