I’ve only been using it for a week so not yet convinced it’s worth the cost. Pros: very creamy and not drying, nice La Mer scent,  foams up nicely, a lot of product as you don’t need much, and washes off well. Cons: Hefty price. I don’t dislike it but I don’t love it either. Just wondering if it really is that much better than other products I’ve tried and loved. I’ll enjoy using the rest of this cleanser but not convinced I’ll repurchase. I’d rather save the money for their other products. I wouldn’t deter people from purchasing it.

It doesn’t irritate my skin and is very hydrating. However, it gets pretty oily sometimes. Probably better for dry skins or mixed skins during winter. For this price, you can definitely find something better tho.

My only eye area problem is puffiness. After reading reviews about the high-end results of this luxury product I committed $200  to the cause and didn’t get the results I expected. I have a rather flat cheek area so when my eyes are puffy they almost protrude a bit. I’ve tried this cream following directions with the wand as well as just using my fingertips. He wand is slightly more effective overall. The cream is very cooling and moisturizing on the skin regardless. However, although it flattens the puffiness I tend to get this weird wrinkle sag like the area got deflated but left a fold with a bit of darkened pigmentation. Which kind of looks worse than just puffiness. For reference I’m in my early 30s but I don’t have any wrinkles, not even fine lines. However this weird deflation effect causes a faint line to form below my inner eye area. Perhaps it would be less problematic for people with fuller cheeks. Overall it’s not a satisfactory result for the price.

la mer is amazing when it comes to body, face moisturizers and serums but oh boy how did they missed so big on the eye creams i m having trouble to understand- so nope never again both eye creams are such a disappointment they made me write my first reviews !

The lotion was very hydrating, but the sample that I recevied was too small to notice any substantial differences. Therefore, I only used a little each time I applied--so my hands weren’t fully hydrated.

I am amazed at what this cream has done for my skin! I feel like my skin is bouncier and more full just after a few uses. I break out really easily and this formula doesn’t feel greasy on the skin, which I love.

About to buy my second bottle. :)

Been loving this lotion! It’s super hydrating & blends like a dream. I’ve been using it under makeup & it’s so beautiful! I love the finish & it makes my skin looks so healthy & glowy! Highly recommend !!

I have a ‘’combination’’ skin and this gel cream is really great for improving the overall health & look of my skin. I used this as an overnight mask considering its price ... but the MAGICAL IMPROVEMENT on pores deserve the price
Absolutely love this. I’ve spent tons of money and time trying to find the best cleanser. This is it. Won’t go without it!

This crème is really amazing it give my skin a beautiful satin glowy finish & I absolutely love how my skin looks after I apply this crème. The smell is very powder fresh so if you don’t like that fragrance be aware… overall I really love this moisturizer & can’t wait to keep using this

My skin felt hydrated without being overly greasy. No breakouts noted and I have sensitive skin. I received the product as a gift, complimentary from La Mer.

It’s volumizing in a way that plumps fine lines via hydration. It doesn’t sting. It is somewhat effectively volumizing. It has a minty fresh taste like the La Mer lip balm but in a more convenient and glossier format. It feels very luxurious and I thought it was quite nice. I might consider splurging again. I wish the tube or it’s contents weren’t pink though. Clear like the balm would have been ideal.

This cream was gifted by La Mer for me to try, and I was genuinely surprised by how much I like it! It’s a lightweight cream, and a little definitely goes a long way--which is really saying something because I have extremely dry skin!

This is the best exfoliador I have ever tried. And I have tried…a lot. The crystals are suspended in oil and they dissolve one rubbed into the skin. It exfoliates without drying out my skin. This moisturizer is definitely worth the price! It’s very creamy and just melts into the skin and turns the skin into a dewy glowy base for makeup, and using this at night before bed, you’ll wake up with your skin still nice and glowy!
Essential product in my routine. Works wonders for my skin which is dry but also prone to breakouts.

I don’t think this is making much of a difference. I’ve used it consistently for one month, and it didn’t do much. I tried not using it for another month and the result was the same. I use this under my La Mer eye cream, and I find it’s just lightly hydrating and helpful; but I don’t notice any improvement in fine lines. Save your money and try something else.

Gifted by La Mer. The mini product was small so I was worried I wouldn’t be able to use it long enough so see how I liked it but a little goes a LONG way! VERY hydrating, I thought it was a little oily at first but absorbs & dries beautifully. I tried it on it’s own & then another time with oil after like my normal routine. My skin feels so soft & hydrated! This stuff is great but can’t say this is something I’d repurchase because of the price. Works amazing though.

This is the first time I am trying this cream. I am so impressed with the quality and the luxurious feel. It feels so good on the skin as you apply it. It’s cooling too.  It has a beautiful subtle smell I live for. My skin feels adequately hydrated, nourished and so soft after application.  It is fast absorbing bit there is a little non greasy residue. Overall, it’s a nice luxurous cream that hydrates and nourishes the skin beautifully. Highly reccomend.

I bought this due to the high reviews and at a time where I was on the La Mer train and felt I needed every product they had. While there are some good products within the line (here’s looking at you Soft Treatment Lotion), this was just one I couldn’t get with. For reference, I’m 34, so wouldn’t say my skin is too young for this — If anything i would think it’s the perfect time to start. However I would use this nightly and wake up with no real visible difference. The application is also a little odd to me. So you apply this on as a mask, but don’t wipe it off and instead rub whatever is remaining after you’re done? Then follow up with a moisturizer? Luckily I bought the smaller pot but even at $75 for 0.5, I’m just not getting the hype. Perhaps I’ll come back to this in a few years and try again. Obviously the majority stellar reviews account for something.

I had some samples of La Mer at one point and when I used them my skin was supple and absolutely glowing. So I ordered this during the VIB sale. I didn’t open it immediately because I wanted to finish the moisturizer I was using at the time--I don’t like to waste products. When I finally used this product I was looking forward to waking up every day looking radiant, but instead, I was waking up with breakouts. I’m 100% sure this moisturizer cause my breakouts since it was the only change I made to my skincare routine. I was extremely disappointed! I was wondering if the formula had changed, because I sampled all 3 La Mer moisturizing formulas and didn’t have any breakouts. I just chose to order the gel cream since my skin is on the oily side. I contacted Sephora customer support to see if I could return the product since it caused me to break out and was told that I could not return the product because too much time had passed since my purchase. So now I have a $300 container of moisturizer that I can’t use or return. Extremely disappointed all around.
Got a free trial size with another order - the texture is very gross, sticky and silicone-feeling.  Usually I’d use it on my body at least, but this was so gross I threw it out!!

the smell is absolutely pleasant and the texture is nicer compared to cream IMO, easier to apply. It does a pretty good job moisturizing my skin however it’s not so much better compared to other $60-$90 creams.
Makes my skin appear healthy and young.... its pricey though but so are all lamer products

my picky skin loves this creamy foam...I do love it. But I go through the small bottles quickly and I haven’t been able to buy full sized tube yet. it is a beautiful product I just wish it wasn’t so darn expensive

I have a combination skin type, it is really hard to find something really moisturizing on my cheeks but not oily on the T-zone. I have used every moisturizer of La mer, and this is the only one which fits me perfectly. I really really love it, and it is amazing to feel my skin so soft but no oil at all when I wake up in the morning. Comparing to the old gel cream,this one is slightly richer, but the old one is too light for me. I just bought my 2nd one, and will keep using it!

I almost finished one bottle, it’s good brand, it did leave white cast, but not sure if it makes my face has bumps and acne after I use which I never had this problem before, most important I just realized this one is chemical sunscreen not physical sunscreen, which is not good for your skin, it absorb UV instead block the UV. I like their moisturizer but not this.

Amazing product! I have very sensitive skin and this exfoliator works like a miracle! Skin feels so soft and fresh. I mix a pea size of this product along with my creamy cleanser. Worth the money since it’ll last you for a very long time.

Absolutely amazing! Thank you for gifting me this free product my skin looks and feels incredible! I just left the beach and my skin was really dry and this helped so much. I’m super glowy and receiving so many compliments!
Very soothing and hydrating. Beautiful texture that really is cooling and hydrates instantly. I love using this in the summer or when my skin is feeling red, flushed, or oily.
Not worth the cost and does not actually plump your lips.
Very expensive. Smooth to apply. Doesn’t leave a cast. Feel indulgent. I just wish it came in a pump bottle.
This lotion is moisturizing without drying out face too much. Very light weight! I love it

This product was gifted to me by La Mer.  The first thing to note is that a little goes a long way.  I didn’t have to use much at all to get my skin to really feel moisturized.  The texture is super lightweight and doesn’t leave my skin feeling greasy.  I am super glad to have found this product because it really took my skin from dry and dull to moisturized and glowy!
The product is nice and relatively hydrating and great for redness. But save your money. The price is ridiculous. Also it leaves a strange film on your skin after use.

The only other lip plumper I have tried it too faced. This one I like more it’s less sticky and sinks more in to the skin. This just all around feels nicer. I personally do feel a tingling minty feel on the lips after but it doesn’t hurt. My lips do get a little plumper but it looks natural. I recommend to use a lip liner with this because that just adds to the beauty you get as this has a little shimmer to it.

Just received this product and I now get the hype! This is the best moisturizer I have ever tried. It hydrates my skin but does not make it oily. The texture is perfect when it mixes in with my foundation. Definitely will purchase in the future regardless of the price.

This was gifted to me by La Mer to review and honestly, the amount I received was only enough for a couple days use. The product is rich and feels nice,  but there’s no way of knowing if the long term claims stand or not. It’s definitely a good product, but I’m not sure if it’s worth the price. If you can get a sample, definitely try if for yourself.

I love anything La Mer but this is my absolute favorite besides the creme. It tones my skin without stripping and leaves me with an undeniable glow! My sensitive skin feels nourished and my texture has improved. Also, the smell is lovely.

I was kinda scared to buy this with all the not so good reviews...but aren’t I glad I’ve tried this! I love the cooling feel this leaves on the lips! It makes my lips feel plumped and youthful. Yesss it is a little sticky but nothing more than a ysl lipgloss. If you are looking for a lip volumizer I would def recommend you to try this!

Frustrated by this product!! It has a six month lifespan- there’s no way you could use it up. It feels lovely and my eye area felt more moisturized after use but it certainly didn’t wow me. There’s better out there I’d say.

Very nice formula. A bit pricey but I’d say it’s worth the splurge. It has a light body to it but it goes on so smoothly. It leaves the face feeling very moisturized and slightly dewy (but not sticky).  I also love the fresh clean scent it has to it!

I recently got to try La Mer’s moisturizing matte lotion. It was a small sample but you really don’t need much of it because it goes a long way. The moisturizer is a light, which was a plus. It also dried matte. It didn’t leave your face greasy. It does have a strong fragrance, which I’m not typically a fan of. The moisturizer was nice and but I typically like more moisturizing products. I would not purchase.

This moisturizing soft cream is absolutely amazing! It feels so nice on my skin, doesn’t burn and the fragrance is really light and smells clean! I love adding this to my night time skin care routine because it gives me an amazing glazed donut glow!
Very useful for my lip and it feels super comfortable, and it’s better than the Hourglass’s one.
I have oily skin and this is the best moisturizer for me. It really helps keep my oil down.

I really wish I hated this thing, but I can’t. It has done wonders for my skin! I don’t know about the lifting but it has made my skin so much smoother, more hydrated, and significantly more bouncy! I have unbelievably dry skin that is constantly peeling so this was really a miracle. I can’t give 5 stars though because for $75, I want more product. The thing is TINY. I thought it was a sample sized product at first!

I really enjoyed this product. It’s much better than the previous gel cream. I always add the la mer oil to any lotion I put on my face to make it extra hydrating. I loved the way this feels on my skin, so silky and cool feeling. The only thing I don’t like about this and the other soft lotions is that I go through them so quick. I have really dry skin and a little dollup doesn’t do the job. I find that when I use the original creme and add oil, it’s so thick that I can make it last longer. Besides that, great cream, I just go through it faster than the original. And since they are the same price, I think i’ll stick with the original creme.

If you’re in your 20s - 30s don’t expect to see any firming or lifting,  you’re too young for this product.  However I’m 30 and I will say this mask (more like a moisturizer really) is liking wiping a beauty filter on your face. Is it worth the money - up to you really, you’re paying for the name in my opinion...

This was a complimentary from La Mer to try for a review.First off, I have to note how much I absolutely love these tiny little sample minis they’re so cute! This cream feels so rich and luxurious. A little goes a long way.  It’s such a thick moisturizing texture and perfect for winter months where your skin is extra dry.

I think many misunderstand that this product is a long term investment. For reference, I have very dry skin. When I purchased this product to compliment my cleanser, my skin care regime included once a week exfoliation, a hyaluronic acid based cleanser on the daily, moisturizing two times a day, and using sun screen religiously. Initially, I was shocked and pleased at how much residual makeup this toner picked up that the cleanser left behind. My skin was noticeably softer as well. However, the product had yet to really blow me away like some of the other skin care items in my arsenal and I seriously was contemplating not repurchasing. After all, I was still experiencing a hormonal spot or two every now then; I just didn’t see the dramatic change I had been hoping for.Then, a couple of months in and half way through the bottle, I was staring in the mirror one day and to my surprise my face was “glowing” as it never had before. To add to that, I suddenly realized I had bypassed Zit City that month too. I found the effect quite stunning and it was at that moment I became a convert. Absolutely a must have for anyone truly serious about skin care.

Finally tried this for the first time and it has quickly become one of my all time staples in my skincare routine. The moisturizer feels so luxurious and keeps my skin feeling hydrated the entire day. It’s lightweight and applies beautifully under my makeup. It smells wonderful and a little bit does a really long way!

Holy smokes! I love this mask - the price tag not so much. I’m on accutane at the moment so I’ve been stocking up on hydrating masks and I finally dug this one out. I immediately noticed my skin looked more hydrated, plump, and radiant and that carried over for the next three days. Even my mom commented on my skin, telling me how good it looked! I will definitely be buying this again but it will be a luxury given how much more expensive this is compared to other sheet masks.

I’m really loving this product. I have oily skin and this is one of the few moisturizers I’ve tried that moisturizes effectively and leaves my skin with a matte finish even after hours of wear under my makeup. This is a perfect daytime moisturizer with my other skincare layered underneath and my sunscreen over top. I dropped a star because I dislike the fragrance and wish it was fragrance free. Luckily the scent goes away in less than an hour.

HOLY GRAIL! The way my skin feels when I use this is amazing. I have large pores and blackheads that if I don’t manage get nasty. I noticed a difference with this right away and my skin feels really fresh and rejuvenated. The smell isn’t that bad, it’s definitely a more natural smell that doesn’t feel artificial.

I finally decided to write a review as I sit here with my face burning after trying the SK-II cleaning line. I’m not a hype person, I never buy into hype and I always do hours and hours of research and testing before buying something especially when it’s expensive. I used this La Mer Cleaning Foam for one year and absolutely love it. It’s the best cleanser I ever used, period. I have dry skin and this always made my skin feel cleansed without tightening/drying it up and is super gentle for my really sensitive skin that has a mind of its own. I was trying to find a cheaper alternative after I am almost out of this one so I tested a few cleaners. I immediately went back online and bought this again after some disaster situations with other cleaners where I face felt like it was on fire and all red and I realized this is still THE BEST! Sticking to this and I’ve been using one bottle for close to a year now, nuts! So in actuality, it’s not that expensive, also, because it’s priced higher than most others you will be more conscious of not wasting or overusing it which means less plastic waste buying more.
Received this as a gift because I love all things la mer.  Struggle with dry lips and this has made my lips so soft and smooth.  I absolutely love it!  No color just shine.

Wow..a little really does go away! I hate to say it but it is sooo good. I wish it were more affordable T.T The texture is so thick and my skin felt so supple after using it. It has a nice subtle smell to it so overall I really like it!

If you have never been to Neiman Marcus and have one of the La Mer beauty consultant showing you the CORRECT way to apply their products, you’ve been missing out! Most people have a negative opinion on La Mer products because they either over use it, or applied way more than recommended amount. I have just received this product as a sample, and I am so so in love with it! Leaves me skin super smooth yet not sticky. It dries up pretty quick. That’s because you’re supposed to use a “pea” size amount when applying this luxurious product.  I love it! Definitely would spend on the bigger size of this.

I have somewhat dry skin and was looking for a new serum. I was really concerned with how the serum would look under my make up/foundation. I use airbrush spray, a light tarte foundation and bb cream (just depending the occasion). This serum absorbed and looked amazing under all of them. I am almost done with my first bottle and don’t really see a big change in the skin’s appearance which I wish there was some since this is over $200. It does hydrate my skin and looks great under foundations but I think I will be shopping around for a cheaper serum first. If I am unable to find any then I’ll purchase again.

love this hydrating serum. Im been using a retinol and this helps with the drying and sensitivity.  also is great for when recuperating from a laser treatment since theres a lot of other moisturizers with too many chemicals. This is amazing for any skin concern.
LOVE this sunscreen.  My holy grail.  It is not greasy, not matte and is perfect under makeup.  I forgot to prime and makeup looked no different -- love this.

This La Mer UV Protecting Fluid sunscreen is the perfect complement to a morning skincare routine. It has a thin milky texture, similar to Laroche-Posay’s much loved facial sunscreens. It melts into your skin the moment it’s swept on. I’ve used it alone on top of my skincare and it makes an excellent makeup base; I’ve also used it with heavier blurring silicone primers, it played nicely with those as well, no pilling. The scent is very light but typically La Mer luxe. My skin has had no bad reaction to it, including around my eyes. Before this I was using the Dermalogica age defense SPF50, but I think I like the La Mer SPF50 better. I believe it would be appropriate for all skin types due to its very light non-greasy and non-drying texture. Currently I use both La Mer and Perricone MD for my morning routine. When I use La Mer I first apply the Treatment Lotion, then the Concentrate, then the Regenerating Serum, and finally I apply the La Mer UV Protecting Fluid. I don’t use an additional moisturizer, this is usually enough for my skin. When I use Perricone I start with the Neuropeptide Facial Conformer serum or the High Potency Lifting Firming serum, then the Acyl-Glutathione eyelid lift serum (love!!), the Neuropeptide day cream, and finally the La Mer SPF50 Protecting Fluid. I listed out the products I use, so you know that all of these products work very well with this sunscreen, with no pilling or balling up. There’s nothing worse than investing in a sunscreen and finding out it’s not compatible with your skincare. This UV Protecting fluid has a texture that seems to be very tolerant of a wide variety of skincare products!

I love this moisturizer! After years of reading amazing reviews for this moisturizer, I finally took the plunge and shelled out for this duet set. At this price point, I was hoping for a miracle, and these little jars delivered! I live in Hawaii and have fair skin, so I have been struggling to find a moisturizer that works without being excessively heavy or greasy. This is it. I love how soft my skin feels after using it, there’s no greasy residue like with some moisturizers, and I have been getting nonstop compliments about my skin. All of my friends and colleagues are asking what I’m using to get such glowing, healthy skin, and the only thing I’ve done different is this moisturizer. I’m hooked. I’ll never go back to any other products.

Other win from La mer I’m almost 30 and I don’t think I’ll see much of the lifting and firming but I really don’t care. This mask is amazing first off you don’t need that much of it.  Second It just melts into your skin once you put it on! And last my skin feels so soft already.

I am in love with this cream moisturizer! It’s perfect for my skin during the drier months of the year. When I put it on after doing other parts of my skincare regimen my skin visibly looked more refreshed and soft.

This serum is great for firming and tightening. Take a few minutes to read the instructions to apply properly. The silver applicator wand has a cooling effect and you run it around your eyes first to increase circulation. Then apply the serum in four spots. It really works!
Tried this on in store and it made my skin super greasy and made the texture look like I haven’t gotten sleep in a week.

Amazing lotion! This is a great primer for makeup which helps with pores and making easy, smooth makeup application. My skin is so soft after using it! Loving this for my makeup routine. Definitely recommend, 10/10!

My absolute favorite sunscreen and the only one I’ve been using for the last few years. I love that it’s a lightly creamy fluid, rather than a sunscreen baked into a cream; I have experimented with many face-cream-sunscreen-in-one products, and never found one that satisfied my skin. This product is literally just sun protection, so it combines easily with any other products you might be putting on your face. Much prefer this type of product that I can put on over anything than having to commit to a cream-and-sunscreen-in-one. This is what I wear daily and on my active vacations, including desert hikes in the sun and cruise vacations. Have had no sunburns on my face in years.

In love! At 34 years of age I definitely want to maintain. I was really concerned over the wrinkles my laugh lines left on my skin. I am a first time la mer subscriber. Always thought “it’s probably not that great” however I caved in and purchased the lifting and firming mask thinking-“if it don’t work I’ll just never purchase it again” after the first couple of weeks I noticed my skin feeling softer but no major difference in the “lifting “ after applying three times weekly for a whole month I noticed the crease of the wrinkles my laugh lines caused had totally vanished. although my face doesn’t look lifted it’s softer and wrinkle free and that’s all I really wanted SO GLAD I didn’t have to take the Botox route. Just purchased my second jar. I’m a very happy! Thank you La Mer so much. Confidence is priceless!!
I really enjoy using this cleanser. The cleansing foam and the clé de peau are my favorite one. They do cleanse your skin without stripping it. Super foamy it last quite a while!
really love this mask. i got this mask because of the review’s. im turning 40 this month and wanted to look my best and im so happy. My skin felts and looks tighter.
Very drying cleanser leaves a cast on my face after washing. Also doesn’t do a good job at cleaning, probably the worst I’ve used.
This product is great! I use it in the fall, spring and summer as my night cream. It really does make my skin glow! In the winter I mostly use the tatcha night concentrate for more skin hydration.

A little goes a long way! The scent of this is comforting and nostalgic - that classic, clean smell. It absorbs nicely and leaves skin soft and moisturizes. It doesn’t get greasy or pill! Pricey but would recommend
Absorbs well, good under makeup. Not hydrating enough though. I have to apply another cream when I need hydration. Not worth the $$$!

I have dropped nearly all La Mer products from my skin care regimen due to cost, but find that I simply cannot give up this toner. I have tried several other toners, hoping to find something a little more affordable, yet equally as effective, but nothing works for me like this one. It makes my skin feel clean, happy and refreshed, never tight or dry. My skin feels calm and perfectly prepped for my essence that follows. I just wish my pocket book was as happy as my skin.

I have always been interested to try and hear about La Mer. I was extremely curious to try this out. I have oily and acne prone skin. This product is nothing special. It does the job and hydrates well but it didn’t make me impressed. It’s a nice cream if you want to just have it because you can. This product was a big “meh”.

this stuff is amazing. I’ve tried everything ranging cheap to $150 and nothing worked. my eye area has been very dehydrated and the weather just made things worse. this is definitely kinda worth the price since it works. I am not sure if it does anything for my dark circles but it is hydrating enough for me to repurchase. if it wasn’t the price this wouldve easily be 5 stars

I have sensitive combination skin and it’s challenging to find a cleanser that works great for combination skin. I’ve tried so many cleansers and they never work. Either they would dry my skin or made it break out. until I found La mer cleansing foam. It leaves my skin perfect. It balances out the oily part of my skin as well as the dryer side. It has a light pleasant scent , and it makes your skin feel fresh and clean. FYI if you use a little too much it may make skin feel a little dry. Only use about a dime size. A little pricey but it’s worth 100%!!
Great for balancing combination skin. A little bit goes a long way. Love the consistency, and leaves your skin super soft.

This moisturizer definitely lived up to the hype! First off, it has a very pleasant scent that a lot of “unscented” lovers wouldn’t mind. The product was creamy, extremely moisturizing, light/yet fulfilling and a little went a long way! Though this is a pricey moisturizer, you definitely get more bang for your buck. OH, and it leaves your skin dewy, firm and bouncy! You’ll have everyone asking for your skincare routine with this one ☺️

So in love with this Moisturizer from La Mer. It works wonders on my dry skin and I love that it’s made with really good ingredients. It is also paraben free which is a must for face products. I definitely recommend this moisturizer and all of La Mers other skincare products

I received the new moisturizing soft cream  complimentary from La Mer. Ive been using it for about a week and it does make my skin moisturized, it makes it feel hydrated, its very little weight and its probably one of my favorite skin lotions that I’ve tried in a while.
My relationship with la mer is like a marriage now. I refuse to use anything else. Will be using for life. Thank you la mer

I was looking for a replacement for the toner I was using and I decided to try this out. This toner is incredible. Before my skin would have maybe a pimple or two. Now it has been perfectly clear since I started using this toner. It is incredible. I highly recommend trying it out!
You really do get what you pay for. Worth every dime. Results are almost immediate.

If you have oily skin and you’re looking for a reliable moisturizer for deep hydration, this is it! My skin breaks out with most moisturizers but I haven’t had any issues since using this, and my skin is producing less oil now that it’s properly hydrated. I recommend using it as a nighttime mask
This is my go-to mask when my face is dry or has been exposed to too much sun

You need this in your life! I love this. I feel so smooth faced and confident when I apply this.  I don’t wear it for only 8 minutes. I use it for a primer under foundation. Listen: LADIES OVER 35, YOU NEED THIS AS A PRIMER. IT IS EVERYTHING!! it gives me a smooth face,  fills in pores and fine lines. I love it

I read that many girls found this lotion to be greasy and clogs pores.  I still wanted to try it because all I use is La Mer products and found the crème to be too heavy for day time.  So I tried this lotion as soon as I got it and loved it.  The next day I used two pumps, big mistake.  The key to this lotion is to use it very sparingly.  I put it on after my La Mer Treatment lotion while my skin is still damp, that way the lotion gets sucked into my skin immediately.  I love this stuff but you have to experiment with the amount to make it work for you.

I enjoyed this product very much. It had a nice scent but was not very strong. The application was also easy and it did leave my skin feeling moisturized and hydrated. Overall I do recommend this product.

There are some La Mer products that are absolutely, worth the high price point. This is Not one of them. I received it as a luxe sample item, and used it for just over a week. In that short period of time, it has dried out my eye area, making wrinkles more prominent, and caused puffiness, to seem exaggerated. It’s a uniquely bad product that can both dry out and wrinkle, as well as puff up, the area. Steer clear, find something else. This one is a major miss, as La Mer products go.

I really love the way this product makes my skin feel. A little goes a long way which I enjoy in my products, especially my skin care. It’s quite smooth, not tacky, and has a great light scent. I have been using it every day, and I can feel that my skin is noticeably softer.

I almost didn’t want to try or fall in love with La Mer because of the price point. However, this has made a huge impact on my skin. I’ve been using it morning and night for about a week now. My skin is so hydrated and smooth with a visible difference in glow

This is very popular brand. I just wanted to try and it was nothing special. It was very tiny product they sent me. If I use more maybe it will be different. Hard to tell about this product. I saw their ingredients and I didn’t like a fragrance in it.

The moisturizing soft lotion is the perfect lightweight moisturizer. I typically wear the cool gel, but this is perfect for my skin in the winter. This is a favorite that I’ve repurchased many time. Love La Mer!
Safe your Monday ladies ! Cethaphil it’s cheaper and dermatologies recommended . Plus it will leave your skin softer and it don’t smell like Irish Spring soap!

I looked at plenty reviews before purchasing and was still sceptical when putting the cream on. I had just passed 40 and my skin lost a lot of elasticity and my cheeks were tired and drooped. The mask is like a lotion consistency. After exfoliating I put the mask on in the evening bit expected it to work in days not hours. It made my skin soft and hydrated at first but when I woke up WOW! I could not believe how it tightened. Never experienced such results over one night! All the ripples on my face disappeared and it became perfectly plumped! Thank you La Mer! You did it.

I am using it daily about half years and It still get half of the bottle. You can use it a little bit like a soy bean size and get lots of foaming. The smell is really nice and cleaned very nice. When I started to use it, I have already bought another one. That’s how much I love it.

I was worried about spending so much on a product but this stuff is with the hype. It’s an amazing toner and makes my skin look smooth and even. It also works super well as a sheet mask using dry sheet masks or peelable cotton pads. I’m really pleased with this. The price is steep but the product is great.

Wow! I put this cream under my eyes before I went to sleep and when I woke up in the morning my skin looked so fresh there! It looked so soft. I am 25 and I don’t have lots of wrinkles, but the skin under my eyes is very thin and dark. This I felt added some moisture to the area and helped it thicken up in some way!

This Moisturizing Soft Cream was gifted by La Mer for reviewing purposes.  This cream is so soft and luxurious.  It feels very hydrating and makes my skin look soft and supple.  It is light weight and works well under makeup.
Smells soooooooo good and my skin looks so clear after I use it!

Listen, I’m a La Mer devotee. I have six La Mer products in my daily rotation of lotions and potions. So I thought perhaps it was time to use their cleanser as well? Well, it’s mild enough for my sensitive skin, and it’s non-drying and doesn’t leave a creepy residue, but SERIOUSLY? $95 for something that smells like the dispenser soap we used in grade school? I’ll pass. You can do better with a cleanser from literally any other line Sephora sells.
One of my favorite La Mer items. I love to use this after cleansing. I feel like it balances my skin. I Anjou he soft, gentle scent. Very pleasant.

I have combination and sensitive skin and it did not work for me. The smell of the cleanser is like that of a hotel soap. After use, my acne worsened and the skin became redder. I don’t know why so many people rated it as their fav cleanser, definitely not for me, not worth the price.

Love how this absorbed into my skin. Didn’t leave an oily residue! There’s a slight scent to it that reminds me of sunscreen so if you don’t mind that then this should be fine. I probably wouldn’t buy this in the future, given the price point but it is a nice luxurious brand if you’re willing to splurge!

Sooo holy wow! This product is expensive - but boy does it feel luxurious. First off - the smell is amazing. Not too overpowering, but there. The texture is silky smooth. I have been using it on my neck at night, and when I wake up - it feels super soft and silky. Definitely a luxury product but worth it!

I’ve never tried La Mer but several friends rave about it. I already have a beauty regimen I love but have been looking for a great lip plumber so thought I’d try the brand. Omg- what a disappointment!!! This product did absolutely nothing. I’ve had more results from the $5 stuff at Ulta :( I will be returning.

I know it’s expensive. But it’s genuinely the best. After 2 weeks my face never looked and felt so smooth. Also it blurs a little. Sometimes I’ll put it on just by itself in the morning and just put on a tiny bit of powder. Usually though this is a part of my nighttime skin routine. The cost hurts me too. But it’s my face. And my face is priceless lol. If you want anything from la mer. This is what you want. I’m afraid to try their moisturizer because if I like it as much as this product I’m doomed. This mini lasts a while too if you use the appropriate amount.

I don’t know how I missed this (actually I do, because WTH?) but you can not use this facial cleansing foam on the eye area. This makes no sense, as it’s intended to be used to clean your face. Other than that, it’s just meh, no better or worse than any of the other pricey washes I’ve used.

Worth every penny! I have been dealing with a perioral dermatitis flare up for the last two months, and after a few days of using the tonic my skin is finally calming down and healing itself. I also notice the rest of my face is more hydrated and actually glowing! Love this product.
This is the perfect sunscreen for underneath any makeup. I did not burn. Another plus is that it does not give a white cast. It melted into my skin and you can’t even tell I have sunscreen on.

I‘m a man with seb dermatitis and moderate acne; I’ve been looking for a luxury cream without the oil content that would flare up those conditions. This is certainly luxurious. It smells and feels amazing, and doesn’t seem to aggravate my seb derm or break me out. Skin certainly feels very smooth and hydrated throughout the day. A lot of skincare junkies will drag jar packaging, but from all the research I’ve done, the preservatives in the formula will more than protect against bacterial growth, and I bought extra spatulas online to avoid dunking my fingers.It’s obviously very expensive, so I bought the large during the VIB sale to maximize value. I really like it, but once I get through this jar I may continue searching for something closer to the $100 range.

I got a free sample with my purchase. I expect the same result as La mer original cream, sadly I can’t like it. I got a really terrible break out. I love original one and I will stick with it. No more adventure.
Upon opening the cream, found 2 small pieces of hair on the inner lid……..

This moisturizer has such a hydrating and skin plumping feel to it which makes it a great option for people who have dehydrated skin like I do. It makes my skin soft and doesn’t feel heavy at all! The only thing I don’t really like is the price for the amount you get but this definitely feels luxurious.

I only bought this because I had gift cards and thought I’d treat myself since I would never spend this much money. Since it received so many positive reviews I was expecting a lot, but after using it for weeks I’m not sure it’s any better than cheaper products. It does not irritate my skin, so that’s a plus, but other than that I would not buy it at full price myself.

My mom is a huge La Mer fan, and as such I got a bottle of this from her. It’s not bad but I’m not sure it really did anything for my skin honestly and stings when I put it on. I did not end up finishing the bottle she gave me and will not be purchasing for myself.

I’ve always wanted to try this product to see if it lives up to the price point. When applying on the face it feels super creamy, thick and almost silky on the skin. However I really can’t get past the smell, almost smells like a baby product. I loved how my skin felt but I can say I wouldn’t reach for it over and over

I have combination skin (more oily) and this left my skin very dry, which was incredibly surprising to me. I used it twice to be sure and I had to return it. The smell wasn’t luxurious, it smelled like hand soap. I was disappointed in this specific product.

This is the best moisturizer I have used in a long time. I have combination, sensitive and also acne prone skin and many products (especially moisturizers and foundations) break me out. At the beginning I tried La Mer Original Moisturizer, then Soft Creme and they both broke me out. Then I tried Soft Lotion and to my surprise my skin actually improved, all acne disappeared and my skin felt so smooth, soft and clear! I couldn’t believe the difference. I know this is expensive moisturizer but I would pay anything just keep my skin beautiful and clear. I wish I tried this moisturizer earlier - I was lucky I got three samples of it from Bloomingdales (unfortunately they don’t give you La Mer samples at Sephora), used for over a month and now I’m going to buy full size from Sephora.

i wanted to like this and i wanted it to work, i was really looking for something to help the bags under my eyes. i used this consistently without any change for 6 weeks. it is VERY overpriced for the lack of results.

Another great lotion by this brand. I have been using these products for a little while now and this lotion is one of my favorites. I love the way it makes my skin feel and I can see a noticeable difference in my texture. It has a great, light scent that I enjoy, but doesn’t cause irritation on my sensitive skin. I look forward to using it every day.

This moisturizer is not what I expected. It’s very lightweight but super nourishing. The main complaint I have is the strong fragrance. It’s very overpowering. Also, the price is absurd. This is hundreds of dollars. I will be skipping this one in the future.

This is not for folks with normal skin that want a “cooling effect“ in the summer! You will not get the results you expect.This moisturizer is meant for acne prone or oily skin that can’t take heavy product in warmer climate. With that being said, I’m one of the few that hated the original formula! It literally did nothing for me so I just used the original in the winter and skipped La Mer in warmer weather bc my skin couldn’t take it. However, this new formula works wonders and, I can truly say, it feels like the lighter equivalent of the original! After just one use my skin is completely smooth, the few bumps I had disappeared, and my skin was so soft, I couldn’t stop touching it, with the back of my hand of course! There is a technique to using all La Mer moisturizers and the little spoon it comes with will help ensure you don’t use too much at once. I also only use as a night cream bc #1) you should be using a moisturizer with SPF in the day time and #2) you will get clogged skin if you use this under the sun!!

I dont understand the low ratings for this moisturizer. It is absolutely amazing. It has made my skin extremely soft and hydrated without feeling oily or sticky. I have combination acne prone skin and so far this has not made me break out. Also, sephora should be giving out samples for La mer, instead of customers buying and returning. This is one La mer item I will be buying consistently. Try it out!

I was kindly given this from a friend who found it too rich/greasy, and after sampling La Mer’s Matte Lotion in the past, which was good but not hydrating enough, I wanted to see if this delivered the right amount of moisture for my oily-dehydrated skin type. The moisturizer comes in simple but attractive packaging, as with most of La Mer’s products, and features a pump dispenser - perfect for protecting the ingredients. The cream consistency itself is quite thick, and it says the best way to apply it is to pat some gently onto cleansed skin, so I usually do this morning and night. In all honesty, I found it much more moisturizing than their Matte Lotion, however, I too have felt my face to be noticeably greasier by the end of the day, which from an expensive moisturizer, is not ideal. I was hoping this would be a middle ground between the Matte and the Crème itself, but this definitely veers more towards the richness of the Crème. I also tried using it just on a night but still found it too heavy and that it still doesn’t seem to sink in. On the plus side, it has brightened my skin and given it a radiant glow which wasn’t there before. As with all Crème De La Mer products, the cream features the key ingredient Miracle Broth: a mixture of sea kelp, vitamins, and minerals, and probably in part responsible for the hefty price tag. However, if it cannot control my oily areas and only add to my skin woes then I would not be repurchasing this.~ My Sephora Top 7 must-have list ~(My top 7 must-have beauty products of all time, focusing mainly on my purchases at Sephora)1. Pigmentation + Anti-Aging Serum: ‘Divine Herbal’ - Facial Treatment Serum5. Face Scrub: ‘Sisley’ - Botanical Gentle Buffing Cream6. Lip Balm: ‘Nuxe’ – Reve De Miel Lip Balm7.Lip Liner: ‘Sephora Collection’ - Rouge Gel Lip Liner

There are a few products that I cannot be without, and this moisturizer is one of them.  I received a deluxe sample of this and my oily/sensitive skin has never looked better.  I have been using this product for almost a year, and love how it gives my skin that fresh dewy appearance that I’m after, without causing breakouts.  The price tag is steep, but a jlo glow makes it worth it for me.  ;)

The moisturizer gives me even softer skin when I layer it on top. My face literally went from being oily, but dry, to feeling like a baby’s butt. Not kidding even a little bit. I use a lot of la Mer products now but this was the first one I started with that led me snowballing into bankruptcy.. but all jokes aside these products are worth every penny. I’ve tried maybe 12 LA Mer products so far and the only thing I think was a miss is the lip balm, the gloss one is pretty, but the lip products are not better than my Laneige lip mask.
Loved the way it felt going on, but had bumps on my skin within a couple of days of using it. Love and use other la Mer products daily, this one is not for me. Returned.

I’ve always heard a lot of mixed reviews about La Mer and obviously with their products tending to be super pricey I never wanted to risk it. I was in the market for a new night time toner and was feeling a little bougie (LOL) so I tried this on a whim...I really like it so far!  I’ve been alternating between this and the La Mer Treatment Lotion (which I 100% adore). I have 2 different night time routines I rotate between every other week so I like to use this Tonic on the week I use my more intense products because it’s light weight and allows the “heavier“ products to sink in properly plus it leaves my skin feeling super soft. I took a star off because while I’m enjoying it right now and it does play well with my other skin care...on it’s own, it’s not anything spectacular in my opinion, so I’m not totally convinced it’s worth the $100 price tag.  I’m sure if I search I could find a toner that works just as well for far less but all in all it is a nice toner.
The packaging is great, but not a fan of the this product
A nourishing oil, but it’s too small and not magical enough to be worth the price
A little pricey but a little goes a long way! Skin soaks it right up but leaves it soft and hydrated. There’s something about a thick moisturizer that goes on so nicely!

Savior for my dry skin! I have very dry skin and I live in Florida so the humidity does help some. I went to Georgia in the winter to visit my parents in the cold that always dries my face out terribly. This time I brought this cleanser and it was absolutely amazing it felt very luxurious and didn’t dry my skin at all. It was the first time I’ve been to visit my mom in the winter that my face didn’t get chapped. If you have dry skin I highly recommend.

This moisturizing cream complimentary from La Mer is so good! It is very light-weight and a little goes a long way. I love the way this leaves my skin feeling so soft and smooth. I would recommend this!

This moisturizing soft cream is a must have! It is extremely lightweight and a little goes a long way. It has a light scent that smells very fresh! I have combination skin and have recently been battling some breakouts. Since using this, my skin is well moisturized, the overall texture is smoother, and my breakouts have been healing really well! I personally use this day & night!

This moisturizing gel cream is absolutely wonderful! The formula is very lightweight and slightly cooling when applied to the skin. A little goes a long way with this product and it keeps my skin feeling comfortable and hydrated all day! There is a light powdery fragrance to but it does disappear after just a few minutes of wear. After just one week of use my skin feels and looks amazing! The price point is a little high in comparison to other gel creams but I really do see a difference in my skin!

Pricey, but definitely moisturizes your skin! A little goes a long way with this product, so a thin layer really leaves you skin supple and hydrated. It pairs well under makeup after your morning skincare.

I enjoyed this lotion it is very hydrating and leaves my skin feeling nice. Although for this price range I don’t think i would purchase it. I would just purchase a less expensive product that does the same thing.

I’d been curious about this - so a Sephora employee dug out a a deluxe sample for me. It was love at first application. It sunk right in —and brought my skin back to life - like I am perfectly hydrated from water consumption. I use this at night over stronger treatments or alone. I also pop this on when I’ve got a touch of a hangover or just got off a plane and my skin is dry and cranky.  I’ve never wiped this off as directed — it sinks in so quickly - I just let the miracle broth work it’s magic. I finally splurged for the full size during the Rouge sale.

Meh. The small size is priced at $55, and the amount of product is too small to reliably remove makeup everyday. I ran too quickly to justify the price and the inconvenience of having to re-purchase all the time. I think it would be best used along with a makeup removing balm. It does not sting though, and even when my skin felt burned/dehydrated during the retinoid purging process, it was super gentle and hydrating.

Broke me OUT! I do NOT have sensitive skin and this literally gave me sooooo many acne spots the very next morning after using it the night before. It’s been over three almost four weeks now and the scars are still slowly fading away. It took the first two weeks to buy and figure out how to treat them because I’ve NEVER had to deal such bad deep breakouts. Horrible, horrible, horrible! I think the fact that it had fragrance in it really broke me out badly! Either way this product was an obvious hard PASS!

I love this version of La Mer for my summertime moisturizer! It’s lightweight & absorbs quickly not to mention the wonderful fresh scent. I can’t understand why some reviews are saying it’s greasy. Either they’re using too much or applying it incorrectly. La Mer products are to be used sparingly with a certain “patting” motion to apply. I suggest googling it if you’re new to La Mer in order to reap the benefits.

This product is definitely worth the hype. It has transformed my skin in just a few days of using. I have dry skin and this product really nourishes my skin all day. It is very pricey but if you’re able to get your hands on it, it’s definitely worth it.

I have been using La Mer products for years & this is the worst that I have run across. Don’t waste your money on this product. It leaves a textured residue I had to rinse it off immediately. Disappointing

a little goes a long way, with intensive moisture all the way! this is what my skin needs as i’m starting to get fine lines on my forehead and have an 11 wrinkle. this locks in moisture all day so those wrinkles and fine lines don’t get dried out or irritated. non-greasy, not heavy, yet oh so heavenly! i wish i could bathe in this product!!

I used this for a week in Hawaii, and did not burn, freckle, or have any other unwanted display of spots. I picked this up on a whim in a duty free shop. I. Love. This. Stuff. It spreads like a lotion, doesn’t leave a white film, absorbs fairly well, and doesn’t look greasy. And best of all, it’s effective. I am in my 40’s with fair, easily burned skin. I’ve tried Sheseido, Clinique, Aveeno, Neutrogena...this is the BEST I have used. The price is no joke and so it won’t be an option for everyone. But if you have the means, this is an excellent choice.
Weightless. Doesn’t smell and doesn’t feel sticky. Feels great on my skin as almost every La Mer product. Worth the price!
Love this product. It is a bit pricey. But makes my skin feel amazing

I received this moisturizer complimentary from La Mer. This is a great moisturizer and a little definitely goes a long way. It doesn’t go on greasy and is light weight. Not a thick moisturizer at all. Not much of a scent either.

Instead of lifting or firming, this mask does the best job at repairing/rescuing your skin when it’s in trouble. Say if you’re having a serious allergic reaction to certain skincare products, which happens to a lot of sensitive skin when trying out new products, or you’re experiencing a huge breakout, or you’re just trying to recover your skin from a day of exposing under the sun, this product will do an amazing job if not the best. However, like I mentioned before, it doesn’t work very well as a lifting and firming mask. When it comes to anti-aging, there are a lot of brands that are better than La Mer, since it focuses on repairing. If you’re looking for a mask that can rescue your problematic skin in no time, this is the one!

Just what my skin needed. Lamer gifted me this product and I couldn’t be more in love with it. After been using it for a week my skin feels like porcelain again , smooth and glowing .Recommended 100% . Don’t walk , run and get it

this was the best lotion i’ve ever tried, and i wish i could use this more often because the results with one night use are incredible. now i know why it’s a favorite for celebrities. it has a faint fragrance but nothing overwhelming.

I am absolutely loving this cleanser! It feels luxurious and works really well with my Clarisonic, and cleans without stripping my face dry. The price is definitely up there, however you only need a pea sized amount of product, so the tube will last a while. There is a slight scent but it doesn’t linger. The directions are correct - avoid getting the product in your eyes - it’ll sting!

There is no argument La Mer products have the luxurious feel! The moisturizing lotion smells like a spa and is lightweight but hydrating. I don’t like to use fragranced products on my face due to sensitive skin so I prefer this one as a hand cream and I think there are similar but more affordable products on the market.
I didn’t even try the sample size first. I went ahead and got a full bottle and it worked out for me. I like this face cleanser a lot. and I will probably buy it again.

Wanted to hate this product but it’s so amazing you can’t help but love it!!!! It leaves your skin so soft. And who doesn’t love a mask that you don’t have to wash off????? Now I just have to muster up the courage to buy the full size!!!! If it wasn’t so expensive I would already have it ❤️❤️

Hands down the best moisturizer I have ever used! So silky smooth and hydrating. You only need a pea size amount and a little goes a long way. My skin is typically very dry and irritated by the end of the day and this moisturizer helps relieve my skin. It does have a small scent to it, but didn’t seem overwhelming.This item is a splurge but will last you a while!

Nice consistency to use. Not sticky or too thick. It gives a nice shine to my lips, slight plumping effect.  Feels minty when applied but not overwhelming. It forms a layer of protection on the lips. Can wear off after a few hours but it helps keep lips moisturized under face mask well. Although I think it is just a tad light for an overnight lip balm.
I personally love it. I love the feel of the gel cream as it is light and not too thick. Using La Mer is such a treat.

This moisturizes around the eyes but doesn’t do a whole lot else. And I prefer the texture of the eye concentrate. The texture of this feels chalky to me for whatever reason. I do appreciate that this isn’t heavily scented like most other la mer products but that I guess is it’s only redeeming quality.
I came here just to state that upon first seeing this pop up in my feed u thought it was a screwdriver.

Leaves your skin very soft and for me didn’t make it break out like my previous product did.  And a little goes a long way so even though it’s on the pricier side I think the tube will last a long time - maybe 8 months or so.
This stuff is amazing. Can instantly feel the lifting...definitely would buy again. Just hate that it’s so expensive! Plus the eye cream as well...an arm and a leg for just the eyes alone.

This moisturizing soft cream is just that!! Nice and rich but still lightweight on the skin. My skin feels hydrated and soft making it a perfect base for my makeup. There is a powdery fragrance to it. Just be aware if you are sensitive to fragrance! Overall, this is a great cream and a little goes a long way!

This is the most hydrating and light weight moisturizer i’ve ever used. I love that a little goes a long way. My skin feels so moisturized and supple after application. Definitely recommend. complimentary from la mer

I’m so amazed at just how soft this makes my skin! It’s incredibly moisturizing and I only need to apply a small amount to completely transform how my face looks and feels. I will absolutely be using this to prep my skin for my wedding!

I have extremely sensitive skin and this scrub didn’t irritate my skin.  I only use it once a week after cleansing my skin at the end of taking my shower so I don’t wash away the oils from the product.  I feel it isn’t necessary to moisturize after using the scrub.

As a long time fan of La Mer, I was thrilled to be gifted this product by the brand. It is just as amazing as I remember…the lightest texture, but a little goes a long way, so it really will last. My skin is so dry from city/desert air, and I immediately feel relief from that with this product.
Love it. First time use, it drys out my cheek, but after several times use, I feel clean and comfort. Great product, but a little pricey.

Love this exfoliator!! I feel like I’m at the spa everytime i use this and I actually love the smell of this although I know many people find it very unpleasant from some of the reviews I’ve read on the La Mer website. Everything about it is luxurious and divine. It’s pretty expensive but a little bit really goes a long way and I only use it about 1-3 times a week, so it’ll last me a while! My skin feels amazing after and I don’t feel like its stripping away my skin. Just amazing and will definitely repurchase again!

I love this moisturizer! I have been using it for years- I love how lightweight it is and that such a little goes a long way! It brings my dull skin back to life! After I use it my skin feels plump and looks glowy

I had avoided getting this because of the negative reviews until I went to a La Mer counter and tried it for myself. I am so glad that I did! I love it as much as my Tatcha Water Cream and Belif Aqua Bomb. These are the moisturizers I keep buying for daily use. I have oily skin, I swear you could fry an egg using all the oil I could produce! Lol. But seriously, remember people everyone is different! Just because it doesn’t work for somebody, doesnt mean it will be an epic failure for you too!

This moisturizer is soo nourishing for my dry combo skin. I’ve never had such a glow from a product. I can’t wait to to keep incorporating this into my every day skin care routine. I probably won’t use this every day but cycle it every 2 days.
Good product. Not creamy at all.

I was disappointed. I wanted to love this but, first of all the smell of the lotion was extremely potent and gave me a headache which I am prone to. When I put it on I used a pea size squeeze and made sure to be gentle and even. I waited for the instant feel of hydration almost 10 mins :) I didnt feel very hydrated for the price of 200 my face better feel something immediately. I wanted to love this but, not worth the money. More to come on the eye concentrate.
I can’t live without this plain and simple I love this. I use a few times a week and it’s such a soft exfoliating oil like no other!! You have to try you won’t want to live without this!!!!
I used this lotion on a few dry patches starting around my nose and face. It helped blur the flakiness and redness. A little goes a long way! The consistency is on the thicker side.

I love this brand overall.  The scent is so nice and light, smells so good.  Super light lotion that makes my skin feel really soft, and has a nice matting so that I can still use makeup over it.  Doesn’t feel greasy or tacky like other have.  Love it, but I don’t know if I could afford to keep purchasing.
This is great in the shower. Very refreshing and light scent. Would highly recommend.

Great alternative to the original. I love that this version is lightweight but still hydrating. I used it at the end of my PM routine and it absorbed so nicely! Plus, the scent isn’t as strong, which I prefer. It left my skin looking smooth and moisturized in the morning.
I love this stuff and anything La Mer! I’m almost 40,  and people think I’m 28-29. Love it!
Great for oily skin! It instantly matte’s your skin for the entire day without needing to reapply! Highly recommend!
good but run out too fast
It is drying on my combination skin and my cheeks feel tight and dry. good thing I tried the small size first. I like the texture and the subtle scent but I will look further.
Didn’t plump or add volume. Was temporarily moisturizing but needed to be reapplied often

I got a deluxe sample of this and have been using it twice a day for three weeks.  Follow with Drunk Elephant B-Hydra serum in the morning and follow with La Mer moisturizing cream at night.  Since adding this serum to my routine my skin looks and feels great.  No more dry cheeks and tightness this winter.  Fine lines are also gone.  Have to bite the bullet and buy the full size.

I’ve always struggled with finding matte moisturizers suitable for my combo skin, as I either find them not moisturizing enough or not matte enough. This product erased both of those concerns. It is moisturizing but keeps the oil around my tzone at bay. While I do need to reapply powder after 6 or so hours, I definitely notice it keeps my tzone matte for much longer than other comparable products I have tested in the past.
Best!!!!i am using it day and night!!!
I have no idea how this mask does what it does, but wow. It actually works. Results are immediate but, of course, temporary. It says you can leave the mask on as a moisturizer, & I always do.

This gloss has been perfect for me.  I love the mint taste, it isn’t too heavy and moisturizers for hours. As I get older I see my lips aren’t as full as they used to be and this brings my lips back 10 years - it makes them look slightly fuller and younger.
I love, love, love this sunscreen!  It doesn’t dry out my skin or clog the pores.  I wear it every day!

I was really loving this mask but have decided I like the SK11 facial treatment mask better. This mask tends to dry out sooner on my face where as the SK11 one stays nice and moist for longer making me feel like the product has more time to sink in and the mask doesn’t end up sucking moisture out of my skin in the end which is how this la mer mask makes me feel. I’ve repurchased this several times but I don’t think I will nearly as often now. I’ll get this one here and there Just to have a nice variety for my face but it’s not a must have anymore.

This is my go-to cleanser. I enjoy the light fragrance and it leaves my face clean and refreshed. I knocked it down a star for being somewhat drying.  I only use this a few times a week, and only a pea-size amount.  The rest of the week I cleanse with the La Mer Micellar cleansing water. I read another reviewer who commented on the instruction to avoid the eyes. As I understand La Mer reps only recommend products specifically formulated for the eye area to be used around the eyes period. Which in this regiment is the Micellar water for cleansing.
I did not see any difference after using this product
i got a sample of this from La Mer! I have to say it does get rid of the puffiness in your eyes! My eyes don’t get puffy! but this did hydrate my eyes! So i would say it works!

This is not my first La Mer product. I currently use the Cleansing Oil (which is amazing) and the Treatment Lotion. This gel cream is terrible. I put this on at night, and in the morning, I woke to a face that had 27 pimples. Yes, 27. Today, Sephora just posted the full ingredients list, which was not included with the deluxe sample. (The sample said to see the salable product for ingredients.) Cyclopentasiloxane and I do not get along, and this cream is packed with it. It’s mostly a bunch of slippery, pore clogging silicones. If you like silicone based products, then this is for you. If not, then stay far away. This line has a few standout products, but this is NOT one of them, in my experience.

This moisturizer is very light weight! A watery cream consistency. Very lightly scented. It has a slightly fresh powdery smell. It’s mattifying when my skin is oily but also hydrating. A little product covers the surface area of my face. Approximately a pea sized drop on each check and forehead does the trick. No sticky or greasy finish!

I just came back from Hawaii and used this daily for my face and when I returned home, people said I didn’t get tan on my face (more on my arms). This is a pretty good investment if you don’t want too much sun on your face. i have tried to find light weight sun block for the face (my pores will sweat if the product is too heavy). This will give a slight shine after you put it on (it has a slight glitter in it).
Extremely greasy. Had to wash off after 20 minutes.
I wish I could find a cheaper alternative, but despite trying many others (including as expensive) this is the best for my skin (combination). Light, smooth, non greasy, smells divine. Just perfect.

Gel creams normally do not work well for my skin but this one is so nice that I cannot deny how much I love it. However, a huge drawback is how little you get for the price. I just can’t justify spending the money.

There are a few of the La Mer products that I consider indispensable, but this is not one of them.  For $90 I was expecting something really special.  It’s micellar water.  It’s very hydrating.  It removes all my makeup.  It does exactly what it is supposed to do.  But there is no way to justify this price, even for a frivolous shopper like me.  There are SO many great micellar options out there for a fraction of the price.

Love this cleaning form !! My skin feel so soft and smooth, I’m also use The lotion treatment and the moisturizing cream after cleaning form  I’m so happy that I decided to purchased Lammer products it’s an expensive but it lasted long time you only need a little bit !!

I have always wanted to try La Mer. This is one of the most iconic eye creams. So I splurged when Sephora started carrying La Mer and I am so happy I did. A tiny tiny bit covers under both eyes. This product is very creamy and luxurious. It is worth the splurge and now a staple product for me. I use it at night only as I think for myself it is just a tiny bit too creamy for under makeup. It really feels hydrating and leaves no white bumps or greasy feel. I love this stuff and suggest giving i a try!
Great prep for my serum and moisturizer! Leaves my skin feeling so resilient and hydrated.

A little moisturizer goes a long way! I’m always concerned with dry skin! And this moisturizer really hydrated and moisturized my skin! Perfect for travel size and fits in your bag, keep dry skin at bay. Highly recommend!

I’ve been using this for a week and it’s amazing. I have been using various sunscreens daily for over 10 years. This one so far had blow me away. Does not pill, weightless and no white cast. I waited too long to buy this but it’s so worth it

Complete waste of $!  I saw no improvement what so ever. I’m 48. Puffiness is a big problem for me.  I’ve tried countless eye creams.   I tried this due to all the positive reviews.   I hope to save someone else from making the same mistake.
Favourite cleanser ever! Balances skin, keeps it clear of imperfections and leaves skin soft. Been using this foam cleanser for two years and I will never go without it. Worth the price.

This product is amazing! I had very high expectations and they were met since I already love the brand. The feel is very light and smooth on my skin and I cannot wait to use this in my daily ski care routine.

This was the first La Mer product I purchased. This product is so wonderful. It’s moisturizing and leaves my skin feeling refreshed and soft. There is no overwhelming smell. I can tell when I forget to use this because my skin feels drier and dull. It comes with an applicator and you can watch YouTube videos of how to apply the cream. I purchased this in April 2017 and I am just now running very low. This product is worth its money because a little goes a long way and it is so good for your skin. I fell in love with this brand so much that I have expanded my La Mer collection quite a bit. People always tell me I have nice skin and I tell them it’s because I use La Mer products. To replace this, I just ordered the Eye Concentrate for my dark circles. I would recommend this to any age group.

I was super happy with this product! I have combination skin and found it worked well with that type! It was light weight and absorbed fast, I hate it feeling oily on my skin. I felt hydrated all day and my skin looked super healthy!

This moisturizer is very luxurious. It has a nice lightweight  texture, its very hydrating, and goes on well . It makes my face feel soft and moisturized. I can’t say if its worth the crazy price though, as you can get similar results with another good moisturizer. Overall, a little goes a long way and it does keep your skin soft and hydrated so if you can afford it, this would be a good choice as a winter moisturizer!

I was ecstatic when I found out La Mer was releasing sheet masks. Especially of the treatment lotion, which is my favorite product from La Mer. I really like these masks. Really hydrating. Only problem is there is SO much treatment lotion in this mask, that I have a hard time finding places to on my skin to rub it. I rub it over arms, neck, and squeeze every last drop out. You get a lot out of this mask. Really nice, love it.

This is my can’t live with out product - seriously, I have traveled before without taking the big bottle on the plane, and my skin was a wreck after just a few days without using it. I have super sensitive, oily skin with rosacea - yay me! EVERYTHING irritates my skin, but not this. I use it with an exfoliating cotton pad every time I wash my face - it removes makeup residue or just dirt, and hydrated and calms my skin! Worth every penny!

This does what it says it does, it hydrates really well, I don’t know if it’s worth the price as I have other products that do the same thing for much less but if you want to splurge do it. Only bad thing is I don’t love the smell and I find it leave a bit of  tacky feeling, although it’s not a problem for me because I layer a different serum on top it might be for some people.

Overall, I really enjoyed using this matte moisture lotion made my skin look really great with and without make up on it didn’t leave my face to dry. I would definitely recommend this to a friend. 10/10

It moisturized my eye area without causing irritation but it did nothing for my dark circles and I’m not sure it did any significant de-puffing but those have been long term issues for meI won’t repurchase

I was hesitant to buy this because of the price and negative reviews I read. I have to say it has done miracles to my skin within 2 weeks of using it along with the La Mer treatment lotion. I have a skin picking disorder and I’ve always had ugly scars, dark spots on my face, huge pores and some acne due to picking. My skin has aged so much over the years and I’m only 22 years old, it’s sad. Today my skin is glowing and my pores look way smaller, scars are finally fading away. I literally couldn’t believe my eyes when I stood in front of the mirror this morning, for the first time in 14 years I see an improvement on my skin! I tried other similar products, the “best” out there with no luck. This might not make a difference for you if you’re skin is not damaged, but mine really really was. I’m forever thankful for La Mer!

A little goes a long way with the gorgeous product so this will last you and is worth the investment! After rubbing it between my fingers, I press it into my skin and my skin has a dewy glow to it. The hydration stays with me all day! I never feel like it’s too heavy and it’s great for warm climates.

This cleanser is amazing! I wear a ton of makeup and I find it hard to get off, even after double cleansing.  I use a pea size of this and foams beautifully and really spreads out.  It removes everything. I have dry and oily skin it balances both.  This tiny tube lasts me for weeks.  And it smells clean.

I unfortunately love this oil. I have always wanted to try la mer and decided for the Sephora sale to get the mini before spending on the full size but I will absolutely be purchasing it. The mini even will last a long time. Ive used it morning and night for the past two weeks and it still looks full. You just need 3-4 drops and press into your skin. It does not make you super oily it absorbs right in and leaves the best glow. I have super dry but breakout prone skin and this does not break me out. I can’t remember the last time my skin was so hydrated and stayed hydrated all day long. It’s a cult favorite for a reason.
Honestly not worth the price, but it does lift and firm the under eye area. Use this with the matching eye cream.

NOT WORTH THE MONEY. La Mer is supposed to be miraculous, but fell far short of its promise. Instead of revived eyes (or at least moisturized), I got flaky skin. I returned the product and bought something else. Save yourself the hassle and skip this.

The Moisturizing Matte Lotion has a beautiful and lightweight texture. A little goes a long way, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t feel sticky on the skin. Make my skin soft and hydrated. It’s perfect for oily skin because doesn’t feel heavy at all. It has an overpowering scent for my acne-prone skin. It’s a great lotion but not my favorite.

I wanted to love this product, but when I realized it has eucalyptus oil in it, I just couldn’t. Eucalyptus, or any mint oil, or camphor- the worst, actually does the opposite of moisturizing, and it dries out the top layer of lip skin, causing more chapping and peeling. Additionally, look at all of the ingredients! Way too many unnatural ingredients going onto lips, which go into the mouth, which end up in your system. You really are better off with an inexpensive Shea butter lip treatment, that moisturizes and protects, with few ingredients.

I rarely find a product that actually does what it advertises so I’m really shocked.  I received a mini sample of this as one of my free samples with a previous order.  It was literally a little tube with a few drops in it and I saw a difference in the fine lines around my nose.  I’ve always had chubby cheeks and as I get older, my cheeks are drooping a little and fine lines are forming from my nose in a downward direction along my cheeks.  I’ve used a tiny drop each morning and night for about a week until I ran out of my sample and I can actually see a reduction in the lines.  I’m completely shocked and happy to have found something that works.

This product was gifted to me in exchange for my honest opinion. This cream made my skin feel so plump and smooth which was surprising for how light weight it is. I don’t love the scent because it is a little powdery which I don’t typically like but it is very subtle and the smell doesn’t linger enough to bother me.
La mer has the BEST products and this eye cream doesn’t disappoint. It’s super cooling and makes a visible difference. I’ve been using it for years!

I have been using every week and am almost done with my first tub (1.7 oz). I love the brush and how the mask feels when I first apply but I don’t really notice and difference and the mask is quite pricey. Also, it states to leave on and the mask sometimes irritates my eye area. I won’t be repurchasing. I feel like their are other products that show results faster and are much cheaper. I wouldn’t recommend.
Quite nice, very moisturizing. I saw results in a couple days, my skin looks like glass. I would definitely recommend as a first product from La Mer.
Skin feels squeaky clean after every wash. It’s a bit drying so watch out if you have dry skin in the winter. I have oily skin so I enjoy this all year long.
Works great. I was hoping to like thus & I really do.
I loved this product. Thank you for the fast delivery.

I’m convinced that La Mer is magic.  I have aging, oily, acne prone skin.  Since my first sample of Crème de La Mer I’ve been adding La Mer to my skin care.  I’ll never give it up.  When I added the Lifting and Firming Mask to my routine I was blown away.  My skin has never looked better in my life.  Blemishes  heal almost overnight even they even appear at all.  This stuff is amazing.  I do add my Crème de La Mer over the top so I’m sure that’s part of it all but, this is a game changer for me.

This is a lux brand and great for pamping yourself. But I say if you can’t afford it, it’s not so extraordinary to splurge on. You can splurge on something not as expensive with the same results. I however love the brand, so I’m willing to spend my money on it. My skin does like it, but I wouldn’t say it is a holy grail item, I do recommend though for people who can care freely purchase this cleanser. It rinses cleanly and doesn’t strip the skin, has a nice scent and a little goes a long way.
