Instantly plumps your skin and gives a healthy look to your skin. My bottle had a slight alcoholic smell in it but didn’t dry me out nor had it listed in the ingredient list. I’m obsessed with this serum and have been for a long time!

I had been using the old gel and was worried buying the new one (last year) due to the reviews.  This does not give any cooling effect which is good and hydrates me just the same - i am happy but there was no need to change it

This is hands down my holy grail cleanser. I have tried almost every cleanser for combination/oily skin just to find a backup for if this is sold out or ever not in my budget, I can’t even find a backup. It’s the only thing that thoroughly cleanses my skin and that keeps me from breaking out. This, the toner, and the gel cream *chefs kiss*
doesn’t leave white mask on your face, doesn’t peel, can be mixed with any ingredients, doesn’t roll even on niacinamide.. ony of my fav!

This sunscreen is the best high end sunscreen, and I have tried all kinds, lower price point, middle and high. I always come back to this one. It does not leave a white cast, it won’t cause breakouts. It leaves skin feeling moisturized while not being heavy or hard to blend into your skin. There is a reason it’s constantly sold out. The price is not friendly, but a little goes a long way.

Got a free trial size of this....have always wanted to try a product from La Mer. #1, this trial size is simply the smallest jar I have ever received, it’s like miniature trial size....#2, probably one of the best creams I have used....and I’ve used many.  My skin is dry in the morning and oily starting mid day, I have occasional breakouts, and sensitive skin. I have been using as little of this cream as possible every morning to try and make it last as long as possible. I have no issues with being oily, maybe a little blot around 3ish, but nothing like I have had in the past.  The smell is like waking in a flower shop filled with roses. Love it. If I could spend $300+ on just ONE product, this would be it.
Not for sensitive skin! I had a terrible tingling sensation after trying this on some areas!

Who doesn’t love a good Moisturizer!! I struggle with dry skin and always have a hard time finding a really good moisturizer! This one might be it for me! My skin loves it and so do I! Highly recommend!

I’m enjoying this cleanser. It foams up nicely yet doesn’t strip my skin or make it feel dry. It doesn’t leave any residue behind. It manages to be calming and nourishing while making my face feel super clean. I use this in the morning as it’s not ideal to use it on your eyes. The best part is that this mini lasts a long time. When I compare to Fresh Soy, this lasts much longer.

I’m a big fan of the original Creme de la Mer and the soft moisturizer- they’d been my go-to for couple of years in winter while I lived in NYC. I bought this lotion for warmer weather, but it’s heavy & oily for summer days and dry for fall. I can get better summer moisturizer at a much lower price.Also, La Mer doesn’t have container recycle program which is super annoying to me.
My skin feels INCREDIBLE after each use! I wish I could use it everyday; it feels so luxurious!

i received a small sample for free and this was my first time trying la mer. considering the price point i wasn’t too impressed with the product itself.. i feel like the the type of resultsi received it wasn’t worth splurging

Was skeptical, weary of the price point, but read 1 Review which especially caught me eye. Having a particular health issue which causes excessive eye puffiness, I purchased based on someone else’s comment that nothing really helped her in the past, except this one. This product most definitely has helped me, and I was spending about the same amount in other eye products. This does dry me out somewhat, having to add back additional hyaluronic acid, however the puffiness is greatly reduced.
For the price, I’d say there’s nothing special about this hydrating serum. You might as well buy a serum with a high percentage of hyaluronic acid in it.

I bought this from the La Mer website but I  came on here just to write a review. I cant believe how amazing this stuff is! Its magic in a tube. I have really bad textured acne prone skin and this stuff has turned my skin around! My scars are fading and my skin is glowing. My pores are smaller and my skin looks smoother. Ive been wearing this everyday for a week now, sometimes twice a day and the difference is incredible. Definitely going to repurchase! I highly recommend to anyone with troubled skin!

i wish i didn’t love this as much as i did because it’s truly that good! i’ve used it on nights where i’m “treating myself” and mixed in with my foundation for a luminous, natural glow. truly worth the splurge!

I have an extensive moisturizing routine when it comes to my skin, especially since giving birth. I have a whole night time routine, but even with that I still wake up and need more moisture. So I tried this in the morning and I love how soft and silky it is! It seems to give my skin life again so I’m going to keep using it and see how I feel! This will be my daytime moisturizer until I run out!
I’ve been trying to find a really good serum and this is by far the best one I’ve ever used.

This lotion feels very luxurious in texture and has a lovely scent that isn’t overpowering. It absorbs into the skin beautifully but does leave a dewy shine to the skin after application. I found that for my combination skin, it didn’t provide enough hydration to last me through the entire day. This might be better for skin types who lean more oily. I also personally could never justify spending this much money on a moisturizer when there are so many cheaper alternatives.
It’s very similar to Dior Lip Maximizer in terms of consistency and minty flavour, but costs twice as much. Not worth the price. Packaging is nice, but I didn’t see any visible plumping.

I have super sensitive skin and have tried sooo many products.  This one is perfect.  I had no breakouts or red skin due to use.  I love it and will certainly be ordering again.  The cost is high - but worth it!!!
Product is great. It foams well and cleanses nicely. This brand is just amazing at every product they produce. Never disappoints.

I absolutely love how moisturizing this product is.  I often have a difficult time finding a great moisturizer that hydrates my skin longs enough underneath my makeup and night time and I finally found my holy grail. I am so happy I stumbled across this product it’s worth every penny! I highly recommend it to anytime who needs it!
Not very moisturizing. Left my face still dry.  Waste of money.
I put these masks in my cosmetic fridge and use it really cool.  it’s so hydrating for my dry skin I will repurchase again.

This is a good sunscreen. Texture is nice, absorbs easily. It’s a chemical sunscreen so it doesn’t leave a white cast. It does have a sunscreen-y smell and there is a sheen to the sunscreen so it is very dewy.That being said, I really don’t think it’s anything special to justify the crazy price tag. The sunscreen market now has a huge number of options with this type of texture, all for way less money.
Why reformulate when the original was so good? STILL searching for a replacement, this product is no bueno.

Treat yourself.  My face has never felt more moisturized.  I’m in my late 30s and decided it was time to take a huge upgrade in my routine.  It is so creamy that I can’t wear it in the morning.  Worth the money.

The cleanser smells like a bad of soap honestly, it makes my skin feel so tight. I wonder if that’s to get you to use the moisturizer afterwards? It doesn’t seem to have much affect on my skin. The L’Oréal micellar water I use seems better.  I am a La Mer lover, much to the distress of my bank account and feel bad saying it... But I don’t think I’ll be purchasing this again and am glad I only bought the mini.

This lotion is great. It was my very first product from the brand, and I liked it. I would give this one 4 out of star for the reason that my skin felt slightly irritated as it was absorbing the product because of some of the ingredients.

This is extremely moisturizing. You feel the difference once applied. I use this in the morning to wash off my overnight cream and it gives you that dewy but not oily moisture for the day. Great under makeup!
This is very concentrated, so you only need a pea size amount to get lots of foam going. My skin feels clean without feeling striped or tight after rinsing.

I got this as a gift and was extremely disappointed with the results that after 6 months of using it (once in the morning and once before bed - sometimes i skipped one, but at the very least once a day) I do not see any major results or changes to my skin. The biggest positive however, is that it did not react negatively to my skin. It did provide the moisture needed without being greasy or sticky and it sunk into my skin quite well. Didn’t break me out, but really didn’t do much either. A little goes a long way and I’m just now finishing the jar. Im just glad I didn’t pay full price for this and cant imagine how I’d feel if I had and received these results... Another thing to mention if its worth mentioning is that i mixed this in the morning with my SPF and it mixed and sat on my skin very well!

I have to agree with other negative reviewers; the previous gel cream was perfect and was responsible for introducing me into the La Mer line as a whole. It used to sink into my skin comfortably and would lay the perfect canvas for radiant foundation application. I tried a small sample jar of this new version and, to my dismay, it turned my face into a slippery mess just like any other $50 water cream. I also sadly noticed that cyclopentasiloxane (a silicone) has moved up on the ingredient list to surpass algae extract (miracle broth), which means that there is more silicone than miracle broth in this new “improved“ formula. I cannot help but wonder what motivated the product team to create this reformulation? Did anyone actually ask for this? Overall I am very disappointed and not sure what I will do when my jar of the old formula runs out.

The product is so boujie. It smells really good and feels like silk on the skin. Definitely tapping into my quality skin care investment era. It feels very protecting without feeling heavy or like I’m going to smear product on everything. In love

So creamy and hydrating yet at the same time mattifies enough to leave the skin balanced with not so much oil! Very pleased what it has to offer I mean it is luxurious 101 thank you so much was able to try it out!

I have very dry skin and this cream leaves my skin feeling soft and hydrated. A little goes a long way and I love that it doesn’t feel greasy and feels very light weight. Before trying this cream I struggled to find the perfect moisturizer for my skin that didn’t break me out or make my skin feel dry. I totally would splurge on this cream.

This mask isn’t lifting or firming. I didn’t find that result in any way, not even remotely, so I wouldn’t recommend this mask if that is your goal. I found this mask hydrating. It still has the La Mer scent, is lovely to apply, and wear at night. I finished the whole jar. But for pure hydration, I still prefer the La Mer moisturizers like the Moisturizing Soft Cream, so I would pass on purchasing this product.

Though it’s definitely an investment buy, taking care of my skin is top priority so this product is well worth it! It’s been over a week and I’m already seeing a difference in the hydration in my skin. The scent is what you would expect from a high-end product, it’s spa-like but not offensive. Will definitely continue to use and purchase the full product.

I have been so picky with moisturizer for the fact it can cause me to break out so quickly if I use one that contains too much oil. But this one worked wonders it hydrates the right areas without making my oil prone areas any oiler!
I love the tonic itself but not the packaging. The silver thin film keeps coming off and I can find on my skin.I used half of it and I am not happy every time when I open the bottle.

This product is really great. It leaves my skin feeling moisturized and extremely soft after just one use. It’s the perfect skincare product to add to your winter routine, especially when you live in NYC.

I received this complimentary from La Mee. This was My first time trying LA Mer and I was so excited to do so! This cream feels so luxurious. My skin felt softer than ever after using. I have quite dry skin and this definitely delivered great Hydration. The price is crazy, but it’s definitely a bougie experience and I loved it. A little goes a very long way I also love the fresh smell. All in all this was a great experience and great product.

Ok, first off, this price is ridiculous for what you get. The cream does feel great on the face, and I love the applicator brush they given you, but that’s about it. I noticed no difference in lifting or firming, and it actually made my skin feel a little dry afterwards.
It was good to be used in summer. However, in fall/winter, it’s too drying for my skin.

I love the scents of LaMer products, this is no exception.  Great product, super hydrating for my combination skin.  A little goes a long way, so the jar I received should last a bit!  Has a cooling effect, so that’s really nice when using in the morning as a little pick me up.  The price is a little over my budget, but a good product nonetheless
Amazing. Love this stuff
Love it! You wont regret if you give it a try.

Slight minty smell and flavor but fades pretty quickly. It lasts longer than any gloss I’ve ever owned. Non-sticky imo It slightly plumps the lips with zero sting and keeps lips smooth and super soft long after it wears off.
Great cleanser, especially for oily/combination skin in my opinion. Doesn’t leave skin stripped.

It’s definitely not worth the price. Like other mentioned, it feels like a cheap soap and didn’t clean very well. I don’t mind using it when travelling in Asia in the summer time since it’s hot and humid there but this is not the right cleanser for winter in Canada. Luckily it did not break me out as my skin is very sensitive. The mini size is good for travel but i will not repurchase.
TOO oily- I got breakout everytime I wear it. I would not recommend it to oily skin type

I used to use this product when I had combination skin. It’s advertised as for oily skinned gals but honestly I probably would not use this if you’re truly very oily. It did work quite well for my combination skin at the time, doing a good job of moisturizing without breaking me out, but I did not feel like it really gave me wow results that justify the cost. Other, much less expensive moisturizers will get you similar results.
Such a waste of money. You’ll see better results using Cetaphil face wash and CeraVe moisturizer for less than $20 total, as opposed to the $560 + tax I spent on La Mer.

Such a great product! It’s so luxurious, smooth, and not oily at all! My skin just drank it up! Definitely my favorite La Met product that they have. I will definitely be purchasing this product in the futute.

This makes for a beautiful, soft focus makeup primer. As a moisturizer though? I don’t find it to be that impressive. Don’t get me wrong my skin feels super hydrated, but nothing more than average. You can get the same results with something half the price.
Amazing product! Best cream to use if you have acne prone skin. Not heavy but still moisturizes!
Best product ever! It goes so well with La Mer Liquid foundation

Balances skin, evens skin tone and heals flare ups. This is the best cleanser I have ever used. I was a little nervous considering some of the ingredients. After using this and the gel, I have to recommend the cleansing foam for combo/sensitive skin.
I bought it,  like it , smell perfect , but then for some reasons I start to have pimples , not sure  cz it is oily not water based ??

This product is okay. There is nothing special about it. I use La Mer cleansing water in the am and was hoping for this to be a pm toner. I will save money by getting a cheaper toner for the evening. And splurge on other La Mer products. I will say this would be good if you don’t want a drying toner. This does not dry out your skin at all. I also feel like it doesn’t do much.

I have oily skin that’s also dehydrated, so it’s difficult for me to find a moisturizer that nourishes without making me more oily. I finally found my dream moisturizer! You only need a tiny amount - there’s a lot of slip to it, so it easily spreads onto the skin. It hydrates without being heavy and the cooling sensation is refreshing. I’ve only been using it for a short time, but I feel like my skin is a little more balanced and smoother, too.

I wish this was life changing. Because the price would make you think it’s life changing. However unfortunately it is nothing special. Definitely not worth the $80 price. Safe your money and get a cheaper gloss that will do the same thing. A few recommendations are the Biossance  rose lip balm or the Laniege lip treatment. Way cheaper and same quality

You guys, this gives me life everytime I use it. Not sure what it smells like but it’s honestly so good. I’ve been using it twice a day for a month and I’m just under halfway through the large bottle. It’s at my limit in terms of justifying being a recurring customer but that smell is intoxicating. It feels great on my skin and seems to help control oiliness, definitely helps with pores, and is just such a pleasant and not to mention alcohol free product to use.
This cleanser makes the skin totally clean. You can actually feel how clean your face becomes. I always use the La Mer Tonic after using this to bring back hydration on skin.

I loveeeeeeee this moisturizer. I have oily and acne prone skin, and this moisturizer is simply amazing! I have been using this moisturizer for about 2-3 months, and lately, I have been getting so many compliments that my face looks so much clearer and even younger. Its definitely more hydrated (and I never previously liked moisturizers because I have oily skin and I felt like all moisturizers made me break out so I always avoided them). I bought the small one only to see if I’ll like it because it is a bit pricy, but with the results I am getting, it’s definitely worth it! The moisturizer not only smells amazing but also feels so refreshing! Definitely purchasing the large bottle next time! Also, a little goes a long way!

I received a deluxe sample of this from Sephora, and I am in love! I’m a 65 year old with oily skin, and the LaMer cream was always too heavy for me. I use First Aid Beauty Intensive Peel, and this is the only moisturizer that soothes after that treatment without irritating. I have tried every moisturizer under the sun, and this is truly my Holy Grail since it moisturizes without making my skin too oily. Will be repurchasing again and again.

Adore this product. It smells so divine, and cleanses so deep while making your skin feel like it’s just being bathed in fancy. And come on - it’s La Mer. That’s some quality for your skin right now. Can’t imagine living without this in my bathroom forever!

The price is no joke but it’s the best option  if you have a darker complexion. I’m Caribbean and all other brands, including dermatologics ones like Avene or La Roche Posay, leave a nasty white cast and make you look like Casper. La Mer doesn’t do that even when applied directly onto the skin. You don’t need to mix it with your moisturizer to limit the cast effect that most sunscreens have on darker skin. Light, nor matte nor greasy, just an healthy and natural finish.
I use this sunscreen as my premier. it perfectly match with any foundations I have to provide a natural look.

It really works like all other La Mer products. You need to be consistent in order to see great results. I have using La Mer for about 2 years and 8 months and it has made a big difference in my skin. It ended my complaints, my skin looks healthy and rejuvenated.

This is the best eye serum out there. When used properly, you see and feel an instant lift. You need very little and it will last 6-9 months. It works with any eye cream. It is expensive but La Mer is worth it if you use it correctly.

Honestly the lotion is fine but I’m not so impressed by the price and what the actual lotion does! La Mer products are amazing but they kind of missed with this one, nothing special about it unfortunately.

The texture of this lotion is amazing. It left my face feeling soft, hydrated and moisturized. I like that it’s free of sulfates and other negative products. The price point however is a bit much in my option.

I received this product from La Mer. While many like this moisturizer, it just wasn’t for me. I found it made my dry skin a little acne prone, and didn’t sit comfortably on my skin, but maybe I just didn’t use it for long enough to see results.

I received a small sample of this product in exchange for an honest review. And I am a big fan not of this moisturizer! My skin does not feel as hydrated as it does when I use other La Mer products. I do like how it gives the skin a matte look though. I would not recommend.

It’s probably a great product, but I can’t get past the scent. Like many high end products this has a strong rose scent, while it didn’t bother me too bad, the scent does linger and will 100% bother those sensitive
Love La Mer so really wanted to love this product. But no...it is completely useless. It is not a plumper. It doesn’t even stay on long. Would not recommend.
Your search for the perfect cleanser is over. Watch as this transforms your face into the best version of itself.

My skin has never felt so hydrated. I have normal to dry skin and am always on the hunt for a moisturizer that ACTUALLY leaves my skin refreshed and hydrated. Le Mer definitely is a staple. A little some size amount goes a long way

Worst eye cream I ever used.  Thinking that if a product costs so much money it has to be good, I used it faithfully for three weeks, morning and night. From the first application I never felt that it moisturized my eyes. But I kept using it thinking It  has to be workIng.  It wasn’t until I went to get my facial with my regular lady and she said to me that she’d never seen the skin under my eyes as dry , she asked me if I’ve not been using eye cream. That’s when I went and returned it back to  Sephora.  The only good thing about it was the applicator which was even better than the Laprairie eye cream Applicator.
I tried a sample then immediately bought a full size.It’s such a magic product, which can use daily and making my face and neck skin so much more softer and hydrated. Worth every penny!

I received the LaMer cream as a gift 2 days ago. I have been using it daily ever since. And when I say daily, I truly only need it once a day. A little goes a long way, so be aware! It dries quickly but somehow my skin looks luminous and glowing as if it were still wet. No sticky feeling and super gentle scent. A truly great lotion.

Ngl!!! It’s a really great moisturizer. Deeply hydrates and nourishes the skin. I’d recommend if the price point was not what it is. How do you justify this moisturizer when there are others on the market that do similar jobs?

One of, if not my favorite moisturizing creams out there! La Mer is like no other. I love the way my skin feels after using this product. If you haven’t given it a try yet, it is definitely a must. Gifted by La Mer.

Le mer creme has been amazing starting to see the difference especially in the neck area I am blessed genetically with really good skin for a 59 year old but still need to protect . Little dab betweeen fingers rub unti clear then pat on the face
My skin looks fantastic! I’m 47 and get mistaken for late 20’s. Adds hydration, perfects skin without blemishes, great for eczema as well. Only complaint, difficult to get last bit out of bottle.

I received a few samples in exchange for an honest review. This product is an OG! It’s such a lux product that really helps plump the elasticity back in your skin. I’ve used this a few days and it’s really made my skin hydrating and I notice my skin is more supple - the texture is whipped so little goes a long way!
Fine moisturizer, wears well under makeup and doesn’t have too strong a scent. But no way is it worth the money, others do the same thing at 10% the cost!

Wanted to love this but it feels like washing your face with soap. I’ve got combination skin and this made my face feel so tight and horrible! Please don’t waste your money! There’s so many gorgeous cleansers out there for half (or less!) this price.

This was my first time trying a La Mer product and it feels like luxury in a bottle! I have really oily skin and I love how moisturizing this was without making my skin feel too shiny! The smell is lovely and the packaging is 10/10. A little really does go a long way!

This physical exfoliant is one of the most underrated products on the market. I have a love-hate relationship with how amazing La Mer skincare is—obv because of the price. This product is the key to baby soft skin and is worth every penny. It’s gentle and nourishing on my sensitive skin, replenishing my skin with those delicious oils while polishing the upper layers. A little goes a long way. I just turned 30 and this is not something I would have used or enjoyed in my 20s; however, I know this is going to be a staple in my routine going forward as moisture and cell renewal becomes more important as my skin matures. If you’re on the fence, try a sample on your hand in-store and feel how incredible your hand feels for the rest of the day… now imagine that for your face! You’re welcome. Buyer beware: the scent isn’t pleasant, but it’s also not bad. It’s a natural, herbaceous kind of smell. Also, the tube will most likely leak on your first use, so be ready to catch those precious golden oils ;)
I just tried this tonight and immediately fell in love . My skin feels so smooth at 75 years old I’m hooked

I am in love with La Mer’s Moisturizing Matte Lotion!!! A little truly goes a long way. Doesn’t leave my skin feeling too greasy or too dry. It’s always just right. Definitely recommend & will be buying the full size.

This has caused the worst breakout in my entire life. I have over a dozen blemishes on my skin after using this for 10 days, and my doctor said the reaction could last for another 2 weeks. Definitely do not recommend.

Was gifted by La Mer in exchange for an honest review.  The cream is sooo smooth and lightweight, left my skin feeling incredible. HOWEVER, the price is insane. If you want to splurge, its a great product and I understand the hype, but you do not need to spend this much on a moisturizer.

I don’t write reviews very often. This product deserves 10 stars. I don’t know how it does it put immediately it will turn your skin in to a perfect canvas for makeup! Blurs all my pores and smoothed away texture in 8 short minutes. I can’t attest of the “lifting” aspect of this product but I will always use as a treat if I want my skin to look flawless.

Very moisturizing and does not leave your skin with any greasy residue. For the price point I was expecting it to have a better smell. It smelt like a very traditional lotion. It did leave my skin feeling buttery soft though
I use the Eye Balm Intense in the morning and within minutes I notice I’m less puffy and the surface of my skin is smoother and primed for concealer.

If you don’t like moisturizer with a scent or fragrance, don’t get this one!! The first time I tried it, I put a small amount on my face and immediately had to take it off because of the strong scent. I also cannot believe how much it costs!!

I NEVER write reviews, but this product is too good not to. I have very sensitive skin so it is hard for me to find an exfoliating product that doesn’t irritate and leave my skin feeling tight. I love the milky consistency the beads form after you add water. Cannot say enough good things about this product! It’s expensive, but a little goes a long way.

Tried both this eye product and the eye concentrate; the latter item was the winner for me. This eye balm isn’t bad, but it isn’t great. Hydrated nicely, layered well with makeup, but I didn’t feel it did much for my eternal dark circles or teeny fine lines. Meh. Maybe if you had little to no dark circles this would work well for you.

I love how it feels.. this is so luxurious ! Cleaning all dirt and makeup . And good for using in winter . It doesn’t left dryness on your face . And keeps moisture for long day . Cleaning up before apply any skin care and makeup for best result.

1. Lightweight, light, pleasant smell, doesn’t have a paling effect on the face, has a moisturizing finish, did not clog pores. 2. My skin is ultra-sensitive to a lot of products, but this formulation didn’t cause any irritation or breakouts whatsoever.3. Yes it’s a chemical sunscreen and has ingredients that are harmful to corals but sadly I don’t live near corals so that’s irrelevant.

One star took off because of the price. I like this product but like any other products under this brand -- it is way overpriced and the story they put together is just ridiculous --- ’Dr. so and so experimented 6000 times before finding this magic formula with deep ocean so and so’ .. come on now ( eyeballs rolling to the back of my head look). The feature I like most of this product is the texture of the scrub.. it left my face soft and mositurized after the use and not causing me any breakout with the oil it contains.  I would love to switch to other products that carry some similarities to this one but with a more reasonable price...

Great mixture of an oil and scrub/exfoliant. Not to harsh and it didn’t leave my skin feeling stripped and dry. Instead, it was left smooth and hydrated. This reminds me of Fresh Sugar Face Polish as far as the mixture of oils mixed with the light texture of scrub. I compared them both and this one did leave my skin a bit more hydrated and smooth, probably because it has more oil in it. If you’re a skincare product connoisseur like myself, and don’t mind splurging a bit, I would highly recommend this scrub, as it is GREAT! If you are just looking for an every other day or once a week Scrub that won’t dry you out or leave your skin stripped, I’ll suggest going for the smaller size Fresh Sugar Face Polish, it smells better, it won’t put a dent in your wallet, and it is neck and neck compared to this.
Waste of money my acne has gotten worse since I’ve been using this product￼

This is Complimentary from La Mer . it’s the perfect natural smelling  moisturizer for those who love a very natural light weight moisturizer. A little goes a very long way it took my skin from looking dull and dry to very moisturized. It isn’t super oily either perfect moisturizer for wearing underneath your makeup !
Recently bought it, didn’t like it at all, Very strong smell

I love how gentle this micellar water is and how soothed it leaves my face. This is one of 5 or 6 la Mer products essential to my skincare routine. The price point is high however and I wanted to get my sister into micellar water as part of her Xmas gift but I know she would never spend the money on this again so I have been looking for a cheaper alternative. The fragrance is also really strong which I don’t mind but I know most people prefer fragrance free. I use this first thing in the morning to refresh my face before doing a few morning chores then do a full routine with Renee Rouleau mint face wash as a primary am cleanser. I looks forward to my skincare every morning it’s the most refreshing part of my day!!

This cream is so luxurious, it leaves my skin super supple. I love the glow it leaves behind and it wears beautifully under my makeup. this product was gifted to me and I will be making a purchase once my sample is done

Was so excited to try this moisturizer after hearing how amazing it was and am happy I got small sample size to try it. I love the way it made my face feel and will have to keep trying it to see if I see a difference.
I really like this texture and it’s very hydrating. There is probably an equally good product out there though but if you have the money get this!
I didn’t hope to see results because this mask is sooooo expensive, but you do see your pores look more refined!

A little goes a long way with this product - it’s the height of luxury skincare for sure. The scent is AMAZING! I place on skin where my skin is dry and it works wonders. I’m going to purchase the full size.

WARNING!!!!! just because La Mer is a well known luxury skincare line does not mean their products are for everyone. I used this eye balm for about a week and I am now having the worst allergic reaction that is causing my eyelid skin to swell up… burn… dry and flaking… darken. Be very very very careful with their products. I definitely won’t be using anything by La Mer again. You have been warned…

I had used the La Mer cream once years before, when I worked at Nordstrom because I wanted to see what all the fuss was about. Unfortunately it was too heavy, and made my skin break out. So I was interested to see if the new matte lotion was going to be a better option for my oily-combo skin. It was! I was super surprised how nice the texture was, with the signature La Mer scent. (The fragrance may also have been what broke my skin out, but it didn’t affect my skin at all with the lotion.) The matte lotion absorbs so easily and quickly, and left my skin so soft. No breakouts or irritated skin, so if you’re a fan of La Mer or have the money, it’s a great option for oiler types!

I used the original gel for twenty years, safe to say I was addicted to it. When the original was reformulated I was so disappointed, but gave this new one a try. It is NOTHING like the original. The original was cooling, absorbed like a dream, and left my face baby soft. This one does not absorb and leaves my skin feeling tacky. If I could leave no stars I would! Don’t waste your money. This new gel is far inferior to the original.

I’ve never had the chance to try the moisturizer and I was surprised with how good it is! It has a nice light texture and feeling. It is actually moisturizing, I usually have dryer skin around the winter and this worked well with my skin. It does have a light fragrance to it which I don’t mind but prefer none.

It sucks that I got only a sample because this moisturizing lotion is amazing! It glides so smoothly onto my skin and makes it super plump without making it oily at the same time! Highly recommend but it’s expensive!

This moisturizer feels really good on the skin and leaves your skin super soft and smooth. It’s a great priming moisturizer to use before makeup. My only issue is that the fragrance is so strong and it lingers for some time. It would be great to see a fragrance free version of this!

A very light feeling moisturizer. If you have oily skin I think you will love this. Leaves no residue or slippery feeling on the skin and has brightened my skin! But i do think there are better moisturizers out there for me because i have dry skin.

The bottle last a while because a little goes a long way but it didn’t do much for area around the eyes. I used it with an eye cream because this is only a serum and I needed an eye cream for moisture.

I absolutely have been loving this: The Moisturizing Soft Lotion 3ml. It has left my face feeling so hydrated and refreshed as we head into fall weather here in NC, it was nice to add a rich moisturizer into my regiment and this one is sooo perfect, even for my sensitive skin!

I’m newly trying this scrub and my skin does feel great afterwards which I attribute to the added oil The additional oil is great in treating my dry areas of skinI use it once a week (on dry skin) in a gentle circles all over my face (avoiding my eyes) because over-rubbing my skin can resemble skin burn

A wonderful way to treat yourself. I’ve tried a bunch of scrubs but find this truly to be one of the best. A little goes a long way and tube should last awhile. Smells great. Skin is soft afterwards. I’ve tried a lot of La Mer. This is hands down one of their best products.

THE OIL AND EXFOLIATING CRYSTALS COMBO IS GENIUS!!! This is my favorite exfoliator by far and doesn’t irritate my desert-worthy dry skin. My skin feels comfortable but clean after exfoliating. It instantly looks brighter and feels so amazingly smooth! The milia under my chin is almost gone now too. I have extremely dry, flaking (damage left by eczema), eczema-prone, and sensitive skin. I usually bite the bullet when I try new products because there’s a high chance my skin will freak out! But this one is a winner!!!The exfoliating sugar/sea salt crystals aren’t too rough but still very effective. The oil feels very comfortable and luxe and smells like their Renewal Oil. The oil itself doesn’t feel too thick and washes off easily. It protects my dry skin when I exfoliate, and I feel that it’d also help if I overexfoliated. It also makes me clean my face more thoroughly - making sure that I get everything off. The ingredients list is wonderful as well. I absolutely love, love, love this this! It’s pricey but worth the results and comfort!!!

I received this product for free from La Mer and I was super excited to try one of their products for the first time! This moisturizer changed the game for me, and it’ll be hard to go back to my original one. It makes your skin so soft, and you can definitely feel the hydration of your face coming back. I used this under my makeup as a base, and it was so lovely. Highly recommend!

Immediately, I can tell why this is a cult favorite! This moisturizer is extremely creamy, luxurious and hydrating. I think it’s best to use in drier months because of the instant hydration you will get after using it! Also, it didn’t break me out or clog my pores, so I’ll be using this every day. One word. Obsessed.

I have been using all La Mer products since I was 20.  I have used this eye cream, along with the eye concentrate every morning and night for 11 years, I am now 31 and the only person my age I know that has absolutely no eye wrinkles or crows feet. This is an investment and you can’t expect results after a few tries or even one bottle. If you already know you won’t commit to buying this consistently for years to come, don’t bother.  It’s only worth the money if you if you are able to continue using it for a long period of time.The price is steep but I only end up buying this product at most twice a year. I usually get around 7-8 months of usage out of one bottle.If you’re planning to use La Mer products SAMPLES ARE KEY! Find a La Mer contact at the department store and ask for samples, purchase during promotions (Neimans has a great one, also Sephora promotions) and you will really stretch your dollar.  I think they are worth it and have been using the products long enough to stand by that statement!

This stuff feels like magical velvelty magic on the skin. I’ve used it on days where my skin already felt great, and on days when it felt irritated and it helped so much! It totally helps repair the barrier, as my skin felt so much more comfortable within hours.

Do not buy or try if you are sensitive to scents! I was so excited to try this cream - I got a free sample. The smell is absolutely overwhelming. I have sensitive skin and I wouldn’t recommend this to anyone with allergies or sensitivities.

Everything LaMer on my skin is heavenly. This face wash is my go to- it cleans, doesn’t dry out my skin but leaves it looking like porcelain. I have combination skin, that tends to get somewhat oily. It’s a splurge I just can’t go without!

The absolute best moisturizer! It feels so luxurious and the packaging is so aesthetic. The lightweight texture just glides across my skin! You don’t need too much and the bottle should last you a long time!
Lovely, light, and is perfect
A very hydrating mask. Definitely worth it!

Was moisturizing, but I was looking for more of a wow with this product. Wouldn’t purchase again, trying out Chanel instead. Plus I saw that green dye is used in the ingredients...so much for “the sea”.

I loved this it was so smooth and lightweight and it didn’t have a strong smell like a lot of others do! It layered well with all my other products including serums which that usually doesn’t blend together nicely but this did! Definitely understand the price point now!
I LOVE this product! Goes on so smoothly, doesn’t smell like sunscreen and doesn’t clump up with my other serums, lotion, etc. One of my favorite La Mer products by far. Also lasts a long time!
I leave it on as an overnight mask. If you need to tighten areas and want to wake up to soft skin, this works.
I know this is expensive but it is worth it. I mix it with La Mer crème and it makes my face feel refreshed after cleansing. I use it at night time. I even apply it to my cuticles.
Does a great job on removal of all makeup. Also love the fragrance.
Different twist on the scrub. Love it! The experience of applying and results are gratifying. Why did it take me so long to find this? I generally hate scrubs. I love this and will actually use it.

This product was free and it was my First time trying this moisturizer and it did not dissapoint. I love how velvety and smooth the formula is. It is definitely very rich and nourishing. I recently came back from the beach and my skin was so dry. I kept applying this daily and it really help transform my skin back to normal. Def recommend if you’re looking for a hydrating and rich moisturizer!

I love love this moisturizer,  you only need a tiny bit as it goes a long way.  It has a very light weight texture and leaves the skin feeling great and not greasy.  I’ve noticed before using this product my skin was very dry, now my skin is silky and smooth.  (Gifted by La Mer).

This gives me that perfect youthful from within skin every time! A little bit goes a long way so this is an excellent every day moisturizer. I have combination skin so it pairs nicely with my natural oils.

I was bummed when they discontinued the refining facial for this. However, this is an awesome product in itself- I wouldn’t say it is a good replacement for the refining facial as this is oil based and the other is clay based- but it’s still amazing nonetheless. This makes my pores nonexistent and my skin is so soft immediately after using it.  I supplement this with the la mer foaming cleanser and then follow with the Koh Gen Do oriental plants lotion, if I have time. If not, I just go straight to a serum (either the Mila Moursi lifting serum or the La Mer regenerating serum) and then the La Mer soft cream. This regimen has made my pores disappear, my skin is now glowing and hydrated, and compexion is even. My skin is literally flawless and I’m so glad to have found a worthwhile addition to my skincare ritual.

Here I was all happy with my long time moisturizer when I was gifted some samples complimentary from La Mer. I will never recover and neither will my bank account. The lightweight creamy texture and luxurious smell are seriously an experience not to be matched. My skin has never felt so fresh and dewy and I’m bummed because I seriously can’t afford this every day.

When I got lazy, instead of applying all the toners, serum and moisturizer, I simply put this mask on instead, I slept with it on, and the next morning, you’ll notify a much more smoother and just ideal skin! 
It’s a little pricy I would say. Waiting the Nov sale in sephora to stock up this mask again!
Definitely worth the money. Absorbs in a second and skin looks glowy and soft straight after. Perfect for winter since it locks moisture really well.

First I have to say as an expensive eye cream, I did not see any immediate effect on improving things. But the good thing is this eye cream prevents things from getting worse. I use it to calm my skin whenever I pulled an all-nighter, and my eye definitely looks different if I don’t use it.
Not worth the money spent. May be I was expecting too much... but, after every use my face never felt clean: this product always leaves a film like residue... .
Dries my not dry skin and has an unpleasant odor to it. A complete waste if money in my case.
Feel great on the skin - but caused terrible break out. I tried multiple times with same results - zits. Sad it didn’t work out for me.
Great like most of the La Mer products!

This cream is silky smooth and glides onto the skin so nicely. A little goes a very long way when applying the product. I noticed an immediate glow and firmness to my face after applying. The only downside to the product is the smell; it is very strong.

I haven’t used it for the 8 weeks yet, which seems to be recommended for best results, but I do already notice visibly plumper, healthier, firmer, lifted-looking skin. I like that the ingredients contain antioxidant to protect skin from irritation, because my skin is really sensitive. Also the ingredient that promotes healing as my skin really needs some healing!
Excellent value and during the VIB sale it’s even better!!!!
It’s true. It works. Leaves my pores super small and makes my skin look incredibly smooth. NOT sure about the lifting and firming qualities BUT works wonders to my 28-year old skin.

Lamer doesn’t dissapoint.   This is such a good cream.  It applies beautifully.  The smell is beautiful but not overpowering.  It absorbs fast. There is no greasy feel at all. This cream is perfect for  upcoming winter months. This is a very luxurious cream. After application my skin feels velvety. Couldn’t love the feeling more. Highly reccomend
I enjoy this stuff because you don’t need to rinse  after using. I use this after my toner. Doesn’t leave skin dry or have a bad smell. It’s an oil. Love!

I love this moisturizer so much! it feels luxurious on my skin. it is lightweight but also very thoroughly moisturizing. I also really like the clean soft scent. I have been loving using this before I apply my makeup.

When I saw the price of this moisturizer, I knew it wouldn’t be worth the price… but then I tried it.  I used both the Soft Cream and the Original and my fave feels like actual silk. I don’t know what is in the “MiracleBroth” but it’s perfect!
I purchased this when it was released in the La Mer website, I really enjoy this product! It really hydrated and gives your lips that beautiful plum pout. It has a minty taste and a very nice shine!
Left my face feeling sticky, and very red. And somehow made my face feel more oily? I’m glad I bought the sample.
not good for dry skin, it will make your skin very dry after use
I love this exfoliator. I have dry skin that needs exfoliation, but it usually leaves my skin stripped and feeling tight. This one leaves my skin smooth and hydrated.

I’m on my 30’s so I think it’s worth investing more $ on skincare products, this moisturizer is perfect for nighttime, when you need extra hydration on top of your anti aging serum:) I wouldn’t use it for day time because I have oily skin, another factor is I live on Midwest, so here we have many months of cold and I feel my skin needs a powerful moisturizer specially for these months. I personally love La Mer products, they all go well together, the moisturizers really go well with the La Mer foundation on top, it gives a beautiful glow skin :)

This unfortunately makes my skin glow, the unfortunate being the price of course. The formula is very hydrating and after using it for the past 2 months I noticed a certain healthy-glowing complexion on my skin. Will look for the dupe in the meantime but I am very open to repurchase the product in the future if I don’t find anything as good as this.

I shared this with La Mer as well; they deserve full credit.  I have a scar near the right corner of my upper lip, the result of an assault when I was 17.  I took a blow across the mouth that opened a gash right through the full thickness of my lip, and I’ve lived with it for over 40 years.About two months ago, I picked up a jar of Gel de La Mer from Sephora (tyvm VIB Rouge!), and have been using it as directed every day.  Not only is my face smooth and hydrated, the scar is now softer, smoother, much lighter, and much less noticeable.  I’m happy to show before/after pics to give you an idea of the difference this product has made:  the pic of me in the gray sweater is from 12/11/2017, the one in the black fleece was taken 1/13/2020.

I’ve only used this cleanser a few times. I wasn’t wowed immediately so I didn’t use morning and night like I typically would. After using it a few times, I noticed that it’s prob the most drying cleanser I’ve ever used. Would not repurchase. Would not recommend unless maybe you have oily skin. Second star is for the price point relative to other products in their line.

This cream was gifted by La Mer and I love it! It’s lightweight and goes on under my makeup nicely! I love how smooth it makes my dry skin feel! I like to make a bottle last, so I’m glad a little goes a long way.
this is designed for people with combo/oily skin which I have. honestly my skin would get oily after applying this so I didn’t work for me :(

After using this moisturizer, I’ve noticed my pores are a lot smaller, and my skin feels softer and looks healthy. I’ve noticed some of the lines around my eyes has been reduced slightly. The cream is easy to apply and I personally use a spatula to spread it evenly around my skin. It’s be definitely noticed my skin is getting firmer as well!

Love, love, love…La Mer. It’s been my bff ever since I had emergency neurosurgery on my neck and was left with a big thick scar. The concentrate was brought to me by a neighbor and that thick scar was GONE in 3Months or daily use. I just this past 2 months bought both La Mer eye creams/balms and I also see fast results with that always amazing and memorable smell
This cleanser is not bad, but it does not live up to the hype.

Out of all the face creams I have used throughout my life, this is by far my favorite and one that I can wear in the summer and the winter. My face looks flawless when I use this stuff! I’ll be going back to this routine.
This mask is amazing! It helped to reduce my large pores and made my dull skin brighter! I’ll definitely continue to buy.
The consistency is amazing, not greasy and it doesn’t leave you looking baked like other sunblocks, worth every penny

Literally one of the best moisturizing creams. It definitely lives up to its reputation. It leaves your skin feeling smooth and soft like a baby’s butt. The scent is not bad either. I got a small size but I will be purchasing the large size for sure.
Meh, i prefer the cleansing gel over this cream.

I absolutely love this product. I have been wanting to try for awhile and I’m happy that I did. It made my skin feel very soft and hydrated, while also giving me a glow. I will definitely buy this full size when I run out. Gifted by La Mer.
I love this cleanser.  You only need a smidge as it foams up beautifully and has a lovely, mild scent.

My skin has never looked healthier than after applying this product. My skin felt incredibly hydrated and my friends complimented my skin immediately after using this product even though I did not tell them I was trying new skincare. I love La Mer, I just wish it wasn’t so expensive!
Amazing like an instant face lift. Worth every last penny!!

This La Mer SPF 50 sunscreen works well under makeup. It is not drying or greasy. It disappears in the skin. As a chemical sunscreen, this does not sting the eyes (I am sensitive to many others). I prefer to use La Mer Treatment Lotion, then La Mer Soft Cream, eye cream, then pat on this La Mer SPF 50 sunscreen, then Tatcha Primer, and follow with foundation like La Prairie Skin Caviar Foundation or Essence Cushion, and Cle de Peau concealer, Charlotte Tilbury pressed or Laura Mercier Translucent powder. Works well under La Mer Skin Tint or Bareminerals Complexion Rescue too.

This poor gel creme is far inferior to LaMer’s last one. The consistency is sticky, does not moisturize, leaves skin with a waxy-like feeling. Also...I experienced breakouts from this gel creme. I do not recommend this creme at all! Far overpriced for such a poor product.

I’ve tried different product from La Mer and this is one of my favorites. I use it at night, after using the La Mer lotion, and my skin feels wonderful the next morning. It’s expensive but worth the money, especially if like me, you used to spend money on various things that did not work as well. If you’re looking for something similar but cheaper, the Drink it up mask from Origins works similar to this one.

I got a sample mask from lamer..on with a purchase. This mask feels so good going on and gives instant results.  There is a lot of lotion in the packets so if u can find a sanitary way to collect the lotion into a bottle...you will have a nice little bottle of treatment lotion.  This mask is fantastic.
Love it. Perfect consistency for combination skin. Expensive but lasts me for 6-8 months.

complimentary from Lamer. Good moisturizer. Nothing special. Very hydrating, Though the smell is not my favorite. too fragrant for my liking, I don’t know if I would purchase it. there are better creams out there

Purchased off lamer when it can out, had high hopes.. failed miserably..this is sticky, minty with a bitter taste and doesn’t plump at all.  It caused my lips to get red around the border. It’s clear in color and I couldn’t tell if it was hydrating bc I wore less then 30 mins due to the taste and irritation. Their original lip balm is good, this not so much. Packaging  is beautiful. Sadly had to return.

I wanted to not like this product Bc of its price tag...... but the very first time I used it... I knew there was something very special about it. I have been using this now to remove my makeup for the whole week and I love it like no other :)

Every penny spent on LaMer is worth it, I was having my skin kind of dull, I haven’t use it that much to notice a firming result, but definitely it gives me a very fresh touch and my skin looks brighter.

I don’t get the bad reviews.  This product is hydrating and my sensitive skin has responded very well to it; certainly more than it has to creme de la mer (too much for me) or the soft cream by la mer (only good for me in the dead of winter), AND IT IS NOT STICKY AT ALL.  Also, you only need to use a very little bit of the product for your entire face.    I’m happy with it and recommend it.

I don’t know why this has so many negative reviews! I got a sample of this and I really like it! It’s super lightweight, NOT GREASY AT ALL, and immediately absorbs into the skin. In my opinion, it dries pretty matte. I have acne prone skin and this actually calmed redness and irritation that I had. I’ve also tried the original Creme de la Mer and I felt like that was way too heavy and greasy even though I have really dry skin. If you’re looking for a lightweight moisturizer that’s goes to leave your skin super soft and not sticky/tacky, then this is the moisturizer for you.

Love how luxurious this product is and how nice it feels on my skin! Not too heavy but not too lightweight. I received this product for free so I was happy to try but no I would not splurge this much on a moisturizer personally.

I like this product. I wear quite light makeup. My makeup routine is always like this primer, cushion foundation, blush, a little bit of conturing powder for my nose, eyebrow powder. I wear lash extensions so I don’t really wear eye makeup. This micellar water takes all my makeup off by using 2 cotton pads. There is no need to really soak the pads for me but gotta get them wet enough. I try to take off eye makeup sometime but it takes more to remove all the colors and waterproof eyeliner. Also, I can see my skin is improving. At first, I was afraid that only using this without washing my face with face wash would break me out. Oh boy! I was wrong. This little friend is amazing for those who would get lazy at night after a long day like me. It can take off everything without rinsing. After I use this, I apply toner with cotton pad and there is no residue on the pad. It’s really cool. It’s on a pricier side for a makeup remover without rinsing so I just take one star off.

La Mer has quite the following and reputation!  I feel it is all well deserved.  Usually I use the original La Mer cream but do find that a bit heavy for the heat of summer so I thought I would try this as an alternative.  Glad i tried it.  It is moisturizing, non irritating and light for the heat and humidity.  Perfect for summer.

I do think this lotion is great. It smells so great and luxurious! I do like the packaging. I do not understand why it’s so pricey. I think it’s great but I do not think I would spend the money on this product.

I have to admit, I’ve kind of thrown myself down the La Met rabbit hole, and this was my latest addition. To say that I was blown away by the way this took my makeup away is an understatement. It is so smooth and gentle and left my skin feeling unbelievably fresh. I’m hooked!!
Meh. Expected more for the price. Goes on non-sticky which is a plus and does not change the color of lipstick like other brands. Pretty color. Overall, not impressed
LOVE LOVE LOVE LOVE!!!! This leaves my skin feeling so incredibly smooth and soft. I use their foaming cleanser afterward with my foreign luna 2. The perfect combination and it lasts!!!
A good after cleanser toner but I prefer the micellar water on my combination skin

I have tried a few different La Mer moisturizers and the newly reformulated Gel Cream is by far my favorite for my combo/ acne prone skin. I have been using it since the weather started warming up and it as been ideal. The gel consistency is great and it always leaves my sin feeling refreshed an moisturized without feeling heavy. The only time I have ever felt any type of “tingle“ or cool sensation when applying this moisturizer is when it is following a strong serum.

First off I’d like to note that I love the scent, however I can not justify the price of the product. I feel like you can get a product that’s similar without the hefty price, but if reccomend it if you like getting luxe skincare

All day healing moisture that makes my skin visibly plumper, healthier, firmer, lifted-looking! This cream helps my skin brace against future signs of age and comes in a silky-soft texture. Love the feeling it leaves on my face

This product is a life saver. The climate dramatically changed after being super hot for a month. Now it’s cool and my skin started peeling on my face. Once I added this to my face routine I didn’t see any peeling.

I got Lamer’s all lotions and I am a huge fan of Lamer, I got almost all their products and This is the best lotion I have ever had!!! So so perfect for summer, and it makes the makeup flawless as well:)

I received a sample of the gel cream. I tend to have dry skin but I used during the humid summer weather. This gel cream did not moisturize at all. I have used other gel type creams from Belif and Aveeno and they worked well. This left my face feeling and looking dry and shortly after applying this I put on another moisturizer.  It has a powdery fragrance which I am not a fan of for face products. I would not purchase especially for what it costs.

This feels so good on my skin! The texture is really light weight while being super moisturizing. My skin is smooth, fresh, and hydrated each time I use it! This product was gifted to me for this review.

Love it! One of the best cleansers and THE BEST foaming cleanser I have tried. In the last few weeks I tried few different brands including La Prairie, Lancer, Kiehls, Origins and few more. Some of them were too drying, didn’t remove the makeup or left my skin too dry/tight. La Mer cleanser gel made my skin very dry and irritated, so I tried the foaming cleanser. It foams perfectly, cleans skin well (I also use it with Clarasonic Mia). It is expensive but worth it. Keeps my skin clear, as well.

4 stars because of the price, this is way too much even for La Mer. I was lucky to get a deluxe sample of this and I’m trying to make it last as long as I can, my skin is simply loving it. My skin used to be combination when I lived in Rio de Janeiro, but a few years ago I moved to Los Angeles and the dry weather here turned my skin into dry. The moisturizing power of this cream works perfectly, I’ve been putting it on before sleep and my skin just drinks it up even though it’s pretty thick. Some days I had to rush out in the morning and forgot to do my mourning skincare routine but the moisture from this cream lasted throughout the day. I have bangs which sometimes can cause my forehead to get oily, but it wasn’t the case with this cream. I’m very happy with it, but unfortunately for something that I would use every day, the price is just too high for me.

I received a small sample of this product in exchange for an honest review. And I am a fan of this moisturizer! It leaves your skin feeling silky smooth in real time. The only part I’m not a fan of is the floral scent. I would recommend.

This could be the holy Grail of all holy grails! I used it for the first time this morning and my crepy neck has disappeared and my skin is so smooth on my face! Totally incredible. I plan to use this every other day as suggested.
By far the best Micellar Water I’ve tried. Leaves my skin clean soft and glowing. No residue or unpleasant stickiness or smell. It is absolutely amazing!
Definitely gives me the hydration my 45 years old skin needs but a bit pricey for a mask!

this moisturizer is definitely a luxury novelty product. the first ingredient isn’t water & i can tell because the moisture isn’t super long lasting. honestly i wouldn’t restock this item because i’ve had other moisturizers, for less, perform much better. [gifted by La Mer]

I absolutely am in love with La Mer, but this one is a bit odd. It felt nice when I put it on. I left it on for the amount of time recommended. Then tried to wipe off the excess. And that was the weird part. It felt stuck on my face. I even splashed water and the water repelled off like rainex!! It felt like I had wax on my face. I then read the ingredient list and it said dimethicone multiple times at the top of the list and thought omg! Dimethicone is a silcone(wax). Which can coat skin and hair and trap bacteria. Which I guess can also hold moisture too but I really felt the wax on my face. Water was beading off. I washed my face with a cleanser to get it off and felt a small amount of residue still left on my skin. I’m not sure I would pay $170 for high amount of dimethicone in my skincare that can trap bacteria. None of the other products have that ingredient. I’m not sure how I feel about this one. Every other product is remarkable! And my favorite. But I’m just not sure about this one.

I’ve been a fan of the La Mer moisturizing face cream for a while and was so excited to try this new launch! I loved the texture and found it to be a bit lighter than the original one. I prefer this for the mornings and the traditional cream for evenings!
I bought this mini because I wanted to try La Mer without spending so much. This cleanser does its job but is not anything special.

Every eye cream has burned my sensitive eyes.  De-puffing creams would irritate and make my eye swell and puff.  This eye cream smells nice.  Make sure you watch the video on how to properly put the cream on.  I use the metal applicator and dot the product around my orbital bone.  Then I rub the application around in a circle.  Then I use my ring finger to pat the cream and warm it up.  Within a week, I noticed a difference in my small eye wrinkles.

For a very long time, I wanted to try at least one part of the LaMer skin care line but the price always held me back. I decided to splurge on this mask & I’m SO glad that I did! I have fair combination skin, issues with fine lines, redness, dullness & pores. The first time I used this product, I saw a massive difference! My skin actually glowed, the fine lines seemed to disappear along with my larger pores & the redness was barely there. I had never used a mask & seen such dramatic results as I have with LaMer. I swear it took 15 years off of my skin’s appearance! I’ve tried Perricone, Dr. Brandt, Philosophy, etc. and nothing gave me these results. I will never be without this anymore & I hope to at least integrate the cleanser, serum & moisturizer into my skincare regimen. A little goes a long way with LaMer & it might be pricey, but it’s worth every single penny.

This La Mer moisturizing soft cream product is incredibly lightweight on my skin. I have very sensitive skin and have had zero breakouts since beginning to use this product. Even after trying several other luxury brands, this will be my go to due to the benefits and lack of issues I’ve experienced. It has a slight sweet but pleasant smell and is incredible soothing on my skin. I have been using it as my exclusive skin product when I get out of the shower and have cleansed my face.

I was soooo excited to try this. It’s everything I expected but the price point is why I gave it one less star. its very moisturizing and soothing too and I feel refreshed when applying. Has a slight smell but it’s ok.  I can definitely tell a difference between this and other brands, but do I always want to spend this amount: no!
Works perfectly for my dry skin.  Love how it feels soft and smooth afters its use on my skin.

I’m obsessed with how soft and smooth my skin looked after using this product! This moisturizer was so hydrating and nourishing on my dry skin. It left my face with the prettiest glow while being lightweight and non greasy! Loved it! Highly recommended!

So when it comes to cleansers I will spare no expense. Cleanser are kinda my thang.But this missed the mark.Why don’t I like it? SUPER drying. Stings the eyes. Obviously I’m not putting into my eyes but just regular face washing it burned my eyes like crazy.The texture and lather of this product is very reminiscent of the gel shaving creams you’ve probably used on your legs at some point.This isn’t any better than the high end cleansers at the $35-$40 price range I have a lot of other La Mer products which I love including their foundation, face cream, toner, and primer. All of which I can justify the price. But $95 for this cleanser is ludicrous.You *might* like it if your skin isn’t dry. I do feel like it is a generous amount of product and a little does go a long way so + 2 stars for volume of product and the fact it will probably last you forever.- 3 stars for all the things I described above.

I personally LOVE this formula, and I like it way more than the original creme de la mer. I never tried the original gel cream, which I know many loved, so that may be why I personally love this one so much, since I din’t have a previous gel cream to compare to. For me though... this one so cooling, and feels amazing on my skin. I like putting it on before bed and I wake up with my face literally feeling like a baby’s bottom. A little of it goes a long way, so the jar will last you a long time. The cooling feel is perfect for summer after being out in the sun all day.

I received a sample and boy was I impressed in as little as 2 days I saw fine diminish and my face was more hydrated .  I m combo skin and not everything works for me . I didn’t want this to work for me because it’s expensive.  But I love how my face looks after wearing this . I’m addicted.  Lol ooh well beauty has a price . I’m 36 w/combo skin.

My mom and I have been using this sunscreen for 5 years. I have super sensitive skin I cannot stand the feel of heavy sunscreen on my skin. This item is amazing feels like a lotion and since makeup sits so well on top of it, it also feels like a primer to me. While I get little bumps from other sunscreens this never even once made my skin breakout or get little bumps. It does an extraordinary job of protecting the skin. I will never be without this one.

this gloss is subtle, and probably should be called a lip smoother instead of plumper ONLY because there are others that plump more.  if you’re expecting bee-stung, this ISNT that.  This gloss isnt sticky, doesnt have a weird taste or smell, it is slightly menthol-y.  its sheer with SUBTLE shimmer and color.  if you like natural lucious lips that have NO discernable lines, you’ll LOVE this.  It’s not your daughters gloss.

I really wanted to hate this for the price, but I have to say this is the best gloss I have ever purchased. I am a Dior Maximizer plumping addict, and honestly did not think I could find something I liked better, but this steals the show. The packaging has a luxe feel and is much larger than expected. The gloss itself is amazing - just the right amount of moisture and slip with no stickiness or tackiness. Super moisturizing and works great on top of the lip balm. My new holy grail for lip treatments!!

I originally sampled this (thanks Sephora!) and never would have bought it otherwise because it’s so expensive to just try on a whim. Well, I guess that depends on your income bracket... this was definitely a splurge for me. The sample convinced me, and to treat myself to help cope with the pandemic, I bought the 1oz. I think I generally have pretty good skin which fortunately doesn’t require a whole lot of maintenance, and I do well with most nightcreams (my most recent go-to being the Andalou Cannacell Dreamy Night Cream, which costs significantly less than this and I had been happy with the results). I didn’t really think there was much room for improvement, but the results of the La Mer have been insane and I wake up with my skin feeling extra soft and smooth after adding this to my nighttime skincare routine. This is way too expensive to be a year-round thing for me, but I think it will be a nice once-a-year treat for my face.

This is one of the best eye moisturizers I’ve ever used. My skin looks smoother, healthier, and the bumps I had before are gone! I typically use this in the morning and the other la mer eye moisturizer at night.

I love this moisturizer!! It’s super soft and thin. Different than the original which is thicker. I love the way this goes on my skin and leaves it feeling super hydrated without extra residue. I highly recommend
I haven’t been able to find an eye cream or serum that matches the benefits of this one! Your eyes feel noticeably brighter and tight after one use!

Trashed it. Didn’t foam and stripped my skin. Pluses are that it’s not heavily scented and it’s lathering. If I had oily skin or wore heavier makeup, I could see liking this more. But definitely not for me.

I received two small samples of this to test out. I had always been curious about the brand and when I saw it pop up as an option to try it I was very excited. However I was quickly disappointed. The lotion felt a bit heavy despite being advertised as good for combo skin. It also has a heavy scent. For the price, I would expect this to make my skin feel and look noticeably different but I didn’t see any results.

I have oily skin and I’m always looking for moisturizers to control oil. This is a good moisturizer but it doesn’t control shine. I was just as shiny if not more shiny after using this. I tried for several days with same result. Not a bad product, but doesn’t control shine well.

This La Mer moisturizing soft cream feels light-weight the texture is creamy. It has a light scent.A little bit goes a long way! I use it in the evening and when I wake up in the morning my skin feels firmer and healthier. i also feel like it minimized my pores. My skin just soaks it up!

The price point may be high, but this La Mer product does not disappoint!! I have very fair, dry and somewhat sensitive skin depending on the season, and this exfoliate was heavenly. Felt very gentle yet efficient; woke up to glowing clear skin in the morning. Sometimes exfoliates are too abrasive for me and leave me red or extra dry, but this one was somehow both exfoliating and nourishing. Used between a nickel and quarter sized amount for my whole face, so I feel this container will last me a very long time. Bought this product at Nordstrom’s, but will repurchase from Sephora in the future.
You do not need much when using this moisturizer! This cream is very lightweight and helps smooth out my skin! I love it!

I LOVE LA MER!!! When they say that a little bit of their products goes a very long way, they mean it. I wish I could test out all of their products! This cooling gel cream feels so good on my skin and doesn’t cause any irritation.

I love La Mer products but this lip volumizer looks pretty and applies nicely , sadly offers just a quick gloss and I didn’t see any benefits. It is overpriced to use as a chap stick, not a good value at all.

This moisturizing cool gel cream from La Mer is super lightweight and incredibly hydrating! I like to use this in the morning because my skin feels refreshed right after application. I’d definitely recommend this for anyone with oily or combination skin.
Sooooo expensive but soooooo good. Worth the splurge. Makes your skin feel amazing.

not good for sensitive skin. The moment I applied it to my face, it started tingling . At first I thought it is supposed to do that. But then when I removed it , my face was dry and red . I had to wash it off an hour later .  it also gave me a couple of small break-outs. For this price it’s horrible. never again.

I know why it’s called the soft cream because oh my. My skin feels so so baby soft after using this cream. The texture feels luxurious and it has a nice subtle smell to it. A little goes a long which is nice since this is an expensive product!
First off it’s a nice sunscreen, Secondly it’s way! Way!to expensive! For small bottle, “One star off”....It’s not matte, I find it hydrating and shiny. Bonus! No fragrance!!! Sensitive friendly!

For me it lasted about 5 months contrary to some people who say it lasts over a year. I gave it 4 stars because I am not really sure how much of a difference it made. It is a great cream, and I love the benefits from it but I find that I use less. I am also in my mid 20s so I have like a few lines. I think it worked, since a lot of my stuff is preventative but I don’t really see a big difference. Aside from that, because it is expensive I don’t apply as much as I would with a cheaper cream, and when AC and dry climate dries up your skin, you want to use a little more.

I am a La Mer devotee and was so excited to use this product! I love the dropper and the bottle lasts so long. I put a drop under each eye since it’s a serum before my eye cream. I don’t know how I’ve lived without this!
Definitely the best!

I’d like to note that I absolutely love the scent of the product, I just can’t justify the price. A little goes a long way, but it is a super expensive product. Maybe if you’d like to have a luxe brand I’d suggest it.
La Mer Foam cleanser is one of my favorite splurges!  It not only cleans extremely well  (and foams easily) but it smells clean - like a typical La Mer product.

I LOVE La Mer, and already have the cleansing gel(which smells AMAZING) so thought I would try this as well, but it smells like men’s shaving cream! If U can get past the scent, it froths well and is gentler than the gel

The other reviewers are correct--this cleanser does have a strong scent reminiscent of Irish Spring soap. However, it is fantastic for my oily skin and the most effective cleanser I’ve used in a long while. It gets all my makeup off and leaves my skin feeling clean and fresh. A little bit goes a long way, so even though I don’t love the price tag, I think it’s ultimately worth it. I just purchased my second bottle and think I’ll be sticking with this for the foreseeable future.

This stuff feels so refreshing and my skin is left feeling very clean. It feels luxurious and I definitely feel better after cleansing my face with this. I feel like it’s definitely worth the splurge. It smells divine as well. Very good product! It melts away makeup and leaves skin clean and refreshed.

No matter how dull, dehydrated, or punished my skin looks when I wake, this morning mask leaves my skin looking dewy, refreshed, and naturally hydrated. It’s a daily mask and the results last all day, but I also feel it has improved the condition of my skin for the long term. It’s well worth the splurge - a must-have skincare secret weapon.

I was a little disappointed with this product. I use the moisturizing soft cream religiously and was hoping this product would be similar but unfortunately this one missed the mark. I wasn’t hydrating like the moisturizing soft cream at all and the smell was very weird—nothing like the signature La Mer scent I’m used to. I’ll stick with my soft cream.

This cleanser for me was just too drying. I have combination/ oily skin. So, that’s saying a lot. The smell of it is so fresh though! Very soothing and just smells clean. Sadly, won’t be repurchasing though.

This is my first time officially using a La mer product. I have combination skin with oily t-zones. I use this cream once a day with a vit c serum and sunscreen. I would recommend if you have similar skin.
are u kidding me with this price?! this is nothing but over priced lip gloss. I’d maybe pay 6 bucks

La mer lives up to the hype with this amazing cream. I was able to try this out for free and I couldn’t be more happy. It’s light weight, smells wonderful, and is very pretty on the skin. I’m so happy I was able to try it!
This is a great lotion find. I love that it’s matte because I can use it underneath my makeup in the morning without my skin looking oily and slick. I also love that a little product goes a long way.
beyond amazed by the results of this product. i got compliments all day!!

This is the best exfoliator I’ve ever used, and seriously, I’ve used a ton! It leaves your skin so soft, and so smooth and moisturized that it feels like you’ve already put your moisturizer on! This is one of those products where you are totally getting your moneys worth. It’s expensive, but honestly, I’d pay more. I couldn’t be happier with this purchase!
My dream sun lotion I have been looking for. We went to the beach and no sunburn on face and neck with this protection.

I love La Mer. I use a lot of their products. Now that I am older I am more concerned with firming than lines. This product is supposed to layer well with the rest of their products. I used it with my Eye Balm Intense and other La Mer products...IE essence. Serum, eye cream, and creme de la mer and not only did it pill but it also made the worst ugliest breakouts all around my eyes. It took months to clear. I don’t know exactly what went wrong but I had to return.

I’ve tried hundreds of eye creams (seriously though I keep track of everything), and I keep coming back to this one because it is the only eye cream I’ve found that provides hydration throughout the night. I always wake up with plump and rested skin around my eyes. Despite the price this is my HG eye cream.

La Mer can do no wrong with their skincare line and this is no exception. Light and airy and blended into my skin very easily! I had no issues layering with makeup as it performed well! Would buy again!
