Disappointed. Thankfully I received a travel sized jar of this before I splurged on the larger. The amount of silicone in this is so gross. I can feel more silicone in this facial cream than in many primers I’ve tried. For such a hefty price tag you’d think they use something else to achieve the desired result. I was so happy to see this new version did not have petroleum as all the other ones in the La Mer line do. This one is a complete letdown. I still love the Eye Concentrate and the Lotion but have yet to find a great facial cream from this line.

I wanted to love this but it was so heavily fragranced that it bothered my skin. It’s surprising considering the price. It’s a fine moisturizer but it’s nothing special. Sorry La Mer this was a la miss.

I received this cleanser in a set with a few other La Mer products. It wasn’t on my radar but I was pleasantly surprised. This creamy foam lathers and makes the skin feel squeaky clean with no tightness or overdrying. I love it at night as my second cleanser (following DHC deep cleansing oil) and in the morning on days when I’m not exfoliating. It provides the skin with a fresh start to layer products on top.
Removes any residual traces of makeup after cleansing and leaves me feeling hydrated. Getting ready to repurchase

In my opinion, it is a wonderful oil that really does wonders for my skin.   Makes my skin glow, without leaving an oily residue like other oils do.  Also gives my skin a supple appearance.   Amazing results when paired with self tanning drops.  Nothing compares.  HOWEVER, The price is ridiculous. You go through the product FAST!  At least with the creme, I have approx 6/7 months use.  One standard bottle of this oil lasts me about <3 months with regular use.  Maybe if I win the lottery I’d have this as a staple in my skin care routine, but for now, I’d only purchase during sales or with decent incentives (at other retailers like Saks/Nordstorm that give u complimentary La Mer products with purchase).   In the mean time, I use Blume’s Melt Down oil.   Works okay, but does not mix well with my self tanning drops.

this was the first la mer product I ever bought and tbh it’s best to skip this one and invest in their cream instead. this leaves your face so tight and stripped, not to mention it caused breakouts and small bumps on my cheeks. the price for the mini is also ridiculous... I will be going back to a different cleanser. will say it does clean your face real good but it isn’t worth for breakouts and dry skin.
So lightweight yet effective. I like to use this as the weather begins to warm up.

A great value if you’re regularly using La Mer moisturizer! I splurged big time on this set and it’s better than I hoped! The box is not only gorgeous but super sturdy and keeps everything neat on my bathroom counter. This will last me a LONG time before I need to repurchase. 5 stars for me!
I’ve tried exfoliators from Kate Somerville, Laura Mercier, Fresh, AmorePacific.. and by far this one by La Mer takes the cake!!!!!!!!!! Face glows after use. THE BEST!

Absolutely love this moisturizer. It wore great on my skin under my makeup and improved the overall texture of my skin after several days of using. Highly recommend if you are in the market for a new moisturizer

This product is a green cream that foams up nicely and it feels really nice and silky on the skin. However, I have oily skin   sensitive skin and this product made my face feel tight. It was a strange feeling because it didn’t look like it stripped my face as it left a residue on my face that made my face look shiny. But my face still felt tight and uncomfortable. I bought the small $25 tube and ended up returning it after 2 uses. I wanted to try a different cleanser and expected more from this product because I heard it was supposed to be a “hydrating“ cleanser but no cleanser has worked for me like Cetaphil’s Gentle Cleanser.

So this moisturizer was middle of the road for me. It has a very thick consistency but doesn’t provide a lot of moisture, so I feel it’s not enough for dry skin. It just soaks in quickly and feels like nothing is there. The ingredient list definitely doesn’t justify the cost, I don’t want to see Petrolatum as the third ingredient if I’m paying $380 for 2oz.
If you can afford the price, get it.  It is a luxurious world-class product.  I think its a good investment.

Nice product!  Great for skin over 40,  great mark better to leave on over night.  If you are in your 20’s - I can understand why you left a not so great review- this is not for you!  I am almost 50 and I wish I started using this sooner!
This is an amazing mask! I put it on before bed and leave it on! My skin in the morning is so soft and hydrated!

I received this today and used it for the first  time. I am impressed at how simply beautiful the bottle is. I poured some on a pad and went it glided like silk over my skin and while removing every drop of makeup without stripping my skin. And it smells fantastic. I already look forward to removing my makeup tomorrow night.
One application and I swear it took 5 years off my skin! I’m a 39 year old man. This stuff is amazing.
Why does sephora not post my review on this??I’ve written one four times now.... Anyway, this seemed to give me little bumps and blemishes and was a tad drying. Its a miss for me.
I have very dry skin and I wear this under my make up it has SPF. This product makes my skin very soft.  My skin looks luminesce.

The la mer soft moisturizing cream is my favorite moisturizer. Doesn’t clog pores, perfect scent, hydrates and plumps the skin. The best moisturizer. A bit expensive but worth it especially for mature skin

My mom loves this moisturizer and bought me one despite  telling her I didn’t want it because I do not like LA MER products. I’ve tried more than a few products and they’ve never failed to disappoint.Not a fan of the smell, broke me out horribly, left my face feeling greasy. I have purchased several moisturizers in the past several months that are far superior for a bit less. Save your money lovelies, this just isn’t it. I promise.

This La mer moisturizer is very hydrating and not to thick or thin. My only problem is that it is highly fragranced. I am usually not affected by scented products but this one is a bit overpowering for me.
One of the best face washs I have ever used you feel so clean!!! So freaking fresh and lives your skin looking like a million dollars it’s pricey but it’s worth it

This mask is okay, but I prefer this Lifting and Firming Mask to this one. This mask is just so thin. It’s even thinner than a typical lotion. I put it in my fridge because I thought that might thicken it up, but nope!
Provides good lathering, removes makeup and dirt and feels refreshing but if I had to wash twice to remove heavy makeup, it’s a bit dryingI’m going to give the gel cleanser a try

Would highly recommend if you have a combination skin. It’s so easy to apply and it feels good on my skin. No sticky residue at all. The smell is so luxurious! So light and refreshing perfect for the fall weather. Definitely my favorite go to cream!

So I have combination skin and rosacea and this moisturizer has done wonders for my skin. I use it both day and night, just one pump for my face (and eyes) and another pump for my neck. I have not broken out, and my skin adores this moisturizer.  It is lighter than the creme de la mer, which my skin was not so crazy about. But also heavy enough to keep skin from drying out during the cooler months. Also, I’ve had a single bottle for over three months now. It is highly cost-effective in that sense. Well worth the money.

I really liked this after the first use as it made my skin so soft and silky feeling, even after I woke up the next morning. I read a lot of reviews claiming it made them break out and I was like huh..interesting. Lo and behold, after 3 uses, I have a handful of massive zits in places I don’t normally get them. My skin has really been behaving too, and this is the only new product I’ve used within the last couple weeks.

I like this cleanser. It doesn’t overly dry your skin (i have oily skin), and it has helped to speed up the clearing of my breakouts. Its just a bit expensive. I’m sure there are other cleansers likes this for a better price. Its green, with little exfoliating beads in it that I also like. It turns into a foam like texture when wet and a little goes along way. I swear I had this bottle for over a year.

La Mer’s only disappointment is always in the price but if it’s in your budget and you want a chemical SPF that sinks in, looking like you put absolutely nothing to your face, this by far the best formula I’ve bought. Would repurchase if I weren’t trying to be more spending-conscious.

If you have acne prone, sensitive, or even sort of normal skin this will break you out!!! Not just a little breakout, it will give you terrible acne. I broke out from it and couldn’t find out what was wrong. My mom broke out from it and so did 2 of my friends. no no no!

I almost forgot this was micellar water and thought it was a treatment lotion... and then I continued to seamlessly remove my makeup without a tug. Yes it’s expensive and I absolutely splurged but I would do it again!!!!! I have a background in skincare and beauty so I felt the need to resist the hype and the prices at la mer counter for YEARS...  again, thinking it was a bunch of hype. I can only speak for what I’ve tried, this micellar water and the pump foundation so far- and so far so great. Will it change your life? Maybe. Will you know that you’re missing something in your beauty routine if you’re already using an a-ok  micellar water like garnier? Probably not.

This micellar water makes me hate early morning wake up calls a little bit less! Beautiful soft La Mer fragrance we all have come to know & love, gentle yet effective texture to remove any residue on my skin that accumulated overnight. I haven’t tried this to remove my makeup, but I’m certain as other reviews said it must work well for that. Personally I prefer to just use a micellar water first thing in the morning for a quick, gentle cleanse before my skincare and makeup goes on. Lasts a long time too. Will repurchase !!!!

This lotion is perfect for my oily skin.  A little of this product goes a long way and helps moisturize my skin without leaving a greasy film.  I love applying this first thing in the morning or right before I go to bed to wake up to smooth and soft skin.

light-weight texture but very moisturizing. I have very dry and dehydrated skin but this works so well. A little goes a long way. I have tried so many moisturizers and this one is the best I have tried.
I love the texture, smell, and the brush that came with it, it’s the softest mask brush I’ve ever used.
Phenomenal and you have left over lotion in the packet good enough for 2-3 uses.Hydrating, nice smell, supple skin. Plumps wrinkles short term
This product calms the skin and it’s not irritating at all. I don’t know if it helps with reducing breakouts but so far it hasn’t done anything wrong.
I LOVE this product, I will buy again for sure!

This cream is so luxurious! A little definitely goes a long way. I am loving the smooth texture of this cream. When I put it on, my skin feels instantly hydrated. I am a fan. It is definitely on the pricey side, but if you have the extra $$ I’d say that this is great! Definitely recommend this moisturizing cream!
I really enjoy this product.  I use many La Mer products but I’m disappointed to see the majority of them have gone up in price recently.

I’m in my mid 30s. And I’ve been using this serum for a few years now. I have puffy under eye and this serum gives it an instant lift. I use it day and night, twice a day without fail. A bottle goes a long way. It usually lasts me up for 10 months to a year. I’ve had a few of the massage wands now that I use two to give my eye a gentle massage every time I use the serum. Had it been more affordable I would have given it 5 stars

I received this product complimentary from La Mer in exchange for my honest review. I love the soft cream! It smells great, and it feels light on. A little goes a long way! It’s not too heavy under my makeup. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and smooth.

Got this in the mail today. I usually don’t get my LM from Sephora as it tends to arrive frozen, however with the spring weather and sale I took a chance. It arrived 2 days after ordering, very quick. My only grip, which isn’t Sephoras fault, is that this set didn’t come with the spatulas the La Mer creams normally do - nota huge issue I can just buy some but for $475 La Mer I expect spatulas.

I’ve been using the original La Mer moisturizing cream for a few years, so I was curious to see how the soft cream compares. It’s quite similar, but it’s a bit lighter and not as thick. I find I have to use more of it to quench my dry skin, so I think it would be ideal for those with normal or combination skin. The cream feels soothing from the moment of application and sinks in quickly without any stickiness or greasiness. It does contain added fragrance, which seems unnecessary.

This cleanser is absolutely amazing. I’ve tried quite a few from many different product lines and this is one of the few that leaves my skin feeling squeaky clean and but not super dry and typically once I clean my skin, it is aching for moisture. I’m interested to see the long term effects

I really like this product! It is so hydrating and cooling. The cream is obviously more expensive than other items, but a little definitely goes a long way so it is so worth it! This is the perfect item to use at night for moisturized skin in the morning. gifted

I wanted not to like this lipgloss because of the price but this so far is my favorite lipgloss. I use the La Mer lip balm first and my lips feel SO hydrated and not dry at all. My lips very easily become dry and flaky but with this and the lip balm my lips feel great. For someone like me with such dry lips this is a keeper. I just wish they had a slightly darker color or other colors with the same formula. It doesn’t so much plump but it does smooth your lips and keeps them nice and hydrated if you wear the lip balm underneath. Its expensive but I feel I’ve spent so much more on a bunch of other glosses I rarely use.
It dried out  my under eye area and made faint lines under my eyes more prominent! It does reduce puffiness a little bit, but left me dryer than ever before! Returning.
love this so much. my skin literally drinks this up. other than the outrageous price it is well love in this house

I wanted to love this so much but it just doesn’t live up to it’s hype for me. This gives me nivea lotion vibes (smells and feels like it). It stings my eyes a little too which I’ve never experienced with any moisturizer before. A little is supposed to go a long way but I needed way too much for it to actually hydrate my dry skin. Yes my skin is hydrated but only after using a lot of product and dealing with stinging eyes.

This moisturizer is soft and absorbed nicely into my skin - no greasy residue or pilling. It smells great too, that classic lotion smell. It’s pricey but you get what you pay for, and a little goes a long way!

Lightweight and non-greasy. The skin easily absorbs the cream and small amount goes a long way. Highly recommendable for oily to combination skin type. It leaves soft and smooth skin after application. I received this as sample product from La Mer.

I went into Sephora at my favorite location (Town square Las Vegas) and I went in for one thing and came out with a full bag of items LOL.. LA Mer is absolutely my favorite brand (yes it’s expensive) I love all things of La Mer... only 2 stores inside SEPHORA (here in Las Vegas) that carry La Mer products and I went to check out the Lip Volumizer and there wasn’t one on display to test out (don’t test their products on skin like eyes or lips!) and everyone know me there so I told the Manager if I could test one out before buying because there was a lot of bad reviews on it and La Mer products is EXPENSIVE so I wanted to make sure before buying I would like it.. she opened a brand new one for me to test and I put it on and it was just GORGEOUS lip gloss.. I am not a fan of lip glosses at all.. don’t like his they feel ( the sicky or TACKINESS) but this one is just absolutely beautiful.. it glided on my lips and there was no TACKINESS to it just pure shine and I did feel the tingle  and it smelled like peppermint which I like.. so I decided to add this one to my La Mer collection along with their The Lip Balm which is just as lovely as this one!!! LA Mer products is all I wear because it is exceptionally one of those brands that really works (at least for me) with the Miracle Broth  infused in their products to other skin loving benefits.. it’s no wonder why the price tag is set so high.. to get what you pay for and you get exactly the results that you pay for.. (getting of topic) But Their foundation is a 2 in 1 because you get the skin care benefits that no other foundation has.. everyone has their own opinion on this but the foundation is just breath taking.. it sets on its own so no need for powder which I don’t like to do.. and it still has the glow of Radiance with soft powder finish on the skin.. skin like finish.. a glow from within.. just PERFECTION! a must try for all their products!!

I have an oily type skin, and I would say that it is not  light cream, I felt it, but it didn’t give greasy and sticky feeling, I liked it. It actually moisturized my skin. It has a cooling effect when you start applying cream, but disappears in a bit, doesn’t burn

I’m 36 with combination skin. Noticed fine line development on forehead and I’ve used a few la mer products before. Absorbs great! Even with the “no rinse out”, didn’t feel any residue. However, I didn’t notice any difference in my fine lines. My skin does feel tight. So I’d recommend this product more for depufffing

OMG!! This mask is amazing, my skin is very dry, I only bought the mini package to try. The first night i put it on the face before night cream and then I can see my skin is glowing in the next morning. I don’t see skin become firm , but i do see my skin become really smooth. Sometimes i didn’t sleep very well , as long as i apply this mask before sleeping , my skin will look perfect and continue to use this mask for one month, i found it’s away easier to apply foundation as my skin has been looking flawless and glowy
Left my skin really dry... And it smells like cheap soaps. A waste of money.

It’s not horrible, but it honestly doesn’t do much for my skin. For the price, I would expect it to do more. I will be sticking to the regular La Mer as that does more firming and moisturizing than this!
how often do you use this? every night? can you use with retinol?

I have heard so much about la mer because all of the celebrities use it and I was finally able to try it. It made my skin so smooth and hydrated. I like that it feels very light and not greasy on the skin but still makes my skin feel nice and hydrated. Definitely a pricey lotion though

The best Micellar water I have ever tried. As all La Mer products you pay for the quality and the quality is top notch. My makeup comes off easy with my cotton pads. It is hydrating to the skin and has a divine scent. The benefits of the miracle broth stays on your skin!
Love all La Mer and this oil gives a real glow to my skin!!
I love La mer! But I must say there is nothing special about this foam! At least for me. I am giving 3 starts because I truly love the brand.
Amazing. Cleanses, replenishes natural oils, and exfoliates all in one. My skin has never looked or felt better. It’s perfect

LOVE this and I will not switch to any thing else. I have combination and sensitive skin. I love how easily it glides and allow my make up to set on it. Fragrance free is a plus for me. Perfect fit for my everyday morning routine.  Not sure if it is water prof,  but I don’t care. Because I use sports one when I am planning to be in the water and in the sun.
Love this face wash . It is amazing , smells clean , and a little bit goes a very long way . This could last me almost a year so I feel it’s worth it !

LOVE THIS. I’ve only had this now for two days and it’s so wonderful. I always wanted to try la mer products and this was one I wanted to try and it’s so WONDERFUL. It glides on smooth, I am a fan of the applicator, and it does plump my lips (I don’t understand other comments how it doesn’t, however I have never used a “plumper” before so it’s understandable I may have nothing to compare it too yet. It’s so pretty and I will definitely be using it regularly.

I know it’s way too expensive but this is an amazing face oil! I’ve very sensitive skin and this oil never irritates my acne prone face! I’ve noticed a significant difference in overall appearance. My skin tone is looks more even and it gives a very healthy glow! I’ve tried many oils which are little cheaper in price but either ended up breaking out or never saw any difference. But this oil is a magic. Use 3 drops in the morning and 3 drops in the evening with moisturizer and skin feels great! I’ll continue purchasing as long as I can afford it. Best oil in the market. Thank you LA MER
It was okay - an average foamy cleanser. I have oily skin and still had breakouts while using this cleanser.

So good! I had tried the tonic for oily skin (I don’t think Sephora carries it?) and it made my skin look beautiful for about ten minutes till it became a grease trap. I tried this because it has pretty much the same ingredients but this is alcohol free and WOW. The first couple of days I feel like my skin did get a little oilier but after a couple of weeks my skin feels a lot more balanced. Not oily at all, but moisturized and glowing. Nothing I have tried has faded my acne scars as quickly as this did, either. Definitely an amazing product!

This has a taste like the LaMer balm but it’s shinier, silkier, more minty and it has a slllight satin/shimmer tint.  It makes your lips feel super moisturized and look perfectly healthy and shiny.  It doesn’t last as long as say the Bite Agave lip balm/masks but I think it’s because 1) it’s a lot silkier/thinner and 2) it tastes good so I keep smacking my lips together.  I love this.  I’m buying another for my purse and probably another for my work bag.  Lots of $$$ for lip stuff but this is worth it to me.  Love it.

omg! totally in love with this product! My skin just soaks it up and it’s great for cleaning my neck after the barn. It leaves my skin feeling amazing and after 4 weeks I’m seeing drastic improvements in fine wrinkles and elasticity. seems to be a nice amount of miracle broth. it is expensive but so worth it! Try it you won’t be disappointed so glad I did.

This is my favorite cleanser of all time. You only need a tiny bit activated with water to get lots of foaming action. The foam is very hydrating and leaves your skin feeling clean and soft. I have been buying this cleanser for many years.

Omg! I bought this as a blind purchase as I love whatever La Mer products I have (gel exfoliant and gel cleanser) and this product is amazing! I only wash my face once a day and I use this in the morning to ’cleanse’ before I use an essence and moisturizer. Let me tell you how my skin feels! So soft, smooth and clean! I use a bit onto a cotton make up pad and it cleans the night cream off and my skin looks amazing! First time using a micellar water and definitely will keep this one going!

I like this micellar water, I find it washes away all the makeup effortlessly. But it leaves my skin feeling tacky, and it smells like sunlight dish soap to me; but I have to wash my face again with water or another cleanser afterwards (which defeats the purpose) For the price point, I will continue to use the bottle I have, but will not repurchase.

Highly recommended! It’s really good! My skin become so much better every time I use this mask. I often apply it 3-4 times weekly cause I also use other mask. I will use the pad to rinse off the mask with honey water( honey and water mixed) And do the rest of the skincare routine. My skin feels so smooth. My pores and blackhead are better as well. I will keep purchasing it in the future.

Sephora sent me a sample of this product. I really wanted to hate this because of it’s ludicrous price tag. When I put it on I was floored by the way it makes your face look. Im considering selling a kidney so I can afford it on a regular basis.
Nice product, but not for me. I prefer something less messy to use, like a cleansing wipe. Glad I got the trial size before committing.
I didn’t want to love it but I do. It replaced my eye makeup remover. I now use less of oil/water cleanser. The smell is divine. It smells like luxurious skincare.

I was using seabreeze to get that “clean” feeling and try to keep away acne and I took a chance and added this to my LaMer skincare regime and I absolutely love this. It balances the ph levels of my skin and completely got rid of what acne I had especially around my hairline on the high points of my cheekbones. It doesn’t irritate and I have severe eczema! Definitely a repurchase and recommend. Worth the money!

This cream is absolutely phenomenal! From the moment I ran my fingers across the cream when I first opened the jar, I knew it was going to be amazing. The texture is incredibly silky, rich and makes my feel super soft. I tend to have dry skin and this is a total game changer! The packaging is luxurious and has a nice weight to it. I don’t think Lancôme has any bad products!

The mask is nice and works well. I dropped it lower for the price. If you look at cost to outcome, I think you can do better. I also found this one hard to position on my face, which isn’t true for most sheet masks. Nice but I wouldn’t repurchase.

This is a fantastic cream! I use tretinoin at night, so my face tends to need some extra moisture. This cream is a wonderful addition to my routine and it feels so luxurious. A little goes a long way, which is nice considering the very high price point. But it sinks into my skin well and leaves my skin feeling so soft by the morning. It has a bit of fragrance, but I am not bothered by fragrance in my skincare. Also, it does not seem to irritate my acne prone skin so far.
Super hydrating! Love these masks. Acne prone and they didn’t break me out. By far my favorite sheet masks. My skin looked plump and smooth afterward
A really rich, luxurious moisturizer. I wake up with my skin feeling very hydrated.

I’m giving 5 stars for the Youth Activating serum (the black bottle). I’m a 25 year old with moderate sensitive skin and I can tell you that using this serum will completely change your skin. It is amazzzzing! My skin looks more radiant and fine lines under my eyes have started to disappear.
This moisturizer feels amazing on! Reminds me of the LaMer cream. I love to apply this at night and when I wake up my skin feels glorious!! My skin feels both more soft and supple

I’m LOVING this serum!! To start, the bottle and the packaging are gorgeous! Be aware, the dropper squirts more than it drops so you need to make sure your face is angled correctly to not waste product. The serum itself is light and has minimal stickiness which made applying it easy and enjoyable. The very next day after the first night of use, I noticed immoderate results. My skin was SO bright, hydrated and youthful looking. This was after one application! Since then, it’s been consistently delivering its promised results!! I will definitely be getting another bottle when this one runs out! I would recommend this to anyone!!

I have acne prone skin and i use the day time SPF version of this in the daytime over my BP/clindamycin prescription cream and it has been a game changer. I was looking for a night cream that had similar effects as the daytime one in regards to moisturizing and anti aging and Lancôme representative recommended i use this one in pair with my prescription retin a. I used it for one week and experienced quite a few break outs. I’m not sure if it just doesn’t pair well with prescription retin A or if it is to heavy for my specific skin type but was quite a bummer considering how expensive it is. I did give it two stars because I’ve been using it on my neck and chest since it makes me breakout on my face and it hasn’t caused any irritation and does feel quite luxurious in regards to its moisturizing properties.
This is an high-end moisturizer that *feels* expensive, and worth the price. It’s a light, silky lotion that provides excellent hydration. I love it.

This is it. This is what I wanted/needed and didn’t even know it. It’s a wonderful toner that includes moisturizing. My skins feels wonderful when I apply it after washing. It smells pretty nice, too.

Love this stuff. Sinks into my skin and gets the job done. Underneath my eyes are definitely brighter with this product. I recommended this product to my cousin and she’s in love as well. I will say I saw a difference within a few days but with my cousin it took a bit longer.

Did not absorb very well. So thick and dense it was actually suffocating.........my face and neck started to perspire. This product is too heavy for my skin type even in the winter months. I did love the creamy texture and the smell was pleasant.
Great smell. Lovely texture. Not for my sensitive skin though. Immediately clogged my pores. Tried it on my husband and it clogged his too. We both broke out. I did receive this product as a sample.

For 3+ years I’ve been using Neutrogena as a moisturizer, and it was okay, until a friend gave me a sample of this baby. I already noticed the difference in a day. I actually did an experiment using Neutrogena under my makeup, and then Lancome -- BIG FAT DIFFERENCE! Using this product made my skin looked porcelain. It’s a little bit greasy at first, but it goes away. The smell is pretty luscious too, another thing that I like about it! Price wise, it’s very reasonable, just because it works like magic. I think the last time I had a perfect skin was when I was 16!

Ok so this is a very nice moisturizer! Super soft and luxurious feeling. This absorbs super fast and didn’t leave my skin sticky or greasy feeing. It does have a really nice fragrance but it’s light and didn’t bother me.
Love this moisturizer. It leaves my skin feeling amazing after a long day and helps it relax. I received this product complimentary for reviewing purposes
Works really well and helped with my dry skin. I took one star off due to the rose scent, it will give you a headache if you’re sensitive to these things.
This serum’s texture is light and really hydrates my skin after using my cleanser. I see my face skin more radiant, clear and smoother than before!

Very great mist. The reason i bought this was because I needed a setting spray and the lady sephora recommended this to me. However, she was VERY wrong. Horrible mist to ever set your makeup. So now i use this after i wash my face and it is very hydrating and smells amazing! The mist is thicker so I end up spraying onto my hand then rubbing around.
Absolutely the best moisturizer I’ve tried! I’ve been a fan for years because it makes my skin feel soft and plump and hydrated. 10 out of 10 will recommend.

I received this product as a sample and have used it day and night for over 2 weeks. I think I have tried almost every eye cream on the market from Chanel to Kiehls to drugstore brands. This product is extremely hydrating and definitely made a difference with crepiness and dryness. I cant say it will reduce your wrinkles, however, due to the hydration factor my lines were greatly diminished.  As far as dark circles I did not notice a difference. Another bonus was my under eye concealer went on smoother and by the end of the day my under eyes still looked very good. Overall I would recommend this product.

I’ve heard pros and cons to using eye creams. Many feel they’re unnecessary. But with mature skin, it is even more important for me to protect and maintain the thinner skin on the eyes. In the past, I’ve found eye creams to either be ineffective, or too thick, causing breakouts or irritating my eyes.The Absolue Revitalizing cream has the right balance. It is emollient, but not too thick. It is also not too thin and watery, thereby migrating into my very dry and sensitive eyes.  I find it gentle on my increasingly sensitive skin. But I don’t know how extremely sensitive skin would react.One of the good things is that you don’t need too much product. With the hefty price tag, you can still get a ton of usage out of one container. So go light with usage as a little goes a long way.

I decided to treat myself with this beauty at my 48th birthday. Money well spent.  I feel as if I’m in a spa every time I carefully layer a full serving of this cream. It’s creamy yet not greasy.  Smells great!  And it’s pretty absorbent it immediately adjust to skin filling in my pores giving my skin the healthy looking skin I crave  Will buy another set for my mother for mother day coming up.
I promise have one pimple apply this at night and it is GONE!!! this makes my skin feel rejuvenated. Love this product line.

This must be the most luxurious moisturizer I have ever used. My favorite part is the scent as it leaves you with a truly rose scent lingering in the air for the entire night. Quality: The moisturizer did a great job evening and brightening my skin tone. I used it morning and evening for three weeks and see a significant improvement in my skin texture. My skin was really radiant in the morning and my foundation make up applied on more smoothly. I have sensitive skin and did not have any breakouts which I typically get from moisturizers advertised to provide such great hydration. Appearance: The moisturizer is a beautiful pink shade and combined with the rose scent truly makes you feel luxurious. The bottle is a beautiful gold finish which looks nice on any counter and I could imagine the entire skin care line together would make a nice display. This moisturizer was so great it reinvigorated my entire skin care routine. I enjoyed washing my face every night and prepping my skin. With this renewed skin care, I even noticed my hyperpigmentation start to lighten. I highly recommend the moisturizer for a radiant glow.

I have combination skin with dry patches and am always looking for a great moisturizer that doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin or cause breakouts.  Because My skin is so sensitive, I’m always wary of scented products, but the Absolue Rich Cream Moisturizer did not irritate my skin and the light scent was pleasant and not too overwhelming.  While it’s a thick cream (which I like), it’s easy to apply and soaks into my skin without feeling heavy.  I also like  that it’s dual function and not  only adds moisture but also reduces fine lines.  After two weeks, my skin does seem more supple and makeup applies better without caking in dry spots.  I look forward to seeing more improvement as I continue to use the moisturizer.

Absolutely love this moisturizer! It’s absolutely perfect for the winter months and it’s that good that my husband tried it once and automatically claimed it as his. Very mild yet pleasant scent. Super rich in texture and I wake up with my skin feeling super soft. Highly recommend if you live in cold climates.
Expensive but totally worth it. A little goes a long way and it’s not too heavy even tho it’s thick. Does wonders to my skin and to my sisters acne prone skin. My favorite!

I received this cream as a sample. It applies smoothly and feels hydrating without feeling greasy. The scent however is terrible, and I really like scented skincare products. It’s smells of musty old perfume. Definitely test this before you buy if you are at all sensitive to scent.
Love this product. Love the way it smells and feels. It feels so smooth and apples so softly.

The moisturizer is a bit thick and i love it. I have very dry skin and I can put this on and still feel hydrated hours later. Usually I don’t like rose scents, but this scent soft and lovely. It absorbs fairly quickly and doesn’t leave you greasy, but very moisturized. I’ve used both under my makeup and as part of my nighttime routine. As for long term effect, I can’t say for sure yet, but in 3 weeks I can say it has made a difference with how smooth and moisturized my face is. The packaging is great, gold glass jar with plastic lid and I love that it’s actually refillable. I can’t say for sure if this will be a repurchase yet because the price is offputting but I’ll know for sure when the jar is gone. This jar will last a long time because a little bit goes a loooooong way.
Love love love the texture of this product. I am close to 50 years old and my skin feels absolutely amazing after I apply this night cream. Will definitely buy it again.

I just love love love this cream, from the very first time I used it my skin was so soft and smooth. I have now used the cream daily for 10 days. I have been using the cream as part of my morning regimen and I have noticeably less fine lines and a smoother complexion when applying my makeup. I intend on continuing daily use, this product now has a new forever customer and I will be recommending this product to my friends & family. this product was provided to me by a free sample program and I am sold on the quality. Soft, smooth skin makes me happy. Happy skin, happy life.

This works wonder on combination skin! This face cream is absolue-tly lovely! It is so luxurious and moisturizing. I love Lancôme skincare products and this one exceeded my expectations. It is wonderful as a night cream. I wake up with soft, plumped skin.

Oh wow, look at me spend an entire fortune on this cream! This cream went on smoothly and my skin felt so soft and hydrated. I was surprised on how much I enjoyed this cream. I have used a few of Lancome’s more “high end“ creams and always seen results but, the price tag on this one takes the cake...and it definitely deserves it. I consider it a hydrating facial in a bottle. Someone take my credit card away :D

This is the absolute best mask I have EVER used. I have  severely dry skin. I have tried numerous mask and lotions to help with my problem. After using this mask one time I noticed immediate results that had my skin looking flawless for a week or so. It left me with AMAZING results. I recently purchased the box of four mask so I can start using them once a week. $15 Is a little pricey compared to other sheet mask, but it is worth every penny!

I received this complementary free eye cream. I works great my fine lines started to slowly disappear after a week of using it. I have used this for about a month.  My skin doesn’t look dry, but it feels tighter than usual.  Maybe it’s the “tightening“ they claim it does even though don’t really see a difference.

This product is so luxurious, you feel fancy just by using it…from the design of the gold packaging, to the thick, moisturizing and lightly scented cream. It’s still relatively early, but after using this product consistently for almost two weeks (day and evening), I do see a difference in the appearance of my dark circles. Lightweight moisturizer, almost a gel cream. Cooling sensation when applied. Rose scented. I don’t see redness decrease with it, but it feels calming and soothing.

I do really like this product, but for the price I probably wouldn’t buy it again. My skin appears brighter and more even. It has a weird smell but it fades very quickly. I do really like how the bottle self measured for you. I received this product as a free trial.
I’ve been using this product for about 2-3 weeks now & my pores definitely look smaller. My hyperpigmentation is also less noticeable.

I received a LancômeAbsolue Rich Cream Moisturizer in exchange for my honest review and I’m so happy I did because I probably wouldn’t have purchased it otherwise. I absolutely love this moisturizer it has made my face and neck so so soft and hydrated along with lightning my fine lines and wrinkles. I will never go back to using any other products. Thank you Lancome !!

I’ve been using this night cream for two years now it’s very hydrating I do believe in its anti aging power as my face in the morning glows and never feels stiff and the price is just right for what you get. I also buy the day moisturizer with SPF 15 and I have no complaints. I don’t feel the need to use makeup since these moisturizers make my skin so youthful looking.
I purchased this to try it out however I wasn’t impressed.  It’s definitely smooth and all but i feel like it didn’t moisterize my skin, infact Iit made my skin dry, I had to mix oil to it.

I’ve been using this mask for a few years when I need an extra boost and is feeling dehydrated or dull. I prefer to buy the multi packs because it’s cheaper that way. So worth it. The smell is a bit much but if you use Genefique it’s nothing new.  This mask definitely works better for me than the serum alone. I like to use it 1-2 days before an event for smooth skin and flawless makeup application. The mask is definitely shaped weird, I can’t seem to ever get it to be perfect, so docking a star for that and the fragrance. My skin feels so refreshed and smooth every time I use this, will continue to purchase.

Absolutely love this product. No oily residue. Weightless. My skin soaks this up and I’m able to apply make up or my evening routine. This doesn’t break me out and has a really nice smell that isn’t over powering. I highly recommend this product.

I have been using this mist for over 2 years now and I cannot go without it even for a day. I have combination skin and this mist hydrates my skin enough to go without an additional layer of moisturizer. Gives a rosy glow to face and leaves the skin soft and supple.The only drawback of the product is tge spray/nozzle. Does not work sometimes and leaves liquid dripping from the nozzle.

I really enjoy using this product as the last step in my skincare routine. This cream is thick and has a luxurious texture. It immediately gives you a glowy complexion, and maintains the moisture throughout the day. I will say I have noticed a bit of dryness around my nose, eyes and mouth, and can attribute this to the actives in this product. Layering this with an additional moisturizer may be best for dryer skin types.

I love doing this mask at night before I go to bed because when I wake up the next morning my skin feels so soft and plump. My makeup goes on smoother and just looks better after using this mask. This mask is a treat and worth the price

This came in one of those Sephora Exclusive kits, with rose products. I honestly didn’t think much of it. More my mums generation brand. I finally got around to using it. It says apply to damn skin, I’ve done damn and dry, just out of bed skin. I enjoyed using it both ways. The sugar gives a nice exfoliating wash. Not to harsh, yet enough to feel it’s actually exfoliated. The scent isn’t overwhelming and fades nicely. The only reason I didn’t give 5 stars: it leaves kind of a thin “layer/coating” on the face. Which I don’t like, I personally prefer the super clean feel, before adding my primer/sunscreen, so a good toner was used after this...to remove that film like feeling. It’s most likely due to the sugar, every single sugar body scrub I’ve used, does this. If you like that coating, you’ll love this. I still would recommend and buy again sometime. I’d just keep my toner handy.

For a scrub and physical exfoliant, I really like it. I have sensitive skin and it’s been safe for me. I use it a few times a week, as an alternative to my La Roche Posay cleanser, or sometimes in addition to it if I’m wearing stubborn makeup.

First of all, I’m a Lancôme fan. I have so many products! So when I got this Absolue Revitalizing Eye Cream as a gift I was excited to try it and after 2 weeks of applying it day and night I truly have seen good results, like the tiny wrinkles around my eyes are less visible. And I only apply a tiny amount, that’s enough to cover both eyes. I apply some concealer after and boom! Magic happens.

Pricey, but a nice treat. It’s an OK base before makeup but I prefer to leave it on for 30 minutes (or until it feels dry) before bed. My skin is glowing after and it carries through to the morning without fail. I use this to target dehydration and texture. I’m acne prone + sensitive and react well to this mask.

This is a nice product, but was overall not a good fit for my sensitive, combination skin. I found the rose scent pretty, but not for a face product as it feels like wearing perfume on my nose. It is a unique texture which I liked for my winter dry patches, but would only use in the winter because t-zone gets too oily in the summer. I would like it more as a gel vs a crème.

This is hands down the most indulgent, effective and quickly working eye cream I have ever used.! And believe me, I’ve tried a lot of eye products and nothing even comes close to the results I’m getting with Lancôme’s ABSOLUE Revitalizing Eye Cream! The texture is just heavenly. It’s thick, creamy and almost gel-like but surprisingly lightweight and breathable too. I apply it to the delicate skin underneath and around my eyes and this cream instantly moisturizes, smoothes and completely rejuvenates that creepy skin around my eye area. Most thicker eye creams like this just tend to settle into my fine lines and crows feet - really doing nothing at all. But this eye cream absorbs completely and quickly and goes right to work making the skin around my eyes appear brighter, firmer and more youthful looking than ever before. I swear in just as little as a few hours, I was blown away by how toned and firmed the delicate skin around my eyes had become. And in just one week, my fine lines and crows feet had become practically invisible, the delicate skin around my eyes was noticeably tighter and I started to look like I was having the best sleep ever because my eyes looked so refreshed and well rested. This cream also does an excellent job at drastically reducing eye puffiness and those unsightly under-eye bags we all hate seeing. With every application, I fall in love with this eye cream more and more. The gold packaging is so beautiful and this cream has a very, very light and delicate scent (fresh and floral) that I adore. A little bit of this eye cream goes a long way too, so one container will really last me for awhile. I honestly can’t imagine ever purchasing another eye cream again after having the absolute pleasure of trying ABSOLUE! Highly impressive! Highly recommended!!

This is a BEAUTIFUL bottle right out of the box. I love the concept of this dropper bottle shape and size. I like how the dropper automatically fills up when you turn it close so you don’t need to draw from the bottle each time. I do have to say that the amount it draws is suppose to be the amount you use. I felt I didn’t need as much as it draws and the dropper leaks if you don’t release it quick enough. There is a strong scent to this. I can’t quite put my finger on it, like a mix of herbal and chemical, and it’s not very pleasant. It’s not the worst but not what I expected out of a Lancôme product. This is advertised as a solution. At first I was like, what is a solution? I’ve never heard of one and when do I use it? I would say it’s basically a serum. Place it after washing or toner. It’s a clear solution that goes on light. It’s not sticky which is a plus. It is quite strong and I found using a couple times a week and alternating helped. Avoid the eye area! It made the skin around my eye peel and itch due to the high level of PHA so just be careful and read the labels.I felt this solution did help with tightness and reducing pores. I can’t say I saw a difference with brightening. I could tell it did really make my skin very light sensitive so wear a sunscreen during the day. I kept this to use only at night. Overall, it’s a great product but I would have to finish the bottle to decide if I’d buy a 2nd depending on full effects.

I absolutely adore every single thing about this cream! The texture feels so luxurious upon application; it is both rich and creamy and also light and soft. This beautifully textured cream is extremely hydrating and moisturizing and feels amazing on my skin. This cream melts into my skin, leaving it feeling so extraordinarily well nourished. It leaves my skin feeling so satiny smooth and so unbelievably soft and supple throughout the day/night. It is truly amazing how long the hydration lasts! Although most skincare products take time to see results, I noticed an immediate change in my skin after just one use. My skin definitely looks and feels healthier and the benefits keep increasing with each use (I’ve been using the cream for two weeks now). My fine lines have definitely lessened in appearance and my skin appears smoother and with a newfound luminosity. An absolutely amazing cream! I can’t say enough good things about it! Love. Love. Love. Additionally, the light scent is lovely and the jar is gorgeous. (I also really appreciate that you can purchase a refillable capsule, making the product more eco-friendly).

I got this in my November Play box and I really wanted to love it because it sounded like a really different and interesting new kind of moisturizer, and knowing it’s Lancôme I had high expectations.Well honestly, it’s kind of been a dud so far. I’ve been using it twice a day and it hasn’t really been at all transformative or life changing for skin. It also doesn’t turn into a gel like how it says it does. I’ll still use it until my sample runs out, but so far I’m not impressed.

I received a complimentary Clarique Pro-solution in exchange for an honest review. I use this serum in the morning and before I go to bed, and I have definitely noticed a difference in my skin appearance and texture. My skin feels smoother and more refreshed, and this solution does not make my skin feel greasy or sticky after use. I would definitely buy this product again, although I do wish that the serum itself were thicker rather than a liquid / thin consistency. Nevertheless, I would recommend this serum to a friend; it is one of the best serums I have ever used!
I love both of these products! I purchased this over a year ago and still have a little left! It makes my skin feel so soft and not oily. I would purchase this

This is the most luxurious cream I have ever used !! I did used more expensive ones before this but Hands down this is the best so far!! If you are looking for a cream with antiaging and hydrating properties with the feel of a rich glowy face this is it! I know this is expensive but its so worth it! I will definitely buy this again!

I have tried the cream for about 2 weeks now.  First the texture feels creamy and absorbs quick with a lovely scent.  I feel like my skin is softer and the skin tone is evening out.  Overall the cream is very nice and I feel like it is helping with my complexion.  However I do think it is a little pricey.  At the same point, need to treat yourself.  And I feel skincare is important.

The lancome absolue soft cream is so luxurious and feels very high end - from the beautiful gold packaging to the way it melts and absorbs into your skin. I saw results immediately as it gives my skin an amazing glow, but also longer term after using it consistently ive noticed smoother, plumper skin. I would definitely repurchase and recommend this product!

One of the best sheet face masks! I know it’s a little pricey but definitely worth it. I wouldn’t recommend using it in the morning before makeup because it makes your skin tacky, however it’s great to use at night. It makes my skin feel so hydrated and supple. I wish the fit was a little better but I love that it’s a gel mask.

This moisturizer is nice but not my favorite. I have very dry skin and it didn’t leave my skin feeling super hydrated. It went on smoothly and has a great texture. However I think it is better suited for combo or normal skin. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

It took me 10 minutes to apply this mask. For the price I don’t think it should take this long. This mask was heavily fragranced. After I took it off, I didn’t see a difference compared to other mask that I am using. I won’t recommend this to anyone.
Amazing! I have dry skin that is prone to redness. This mask didn’t irritate me at all, moisturized, and I swear made my skin look younger! Definitely will be re-purchasing!
It’s good not great! I have not noticed anything going on at all. I won’t be buying again. The best thing about it is the smell. It smells good, but not over powering! Thank goodness.

I am a full blown product junkie and absolutely love makeup and body products.  However I have really had to reign it in over the last few years because my face was breaking out.  It have tried everything from cheap to expensive and didn’t have a while lot of luck.  I got this in a gift set and figured ok something else to try.  And boy and I glad I did!!!  Between this and the glam glow mud mask I also got a sample of, I am buying the full size of both.  For once my skin is soft and breakout free.  I wore lancome for years and then stayed away but I am so glad I am back.  My skin looks so great and the smell I think of the cream is luxurious and lovely.  It is a bit pricey but for all the money I have spent over the years trying to find something that works, it is worth every penny.

I gave this 4 stars just because it’s advertised as a mist and it’s truly a softening lotion with a milky consistency. That being said, it’s an AMAZING softening lotion. You can spray it but you will end up spreading it with your fingers.
Bought 2, one for me, one for my mom and it was a slimy mess and was so hard to apply it was more stressful than relaxing, didnt see any results after either, big waste of money

I’m a skin care junkie, and I have just about every mask out there and this one has a special place in my heart. The only down side to this mask is it has the powdery smell that I find a lot of luxury brands have (similar to Amaora Pacific) which I don’t love but this mask works so well I don’t care about the smell.
Love it! Thick and rich that’s perfect for my use in the evening and wake up to smooth skin in the morning. Already had my mom try who loves it as well. The scent is very pleasant like light floral.

I have been using Lancôme Absolue Revitalizing Eye Cream for 2 1/2 weeks now and I am very impressed with the results that I have gotten. It worked for me.
Not for me. Couldn’t get it to seal on my face. Thought the mask was way too big overall. Would not buy again.

It’s the absolute best face cream for dry and aging skin. It smoothens and rejuvenate my skin appropriately. I love it. It gives my skin immediate  glow. Perfect for fall and winter, not sure about summer time. And I won’t be using this cream if I had oily skin.

I ABSOLUTELY love this product! I have super sensitive skin and I was able to use this with no issues. I love what a difference it made to my face in just the two weeks I used it. I like how you can help the environment by buying a refill to put into the container it came in. Will purchase the refill!!!
Ok so the pearl eye serum in this is amazing, I have very sensitive eyes and can put this all over and don’t bother my eyes during the day. I also use it as eyebrow serum for growth so two in one

I really like Lancome Absolue Soft Cream Revitalizing & Brightening Moisturizer.  The cream is packaged  beautifully and I love the golden color choice of the packaging. I feel like anyone that tries Absolue Soft Cream Revitalizing & Brightening Moisturizer by Lancome will be pleased

I use this as an additive to my skin care routine after my toner and before my serums. This product leaves the skin feeling cleaned refreshed and plumped. It hydrates the skin and gets it ready for the next steps. I love this so much I hate to continue on with other products. It just feels so clean and fresh and light on the skin. There is an absolute difference in adding this essence after your toner. I will buy this product again.

I have been using Lancôme Absolue Revitalizing Eye Cream for about three weeks and can honestly say I notice a difference. I first noticed after one application that my makeup applied more smoothly and I didn’t have to “work“ much to prevent creasing. After using for a few days and nights my eyes looked less tired, even on mornings after no sleep at all. The before and after (slightly embarrassing) does show some makeup on the after shot but it is at the end of a long day and a close up to show the fine lines that were under my eyes have disappeared in just under a month. I purposefully wanted to show that the effects last and aren’t just a one hour caffiene “trick“. This is by far the best eye cream I’ve used and after turning 40 this year I have tried quite a few.

dear mother mary i already love genifique but this is just so amazing, to have the product as my favorite type of face mask (i love hydrogel). Feels so nice and actually does what it says it’s supposed to do so i justify the cost
This cleanser & toner make my skin. Soft & glow in love with I recieve this as my birthday gift famo definitely purchasing again

I received this complimentary from Buzzagent. I could not be happier with this cream. My sister saw me with this cream and immediately she said my face has a glow and looks more plump. Using this cream once you will see an improvement. Face looks more youthful and very well taken care of. I would definitely buy this cream.

This rich, luxurious cream was so soft and hydrating. Not only has it made my skin softer and smoother, it’s made it more even toned and brightened it up a bit! The ascent is light and rosy. It’s lovely and so feminine!

This has to be the best moisturizer I’ve ever used. My skin is on the drier side and I tend to use two different moisturizers. This one is so creamy and moisturizing I only need one. Definitely recommend it to anyone who is looking to switch moisturizers.
I received a sample of this, and I splurged for the full size. Completely worth the money! I love the way this makes my skin look and feel.

This cream is just so luxurious and moisturizing! It has easily become my favorite moisturizer!! I have super acne prone skin and this moisturizer did not break me out at all. It makes the skin so smooth, soft and moisturized. It is so worth the price!! I’ve tried so many moisturizers and there is just nothing like this one! It’s consistency is smooth, creamy and hydrating but not heavy at all! I definitely recommend this product, it is worth the price!!

I’ve been using Lancôme Absolue for about two weeks now, and I’m fairly impressed with the results thus far. First thing I notice about facial products is the smell. Being someone who has migraines and very sensitive to smells which can trigger migraines, I was worried this product might smell too rosy. I was actually impressed that the smell, while there, was not overpowering at all and you really don’t smell it at all after application – that is a plus in my book. Having only used the product for two weeks, I haven’t noticed some of the results that other have or results the product claims to help with. However what I have noticed is the puffiness under my eyes seems less in the morning and any puffiness I do have in the morning appears to goes away much faster than before using this product. My under eyes definitely look and feel more hydrated. It also works really well with my other face products and is not too thick.   Couple of side notes about the product: 1. Beautiful packaging and jar! 2. I didn’t get a set of instructions in the packaging, so I found I needed to go online to read about how to apply. 3. The opening of the jar is kind of small, and I had to start using the tip of my nail to get the product out once the level went down. I wish it came with an applicator or was a flatter jar, so I could continue to use the pad of my finger to get the product. 4. This product seems like it could last a long time, given the amount you use each time, so the price tag of Absolue doesn’t seem so bad. I’m looking forward to more results as I continue to use the product.

Love this product! After using for a week, my skin is smoother, both in texture and pigment. I see a reduction of fine lines as well. I also LOVE the scent. I am sensitive to too much fragrance but this is perfect. Plus I love rose, so this is great! Highly recommend!

This is an AMAZING mask!! Instantly hydrates and plumps skin. Great for all skin types- I’m oily and it actually helps to hydrate without making me greasy. Make sure to lay down or be fairly inactive when wearing any sheet mask. Fun tip: after you’re done, flip the face mask over and wear on your neck & chest!

I have been using this eye cream for awhile now and it works for me. It has helped with the bags under my eyes and dark circles. I find that my eyes look more rejuvenated. I have sensitive skin and had no issues using this cream. It’s texture is very nice and creamy and leaves the skin feeling very soft.
Hands down one of my fav sheets masks I have done in a while. It made my skin GLOW & plumped it within 10 minutes!!! I will be purchasing again.

If I had to chose one moisturizer to use for the rest of my life, it would be this one. I bought this on a whim becuase I wanted an anti-aging day cream (+SPF). This has never made me breakout and it provides great hydration, I’ve even used this when I had some mild sun-poisoning and it helped clear it up in a couple of days. Bottom line, if you have skin, this is the moisturizer for you. :)

Nice light weight serum that works well with other serums. I believe I have noticed a slight improvement of the lightening of my post acne dark marks. The negative for me is the scent, it smells like a green bell pepper which makes me not want to always use it. Besides the scent I think it’s really great serum.

- glides so nicely over skin. due to price this is a luxury item for me. the scent is lovely not overpowering I get a little nervous with the word “rose” it’s not my favorite smell for facial products. I wanted to love this cream. Unfortunately after using the whole jar, I notice no difference. I am very disappointed after paying so much for this product.
I have been using it for few weeks and my skin looks fresher. I’m happy to be able to try the product that helps my skin to get back to normal. It smells great.

I received a free sample as part of a promotion for reviewing purposes. After trying this moisturizer for roughly 3 weeks I can honestly say that it is AMAZING! The cream feels amazing and has a nice, calming smell. But it didn’t make any difference to my skin compared to other moisturizers given the price. Wouldn’t purchase this again.

The design is seriously flawed.  It was difficult to get in place and the mask kept sliding down.  After about 15 minutes, it dried enough to stay in place.  The good thing is that it is a lovely cooling sensation and leaves the skin moisturized.  But until they fix the design, I will not purchase again

I was incredibly skeptical of this product when I received it. I’ve not had good luck with nonskincare-specific brands. I have very sensitive, reactive skin, so I am very careful of what I put on it. It kept my face moisturized and comfortable even in winter weather and while being outside in the dryness for hours. I love this cream and I think it really works. The only con is the cost. It’s very expensive and you would get similar results with something cheaper.

I love this scrub, it’s gentle and leaves my skin refreshed and smooth, after gently removing dead skin. I use this 2-3 times a week, the fragrance isn’t overpowering and I just love it. Would recommend.
I love this wonderful product. I noticed the tightness and elasticity of my skin within 4 applications. I have purchased additional products for my sister and mom.

This scrub is very nice, it’s not extremely gritty like some scrubs are, but definitely has texture. It gets kind of warm and melty, but exfoliates nicely. The smell is pretty and not overwhelming. Overall very nice.

I was skeptical at first about this product but soon realized that this eye cream actively applies its ingredients to smoothe and diminish unsightly wrinkles. Let me break it down:Citrus-C Mask & Daily Moisturizer – while this product smells lovely and has a great creamy consistency, I did not find it particularly moisturizing. I also love that the products are the perfect size for travel and the bag they come in is very high quality and re-useable. My favourite product of the trio is the moisturizer. Overall this is a decent kit if you’re looking for something that won’t break you out and gets the job done but I think there are better kits out there.

I was really hoping to love the Origins Checks and Balances Polishing Facial Scrub because I do really love the brand. As soon as I applied it to my skin, I knew that it wasn’t going to be good but I powered through for the sake of leaving this review in hopes to help others. It has a thick cream consistency with an extremely rough, sandy exfoliant mixed throughout. After feeling how rough this product was, I made sure to be gentle when scrubbing my face with it. I used it for about 30 seconds before I knew it needed to be washed off because my skin could no longer handle it. I do have pretty resilient skin, but this product completely broke down my skin’s natural barrier, leaving my face hot and red and causing my normal following products (hydrating toner, calming serum, and moisturizer) to burn and sting - a telltale sign of a damaged skin barrier. I want to note that the last time I exfoliated was 4 days ago, so this is not a result of overexfoliation on my part. I should say that this product does exactly what it says it will do - it sloughs off dead skin cells and surface impurities, buffs the surface of the skin, and helps unclog pores - although not in a way that is safe for your skin. While this product does have many natural plant oils and healthy ingredients, the few bad ingredients overpower the benefits. I’m afraid that those who liked this product do not know enough about skincare to realize what this product is doing, in the same way that many people love the St. Ives Apricot Scrub. I have to say that the Origins scrub is worse than the St. Ives. Unfortunately I will not be using this product again and cannot recommend it to others. If you do decide to try this scrub, please keep my review in mind and start slow and gentle.

I have always had hit and miss experiences with Origins.  This mask, sadly, was a miss for me. I typically use overnight masks to keep my dryer cheeks and chin hydrated; this mask did nothing to help those areas.  After a few weeks of using DRINK UP every night and still waking up with flakes around my jaw line, I decided to discontinue use (which was easy, since the mini I purchased was about out).To be sure, the mask did not irritate my skin, leave me feeling oily, or make me break out. It is a light, creamy mask that the skin drinks up quickly and happily.  It also had a surprising smell, sort of like a jolly rancher or those orange tic-tacs.  For some reason I really liked this aspect of the mask!  Given that the mask did me no harm, I do not begrudge purchasing it.  I just think that it is meant for skin that is not as dry as mine.  Final Note: I am very impressed that Origins makes so many of its products available as minis.  Having a more affordable option for trying their products has allowed me to test out products I’m interested in for a few weeks before deciding whether to commit.  Their minis have put me onto products that I eventually feel confident purchasing in full sizes (e.g., their Rose Clay Mask), and when a product doesn’t deliver in the way I want it to, I don’t end up having to choose between continuing to use a product that I don’t like or discontinuing it and wasting the remaining product.  I wish more skincare companies would follow Origins’ example on this front.

I could see where the device had removed as the surface looked more matt which is helpful so you don’t go over the same area again. A healthy moisture barrier will prevent so many other skin issues that people frequently struggle with, so a product like this is a good investment. I’ve tried a couple of other cult classic products (Stratia Liquid Gold and Krave Great Barrier Relief) that are formulated with the moisture barrier in mind, but I think this is my favorite as far as user experience goes. It doesn’t have the odd smell that Great Barrier Relief has and it doesn’t leave a yellow-orange stain on my pillows like Liquid Gold sometimes does. This serum has a creamy yet lightweight texture. It absorbs quickly and easily without leaving the face looking or feeling greasy. While I haven’t noticed a drastic change in my skin since starting to use this, I think this is mainly a product to use if you want to maintain a healthy moisture barrier rather than something to use for extremely noticeable differences. Can’t say how well this works for repairing a damaged barrier since I haven’t been using it for that.

I would have enjoyed it if the smell lingered while wearing but it’s probably a good thing irritation/sensitivity-wise that it doesn’t. Another positive is the price—it says 5 uses but will definitely last longer. I tried using more product the second time but it didn’t make a difference.The reason for only 2 stars is that this is NOT a peeling mask and it doesn’t seem to do much of anything. I’ve used at least three times, waiting different amounts of time, using more or less product, with and without water, and no matter what it is impossible to “massage” the product or make it “peel”. Usually peeling products combine with the oil on your skin and the product balls up, gently removing dead skin cells. But this mask dries so fast that it creates a rubbery film that won’t budge, peel, or even rinse off without any sort of cleanser. It has what feels like little exfoliating granules but they just sit on your face since you can’t massage them around. I even tried using as a scrub cleanser and it just slipped off and left the same rubbery film. I also didn’t notice any brightening or polishing effects unless the rubbery layer is supposed to be a polish. Luckily it didn’t irritate my skin (except for the excessive scrubbing/washing) or cause me to breakout. Maybe those with oily skin will have better luck?So one star for price, half a star for smell, and half for not being irritating or causing breakouts.

The most important thing is the angle at which you hold the razor and not performing this too frequently (over-exfoliation is a def a thing). Make sure you’re always holding the razor at a 45-degree angle against your skin. Short downward strokes are the best way to go when you’re dermaplaning at home after you cleanse and dry your face. Keeping the skin taut and moving from top to bottom is the general rule of thumb. Take it slow too and be conscious of the unique angles/curves of your face. Dermaplaning is a very intuitive practice! I’d recommend only doing it every 3 to 4 weeks for optimal results. Afterward, avoid direct sun exposure/extreme heat for a few days days, don’t use scrubs or other exfoliators for a week, avoid chlorine on your face for a week, apply serums, moisturizers, and sunscreen as usual.

My skin typically doesn’t tolerate harsh acne products since they use very strong ingredients and are often combined with alcohol, which only makes the situation worse. These peel pads are gentle but effective since they use natural salicylic and glycolic acids to decongest the skin without stripping the skin of its natural oils. As opposed to wiping the pad over my whole face, I position it so that I’m using one quarter of the pad for one quarter of my face and use both sides. This helps prevent acne migration and allows the pads to do their job more effectively. The cherry on top is that they are clean products, feature sustainable packaging and are made in France. First and foremost, I received this product for free from SK II in exchange for a review. These are my own, honest opinions. 

I have been using the SK II GenOptics Aura Essence twice daily for the past month, and I have to admit that I have been pleased with the results so far. I have light, combination skin with freckles on my forehead, nose, and cheeks. I also have areas of hyperpigmentation from past acne marks. 

The first thing that I noticed about the product is that the packaging is quite stunning. The bottle is feels very substantial and the dropper is easy to control how much product comes out of it, making it easy to conserve and use only what is needed. Both the bottle and the product have a beautiful opalescent glow to it. 

As for the product inside, the essence has a clean, spa-like scent to it. The product spreads out very nicely, so you don’t need to use that much of it. When applied to the skin, it absorbs almost instantly and provides a nice layer of hydration before applying your other face creams on top. My skin is left feeling very soft and hydrated. After one month of use, I do think that my complexion has become more luminous and my sunspots and hyperpigmentation are less pronounced. This does not make my skin look or feel greasy at all, it just leaves it looking soft and radiant. 

As for the actual ingredients in the product, Niacinamide is the third listed ingredient. Niacinamide is an ingredient that is used in treatment for rosacea, a skin condition involving facial redness and pimples. It does contain Dimethicone, which is a silicone based substance that will smooth the skin on the surface, but does not actually make changes to the quality of the skin. It is essentially a way of “faking” the smoothness. Towards the very bottom of the list is Methylparaben, which some people have issues putting parabens on their face, but research indicates that the minute quantities of parabens in skincare products have negligible effects on our health. 

Finally, let’s talk about the elephant in the room…the price of this product is WAY up there! Is it really worth it?? Honestly, for the average working person, I would say save your money and shop around for a more affordable option. If money is not an issue for you (lucky you), then yes, I would go for this product as it is very luxurious from the bottle to the product itself. Most importantly, I have noticed subtle results after using it for one month and am curious to see what the results will be after another month of use. I would LOVE to try other things from this brand…maybe when Sephora has their sale in November I will splurge on something for myself.

First, and foremost, I would like to thank SK-II for the opportunity try this product. I feel very lucky that I was chosen to test SK-II Ultimate Revival Cream, for free in exchange for providing my honest feedback in return.

On that note, here goes:
Packaging: The product is packaged very well. It is classy looking and I really like the container it is in. The included spatula is very helpful in taking out the perfect amount to put on your skin, and added bonus there is a slot for it on the base of the cream, so it stays with the product as opposed to it being separate. 
Now on to the actual product review
The good: The product DOES work. I live in Las Vegas, so it is a very dry desert climate. While we have a water softener in our home, your skin still dries out living here. SK-II Ultimate Revival Cream does a fabulous job keeping my face moisturized 24/7. I apply it both in the morning, prior to my make-up and again at night before bed. I spend the day with my face feeling fresh and not dry or itchy. 
A note of caution, a little goes a VERY long way. If you use too much, you will have a greasy feeling on your face. Simply use less cream the next time until you find your perfect amount. The good thing about a little going a long way is that the product will last for quite some time. 
I did try to use the cream the way they recommend (putting it on my palms and rubbing my hands together, I felt I lost too much that way to my hands. I had to use more than I wanted to transfer the product to my face. Now I dot much like you would using foundation and apply that way.
The smell is very subtle, it smells very nice but it is not overpowering at all. 
The not so good: I wish it contained SPF. I have very fair skin and so I have to apply any additional sun screen if I will be outside. Typically, I prefer keeping straight sunscreen off my fact, luckily my makeup foundation does contain it.
I was hoping to see some wonderful anti-aging effects from using this cream and I have not. Then again, the product is not at all marketed as such. 
Bottom Line:
The good: It does do its job moisturizing your skin. It feels very luxurious on my face and my skin feels somewhat silky once it is applied. 
The not so good: The price is the only thing that would keep me from purchasing this item in the future. The price is also the reason for the 4-star review I would provide.

I am late 20’s, and have combination skin. I’ve used SK-II since I was in my teens, and since that time, generally have not felt a need to stray from the brand. However, they discontinued my go-to Derm Brightener moisturizer a couple of years ago. Since then, I’ve experimented with a lot of different moisturizers and avoided purchasing this one because of the extremely high price point. Throughout my travels with a lot of the “trendy“ brands these days, such as Tatcha, Fresh, Biossance, Caudalie etc., I was still dissatisfied with my main moisturizer — Tatcha especially left me scratching my head with the texture and the fact that it made me constantly break out. Biossance, I will admit, has moisturizers that “feel“ nice, but don’t seem to actually improve my skin. After a year of breakouts, I caved and bought the Ultimate Revival cream. It looked like the closest SK-II product to the Derm Brightener albeit twice the price. And boy am I happy I made that choice! My skin started to get back to its glowing self within a few days. It’s chock full of ingredients like pitera/niacinamide/zinc gluconate. Despite it being “greasy“ upon first application, what I’ve noticed with the SK-II thick creams is that once your skin adapts to them after a couple of weeks, it loses that initial greasy feeling and instead sinks in and leaves it feeling soft and luxurious. I do have oily skin but this has not ever caused me to break out or become oilier. I only use this as a night cream due to its occlusive texture (the ingredients don’t seem to confirm that it is in fact an occlusive but it definitely has that texture, might be just a heavier emollient). And for the price, I’m not even halfway through the jar and it’s been four months since I purchased, so it’s turning out to be decent value. A little goes a long way for this moisturizer too. My only possibly negative note is that it does have a distinct rosy fragrance which is pleasant enough but not really my preferred fragrance.

I am a mask fanatic… I have masks for every purpose (clearing pores, exfoliating, moisturizing, brightening, etc) and I give myself a facial at least once, usually twice a week.
