This mask really works for both of these issues. I find that with regular use it really does get rid of any dark spots I might have, and it provides my skin with a long, cool drink of moisture… which makes fine lines much less noticeable. My skin definitely looks brighter and refreshed after this mask.Just a couple tips for using it… I personally find the mask itself a little big for my little face, but it still works just fine. However, if this also happens to you, I recommend just taking the 10-15 minutes recommended on the package and lying down. While the mask WILL stick to your face if you get up and walk around, it is a little bit annoying when it’s too big because it likes to get too close to your eyes and/or up your nose when you walk. If you lie down, it won’t bother you as much, AND you get a little rest out of the deal. Also, the mask is very wet, and there will be extra serum in the packet after you use the mask - DON’T throw that away! It’s good stuff. I usually rub it into my neck and chest area to absorb while I am wearing the mask, but you can also save it and use it as a serum during your next facial cleansing/moisturizing session for extra brightening.

Shiseido is my go-to sunscreen. Worth every penny. I can’t say I’m loyal to most brands/products, but Shiseido sunscreen is everything.

I used to use a very similar cleanser with white clay in high school that whips into a stiff foam and even had ‘face cleaning training’ from a family friend who worked for shiseido. It’s such a relief to switch back to this kind of cleanser that really does the job well. There is a scent to the cleanser, but it smells exactly like the lobby of the Hilton Tokyo (which I like). The key is to use a quality Japanese face cleansing/foaming net. (Sephora should carry one in their stores!) I used to use my hands to whip it up in high school, but now with a foaming net you get more foam and faster, and you can really get stiff foam. This is how I learned to use this type of product: Using a tiny, pinky-nail squeeze of the cleanser with a foaming net, you can whip it into a giant handful of foam. I like to whip it, squeeze it out of the net, and then put it back into the net and whip it into a stiffer foam, about the texture of really good freshly-whipped-meringue. Light, but stiff. The key is to start with a wet net and slowly add tiny splashes of water as you go (but not too much, or your foam won’t be stiff!)Then after spreading most of the foam across your face, you make the left over foam into a ball and begin to “roll” the foam in tiny circles across your face. It’s a really soothing feeling as the stiff foam gently tugs on your skin. It feels like the foam is lifting impurities from your pores. Then after washing all of the foam off, your face feels clean, soft, and hydrated. Get a foaming/cleansing net!

However, due to the soft, smooth feeling of the paper on my fingers, and the very slight residue of powder on your fingers, I could just tell that there was a powder coating on the papers. When applied to my face, the blotting papers would remove excess oil and leave a nice, matte finish that did not look “powdered“ but more looked as if my makeup was fresh and just applied, rather than the oily mess it was before using the blue papers. If there was ever a scent to the old version of these, I did not detect it or at least it was not offensive in any way. I have used the old version of this product for over 10 years, and would use 1-3 per day, depending on climate.  I could have easily used more, because I LOVED those papers, and absolutely loved having the “fresh, just applied“ makeup look after application. The only thing that held me back from using as many per day as I wanted was the price.  It has steadily creeped up over the years from about $11 to now $18.50 per pack of 100.The new version is thinner, scented, and there is no powder coating--or it is at very minimal. While they doesn’t feel like the inexpensive, crinkly, extremely thin versions made by other brands that are pretty much useless, this new Shiseido version is much less effective than the old. They remove oil, but no longer leave me with that “polished“ matte look.  I will continue to purchase, as these are still better than what else is out there, but I know how much more incredible they once were and could be.

I kept seeing this online, and I wondered who paid $99 for a single king size pillowcase? I wondered if it was possible that it lived up to the hype and rave reviews I saw here and on other sites. 
During the 15% off sale, I decided to get it, almost to prove the claims were wrong! I waited for over a month to write this review just to be sure!
I’m currently undergoing daily IV treatments for an illness and the meds haven’t just made me lose hair, they started making it break. So, I was more interested in the people who said they woke up with their hair looking the same as when they went to bed. My hair is very long, to my waist. Not by choice, just not up for a salon visit yet. As it has been this long before, I knew it doesn’t break from length. Something my friends have been in amazement of since we were young! And, yes I eventually cut it myself - ha! I just wondered if all my time spent in bed scrounging on pillows was leading to some of the breakage? 
At the same time, my doctor says the night sweats that come along with the illness - and often get worse during treatment - are much more than what most women ever go through during menopause. All I know is I was waking up several times a night laying with sweat all over me, on a soaked sheet, with wet hair to boot! 
The FIRST NIGHT I used this...I woke up to no bed head!!! I was amazed! I didn’t really need to brush it! The crown of my hair, usually sticking up and all a mess from rubbing into my pillow...was flat!!! 
And my fear that night sweats would be worsened using a silk pillowcase - turned out it was totally  the opposite! My night sweats hadn’t woken me in the night! In fact, they have been SO MUCH BETTER! I realized over the next couple of weeks that this pillowcase stays cool...even though I still turn it over in the night, pretty sure that’s from habit! My night sweats were still occurring on my chest and abdomen, but it was like from my shoulders up...no more sweats!! I couldn’t believe it! 
Then, I saw the difference in my skin. By this I mean, I was sleeping on 100% Egyptian cotton sheets that felt almost like silk themselves, but I didn’t realize they were soaking up some of my nighttime skin care products! I just noticed my skin had a nice dewy glow, yet I had used the same facial oil. I saw that it was the lack of absorption from the cotton pillowcase! My overnight cream masks... I saw my skin was brighter than it had been before! I pay good money for my skin care products, so this was just a huge bonus! 
I don’t think I have used it enough to say anything about long term use helping with wrinkles. But, I know that my face slides across this like butter, so I feel like it’s probably at least keeping me from forming any future wrinkles. 
I did my research before I bought this because there were several other places selling silk pillowcases for much cheaper. Turns out that just because they say 100% silk, it doesn’t mean that the pillowcase itself is made of only silk. Just that the silk used is real silk, but apparently often mixed with other materials like polyester! I also researched what the big deal was about “the highest grade mulberry silk“ - I found out that it’s the best sillk produced and there’s a big reason it costs what it does! Also, I figured the 22 mm must be somewhat like the thread count of cotton sheets, and I was right. This is actually stated on several sites discussing silk as “the best for silk sheets“. 
Then one morning my mom came to see me and couldn’t believe that I hadn’t brushed my hair yet! She saw my skin was actually looking more fresh and glowing...then said it would be nice to try one out. Yes, this was just a week before Mother’s Day so - hint, hint! I got her one and she said her 72 year old skin was so thankful for not having to deal with what had become more than sleep “creases“, they were looking like sleep “crevices“ - the pillowcase stopped those for her!
I’m so glad that my hard headed self decided to order this just to prove it couldn’t do all it claimed -  I proudly admit now, it does do it all! So much so, that as I am in bed all day, my husband said to get another one!!! That’s always the true test --- when the husband notices enough to say spend another $99 on a pillowcase - ha!!! 
Seriously, I have fallen in love with this and honestly couldn’t go back to my others!! It may be expensive, but it is actually worth it!!!

The product also has a nice light scent that I personally enjoy, and the product feels like a luxurious serum that glides on the skin. 10/10 for packing and user experience. Unfortunately, that’s where the good experience ended for me. If you’re using the correct amount of product, this sunscreen leaves a white cast--and I have very fair skin with pink undertones. I spent a considerable amount of time rubbing in the product to get it to tone down, and then the streakiness started. Omgggg. Y’all! I have used self tanners for years and years. I’ve never in my life had so much streaking and patchiness. I always exfoliate, shave and moisturize the night before tanning. I am so shocked to see the reviews stating this didn’t show up or did nothing for some. I don’t normally write reviews but I couldn’t believe the ones I was reading on this. This tanner has been the best self-tanner experience I’ve ever had in my history of self-tanning. The tan goes to such a flattering brown instead of orange. I do believe this claims to show in as little as 3 hours, which is why I think everyone is saying it doesn’t work. I have never left this on for just 3 hours. I will usually leave it on for at least a full day before I even think of going near water! The longer you keep it on, the more it will keep on developing, and trust me it will not stop. If you leave it on for more than a day it will almost over - develop, meaning go a bit orange, but it will become a part of your skin as you will notice once you wash it off, unlike other self-tanners that feel like they are only on top of the skin and make me scared to rub them off by accident. I feel like this one truly “absorbs“ into your skin. I also usually do a body exfoliation prior to applying, as well as moisturizing  any areas that are prone to dryness, like knees, ankles, elbows, etc. Use a basic moisturizer like aveeno that will do a good job but sink in quick. After that’s absorbed I use 1-2 pumps each round and start blending into the skin in circular motions. Its easy to blend because you can see the difference in colour on your skin. Once again I’ve never experienced any problems with this amazing tanner but I have also never kept it only for only 3 hours. I recommend everyone try this again for at least a 12 hour period and watch how deeply the tan develops. It may not be so noticeable if only done for 3 but longer than that you will definitely see it show up. The whole 3 hour express claim for this product was obviously not well executed by St.Tropez, but the product definitely works, just not quite by what they say it does I guess (also referring to those looking for a deeper tan).

I love Sunday Riley products. I’m a licensed aesthetician and have been using their products for over a year and a half now and have noticed a huge Improvement in my skin. The only drawback that I can see is the dimethicone in the products which generally I try to avoid. It is a synthetic plastic and a silicone. I’m not sure why they would choose to use it in their products as most companies will use it because it is cheap and it provides the illusion that the product is working but over time it traps impurities, is hard to wash from the skin, and causes an increase in acne and other skin disorders. With that said, I have been using the good genes on and off for quite some time now and I can’t deny that my skin is dramatically exfoliated after just one use with an even texture. The fine lines are improved over time with an increase in plumping and softness to the skin. Definitely wouldn’t use the Good Genes everyday as it would be too exfoliating for my skin. I notice a definite increase and brightness with just one use of the Vitamin C. I just wish they wouldn’t use dimethicone. Either way they have some great products that do not have the dimethicone like the Ice Ceramide moisturizer which I use everyday and is great for dry skin. It gives that glass appearance to the skin that we often try to achieve through other products unsuccessfully. I am still giving this 5 stars because the rest of the ingredients are great and the pros definently outweigh any cons. Hope this helps.

If you have sensitive skin this is probably not for you. I had a bad reaction by using a very small / thin layer - my skin is very irritated to the point that the top few layers of skin have come off. Have used other sulfer products with no problem (e.g. Kate Sommerville Eradikate).

The products are fantastic.  I loved this as a ’get to know Sunday Riley’ starter kit, and my aging skin has never felt better.  However, I’m appalled at the packaging.  Just last night I got to the point where the pump jar of A+ would not pump anything out.  I removed the pump in order to get the last bits out with a tiny spatula, and discovered that the product is contained in a plastic bag attached to the pump, which collapses as more product is used.  So, to start, I can’t scrape out the last of it with a spatula, because it’s sealed in this soft plastic compartment.  But worse, this means the entire outer jar is just there for show! For a company that prides itself on sustainability, clean skincare, etc., you’d think they’d be smarter about creating less environmental waste.  It’s a waste of resources to produce it and generates unneeded trash.  Removing a star for this, because presumably the Good Genes pump bottle is the same way.

I don’t get all the negative reviews based primarily on scent. It smells strongly to me (of tea tree mostly, which I don’t personally have an issue with) but it’s a mask/spot treatment, not a fragrance you wear all day. I’d prefer my skincare to be effective than to smell great. If you’re really suffering that badly from acne, you probably won’t get hung up on the scent if you find something that works. I think this product is particularly good for fungal acne (in my case, acne caused by wearing a mask all day) since it’s effective on the type of blemishes that seems to be resistant to the standard benzoyl peroxide/AHAs and BHAs. I definitely plan to buy the larger size when I finish my smaller tube I bought to try it out.

It has a nice spray pump but that’s about it. The mist dried out my skin and made it really red. I thought that the first time it might have just been a fluke so I applied it a few more times throughout the week and still got the same flare up each time. It’s an overhyped toner don’t waste your money.

I seriously never write reviews but this is the 5th time I’ve ordered this mist because it has been such a game changer for my skin. My skin immediately looks better after spraying and this has really helped with my dark spots from when I had acne.

i loooove this. i use it as a spot treatment overnight and every time i see a huge difference in the pimple. it is usually flat or nearly gone after use. one of the best spot treatments i’ve used. a littlegoes a long way however so i find I only need a thin layer on my trouble spots !

I had this stubborn seborrheic dermatitis that even prescriptions wouldn’t clear up. It did take several weeks of using this morning and night, but it cleared it right up! Just ordered a second bottle and it will be part of my regular routine. I took off a star because of the price, but I do love Sunday Riley and will always pay more for products that really work.

This brand is incredible and worth every penny. However if you have oily skin or follow a makeup routine this kit is not for you as it leaves my skin oily. I recommend the go to bed with me kit instead. If you have dry skin absolutely buy this kit!
Not effective. Does not feel good. Expensive. There is better out there. I use it occasionally on my butt cheeks.

This stuff does work really well, but that’s only if you can get it to stick to your skin. It’s almost a dry formula in a way, it want to ball up and pill, it has no stick to it, so you have to be careful when applying and not mess with it after. If you touch it after application you won’t be able to get it to stick to your skin again and it’s a waste of product, which is not ideal considering how expensive it is for how much product you’re getting.
I have NEVER had texture on my face and this product my my face sandy. Also didn’t really provide any moisture at all. Skip this one from Sunday Riley
Super upset that they no longer sell the larger tube, this is a total rip-off.
I like it but I ran through the bottle in like 3 weeks and I only use it once a day. I also didn’t see any difference in my skin so I’d probably pass.

This cleared up my chin acne from wearing my mask! It is so amazing that I will never be without it. It doesn’t cause any flaking or irritation on my overly sensitive skin like most spot treatments. I used it like an overnight mask on my entire chin and within a few days my entire chin is all clear! I am currently using it on one on my forehead.
This does NOTHING. It doesn’t even feel that great on the skin. It feels like you are spraying expensive water on your face. I suggest the innisfree serum.

I’m a huge skeptic when it comes to spot treatment/masks since they rarely work for me. However! I am just LOVING this product. The smell isn’t bad at all, but the trick is! Use it as a spot corrector instead of applying it as a mask to get more bang for your buck. I use this every other night, especially when my acne feels irritated or for a quick fix if I am going out the next day. I also leave it on overnight and see a HUGE difference after I wash my face in the morning. My acne is less red and less bumpy. I will rebuy when I run out!

Despite some harsh reviews I wanted to try this for my oily/combo skin . I like it a lot ! It works well for me as a shortcut in the mornings . The heat and humidity makes my face so oily and grime feeling , I like to start my day with the ceramic slip cleanser then this . It absorbs instantly and has a nice mild clean scent that doesn’t hang around . It works well for balancing my skin and that’s what is most important to me

Fixed up my maskne, some texture on my skin, & hormonal acne, without further irritating it. Retinol does have a purge period- be patient for like 3 months- although there are immediate results as well! Really thankful to have been suggested this my a Sephora employee- I was at my wits end & it gave me a lot of hope. I’ve also added summer fridays cloud dew to wrap things up. :)

I’ve been using for a couple of weeks, have not seen any drastic improvement, but it is a clean, easy routine in the morning. My skin does feel more hydrated, just haven’t see the dark spots disappear....yet

I love this product! I feel like it helps to tighten my skin without making it feel dry or adding oiliness which I struggle with with most skincare products. It just feels like a luxurious addition to my skincare routine.
Product seems to be good but there were only 2-3 applications in the tube. To be clear, the tube was almost empty.

I absolutely love this essence! As a new addition to my a.m./p.m. routine, it really works! I’m always looking for ways to add ceramides and peptides to my regimen and this product is really perfect because I simply can’t use heavy products on my oily acne prone skin. This essence balances the skin’s natural microbiome so that benefit is essential to get the most out of your other skincare products. Lastly, how to make this essence last? Don’t spray your face! You absolutely waste product! Spray two pumps on your clean palm and press all over your face. If you want to try it out, Sunday has 2 holiday sets (limited edition) that include a small bottle and watch for the discounts too!
I’m about half way through my bottle and I’m still not entirely sure what it’s doing. I do notice my skin is more dehydration and raw feeling. Will definitely not be repurchasing this.
Good product but you’re not getting what you pay for…. Not a whole bottle full, just tiny bag full…

Not sure i really like this treatment mask, I prefer the UFO clarifying facial oil. That ends up working better than this treatment mask. I have used it a few times on just up and coming acne or prevention and it doesnt really do much for my skin. I dont think ill be repurchasing.
Definitely not for sensitive skin. Had a pretty bad reaction after one use.

This product is effective and works well as a spot treatment, but with that being said, it’s still over priced in my opinion. The consistency of this is super weird, it almost separates or something. Not the best from Sunday Riley but it does work.

I bought this during rouge sale and when it arrived I totally forgot what it was for. Did my research and honestly still confused as to what exactly it does, but it’s a nice addition to my routine. I have to agree the spritzing it on my face I feel like I’ll go through it quick which is why I gave it 4 stars. I’ve used Good Genes for a little over a year now and it’s a holy grail in my routine. I feel like this product is an extra boost. My face does look and feel firmer after I use this combo.

Bro I put this on a spot that was just one of those annoying bumps? No head no tenderness just jutting out of my face. In twenty minutes there was a head and it popped easily. Am always going to keep this on hand.

I will have to say, I was in love with just the CEO cream and since that was a good buy for me the past few times , I figured why not try others from their product line. This was an amazing buy!!! The sizes were actually great, products lasted me awhile which was surprising. I did the exact routine the box set said and my skin in 1 week changed! I will for sure pick up this set again and be confident in buying the full sizes as well.

I love this product, I thought the bottle would be a bit bigger since they used to sell bigger ones but now when it came it’s so small! Kind of disappointed but don’t get me wrong I still love it!, it’s just kind of sad because it’s so small.

The best pink drink you will ever have. Your face will crave this drinky drink.  It’s a refreshing spray for one beautiful face. My face has the glowing and getting the firmness I. The areas where needed. Love it for all my life. Turning 50 and looking like 35 is good for me. Wink*
Made a difference in my skin after the second use.

After almost 2 months of use, my skin is softer and smoother than it has been in a long while. I like this essence because it is gentle and effective and it has kept my skin well hydrated even with the cooler weather and indoor heating ramping up. Another plus is the refreshing, mild scent.

I originally purchased the 2 oz tube for $55 and it lasted TWO YEARS. The consistency is no longer the same, it’s separated & chunky, so I’m glad they replaced it with a smaller size that won’t go bad. The price difference isn’t that off either. This works better than any other spot treatments I’ve tried, and smells no worse than other sulfur products. I’ve tried 10+ spot treatments and this works the best and the fastest.

OMG I am not exaggerating when I say I immediately saw a difference.  I used it as spot treatment and rinsed with water after about 20-30 minutes.  THE REVIEWS ARE unfair regarding the smell it’s not that bad. at all. but it is UNDERSTANDABLE regarding the quantity because it is not that much for $20 but it was DEFINITELY worth it to me & if the price doubled, I’d still buy it!!!!! I first washed my face with the ceramic slip cleanser as instructed. Then I shook it up so it mixed really good and applied as a spot treatment and rinsed with water.  IMPORTANT I saw great results once rinsed but when I say, I saw freaking amazing fantastic results “after” applying the A+ high dose retinol serum (one pump) followed by the UFO acne treatment face oil (two pumps) then the luna sleeping night oil (two pumps) I swear I CANNOT STOP STARING IN THE MIRROR because it seems almost impossible that two hours later it looks like my acne disappeared… basically it appears as if the pimples have either disappeared completely or appear to be 95% reduced. I soooo regret not taking before and after pictures. I did this at night and I sure do hope the acne does not reappear in the morning because this just seems too good to be true. I mean wtf, I am amazed amazed amazed. The lady that helped me at sephora swore by the UFO oil and I am so glad I bought it.  I initially went in to buy the UFO oil and this saturn mask and asked her if she recommended the UFO oil or the multivitamin oil they have and she swore by the UFO oil and it did not disappoint. ps when I don’t have acne, I am in love with their WAKE UP WITH ME morning routine & the GO TO BED WITH ME evening routine… and their blue moon cleansing balm
I use this every night right after my shower. It become a staple in my routine. It’s dewy and makes my skin feel plump and prepped before I add my nighttime products.
I love these products but when I purchased the set the CEO lotion was almost empty!  Used it 2 times. Disappointing.

Another great product from Sunday Riley! The Pink Drink is a great essence also super quick and easy to use. I just mist a few sprays onto my face and neck, pat into the skin then let dry for a minute and continue with my other skincare products. I do use this after cleansing and toner as a third step in my skincare routine. It feels very hydrating to the skin and so luxurious. This is definitely not just another face mist! It has a purpose, so if you use it correctly you will get results! :)

I can’t say that I’m noticing a huge difference in my skin with this product alone. It does make my skin glowy and soft within the first few minutes of using it but I haven’t noticed this product giving me any long term benefits. This product does pair well with hyaluronic acid (since your skin should be damp before applying hyaluronic acid). Besides that, I think there’s much more affordable essences out there that have more to provide than this product. This spray also comes in a glass bottle which is great if you prefer recyclable products in your routine!

Honestly not mad about the new size - yes, the value is way lower than it used to be but, PERSONALLY, I hardly ever use up a face mask to completion within the recommended expiry length (this one is a year) AND I use this as exactly it’s labeled: a spot treatment mask. It’s a lower price point in a tube that I’ll maybe actually use up before it loses its freshness (and potentially becomes a playground for bacteria that can cause further problems with your skin). I do think this helps bump down redness and soothe moderate/minor acne when used in conjunction with other products. I’m not sure if this alone is your godsend, but it plays well with others and does seem to do its part.
Tiny amount for the $$. I thought I received a used product because it was like squeezing an empty tube of toothpaste to get anything out of it. Going back to Control Corrective.
Great product. I leave it on till it drys. Ive seen a difference with 2 uses. The redness goes down and the spots shrink really quickly.

I had been wanting to try Sunday Riley products for a while- I had been going between the night time value set and this one, and ultimately chose this one because I didn’t see the need in the oils and treatments.First, the packaging is very high quality. My husband was impressed by the exterior packaging and the individual bottles- enough that he commented on it! All of the products are great- I’ve seen results already. The lactic acid treatment does smell vaguely like lemon pledge...but fades pretty fast. The eye cream goes a LONG way- half a pump is more that enough for both eyes! I would just say give it plenty of time to sink in before applying concealer or you might get creasing.

Back before when they had the bigger bottles of this stuff it worked sooo much better and you had the option to get a lot of product now it’s such a tiny little thing. I also don’t know if they changed the formula but it does not work as well as it did before. I used to love the previous product before it was ruined because I literally had soo much acne & basically 80% of my face had to have product but when I washed my face the next morning the pimples would reduce in size & would heal much faster. Now it just dries out the spot where applied & doesn’t heal the pimple like it used to. How disappointing.

I’m almost done with my bottle and haven’t noticed any improvement to my skin. It does smell good and my skin looks glowy when it’s first applied but it doesn’t last long. If it were less expensive, I may have purchased more to see if it has any long term affects but I just couldn’t justify the price for such a tiny bottle.

This has been so helpful with my sensitive skin it’s one of the few face masks I can actually use when my skin I super sensitive and deal with cystic acne and this was really helpful but now what am I suppose to do $20 for .5 oz???? I can’t in my right mind keep buying this product.

I have lupus so my skin is hyper sensitive to absobloodylutely everything it comes into contact with. I am a red head with fair skin & blue eyes so there’s a lot going on.I LOVE THIS ENTIRE KIT!! The rep was at my Sephora store in Folsom and I came in originally to just get cream. That’s it. But he asked about my skin (dry, sensitive) and showed me how each product in this kit will work on many of my issues. First time I used it was today - and I have NO REGRETS. The scent is very light, the application is without trouble, and the way I felt afterward made up for everything else. It is a pricey brand and a luxurious skin care line. But I wish I had bought it much sooner.

I love this stuff. Clears pimples quickly, use as an overnight treatment and the next morning skin is smooth and clear. Even works on those stubborn, painful cystic pimples; may take a couple of uses but it does what it says. The ONLY issue I have is the price now. The old package was 2 oz for $55 now they are selling 0.5 oz tubes for $20!!! That’s crazy!!

I have been using other Sunday Riley products, and I’ve used and loved the CEO serum for a while now, and I have been wanting to try A+, Good Genes, and Autocorrect to see if I like an all Sunday Riley skincare routine because I’ve loved everything else I’ve used and I love that Sunday Riley offers these kits with enough product to see if you like the results without committing to $85+ full size bottles of each. I can recommend the CEO serum for a vitamin C serum as I’ve been using that for over a year, but my five stars are because this is a perfect set to try Sunday Riley products to see if they work for your skin without a huge financial commitment.

Not a useful product. It didn’t pair with any of serums, treatments. When combined with other products it irritate my skin. I couldn’t see any discernable difference that the product made when used alone.

The beautiful packaging and pretty pink formula first caught my eye, but sadly that’s all there is to this product - just looks good as a collectible on your skincare shelf. I am definitely skincare oriented trying to take care of my skin as best as possible, so I use essences daily and was excited to switch it up with a new essence I hadn’t used before. I have had good results from other SR products I’ve used in the past, but this one was not happening for me. I literally could not feel or see any difference like I have with other essences I’ve used. I didn’t experience any adverse reactions, but definitely no positive results either.
There is not much in this tube and it does not smell good but it WORKS. I had acne on my forehead I could not get rid of (possibly fungal acne) and this worked after one time.

This product is just ok and it’s performance doesn’t justify the price. It may be that the product doesn’t really have a place in my routine. It’s not as hydrating as some of the other toners out there and doesn’t deliver the peptides that a good moisturizer does. I wish this was a thicker serum-like toner or a moisturizer.I don’t dislike it but it’s pricey for a toner that doesn’t do enough.

I wanted to try this product for a long time, so when I finally purchased it a few months ago, I couldn’t wait to incorporate it into my routine.  I was underwhelmed, to be honest.  I noticed no benefit or change in my skin, despite its cost and overall brand reputation.  I will not purchase again and don’t recommend it only because, at least in my experience (I used the entire bottle before reviewing here) using it was inconsequential to my skin. For the price, I expect some benefit, however I might as well have been spritzing pink water on my face.  It’s too bad because I really wanted to like this.  If I were to point out a silver lining, it would be that it did not upset my extremely sensitive and reactive skin.  That’s always a bonus.

Oh my god. So I was had the worst acne before this (which is dramatic, because I never have a ton of acne, but I was waking up with new small white heads every day and hated it). I have been using these products for a week now, and I have not gotten a single pimple. Not only this, but my skin is SO soft. My pores have never been so small and my cheeks are so smooth. I will be using this for the rest of my life lol
Since I can’t write a very long review, I’ve been using this since the end of November.. best products out of this would be: the cleanser, good genes, A+ mixed with Luna & the moisturizer.
This set is amazing. I see a huge difference after just one week.

I really wanted to like this product but honestly it feels like I’m just spraying water on my face. Smell is very light which I do like. I really enjoy using Sunday Riley products but this was just a no for me. It dries very fast and I don’t notice a difference at all after. From the price point of this product I would not recommend. Not worth it.

The first essence that actually does anything for my skin! I have tried both the glow recipe toner (works better in winter since it’s a touch more moisturizing), and the paulas choice bha liquid exfoliant (bit harsher), and neither do what this does. Do NOT spray it on your face. Gently spray into your hand, and apply directly to fresh cleansed skin first thing after you wash your face (as you would any toner). No breakouts, no pilling, no dryness, no sticky ness, absorbs into skin quickly, dries down as if nothing is on your face, and layers very well (I’ve had pilling issues with both of the other toners).

Sigh. I hate that I love this. I actually got this because I ordered a day and a night kit. I used the first bottle and didn’t notice anything and knew I wasn’t going to purchase the full size. I’ve gone through most of the second bottle and use sometimes instead of toner. However, this morning I sprayed on my face and did a few things around the house. When I went back to the mirror to finish my routine, my face felt a bit tight and dry. Fast forward a few hours later and I’m in the bathroom and I look at my face. It was  appeared noticeably smoother and I dare say tighter/firmer.    So now I have no choice but to purchase Pink Drink.

It smells terrible (sulfur, of course) but works better than any spot acne treatment I’ve ever tried.  My teenage son uses it for breakouts as well and an application before bed has his skin looking 50% better overnight. Consistent, daily use on clean skin rids his breakouts entirely.  Anyone who struggles with acne should give this a try because if it works for your skin it feels like a miracle.
Wish I could give this 0 stars. Does not work and doesn’t even stay on your skin. It flakes right off
Sunday Riley has always been a good and fast acting product, with the few that I used. But the amount in the tube is very little. It’s not worth the price. I’m upset that I got this.

I love everything in this kit.  I use it almost every morning.  I can’t say one bad thing.  The sizes are appropriate for the price and the variety of products you get to complete a whole morning routine is unmatched.  I have acne prone skin that is also oily.  The turmeric oil works wonders with my skin, and the smell is also amazing!  Buy this and you won’t go back to anything else :)

My experience with this product has been generally positive (my only negative is the size of the bottle). My skin loves Green Tea and this product is full of it. I mist it on my face every morning and night and it absorbs quickly, doesn’t leave any residue and had a pleasant scent. I’ve been using it for 3 months now and the first thing I noticed was that any redness or spots on my face started to disappear and the texture of my skin was clearing up and much smoother. I have a very basic skincare routine (Cleanser, mist, serum/cream & eye cream) so it was easy for to figure out this product was doing it’s job! Wish it came in a bigger size but it works so I’ll keep buying!

This set is a GREAT value! I use Sunday Riley skincare products religiously so when I had the opportunity to purchase this set at $104.00 during the 20% off sale, I jumped on it! This set gave me 3 more bottles of products I use on a daily basis along with a fourth I’d been wanting to try.. at a fraction of their retail price! If you’ve been wanting to try Sunday Riley or if you just need to restock your skincare, I highly recommend this kit! I’d rather pay $32.50 for each product through this kit at $130 than to pay $85 each—$65 for Autocorrect—if I were to order them individually! Aside from the fantastic savings, my sensitive skin handles each of these wonderfully! No breakouts, dryness, irritation, or clogged pores! Sunday Riley is easily a top favorite of mine!
It’s so good! I’ve tried everything for “maskne” (face breaks out under my mask) and this clears it right up!
Nothing special. Pretty gentle and does increase absorption of products but no major effect.

Not my favorite product from Sunday Riley. It’s very refreshing and absorbs quickly, but I used a whole bottle and I did not notice a difference. In fact, when I stopped using it my husband made comments on how good my skin looked - so I wonder if this caused a residue on my face that didn’t make it look healthy. I would skip this one as part of your routine. I will not be buying it again. Still LOVE my good genes and Ice moisturizer.
I don’t write a lot of reviews but for this one I have to....one of my fave new products. I’ve noticed a difference in my skin. It’s so soft! Only thing that’s weird is it’s a spray.

I agree with the other reviewer, these are actually a really good value. GG and the retinol even in this smaller size last me forever because they’re potent and I can only use about 2 to 3 drops at a time. I mis the retinol into plain old moisturizer from The Ordinary and it works great. When the pumps run out you can also open the plastic top pieces to get the extra product out of the little vacuum bags attached to the pumps. I like Sunday Riley and approaching 30 it’s made my skin look pretty bomb but the price point def isn’t for everyone, this is actually a good way to try the good stuff and get your money’s worth.

I really don’t get all the negative reviews on this — what, does all of your skincare need to smell like flowers?! Lol it definitely smells like sulfur but this is AMAZING as a spot treatment on my cystic acne. When I feel a cystic pimple coming on, I pat some of this on it and poof, overnight it shrinks! I think this stuff is magical. HIGHLY recommend!! I even bought the tiny travel size for my purse because I can’t be without it!

My brain cannot comprehend all the bad reviews because Pink Drink has been an absolutely amazing addition to my AM and PM routine!! This firming essence does exactly what it’s supposed to do. I quickly have noticed my skin becoming firmer and smoother. It feels great and works well. Absolutely worth every penny compared to other similar products I’ve tried. I definitely recommend giving it a try and make sure you are using correctly.

I see people fussing about the empty tube, ya get .5 oz so yea the tube seems empty but that give you the space to mix it up before you put it on. I’m 40 dealing with some weird acne and this knocks it out. I do not smear this all over my face just hit the bad spots and let it work it’s magic.

Great way to try out all of these great products in a cost effective way! Also would make for good travel products. Bought for good genes and CEO but ended up loving those two and auto correct as well! Pleasantly surprised.

This product is okay. Out of the line I enjoyed the night A+ night cream the most… the others lacked moisture to last the day. The packaging is the worst. It has a glass bottle which is great! But they shove a plastic liner in the glass bottle… horrible design if you want to use every last drop a ton of product is stuck in the plastic pouch design and gives you the impression that you’re going green with the glass and that you have more product than you actually do. Just fill the glass bottle please…

I am 33 but still have the pimples of a teenager. Wish it was the metabolism instead but here we are. I’ve been using this set for a month now and my skin looks pretty great! I definitely went through a little purge when I first started using it but that went away quickly. I will get an occasional pimple still, but they go away super fast, like in less than a day. Pair it with a nice moisturizer too if your skin can get a bit overwhelmed with all the treatments. My skin texture has been great and besides the weird short lived pimple it has been clear and I am just waiting till the Spring sale to buy the full size of the Good Genes, UFO, and A+!
I have no idea what this product does - I’ve included it as part of my nightly routine but don’t notice any difference from using it.

This spray is really refreshing and I’ve definitely noticed more glow/brightness and less redness since I started using it. Also, I have not had any issues with the product running out too quickly at all. I have used it almost every morning (by spraying 3 pumps into the palm of my hand and then patting onto my face) for 3 months and I still have about 1/4 of the bottle left. When I first started using the product though I tried to spray it directly onto my face but I found that I wasted too much of the spray that way.

Really not sure if this product works, I used this product twice now. I have been actively breaking out part of which could be use of retinol. But the smell of this product is horrible. Will give it a try more later, as of now no change.

I’ve honestly never written a review on Sephora and I shop here a lot - but I felt like I had to write one because I know I was really hesitant buying this product. It is not just expensive water, and out of ALL of my skincare products, I feel this one the most - it’s instant and I can FEEL in real time it my skin tightening literally as soon as I spray it on, which is way more than I can say for any of the other expensive products I use. I use it at night before my retinol (which I’ve been using for over a year) and since adding this spray in last week, I’ve noticed a difference in my skin when I wake up in the morning. This stuff is legit

Not understanding the negative reviews, this spot treatment truly works. I struggle with PCOS hormonal acne... there’s times I’ve just cried over the frustration of dealing with painful cystic acne due to this condition. I put this stuff on the acne cysts and keep it on overnight. After another day, the cysts go down significantly. It also helps to prevent scarring, which is another huge issue I deal with. I do understand the reviews about its trickier to put on, but I think it just takes a bit getting used to is all. Even if you think you haven’t applied it perfectly, it still works great. The reviews about the scent, I mean, it’s sulfur so it’s gonna smell like sulfur lol. It’s not that big of a deal, it’s an acne treatment doing its job. I don’t think it’s that overwhelming really. It’s honestly worth a try if you get frequent hormonal acne that you don’t want to scar.
Love this spray. My skin feels fresh, clean, tighter and brighter. Easy peasy too.

This essence sounds very appealing until you get it in the mail and realize the bottle is much smaller compared to other essences. The spray nozzle also sprays TOO MUCH! So much I was done with mine in 4 weeks...I also didn’t find my moisturizer sat better over it, and I got so bumps on my forehead which turned into blackheads which I haven’t been able to finish clearing.I think as an option for dryer or less-sensitive skin types this may work...but not a win for me

Very disappointed in this. I’ve been a huge Sunday Riley fan but this is just a complete no. It doesn’t Even feel like you’re using any sort of a toner because all you do is spray it on your face. I don’t feel any firming I don’t feel any additional cleansing or anything. In my opinion this is a complete waste of money and I will never purchase it again.

This stuff is very mild and slightly tingles when applied to a blemish but works great! I use it ask a spot treatment and leave it on overnight. I’ve tried plenty of spot treatments and I have no complaints about this one! It does it’s job :) I would definitely recommend it!
I almost didn’t buy this because of the reviews. This spray is amazing. Refreshing, hydrating. My skin looks and feels amazing. The scent it delicate and lovely. It smells like the color pink!
They have completely lost their minds with this new size. They better fix this asap.

In May, I started using this product and I’ve noticed my skin thank me for it!I mist the product onto my face and pat it, I let it dry and apply moisturizer & eye cream after. I’ve purchased the Tatchas 95$ essence and used it for months, in my personal opinion- this is way better for skincare and the pocket.

Pretty disappointed so far.  I have very normal skin and was excited to try this because I’ve had people tell me how they glow after using many of the Sunday Riley products.  After three days of the routine (followed the directions to a T) my skin was red and burning.  I figured it was the lactic acid so I stopped using the Good Genes.  Two days later my skin still red I decided to stop everything except the cleanser and also purchased the ice moisturizer separately.  I only used consistently for 3 days but I’m on day 6 & my skin is no where near normal.  My husband said it looks like I went skiing because my skin is so dry.   My fine lines are showing more than ever because of the dryness.  No matter how much moisturizer I put on it it’s not enough.  I contacted SR customer service… they told me to stop everything (besides cleanser and moisturizer) and slowly add things back to see what could be causing the dryness.  No thank you.  Will be returning the kit. Hoping my healthy skin comes back soon.
Really like the retinol and may end up buying full size but the CEO vitamin C Serum was more of a cream and left my face feeling sticky, especially if I tried to put a moisturizer over it.
WORKS BUT, the tube comes filled with only 20% product and the rest is air :(((

This spot treatment is just kind of...meh. I think it does help, but I typically need 2-3 applications of it over a period of days and at that point the spot might have just been going away on its own. I haven’t had any issues with watery consistency-I make sure to shake the product very well before opening it every time. For a sulfur treatment, it doesn’t have an overpower scent which is a relief. I have better results using less expensive spot treatments, so I’ll go back to those after finishing this one.

I really love this product and was looking to replace my tube, but this new size is a rip off. Only have an ounce of product for $2 less than the original 2 ounce bottle. Neither of which I see are fully filled anyway. Extreme disappointment. I hope the brand takes this feedback and does better by their customers.

I am so glad that they came out with a smaller container and I very much enjoy this product but I do have to agree with a lot of reviews I have read that for $20 it should be a full container and it’s actually only about half full and I don’t understand why what’s going on with the factory but I wish they’d fill it fully because it would make it a lot more work the money but the product is so darn good I’m not even going to dock a star for not being a full container and I would buy this again

Love all the products my only issue is that if you use them all as suggested you run out of some way before the others which sucks. Perfect travel kit, id say it will last for roughly 4 weeks worth of daily travel (I used for summer in Europe)

I love this stuff! I’ve tried the SKII essence in the past and didn’t notice much - almost gave up on essences until I found this product. Truly life-changing. It makes my skin supple and glowy. I use it on clean skin before applying my serums and moisturizers, both day and night. Only downside is how much product you get.

I bought 2 tubes of this thinking I needed to give it some time to work. It kept my acne at bay and reduced the redness but honestly it didn’t make it go away and I wasted my money. I have deep hormonal acne along my jaw and neck and it’s still there. I can see this working if you have a couple whiteheads or acne that’s already surfaced but for cystic and serious clusters I would try something else. This isn’t effective and I’ll also add that it doesn’t come with a lot of product.

I’ve been looking for something to help with my “maskne” and this little green tube has been amazing. I have been applying it to my break out for 20-30 mins and seen them gone within a day or two. It’s helped keep my breakouts under control.

I can’t say enough good things about this kit. I’m 38, have discoloration, and hormonal acne. This helped all of those things. I’ve never seen my face instantly brighten and seem to glow. It also helped with my breakouts.

I absolutely love Pink Drink! It’s become the favorite part of my routine. It’s light and smells refreshing. Usually scents affect me, but this is super light and it makes my skin feel great! I do wish it wasn’t so small, but a little does go a long way.
Love this product, but I miss the huge size I could buy. It lasted forever. BRING IT BACK SUNDAY RILEY!

I’ve purchased this kit months ago but never got around to really using it until this week when I had to deal with the menstrual breakout 👎🏽 it has helped tremendously with calming it down and taking away the redness. I seen a lot of negative reviews on the spot treatment but also read that you’re supposed to shake it first which helps a lot! I’ve used it for the last two days and it’s really working. I love Sunday Riley and just ordered the Wake Up With Me kit as well 😍

I never write reviews but I just gotta say.... this lil guy is WORTH EVERY PENNY! Yes, it’s expensive. Yes, it could be bigger. But the payoff is huge! I have very sensitive skin and any time it is irritated, i know patting some of this on will relieve the irritation and speed up recovery time. It’s so good that you can pop a pimple and then get ready for bed and by the time you have finished brushing your teeth, the spot you just poked at is already less red and no longer inflamed!!

Yes all you do is spray it on your face (as another reviewer said). It’s a spray? Duh? IMO this is WAYYYYY overpriced for the amount of product that you get. Wanna spend money on a good toner that has fermented ingredients? Go with any other Korean brand. Come on SR. Don’t joke around with us and this prove for only this much product. You can’t just launch a bunch of new stuff and expect us to love it. You used to launch one product at a time slowly, built love for it. Now you’re just being greedy.

I have acne prone skin and while I use azelaic acid 15% religiously, I do get a pimple every 3 months or so. I immediately apply this product & few days later, the size of the acne has significantly reduced. I use it on my boyfriend as well!
Never again. Same price. Less product. This used to be my favorite night time skincare routine, but there is no way I’m paying $100 for a few sprays of each product.

I got on the Good Genes train and am wow’d by that product, so I thought I would add this to my skincare routine as well. I’m down to half a bottle of Pink Drink. I use it at night after cleansing but but before putting on Good Genes and my moisturizer. When you spray it on, it smells like champagne and I can see how they’ve added that fragrance for the luxury and ritual of it ... but if I’m being honest, I’m not sure what else this did. There were no noticeable results from it that I couldn’t credit to my other products. It’s also quite pricey. For those reasons, I see no reason to purchase again or recommend.

Started using this a few weeks ago. My skin does appear firmer! I use it along with the products in the Sunday Riley vault. I’ve started losing weight, and at my age was worried about elasticity. My face and neck look a lot better than I expected. Definitely buying pink drink again!

I’m an RN and have to wear a mask all day. As a result, the areas of my face under my mask have broken out with terrible adult acne. It was all over my cheeks, chin, and above my upper lip below my nose. I also had lots of black heads on my nose. I started using this (as a mask) twice a week for the first few weeks. my acne has completely resolved. I still use it once a week, as a mask, for prevention. I’ve tried other sulfur based treatments, including Peter Thomas Roth and others, but this one works the best.the smell is awful, so don’t sleep in it. it will get on your pillowcase, and it’s super difficult to get that smell out (sulfur).I leave it on for about 6 hours at a time. it does flake off around my mouth, but that’s the only area, and the thinner the layer, the less likely it is to flake off.

I LOVE everything in this set. I was recommended this set while I was in Sephora looking for something for my hormonal acne and I’m obsessed. I absolutely love the UFO oil and the serums. I haven’t used the sulfur acne treatment mask much mostly because it smells really strong but when I have it has been great. I also love the face wash, its so gentle on my dry skin, I’ve seen my skin visibly be more even and hydrated.
This is so refreshing. I love this stuff so much. So hydrating for the skin.

This Superstars Kit by Sunday Riley has very quickly become one of my favorites. I use every item in the kit religiously and love it so much that this is the second time I purchase it and truly hope this one never runs out of stock.

I only wanted to buy the eye cream but then I realized that for twice the money I could have the full size eye cream AND get to try all these other great products! I love the instant brightness from the eye cream and it keeps the skin around my eyes hydrated all day. Works well under concealer too. The vitamin C serum is so much more hydrating than I expected and so far I haven’t had any irritation. The A+ is very tolerable on my sensitive skin and Good Genes is an all time favorite of mine that I have used in the past and will definitely use again. I would grab this set before it’s gone if you’re new to Sunday Riley.

I have super bad hormonal acne that feels impossible to combat. With that AND having to wear a mask 24/7 now it’s a nightmare!!!! Im a huge consumer of acne preventing/fixing products and I have my favorites but THIS is a new #1 in my book. I was really surprised to see this only at $20 because it feels like it works better than $80+ items I’ve used. I leave it on for 20 minutes as a mask or sleep in it and every time it makes my acne look almost gone the next day. Even with products that felt like they did the best, I would get new acne sprouts within the same day or a ton the next day, but using this as needed I can def tell it’s a full day to a few days without any new breakouts (which is HUGE to me as someone who religiously tries to fight acne). I also love that this is cruelty free as someone who now only buys cruelty free products. ***WARNING*** it does smell reeeeaaalllyyy bad. This product does exactly what it promises but if you’ve ever smelled any type of sulfur, you’ll know what I mean. It smells bad, but if you want your acne gone, THIS will do the job! I will 100% be buying this frequently.

I picked this up to keep unexpected surprises in check and I had several arise recently and it didn’t do much to reduce them but it sure did make my enlarged pores non-existent. The tube is a joke. More plastic than product. And it definitely didn’t warrant a huge box either. Would I re-purchase this? Probably not. I’m sure a cheaper dupe can be had at the drugstore.

I frequently pick at my pimples on my face, which will usually leave my face inflamed for a week or so before it calms down. When I pop my pimples, I put this on at night...ZERO redness in the morning. It didn’t bring the pimple size down 100% in one night, but it’s definitely flattened out after a few hours. The smell honestly isn’t bad. When I first read the reviews I was scared of my face smelling, but it just smells like Mario Badescu pimple treatment with a hint of tea tree. Holy grail product. Put it in your cart NOW!!

I do not like this as much as the Caudalie product.  I purchased this because it was suggested by the consultant in the store who claimed it was a better product and same price.  This was untrue.  When I got home I realized that the Caudalie mist was 3.4 oz and not 1.7 oz for the same price.  I was disgusted.

So it’s cute but it’s too small ... and for the price someone would be better off buying SKll the Japan essence .. I love sundays juno oil and good genes ... those are worth every penny ... but this needs a upgrade I am going to use the whole thing  and come back if anything changes ☺️❤️Too small for the price . I am going to buy SKll the Japanese Essence when I am done with this one ... I love their Juno oil and good genes products tho :)
I love Sunday Riley skincare and it is very expensive but this set is the best products at a really great price! My skin literally feels like a million bucks!!! Definitely buy this!!!

This product isn’t bad by any means, but its nothing special at all. It’s no better than a drug store acne product, and it smells like rotten eggs from the sulfur. I’d be completely ok with smelling like eggs if it worked any miracles, but it doesn’t. Plus, the tube is only half full at best so it’s a waste of packaging and misleading. Literally get the same results from Clean and Clear acne spot treatment, which cost way less.

Love the results on my super sensitive skin! No burning, itching, or increased redness. This set is also a great value. The only two items in the set that I’ve already run out of are the pink drink and the moisturizer. Good Genes, A+, and Luna Oil are the most expensive items in the kit and they aren’t anywhere near finished and I’ve had the set about 3 weeks. This is a great set if you want a complete routine and want to try something without spending a fortune.

I’m obsessed with this skin care line! After two uses of all 4 products I noticed a huge difference in the texture of my skin. The UFO acne treatment oil is by far my favorite, I have oily skin and areas of large pores. Immediately after two uses of this oil my pores decreased significantly and I do not have oily skin throughout the day. My makeup lays beautifully now and I don’t worry as much about oil as much. So glad I found this skin care line I’m hooked!
Used it a few times and haven’t noticed any difference. Actually made me break out and my acne worst than before. Don’t buy or waste your money.

I’ve been using this about a month pretty consistently right after washing my face, then I use my usual products after applying. I really feel like this is helping the overall health of my skin. I spray on my hand then pat onto my face and neck, similar to a toner. I have reactive skin and I haven’t had any redness and irritation from my vit. c and other harsh products if I use this first. I recommend this! I love it.

Just want to say first I have very oily skin and my skin can put up with a lot of exfoliation and is not sensitive. Having written that, I used this on my nose three nights in a row and it made the tiny blackheads on my nose disappear. Nothing has helped with the tiny blackheads before. I have used it on larger breakouts I get once a month, it’s reduced the swelling but never brought the zit to a head. I would recommend if you have tiny blackheads.

I love everything Sunday Riley. I added this to my lineup use it in the morning and in the evening after cleansing with ceramic slip. Three sprays is all you need and then I just pat into my face and follow with all the things Sunday Riley.

I have dry skin with the occasional acne and I’ve been using this mask for years. It is very strong and drying, so you need to be careful. I have used it as a spot treatment overnight for a really bad pimple before, and it will bring the deepest under the skin pimples to a head and speed up the healing process A LOT, but if you leave it on more than 20 minutes the skin will appear reddish and sensitive afterwards. For me it works best as a spot treatment.
Not worth the hype /save your money! Cause my perfect skin to have numerous problems. Do not buy this.

This works really well for skin firmness and elasticity! I love it!  I’ve been recovering from TSW for a few years. It left the skin around my eyes a terrible mess. Very thin weak skin. It desperately needs elasticity and firmness. I just can’t believe how much it costs for such a tiny bottle!! I have found the best way to stretch it out is to spray about 5 spritzes into my palm then use both hands to pat it around my face, eyes and neck. I also only use it at night to save product/money and also because it leaves my skin slightly tackier than I prefer for daytime.

The concept and ingredients seem AMAZING. The product only last bout a month.....NOT AMAZING. The amount you get, the wasteful spray applicator, and to only last a month is not enough for me to repurchase. (Just can’t get over how it could barely last a month.....shortest lived skincare product I’ve ever purchased)
I’ve been using it for a week or two and I am enjoying all the products. My pores look smaller and my skin looks smoother with less breakouts. Nice value as well, these will likely last a while.

SR products are hit and miss for me and this was a miss. The spray comes out a bit aggressively so I often sprayed it into my hands and patted it onto my face. Aside from that though I really don’t think this did much of anything for my skin. I waited until I finished the entire bottle before reviewing and honestly I never noticed a big difference. There was no firming or quenching of my skin so I’ll leave this in the no repurchase category.

I never write reviews but I had to because this was just  horrible. It said it could be used as an overnight, but I woke up and washed my face and my face was bright red from the cream. Not only is it impossible to apply, but it completely irritated my face. It’s only been a few hours since I have waken up but it’s still completely red it looks like I have a rash. Never purchasing again.

Before you pass this essence off based on mediocre reviews, please READ the ingredients to see how many fantastic and beneficial ones there are! The best ingredients are at the top of the list, unlike with so many other essences and toners! Some of the very first ingredients are: ferment, peptides, ceramides, lipids, fruit extracts, etc. Most other essences contain mostly water and ferment extract, especially the “famous“ ones. I have used this now for 7-8 months and am buying a new bottle just now. A little goes a long way. I spray a couple squirts in the palm of my hand and then press it in my face and neck in the morning and at night. It makes my skin plump, dewy, glowy, firmed and clear. it is very light but at the same time hydrating. The scent is natural from the fruit extracts and is refreshing and very mild. No stickiness, no heaviness, NO tackiness. Skin feels moisturized and dewy, not greasy. Don’t use more than one or two squirts in your hand, it is all you need. I will never stop using it - it’s necessary skincare staple!

Would give this 5 stars but I think it’s such a small bottle for the price. With that being said, this has become a staple in my nighttime routine. I love this product but really wish it was a larger size for the price. I have very oily sensitive and acne prone skin but this seems to really help. After cleaning at night, I spray this on my face and neck then apply my curology formula followed by my night moisturizer. I do see a difference in my skin if I don’t use it, especially the redness. If you can afford it I think this product is worth it.
very good value if you’re looking to get good genes, A+ and the luna oil. the rest of the items are pretty much sample sizes though

About a year ago I bought this set as a last resort while I was struggling from acne. This changed my life. I now only use the UFO right before my period and I have added in the morning set… but if you’re considering this, just try it! I promise no regrets

I did an exchange for this after returning another spot treatment I was really unhappy with and while I don’t love this, it does work - however, I needed to use a LOT on my face to get it to work. Would not buy again just because I know I am going to go through this super quickly.

The A+ Retinol and the UFO Oil in this kit have made some dramatic changes in my skin, and I am really glad I got this kit since it introduced me to these items. I will re-purchase them again, although I only spot use the UFO Oil on problem areas and it will last most likely a year. The retinol has definitely made a difference in my skin. I look significantly more luminous and glowy and some fine lines have softened, become less noticable. I will keep using this retinol! It is fairly gentle for being a stronger product than the CeraVe retinol I started with. I am very happy with the changes. The Saturn mask does not seem any different than other run of the mill clay masks, the cleanser is also just a cleanser, and since there are affordable options that can produce the same results, I would not buy those two items again. I have not been able to use the Good Genes product enough to know if it’s very beneficial to me, because I have been building up my retinol use and using non-retinol days to avoid actives and ensure I am not damaging my skin barrier. This photo shows my skin on the left on 2/15/22 and on the right on 3/12/22, so less than a month of use! Sorry the light quality is not identical. But I feel you get the idea, my skin is so much more even, some darker spots have also disappeared! and my skin looks more luminous and hydrated, less fine lines and tight areas, less breakout for sure. For reference, I am almost 40.

Really disappointed with Sunday Riley. They took a fantastic mask product and decided to re-market it as a spot treatment and drastically reduce the size of the packaging to .5 ounces. The tube is mostly air, and I’ve already gone through a third of it in one use. Not worth it for what you pay unless you’re just dealing with the occasional pimple.

I got this as a free sample from Sephora. I don’t usually have breakouts, but I got two monster pimples and decided to give it a try. After three uses I saw that it actually made the pimples far worse. They were red and peeling. A week later, they are still red. Plus, the smell of the product is terrible (think rotten eggs).

As someone who is trying to learn more about skincare, this is a great way to explore this brand. While I don’t see major changes in my skin, my makeup looks so nice lately. I have been using all of the products and my skin isn’t dry or sensitive - I often get hives from some skincare ingredients.
I didn’t notice that this did anything to impact my skin.  Maybe my skin isn’t in bad enough condition but I wouldn’t recommend it tbh
If I have a bad cystic pimple this is my go too. Always makes it smaller by the next morning! I’ve had it for over a year and have yet to run out of it. A little goes a long way!

The sales associate swore by this product. I told her my skin concerns were dryness and uneven skin tone. Not sure if she actually took it into consideration but she said this made such a difference in her routine… It honestly made no difference in mine. My mother also used it and saw no difference either.
I don’t feel the product did anything. I ended up returning it I wouldn’t recommend it.

I got a mini one of these and I was pretty excited to try it. Unfortunately, it smells like some kind of rotten grass. I’m not sensitive to scents normally but this one was bad enough to write a review about.

I recently purchased my second Wake Up With Me Morning Routine kit. I have been pleased with the trial sizes and most of them have actually lasted much longer than I expected. I immediately fell in love with the smell of the products and just how great it feels to start my morning using these! I’m not a morning person and have never had much of a morning skin routine so I was worried it would feel like too much. It doesn’t at all, though, and now I would miss it! I wasn’t sure if I was really noticing a difference in my skin so I was holding off on doing a review. Tonight, though, I was looking through pictures from before I started using this and my skin looks noticeably brighter.

Buyer beware! this brand is not worth your money, there are plenty of good brands out there that care about consumers who I would rather give my money to.Product is ok, packaging is horrible. The glass bottles have writhing them a smaller bag of product intended purely to deceive consumers and sell less product for more money.No Thanks. I will not be buying this again or anything Sunday Riley,
This is really pricey. I saw no difference and it had a very unpleasant smell

I’ve been using this product for over 5 years and I love it. I typically use it on any cystic acne overnight and I’ll notice a difference by the morning. It definitely helped to make my acne more manageable in conjunction with a balanced skincare routine.
This was a great chance for me to try UFO and Saturn and I am definitely adding those to my regular skin routine. Good price for what you get. I would definitely purchase another one.

I bought this for a friend and it arrived yesterday…We open it together…Not to be that person but… First of all, the box is huge and wasteful for this tube of product. Second, the tube I received is not even halfway full. I was embarrassed when they asked if that was the full size. I could fold it in half without any product coming out the opening. My Summer Friday lip butter has so much product I don’t even touch it and the product just escapes the tube. I stopped buying Sunday Riley for many other reasons a while ago and decided to get this for a friend who really struggles with acne. I will NEVER ever BUY Sunday Riley.. I’ll take a free sample with a bowl of salt.

My skin is far from perfect, and the masks make it SO much worse. I found a sample of this in my drawer and decided to give it a shot. Wow, this stuff is good! The redness was almost gone, and the actual blemishes were so much smaller and less noticeable. Now I’m getting the full size product.
Although products were easy to use and feel good on the skin, I saw no improvement in a month. Made no visible difference. Still the same textures and acne I always had problems with .

I bought this as a gift for a 19 yo girl with painful cystic acne. I also bought her the Lightstim® for Acne laser. She has tried many prescription topical creams and Acutane w/ avg and temporary results.  The combo of Sunday Riley and LightStim has cleared her face, neck and chest at a level she never thought possible.  These leave her skin soft and smooth without harmful chemicals or harmful medications. It’s changed her confidence level completely!

I’ve been using this for the last 3 months and took a short break after I ran out after month 1 and wow did I see a difference. This light and magical drink resurfaces my acne scaring, softens my skin and helps my other serums and oils absorb faster.  I just bought my 3rd bottle and am considering grabbing a back up once it’s in sale next because I can never not have this in my routine. love Sunday Riley!

I can’t speak to the change in packaging, as I only found this recently, but this stuff is one of the few (if not only) things that has made me want to write a review. I’ve been struggling with hormonal cystic acne and awful scarring since I turned 30 (4 years ago) - tried every cream, every patch, every everything. This isn’t easy to apply initially, but I tend to rub it in on and around each spot (rather than try to cake it on like a mask) and it WORKS. Not only removing acne, but preventing new spots, and has been the first thing to make old scars fade (been spreading it over old spots as the new ones became few and far between). Sure, I’d love if it came really full to the brim, but otherwise I hope they never stop making it.

I absolutely love this stuff. It works. My skin feels supple after using. But the size is absolutely ridiculous. I have dry skin. To get enough on that I can feel it, I’m using too much of the bottle. It won’t even last a month which is a shame. Sunday Riley, make it bigger or make a different version a little thicker so it lasts! At this price and the quantity, it’s cheaper and probably more efficient to buy Tatcha The Essence or even SK-II pitera essence. Those are expensive do what’s that tell you? I’ll be switching to a different brand due to the size and consistency of the product because you have to use too much for it to work.

I ordered this directly from the Sunday Riley website when it first came out and have been using this for a few weeks now. I’m a huge fan of essences. I’ve 100% noticed an improvement in my skin. It definitely works. The issue I have is the size. It’s really small for an essence. Within 10 days my bottle was 1/2 gone. This makes me sad because on one hand I want to repurchase it and continue using and on the other it’s really pricey for such a small amount.

Bought this set a few months back because I needed a good eye cream & I was still breastfeeding so the beauty advisor said that this & use the rest when you can I used the eye cream alone it didn’t work so I put the whole box away to rerun it never got around to it! When I stopped breastfeeding I decided to give it a chance I have been only using it for 2 weeks & I can already see my marionette lines going away no puffy under eyes, super bouncy skinny, my face is bright?! I can’t believe it & by the way I forget to put the night stuff sometimes!!!! It’s amazing worth every penny so far! Only 4 stars because you literally have to use everything to get best results
I expected this to have more clay in it, to be used like a paste but it’s very thin and sinks into the skin. It doesn’t dry out my pimples. It didn’t work for me.

Right after I started using this product my skin definitely has started looking more hydrated, clearer, and more plump. I’m not sure what it is about this product but it just feels right in my routine, like a missing step I didn’t even know was missing. It’s been working harmoniously with my other products and I’ve yet to see any adverse effects. I try new products all the time and I fully expected to hate this product or have it be a one and done but this is definitely getting added as a staple in my routine. I hope one day they make a bigger size!

I have mixed feelings! First of all- the smell totally doesn’t bother me. It has sulfer in it & a few other things- & not everything needs to smell like a lily if you’re looking for results. This helped my maskne & hormonal acne! However, I feel like over time my skin was less responsive. Get it with the SR acne kit- full size & the other products in it are great for acne.
Love it, a little goes a long way! I do wish the bottle was larger

First time user & I have seen some positive results after having used this product a week or two. However, this doesn’t work as a overnight treatment, more like a 20-30 min mask if you can handle the smell.

Sunday Riley is truly saving my skin! I honestly love all the products I got in this kit. My only beef is that they color the bottle so you think you’re getting more than you are. When I pulled the bag out of the bottle, it’s soooo small! Come on Sunday Riley! You’re making money hand over fist. At least give us the whole bottle!

I like this product. It has great ingredients - ceramides and peptides. I like the light, refreshing scent of it. I spray a couple times on my hand then lightly pat onto my cheeks, chin and forehead after my toner. I like the look of the packaging, the sleekness and pink and gold color of it.
