An absolute must have in my line up! I keep this on hand to I can easily reapply my spf through the day without messing up or dulling my makeup. I cannot recommend this enough! This is an absolute game changer

I have been using this sunscreen for a few years now - hands down, this is the best mineral sunscreen out there. Even though it’s oil-free, it has a great silky texture and a moisturizing effect. The light tint is very flattering by itself but also works great as a primer. I get many compliments on my skin with only this sunscreen. Totally worth the price, and sunscreen is a good investment.
Wonderful sunscreen, light and with a nice texture

I’m a huge fan of Supergoop and was super excited to try out their new mineral powder sunscreen. This is one of my favorite products to throw in my purse and use to reapply my sunscreen when I’m on the go!

A bit thick for daily use but I love having this as a travel product when I need to consolidate products. Works really well as a all in one moisturizer/BB cream/SPF. Still gets a touch greasy on hot summer Florida days but it’s bearable enough. Do wish there was slightly more SPF than just 40 rating considering how thick it is.

I’m extremely fair-skinned and I’ll tactically burn if I look at the sun, so I needed something that I can easily apply daily during the spring and summer. This fits the bill for me. It has a good SPF, and I love how lightweight it is, so it absorbs quickly. It has a very subtle scent that disappears after application, so it doesn’t interfere with your perfume. I’ve not used it for the beach or pool, just for everyday use, but it’s definitely the best sunscreen I’ve found so far.

I loved the previous version of this as an easy way to touch up sunscreen and mattify my shine. I found this powder personally a bit too glowy for me, it would work for most people and I love the concept but don’t need more shimmer in my life. It’s a warmer shimmer that is supposed to be universal and worked on my light skin.

Initially the first uses I had difficulty with this sunscreen, if you use this under makeup you have to make sure you don’t pair it with any water based creams beforehand, I would prep with water based serums and put this on top and it would pill and was so annoying, but I love the blurring affect this gives is great! And definitely provides some evening throughout the skin
Great mineral body sunscreen! Packaging is nice and light, great for travel.
Love this product! Works really well as a primer and sunscreen. It has made it into my everyday makeup rotation.

I love this product! It’s super lightweight and I have noticed a difference in my skin since getting it a month ago. I did break out when I first got it, but it was a result of my skin getting used to a new product. Overall, I definitely love wearing this under foundation or concealer, it doesn’t make me break out and it really breathable!

I’ve used this sunscreen for a few years now. As an extremely oily gal who uses foundation everyday for work, this is the only sunscreen that hasn’t messed with my long lasting full cover foundation. I still get oily after a couple hours even with powder, but not as much as with other sunscreens that claim to be matte. There are other good matte sunscreens out there, especially the Asian ones, but if you are specifically a full face makeup wearer, this sunscreen will hold that makeup in place and not mess with your foundation’s formulation which seems to be my battle everytime I try a new sunscreen. I always go back to this one for working days.

This sunscreen is good, I love how it goes on the skin, it has a minimal blurring effect to even our skin tone. BUT it is so drying. I’m having to work harder than ever to keep my skin hydrated because if feels like this just sucks all the moisture out. I think I will have to switch products.

This is nice, it’s a nice refresh to spf during the day that ain’t going to mess up your makeup or make you have to redo your whole face. I will say I’m not in love with the fact that it has shimmer or glitter in it, but since I love dewy skin, it’s not the worst thing ever

Love this sunscreen.  This replaces my foundation on casual days.  It is very matte, great coverage, works almost like a primer as well.  I wear sunscreen year-round, and with moisturizer, primer, sunscreen, foundation, etc. it is a lot of layers.  With this, it cuts it way back, and seems to do the trick.I had avoided this brand, as I assumed it was connected with Gwynyth Paltrow, but it’s not.

I like the texture, tint, and feel of this, but it started pilling making my cheeks look really dry - I don’t wear foundation or any makeup over my sunscreen so I’m not sure what would have caused it. It’s a shame because I liked everything else about it. Perhaps it was my vitamin C serum under it, but I had let it dry very several minutes before applying the sunscreen.

I’ve been super impressed by Supergoop suntan lotion/gels. I was excited to try this one. I found it to be a little tacky with a somewhat odd scent. I wish I had gone to a store to sample it first. The idea of body mousse was intriguing. That said, this was disappointing.

I’m combo skin (oily in my t-zone) and this gives me a great matte finish all day. It’s an immediate blur that is great under foundation or with concealer. A little goes a long way and make sure you take the time to rub it in completely and set for a few seconds. Highly recommend.

I’m sure it works as a sunscreen but it leaves a film on my skin that catches every tiny bump and hair and makes me look cakey and powdery. Not cute. And if I try to out any makeup or anything on top I get a filmy residue that balls up on my face.

the Play sunscreen is my favorite sunscreen I’ve encountered, so obviously I tried this one. I used to solely use mineral sunscreens but I just couldn’t find one with “clean“ ingredients that also fit my skin. I used to use the Supergoop tinted mineral sunscreen, I did love it-was a little oily for my skin in summer but I made due- then the formula changed and it was even oilier on my skin. anyway so I loved Supergoop, decided to buy the mini starter kit and LOVED the Play screen, so I bought the big bottle. still kinda skeptical on chemical sunscreens, but I loved play screen so much I decided to just try and get over that. once they released this one, I had to try it. thicker then play screen but that’s to be expected with mineral, dries down very nice, wears nice under my foundation and no white cast. Supergoop please give us a big bottle!!
This is my everyday sunblock. It is non-greasy on my oily skin. I wear it under foundation.

I found that this product was not matte but its not bad either. I thought at first that it made my skin look bad but then I realized that I needed to let it sink in before proceeding with my makeup. If I did it straight away my base makeup would break up! It’s super silky on, like a whipped silicone primer texture. It’s clear (at least it is on my fairer skin) and makes my skin look like it just has moisturizer on once it sinks in.

This stick is perfect for traveling - it didn’t leave a white cast on me (I have super fair skin, though) & the application went on super smoothly. After multiple applications throughout the day it didn’t leave my skin feeling greasy or itchy. I am acne prone and this stuff doesn’t break me out. I took it on vacation with me to New Orleans and it saved my life. I will purchase these again and again!

I love this for touch ups! For starters once you figure out how to use it it’s great. You need to pull the yellow piece in the center out for any product to be used. It’s great to sparingly use to reset my face after a day out! Definitely just light coverage but it’s a nice thing to carry in your bag!

I have very oily skin and really wanted to love this product but I just can’t take how dry it makes my face which is really odd. Yes, the oil is controlled but after half an hour of wearing this product, my face gets very dry and it feels so tight. I’ve also tried it with makeup and it’s extremely uncomfortable because it creates these dry patches that are hard to get rid of.

I really like this product, but my only issue is it leaves a slight bit of an ashy look on my skin. But overall this product is great! The Matte finish definitely helps control the oil on my face. I would definitely use this as a primer before applying my makeup. I plan on using the Unseen version which I was told won’t give me the ashy look on first application. I would highly recommend this product.
Even though it’s a little expensive, it’s worth it ! Have tried a ton, eucerin, sesderma. And this one leave your skin soft and not shiny, kind of a primer ! Amazing !
Lightweight spray and convenient. Love this for the kids and for myself.

I have a fear of them discontinuing this! I have tried every mineral sunscreen and clean primer. I have big pores and redness and this evens out both without feeling or looking like I have makeup on - I would use it even if it didn’t have spf! It’s also the only mineral spf that doesn’t make me look and feel greasy.

Not me reliving my dream matte mouse from 2002, but YESSSSSS THIS IS AMAZING  and I am absolutely in love I bought a travel because I was skeptical because I tried a different supergoop and it was super oily. This was the complete opposite and it left me with a super soft and smoothe face with no make up on. I can’t imagine how perfect this would be for someone that knows how to apply make up . This is all I will use from now on as a main spf

Really wanted to love this sunscreen because of the price, but it just didn’t work for me. I have light tan complexion it leaves a pretty harsh white cast on me. I don’t think the white cast is as noticeable in natural light/light with more of an orange tint, but under i definitely look pretty washed/ghostly when I use the recommended 2 fingers length amount. Again, some of this white cast does go away, but would recommend for people with a deeper complexion. It also has a thick consistency so you have to take some time to work it in to the skin. That being said, I do like the feel of it, I think it protects well, and when I sweat it doesn’t irritate my eyes. Works great for neck and chest so I will keep using it for these areas!P.S.: Make sure you cleanse and moisture your face well or when you apply mineral sunscreen it will highlight all the un-exfoliated skin.

Love the mattefying affect of this product. The photos are deceiving though, the light tint does not give coverage at all lol BUT it was important for me to use a sunscreen that would not make me look oily- this does the job
Love how it feels so far but was really disappointed that it’s as much as it is and it’s a little less than 3/4 full!! If i use it everyday it definitely wont last a month

This is a bit difficult to get the powder to come out. I suggest closing the lid and tapping on a surface to get the powder on the bristles. It’s a bit clunky on liquid foundation, but it sets nicely and is good protection on top of normal spf

I like the idea and how convenient it is to keep it in your purse for touch ups though the day. It’s very sheer and it’s super glowy, you can definitely see the glitter.  The blush is soft and I think it looks good as a highlighter.

This sunscreen is so lightweight and hydrating. There’s no powdery or thick greasy feel just pure hydration and it makes your skin look so smooth and naturally luminous while protecting it from UVA and UVB. I’ve never loved a sunscreen more and I’ve tried so many at much higher price points. This will be my facial sunscreen for life.
Best sunscreen I’ve ever used! Smells great and rubs in quickly. No white residue left behind. Not greasy or sticky. Love it!!

Don’t get me wrong this is definitely expensive for a spray body sunscreen but so worth it in my opinion. Doesn’t feel greasy, the spray bottle does a great job of generously dispersing so none of that annoying rubbing after. Plus with super fair skin its the first that has protected my skin and kept me burn free while in the pool or at the beach all day. Love supergoop products!

This is not water resistant at all; I wore it in the pool for an hour and got sunburned. That said, it works well if you don’t get wet, is easy to apply, has a pleasant, light fragrance, and isn’t sticky. Just don’t plan on going swimming.

This sticky liquid out of the spray. It feels like a cheap made spray bottle. If I spray it over it is not a mist it is a all over spray most of it going waste. I spray it on my palm and then apply to my body. Product is good though, wish it was less sticky.

I am a generous applied of sunscreen and loved the idea of this. The texture is very nice but melts into a lotion quickly after the dispenser foams it. No worries still nice, except when you go to reapply... oh boy. It rolls and balls up like CRAZY! It then looks awful. I looooove Supergoop but they gotta fix that.

Super practical this sunscreen. I like that I can touch up my sunscreen whenever I want with this product because it allows me to keep my makeup intact. Besides, if you have oily skin, it will help you a lot because it mattifies quite well. I always carry it in my bag.

i wear makeup everyday so i have a hard time reapplying my spf, this makes it so easy to reapply throughout the day and i love that it helps sets my makeup too. i didn’t get too much flash back with pictures also.
I really like this product, it is perfect for my oily skin. It gives light tone, but you even don’t feel it on your skin, and it looks healthy but not greasy. I will recommend it to my friends !

This is the best sunscreen I have ever used and I highly recommend it with the caveat that I personally cannot use it daily because I can’t use titanium dioxide. If you have no sensitivity to titanium dioxide and you have normal to oily skin this stuff is so good and also easy to reapply throughout the day. It feels like a primer and even though it looks tinted I never had an issue with any orange or weird cast (for reference I have very pale skin (MAC NC10, PMG shade 3 in concealer, NARS Chantilly). Really sad I can’t use this because my skin can’t handle the titanium dioxide so my search for the perfect sunscreen continues! I do think this would work well for a lot of people though!

i love the light, fluffy texture (you’re encouraged to shake the bottle before use)! i don’t wear makeup over it but i think it does well on its own. it’s not very matte on my skin but is a little blurring so it evens things out. they should probably make this in a darker tint as well; it disappears into my skin, but i cant imagine it not leaving a slight cast on someone more brown.

I can’t stand when I wear makeup and have to reapply sunscreen gently overtop. This product solves all of my problems! I felt super fresh reapplying and it was like a setting powder but served a purpose. The glow particles are very glowy, so not sure I can wear this every time but I still love it.

I do see a difference with the skin my pores actually become less noticeable I really like except for the consistency which is why I give it 4 stars  it’s like a thick silicone feeling but other that it looks beautiful on the skin

I love to apply this glowy powder, the packaging is so convenient and practical. I have very oily skin and this powder feels very lightweight and keeps my oiliness at bay. Perfect for my spring break vacations. I received this product complimentary from Supergoop.

Gifted by Super GoopThis is such a nice mineral powder. It applies nicely very easy to use.  Once applied it leaves behind a beautiful shimmy. Definitely recommend if you like to have a sparkly glow. This is the first mineral powder with SPF I have used and really like it.
This feels like a cloud on my face, I love it! And even though its tinted it doesn’t get on my clothes.

I love the concept of this setting powder on the go- now with added glow! Unfortunately, I dropped it from my desk ONCE and it broke off at the clear portion holding the powder. Powder spilled out and I can’t really use it as intended anymore since it snapped off where the threading was. However, I did get to use it a few times before and the powder + SPF + glow was great! It helps keep your makeup in touch and adds shimmer. I’m so sad I can’t take it with me on the go anymore. Gifted by Supergoop.

This is a great product to carry around and to re apply sunscreen throughout the day without messing up your makeup. I have been really impressed with this (make sure you completely remove the yellow stopper - I used tweezers, and the product dispenses perfectly fine!!!!). I love that it has a glowy finish because I tend to avoid powders since I have dry skin and I don’t want a flat matte finish, but these are perfect! It’s the perfect amount of luminosity without being glittery, and there is sun protection on top of it all! Truly a great product and it will live in my bag from now to take on the go!

I have acne-prone skin and this product did not break me out at all! My first purchase I was a complete fan and I loved how smooth it went on to my skin and it lasted me a good while! My second purchase didn’t go as well, I felt like it was harder to apply evenly (even when I shook the tube before applying) and it also got this really weird smell that wasn’t there the first time. I also went through the tube a lot faster as getting a good amount of product was difficult. Not sure if it was the batch or there was a slight formula change. But I ended up not enjoying it enough for the price, so I am no longer purchasing. I do recommend though, good for acne-prone/sensitive skin and a great starter for those getting into sunscreen. Could be better on redness coverage but the tint is still there.

Gifted by Supergoop in exchange for an honest review. I love the idea of re-upping your SPF in a powder but this one is straight glitter which is unfortunately not what I was looking for - I was hoping for a more subtle glow from within. Really difficult to wear unless glitter is your vibe.

I was so excited to try this product out, I love Super Goop! I love that it is in a brush, it makes the application so easy and seamless. It doesn’t cause any major breakouts either which is amazing!!

I am super oily so I was really excited to try this product out! Unfortunately, no matter how little I use or how I apply it-it peels off my face on initial application. It’s a terrible product and I think I have wasted more of it than actually applied in my face.

I’ve been using this SPF daily for 2 weeks now. I’m not a fan. I have pale white sensitive skin. I like to use SPF on my face, neck, and hands daily. This made my skin dry. Especially, on my hands. Unfortunately, I didn’t find this as effective as chemical based options Ive used in the past from this brand. I applied it 3 times when I was in the sun for 4 hours at a game and still got burnt. I was wearing sun hat too.

I’ve been using this all week on a beach vacation and have really been enjoying it. I haven’t gotten a sunburn once despite being in and out of the water. This is one of the few chemical sunscreens I can put on my face without it burning my eyes. It has a very light, pleasant scent that helps it not smell like sunscreen. You can feel it on your skin a bit, but not as much as lotion sunscreens and it doesn’t dry me out like spray sunscreens. Overall, I would recommend this as a body sunscreen and perhaps even as a cheaper daily facial sunscreen.

Summer is coming and this SPF powder is a must have! It’s so convenient and compact you can literally take anywhere. The brush is soft, the product is easy to apply. It does have some shimmer but when applying over makeup it looks great. Love that they made this SPF in powder so it’s easy to reapply and not ruin your makeup.

Glowy sunscreen powder that is perfect for reapplying sunscreen throughout the day. The glowy formula is very shimmery so beware of that. You need to apply quite a bit of powder to ensure decent sunscreen coverage, and if you mind a shimmery face, just stick to the original powder with no shimmer.

This is such a beautiful setting powder, especially for spring and summer. It has a lovely slight shimmer. I use it in addition to my sunscreen, but I love that it has also has SPF. Definitely a great finishing touch after my self tan drops & natural makeup for a natural look. Gifted by Supergoop!

This being the first Supergoop product I’ve tried, has raised the bar high for the rest of their products!! I love having multiple products of spf, especially during summer, but I don’t want the weighted down feeling. The brush is soft and the powder is absolutely beautiful. It’s a total WIN WIN in my book. Grab this, you won’t be disappointed. - gifted by Supergoop

This is my first SPF in a powder form and I’m hooked! The powder is so much more convenient to use than any liquid form! Reapplying throughout the day has never been so quick - it takes me literally just several seconds. No need to pat several minutes to remove the white cast and it’s still mineral. Compact tube makes it a great option for traveling. I was afraid the powder would look orange on my pale skin but it’s not. The best sunscreen overall!

I keep this sunscreen in my purse so I’m never without. It glides on easy and doesn’t leave a film. We have avoided sun burns after we switched all our sunscreen to SuperGoop! My family is very fair skinned and would still get burned with other sunscreens. Plus the ingredients are safe for my young kids.

FINALLY, I am so glad they have released a mineral version of my favorite sunscreen! I’ve been trying to avoid chemical sunscreens and I was so happy to find this on the Sephora website. I was anticipating it to have a white cast like most mineral sunscreens, but I am happy to report there is no white cast and it’s very easy to blend into the skin! It feels silky - a perfect sunscreen texture. So happy that Supergoop has released this, now they just need to release a mineral version of Handsceen and my life would be made, lol.

I bought this product bc a coworker recommended it to me and I really like it. I have been wearing for about 6 months and honestly since I bought it, I have maybe used my foundation about 3-5 times because I use this as my primer/ foundation everyday. It leaves your skin feeling so soft and even. The tint is beautiful and it matches my skin tone very well. It does not leave my skin feeling oily hence the name.

I love Supergoop sunscreen normally so I was excited to try out this product as a setting powder! The SPF is great so that I feel protected all day long against the sun’s rays. Application is easy and I love how you can take it on the go/in your purse. This was complimentary from Supergooop!

I really enjoy this!!! I have combo/oily/acne/sensitive skin and this has really played well with my morning routine. I have a medium olive skin tone and this doesn’t leave a weird cast. What I love the most is that it’s NOT oily!!! I can wear my makeup just fine without it disrupting my face. I do suggest letting it dry down a bit.

This setting powder gives such a beautiful, natural glow to your complexion! It doesn’t look oily or greasy and feels like you’re wearing nothing at all. It’s super lightweight and doesn’t leave a white cast either. I love the added spf protection and how it extends my makeup wear. Gifted by supergoop

I did not know this was going to have actual shimmer in it. the application is super easy and it’s nice for setting your makeup or a touch up of sunscreen throughout the day but it’s just too shimmery for my liking. If you’re fine with the shimmer you’d definitely love this product!

I love the idea and creativity behind this concept. I personally use this powder to set my makeup and it does a pretty good job at it. One thing I am skeptical about is the spf part. I don’t know how well it protects the skin so I do use sunscreen over moisturizer just to be safe. The product is great tho!

The matte idea is great but when rubbing this into my skin, it would ball up and almost peel off of my skin. Works better on a hand than on a face. Maybe it’s because of peach fuzz but I just wasn’t a fan :/
This is my favorite sunscreen ever. The unseen is a close 2nd.

Loving this 100% Mineral Powder SPF 35. This is my first time trying a product like this, I’ve only used cream sunscreens before. This is nice because it doesn’t give that greasy look most sunscreens give and it feels so nice on the face. Gifted by supergoop!

I have the SPF 30 with Marigold Extract version. I like it because the spray works well. The product itself is nice ’cause it dries down quickly and doesn’t budge. I use it for when I want something waterproof when being outside during hot sunny days. It does have a white cast, but I like it since I use it for when I want the reassurance that it’s on my skin. It’s protected me at the beach, at a music festival, or all day at an amusement park. I can’t wait to try the SPF 50 with Green Tea version because I like the idea of higher SPF.

I purchased the Supergoop Matte sunscreen for my upcoming cruise to Mexico. I will say I’m very impressed by the matte finish. It doesn’t have a prominent white cast by itself, and it looks great underneath foundation too.
Love this sunscreen, the texture is great! I have combo skin and this left my face a little shiny but I didn’t mind it!

I was on a search for a new mineral sunscreen for my sensitive skin that is matte, has no white cast, doesn’t pill, non sticky & non greasy. I tried a lot of different brands, affordable & pricey from Cerave to Biossance, the past few months & have finally found The One! Downside, it’s pricey! :( but other than that this sunscreen is everything that I’ve been looking for! Truly matte, non greasy, non sticky, no white cast & glides on so smooth & silky. This will be my holy grail sunscreen unless I find something better....

This is a go-to sunscreen of mine! When I have makeup on, it makes it so seamless to reapply my sunscreen with this product and it fits in my bag to take with me throughout my day. I enjoy the product being lightweight and the overall concept of it!

As a longtime glowscreen wearer I was excited to try this product. Love it but I definitely won’t be wearing it every day. The sparkles in the powder are so fun and add a nice glow to your face, but not practical for everyday use for me (I’ll have to look into their non glow powders). However I do love it not only makes your face matte but adds a touch of shimmer and spf! The packaging is a tad tricky to figure out though, I’m still learning how to best get product down to the brush without wasting powder and for that I have to take away a star.

I tried this and it is straight up GLITTER! I swatched it on my hand and noticed it had a ton of glitter and started to swirl it all over my face and It looks like a whole glitter bomb exploded on my face, it’s glowy in the right places but it’s big glitter particles all over my face. Not a fan. I liked the packaging but not the product inside

Gives great coverage and not oily at all.  I don’t wear a ton of makeup but this sunscreen does a good job being a light layer of “lazy girl foundation.” I’m light/olive skinned so it works for me but I don’t see this working for every skin tone. It blends well but because this is a mineral sunscreen it needs to be rubbed in more than the Supergoop Unseen Sunscreen. I love that one too but Unseen Sunscreen is more like a clear silky makeup primer.

Wow! What a stunning product. By far the most beautiful finish from SPF product. Love the finish it gives my makeup, super easy use and best part reapplying isn’t a problem anymore while at work or running errands. Love how easy it becomes with this powder spf. It takes the worry away and stress off that I didn’t reapply my spf today, because it could ruin my makeup. Totally recommend to all!
I’ve never used a sunscreen that is this drying on the skin than this product.  It does matte the skin which is what attracted me to this product but I will not finish it.  It’s going in the bin!

I was very excited when I saw that they reformulated this product to be oil free and have a more neutral undertone because the oiliness and warm tone were my only complaints. Unfortunately, now the issue with this product is the pilling. Even if you wait 15 mins after applying your moisturizer (which nobody has time for), and you swipe it on gently rather than in a quick circular motion, this product still pills as you’re applying it. It’s a shame because the subtle color helps a lot to even out my skin tone, especially my dark circles, but the pilling is super annoying. I thought maybe the unseen sunscreen would be better so I tried that next, but it pills even worse!!!

Was SO EXCITED to see them come out with this product because I LOVE the original setting powder. I’m a mineral sunscreen user so unfortunately I’m not able to use the regular glow screen, even though I’ve admired it from afar for so long. So when I saw this product launch, I knew I had to get my hands on it. So happy they stuck with mineral for the powder version. It mattifies my skin if I was oily which I love for an on-the-go reapplication. At first I was nervous it was going to act like a powder highlight all over my face, but that’s not the case at all! It helps soak up oil but leaves a healthy glow on your skin from the glowy powder. It has kind of a golden peach town but it’s sheer enough to where it doesn’t provide coverage. I feel like it still helps you stay natural and matte like the original powder, but this one just adds that extra pop of ✨glow✨. Gifted by Supergoop!
Too oily, gooey, slippery, not great. Does not have a scent to it which was great, but I didn’t like how it left my skin feeling too oily, wipes off on your clothing too fast.

Love this  (Glow)setting 100% Mineral Powder SPF 35! It was gifted by Supergoop! I love the shimmery finish this SPF mineral powder leaves. Love that this can be used on the face and body . I highly recommend getting this glow setting SPF 35 mineral powder!
Love mineral sunscreen! This one is hydrating without feeling greasy. Any white cast dissipates quickly!

This is the perfect product for someone who has a hard time remembering to apply sunscreen. This makes it super easy to set your makeup and leave a stunning shimmering glow on the skin. It’s all really easy to re-apply as needed.

At first I was nervous to try these products after reading reviews but I really like them all! I can not speak for people that have naturally oily skin but the glow screen does not make me look oily. I really like all these sun screens:)

This stuff is so cool! The packaging is cool and it definitely Is a great idea and it definitely is good at sun protecting while adding a nice glow! I love the super goop brand! So cool and will repurchase!

Gifted by Supergoop. This is a loose powder that can be worn by itself or over makeup. Pros: The packaging is super cute and convenient and easy to use. It is broad spectrum SPF35 which is awesome.It also matches my skin tone - medium - which I appreciate.Experience: The first time I tried it, I had no makeup on and was a bit surprised at how glittery and shimmery it was. Then I tried it on makeup and applied to specific areas only and felt that worked better. The shimmer is way too much for me for daily use without makeup but I could definitely see myself  using it as body shimmer or highlights after makeup.

The powder form is easy to apply however sometimes it is difficult to get the product out. You have to read the instructions very clearly. I love the matte effect it provides to my skin. I received this product complimentary from Supergoop.
I love how glowy this makes my skin feel and look! The only reason I gave it 4 stars is because I feel like there isn’t that much product inside.

Such a beautiful powder & love that it has SPF protection! The powder is so fine and very soft on the skin! Gives a beautiful glow ! The packaging is great for travel also! perfect amount of bronze glow without being yellow--not streaky if you follow the directions on the bottle--nobody could tell I had sunless tanner.

Worth the hype.   I’m pale with sensitive skin and rosacea.  I like my skin much better with a light tan.  This works exactly as it’s supposed to.  A light tan with no streaks.  A small odor but not unpleasant or heavy as with body tanners.  Well worth the purchase price for me.  I was a little leery about the reviews of breakouts, but have had no issues at all.

This stuff is amazing. I absolutely cannot live without it! There is a trick to it though. You must work it in just like you would any self tanner. It sprays evenly and I use gloves to work it into my skin. You can’t spray and go. It’s light easy to work with if you’re an experienced self tanner. If you’re not experienced watch some you tube. It dries quickly and doesn’t transfer to clothes or sheets!! I love it!!

I used to use St Tropez mousse until my skin became extremely sensitive to Literally everything I put on. This does not cause any irritation whatsoever. I am very fair skinned and have to make sure I don’t leave it on too long or it begins to looks a little orange. Grateful to have found this product!

I was gifted this product from Tan-Luxe in exchange for an honest review. I have been using the Super Glow for over a week now and absolutely love it! I noticed a radiant, natural tan after just a couple of days. I have naturally pale skin, and this serum is perfect because it provides a gradual tan. No streaking at all! Because it’s so gradual, the tan shows up even and natural. Not only that, it also hydrates skin and boosts collagen. Love multi-purpose products like this! Definitely recommend!

Good but not great. It’s easy to apply. I have dry skin and it usually applies smoothly and easily in hot or cold weather. Cons is that it’s a bit too orange. Also it easily stains the brows. I have darker brows so it doesn’t stain the hair but the skin around the brows looks patchy orange. Lasts about 3 days before I reapply but if you reapply too often it starts to look patchy.

wow! I bought this on a whim! I am tired of being sticky  from all my other tanning foams, so I thought a water might be quicker drying...it is! I applied to my legs after a shower, dried by the time I went to bed, woke up with a beautiful even tan. I am impressed with the color after just one application, I didn’t expect much but this really surprised me. curious to see how it fades ans how long it lasts.
Smells so nice and so soft but super streaky Will be taking it back

This product has become a go-to for me. I’ve tried sooo many self-tanners and I love this stuff because it goes on clear and unlike most tanners, you don’t have to shower it off once it develops. I have pretty fair skin naturally but I like my tan to be dark, and this water in medium/dark gives me that!! The color is suburb, dark but not orange and very natural-looking. Put this on with a tanning mitt before bed and you will wake up looking like a bronzed goddess! One thing I will say is make sure you moisturize your ankles, knees, and elbows before putting this on or else it will develop darker in those areas.

The only thing I don’t like about this tanner is the roller ball applicator. I tried removing it and just pouring it into my hands but it wouldn’t budge. I have really bony shins and the roller ball doesn’t feel great or roll very well on bony parts of the body. I learned to concentrate on my thighs and back of my calves and blend around to the shins. The first few times I used this, it didn’t seem like a lot of the product was coming out...it may take an application or two to get used to the roller ball application. My first time, unbeknownst to me, enough of the tanner came out to drip down my ankle to the side of my foot...it left a huge dark drip mark. Now that I’m more used to the roller ball I can apply it pretty well. It smells great - it reminds me of Lancome Aroma Tonic body oil, which has been discontinued for years. I also haven’t noticed it having a funky smell as it starts to develop. The oil is also moisturizing, although beware it takes a bit to dry. The light/medium gave me a pretty deep, nice color and it seems to last longer than other products and also fade in a less mangy way. Overall I really like it except for the roller ball. Oh and maybe the price!
Saw these bronzing drops on TikTok and had to get them! I add these drops to my moisturizer every morning and it gives my skin the best glow.

Sadly, I’m really not impressed from a tanning/color perspective. I’ve been using this product twice a day every day since I received it which has been over week at this point and I’ve seen little to no color building on my quite fair skin. When I apply the serum, I let it sit for about 30 minutes before putting my other skincare on top. Still no color. This is a super pricey product for what it is. I’m giving it 2 stars for the hyaluronic portion and the fact it doesn’t smell chemically. Other than that, I would not buy this again. Super unfortunate waste of money.

You know that old saying, “you get what you pay for“, well, that couldn’t more true when deciding whether this product is worth the cost. Yes, it truly is.At 56, I’ve tanned my entire life, but in my 40’s I realized laying out in the sun or using tanning beds was no longer the best thing to do for my skin. I’ve used every single self tanner in every different formula available, from high end brands, mail order brands and drug store brands. Some were okay, some were really bad. But, then I tried wonder oil.Wonder oil is just that, a wonder oil. Application couldn’t be easier, just roll it on and rub it in just as you would your lotion. Because it’s an oil, it’s easy to tell where you have applied it and as one would guess, it’s very moisturizing. The color is beautiful and natural. I have olive skin to begin with and tanning brings that out deeper and darker, wonder oil gives me the same color I would get had I laid out or used the tanning bed, deep and natural looking.One of my biggest issues with self tanners, and that which will make or break a product for me, is how it wears and fades. We all know that splotchy look some self tanners give as they fade, not this one. Wonder oil fades evenly with no splotches whatsoever which makes it easy to bold upon the initial base.I apply wonder oil twice weekly to maintain my tan all summer long, this product builds upon itself beautifully without any streaking. The key to a good self tan with this, & any self tan, is the foundation you use. For your initial use, make sure your skin is exfoliated well, shave the day before, & wait at least 1/2 hour after a shower before applying. Because it’s an oil, it does take longer to dry down. I put on a light robe & continue with makeup & hair before dressing. In between applications, make sure you’re moisturizing your skin daily and you won’t have to exfoliate after that, just continue applying wonder twice weekly all summer long for a beautiful, natural looking tan.

I was really excited about this, I’ve used a lot of different self tanners and I always prefer ‘water’ over foam. When I initially used it I would’ve given it 5 stars, it’s not sticky on the skin and absorbs pretty quickly, works well with a mitt, good coverage. Waited 8-9 hours for development....... not much happened. I ordered the medium/dark but you would’ve thought I ordered the extra light/light. It gathered on the wrists and in the armpits, unfortunately those are the only places you can really even tell I used a tanner. I will probably use it again to see if I can achieve a darker tan, but this just wasn’t worth it to me.

This product is absolutely fantastic. Very strong so I suggest applying as directed to ensure even & natural looking results. I added one drop to my AM moisturizer and noticed a difference right away.. I suggest applying one drop to face and one drop to neck once per day consistently for the best results.
I’m not sure if I received a bad bottle, but the say it is odorless and mine smells like sour milk or something
It didn’t work for me at all. I was super excited to use this but I’m pretty disappointed.

This gives a nice glow, and blends out well. Felt hydrating.  The only thing I didn’t like was the size of the bottle. Too expensive for such little product.  Probably won’t order again because of this. Drunk Elephant bBurti bronzer was way more concentrated and a much better value.

I’ve been dying to try a self tanner without the guide color, after dealing with staining on my clothes, sheets, etc. The Sephora sales associate recommended this one, and I’m obsessed! It doesn’t have that weird self-tanner smell – I can even apply it in the morning and wear it all day without noticing a smell or having any color transfer to my clothes. I do like to use a mitt to blend in some spots, but I have also just misted it and had good results. It goes on evenly and not patchy at all. The color is beautiful and so natural. Love this product!
Great product. I mix it with my everyday moisture. Be sure to wash your hands and cover your neck, ears, and chest lightly, or you will have two-toned skin color

I been using this serum for about a week and legit have used zero makeup! Given the humidity in the summer, I love rocking a natural glowy look and and this serum delivers just that! I’ve never used a product that provides this tan solution well hydrating your skin.
Wasn’t sure about this at first The scent is quite strong but dissipates quickly The results are worth it My skin is soft firm & smooth with a light even color A few drops is plenty

I love love love that this is a tanning mousse without color guard! I loved the clear st tropez one but they discontinued it for some reason. This one is even better because it does not have a strong perfume scent. It does not dry out your skin AND it has actual good skincare in it! the color if wonderful as well! just take your time rubbing it in and making sure you are applying it evenly.  It is so clean and keeps me from making a mess all over and the color it produces is so nice after one application when I usually need 2 or 3 coats.  The price is just over the top tho!

I really love this because the color just looks like I spent a day in the sun. It’s a really natural color and not a dark fake tan like most other self tanners I’ve tried. The hydration is also a huge added bonus!
Didn’t do much. Exchanged them for the paradise tanning drops
This is the first self tanner that I really like. It is so easy to use, and it smells good!

I like that this self tan doesn’t smell as strong compared to others on the market. Truly amazing product! Simply apply it (definitely recommend using it with a mit so it is perfectly even!) and in 4-6 hours you will see very natural results.

Love this stuff. Would re-buy, but you have to rub in with a mitt very well and bottle doesn’t last very long, but is a nice golden tan
seulement une ou deux gouttes et c’est parfait! j’adore ce produit

Was doing my usual stroll through Sephora while trying on all of their testers when I ran into this product. Side note: if you ONLY saw my hands, you’d think I was a beautiful tanned Brazilian goddess, and not a pasty pale Irish lass with strange radioactive glow hands. Therefore, would recommend.

Best self tanner. Comes with a mit. No tanner smell, it smells like something light, but doesn’t linger. The mouse spreads beautifully. Yes it’s clear so you are missing the guide color, but it does leave a slight sheen where you’ve applied so you could use that as your guide. Skin actually feels nice and hydrated after use.  Does not transfer on to white sheets. Actually tans an even tan with no streaks. I am light with olive undertones and got medium/dark. This gave me just enough to be slightly tanned, but no orange.
I have used this product a handful of times and every morning after I apply it my skin feels extremely soft. It doesn’t over color, look orange, or stain my pillows, and I personally love the smell.

I love the regular Tan-Luxe tanner drops so I was super excited to try these since they do not have to be mixed with lotion.  Sadly, these do not work for me at all.  I used lots of drops, several days in a row and they did not give me any color whatsoever.  I will be exchanging for the original drops that work well for me.  Gave it two stars because it did not break me out and perhaps it would work for someone that is very fair but did not work at all for my light-medium skin tone.

I’ve had so many problems with self tanners in the past and Tan Luxe has restored ALL of my hope. I love this serum! Soaks in and dries quicker than water and layers seamlessly with all other skincare or makeup. Gives a gradual glow that can be built upon. I’ll usually use it for 2 days/nights straight then take a little break. Love love love.

I was also able to put this on my face and it made my skin look nice.Really, the only con is the color. And it wears VERY patchy, despite my obsessive exfoliating and moisturizing. For the price, I expected better. I will use this bottle, because I appreciate how gentle it is, but will not repurchase.

I have used a few self tanners over the years and this one is by far the best.  It went on so nice and my color developed very quickly.  No orange color.  And none of that terrible smell!  This is now my go to and I can’t imagine not using it!

I’m shocked that there are any reviews about seeing color. I saw absolutely no change in color in my face and I was even applying twice a day. There are other far more effective brands for face color. However, I did like the texture and the absence of gross faux tan smell.

Can’t get enough of this sleep oil! I love how you only need just a little bit for soft, nourishing skin while you sleep and awaken to a nice tint of color. But honestly I’m putting it on my face to go to sleep, and I’m someone who suffers from Chronic Migraines.. you can get over a faint scent for a few moments before you fall asleep, it’s no where near as bad as people are saying. Highly recommend
I love this self tanner! It creates a nice, even, natural looking tan. Better than others I’ve used because it is easy to apply and doesn’t have a scent.

I wanted a spray tan I could use on days I don’t want to use the Isle of Paradise drops that i add to my self tanner and while waiting for other Isle of Paradise self tanning products to arrive. I didn’t use a Mitt either and it was even but that might be because I have a subtle fake tan already but it’s AMAZING! Very impressed! A+ from the self tanning guru, high end product junkie

Let me just say I have been a die hard Clairins fan for years, until now. I have super sensitive, acne prone skin and this doesn’t make me breakout and doesn’t leave me sticky or oily. If you’ve ever been to a spray tan before, this is basically the clear solution they spray on you. Smells mildly like a mystic tan. There’s no getting around it, anything that tans you smells a bit unless it’s heavily perfumed. It’s a light super non offensive smell though. No creamy sticky lotion, no bronzer that dyes your clothes, just clear liquid and it dries fairly quick. I find lotions can smudge especially when you sleep and can make your tan uneven. Happy I went with the darker colour despite my light-medium skin tone. The colour is perfect. Expensive but amazing!!

Yes, like the headline says... this product gives a perfect olive tan that fades naturally with no streaking or blotchiness. And it did not transfer onto my clothes or sheets one bit. I’m new to self-tanning products, tan-luxe water being one of my first. With that said it’s super easy to use and apply, even though it’s clear. Just spray and spread section by section with a tan mitt. Also easy to layer and reapply the next day to achieve a deeper color. I naturally have medium olive toned skin, and this gave my skin an even and healthy golden olive glow tan. So beautiful! Very happy I gave this product a shot, even though it’s on the pricey side, it is a high quality product and definitely worth it. I’ve used a few times now and the bottle is almost full like brand new. I will get plenty of applications out of, which makes the $ per tan cost very inexpensive. Smells like raspberries initially, sweet but subtle. Once dry the typical self tanner smell faintly appeared, almost undetectable though. Overall a great purchase, 5 Stars!Application Tip:  the over spray tends to fall on and around the feet which can lead to over application on the feet. After application is finished, take a makeup wipe and gently wipe the top, sides, and bottom of your feet to avoid product build up and overly tan feet and feet wrinkles lol. Also stand on and over a large bath towel when applying.

Amazing! I bought this on the Sephora app. I was going to return it and actually printed off the shipping return label. But I am glad I didn’t. This is the best sunless tanner I have ever used! It looks so natural. It dried in less than 2 minutes and I applied with my hands. I highly recommend this product. Well worth every penny.

I had a sample of this and it dried my skin out pretty badly and broke me out a little bit. I’d give it 2.5 stars because it gave a nice, natural color though. I have dry skin anyways, so it may work out for someone with normal or oily skin. I will say that you don’t need much to cover your face, neck, and chest, especially if you use a face mist right before because it helps it spread more easily. I’m really sad it didn’t work for my skin because it has some great ingredients.

This is by far better than other tanning creams on the market - the oil is much easier to use I find. I bought the Light/Medium and feel like it’s dark enough - I have lighter skin but tan easily. Would recommend exfoliating right before application - I didn’t do this the second time and ended up a bit streaky. I’ve also noticed this come off on my white bed sheets a few hours after application - just a head’s up. Otherwise, will continue to use for a bit of a glow during the winter!
No words to describe how happy I am with this product. It blows everything else away

I really like this product - I’ve had no issues with uneven color application on my face (which I had when I used Tan Luxe’s “The Face”). The only reason I took one star off is because it doesn’t have a huge color payoff; it takes 3-4 days of intense applications to get even close to what I used to get from my previous facial self-tanner wipes by a different brand. At this price point, I need the product to be absolutely perfect in order to give it five stars. As long as you are okay with truly gradual color, you will love this product! It will be perfect during winter when I’m not looking for a super bronzed look.

I have EXTREMELY sensitive skin; am prone to breakouts at age 49 and am allergic to both chemicals and natural oils & essences. My skin did not have an issue with this product at all. After cleansing, I applied my serums and water-based moisturizer and then these drops. Duration: 2 weeks. I did not notice a supreme color difference--very subtle each day, as it seem to wash off each night--although there was some change but it gave my skin a nice luminosity. I’m unsure if I’ll continue with this product, but, as I said, it did no harm at all to my face.
Amazing! I’m very pale and this gives me a nice glow, not orange. Only complaint is it can take some time to absorb.

Straight to the point self tanner. I have eczema and this didn’t irritate my skin. I highly suggest using this with a glove to get the best results. I put some on my face time to time. Natural looking and doesn’t give off an orange hue.

I have very fair skin, use sunscreen daily. For my face I use a tinted moisturizer with an SPF above 40.  However I would stil need a bronzer and a blush until I came across Super Gloss Face. I apply this lighly over my moisturizer to give me more of a tanned look.  You can apply more or less depending on the depth of color you desire.  It is not shiney or orange and looks very natural plus it has an SPF as well. I do use a cream blush as well, some eyebrows, lipstick and I’m out the door.  I have used it on my arms to give them a little more color.  Tanning Butter is wonderful too!

At first I thought I loved it, but then I decided it’s a waste of money.Pros: •The smell is actually pretty tolerable. as someone who is very sensitive to self tanner smells, I actually think this is the most discrete smell I’ve ever tried. (and I’ve tried them all) • the color lasts longer than most. (the 2 reasons above are why I thought I loved it at first)Cons: •It DRIES my skin SOOO bad. I already have pretty dry skin but if I don’t lotion everyday or sometimes multiple times a day while using this, it will make my skin look like leather! I don’t know how this is hydrating, perhaps when you initially put it on but what about every other day for the next 2 weeks? that brings me to my next point-->• it is SOOO patchy when it wears off. I’ve been a frequent St. Tropez user for years, while ST wears kinda fast, it doesn’t wear off bad. BUT THIS, is embarrassing. and the bad part is. It’s so hard to try to get off. • It’s doesn’t last long! I’ve only used it 3 times and half of the bottle is gone. I DON’T EVEN TAN MY WHOLE BODY! I feel like there are better self tanners for a fraction of the cost  (i.e. Sephora spray self tanner is amazing)

This is so easy to use, and I’m a gal that can not be bothered with rubbing in tanning lotions. It’s light and hydrating and smells amazing, like their Face drops. Also like the Face drops, the Water gives a REALLY nice natural glow to the skin. Even if you apply it over makeup, like a setting spray. That blows my mind! I love how innovative and effective Tan-Luxe products are.

This mousse leaves a nice, even color on your skin. The only reason I️ knocked off a star is because 1) you need to be experienced to not miss a spot with the clear application and 2) it does leave skin with an oily feeling. It’s definitely hydrating, but I️ prefer tanners like Vita Liberata that dry instantly. If you like oil, and hydrated skin - this product shouldn’t bother you. I️ like how the tan does last 3-4 days without fading. But be warned - as someone very fair, I️ did order the medium/dark to get a truly tanned look. I have experimented with self tanners for the last 20 years of my life, and this is my holy grail. I use the Light/Medium on my face and the Medium/Dark on my body, and it comes out amazing every time!

So… I’ve tried A LOT of different self tanners. High end, drug store, in between. You name it I’ve tried it. This is by far my absolute favorite. My reasons are quite simple. I have WHITE sheets, I applied this on after my shower, let myself dry up for about an hour and then went straight into bed. I woke up the next morning and not ONE little bit of transfer anywhere which was very impressive. I also hate self tanning smells and although this does have a slight smell to it, it’s not as strong and gross as all other products I’ve used. I deff recommend using a kabuki brush when applying this to your hands, feet/ankles, and face because it is clear so you don’t really know just how “even” it’s spreading. However, what I like to do is if I use 2 pumps on my entire lower leg, I will use the exact amount on the other so it distributes evenly. It gave me a really nice tan, wasn’t orange at all and it didn’t leave me streaky whatsoever. I do also recommend applying with either a mit, or powder-free latex gloves (blues ones from CVS work great) just make sure to exfoliate and shave prior to application for best results!! Best of luck :)

The best tanner I tried. It’s really easy to apply, I use my hands. It dries immediately. Has a tiny bit of a self tanner smell to it after it dries, hardly noticeable. Does wear off after a few days. I reapply every two days and have been using all summer long. So natural!
Hydrates skin very well and tan looks great! Also, smells so good!

I initially was going to purchase the tan-luxe oils, but the Sephora representative recommended this as you can use it for both body and face. Girrrrrl talk about dark!!! Love it! Doesn’t have an over powering scent still has a slight fake tan smell but nothing like others. Color is awesome. Dries quickly. Only down is it dries quickly. If you are looking to be tan without going into the tanning bed or laying out in the sun, get this and the butter and you’ll be good to go for the summertime. Highly recommend.
So great , leave the skin with a beautiful glow and dont smell bad
Sadly does nothing at all but a nice hyaluronic acid
The serum was super lightweight and worked great with my sensitive skin. My tan the perfect color and allowed me to have a good glow!

yikes orange color & streaks. I tried this hoping for a new amazing product and it looked so orange on me. I’ve never had a product that looks orange on me. also it left streaks and didn’t see a recommended applicator for it. although color is pretty quick, sorry but I would not recommend.

The only reason I give this one star is because it technically changed the shade of my skin. However, the cost was irritated and incredibly DRY skin. I had to wear several overnight hydrating masks to get my skin back to normal. It was SO blotchy and flaky. NOT WORTH IT.
Color doesn’t look natural.  Has an orangish color to it.  I will probably return this product.
I am so happy with this product! This is not your average self tanner! It looks natural. It also smells Amazing! The application process is easy and doesn’t leave a mess! I highly recommend!!

I’ve only used this twice so far and am loving it! The colour takes a bit longer to develop than the Isle of Paradise drops, but it looks a lot more natural in my opinion. Love it, I have very sensitive skin and I love how this product make my skin feel, super glowy and healthy

This product is awesome. Be sure to evenly mix into hairline, otherwise you may end up like me with a confusing tan line in the shape of a white rainbow across the forehead.
I wish this wasn’t quite as expensive but it is really the best self tanner I have ever used!!

I have used a lot of self tanners and this one is great to use a couple of times a week to build a nice tan. I love how you can use it alone or top it off with a moisturizer. Like all self tanners there’s a slight learning curve but after my first application I got the hang of it. Use your hands but make sure to wash them afterwards! Good for anyone who doesn’t like messy tanning.
Really love this product. Hydrate and make my skin little tan and glow. Not to much and perfect color. Now I didn’t use the skin tone, because my own skin looks amazing! Totally recommend

LOVE! This checks every single box I want in a tanning product and it has taken me forever to find it. It dries fast and I don’t feel slimy or greasy throughout the day, and I don’t have time to lay around waiting for it to dry. AND, this was my biggest struggle, it does NOT give me body breakouts. Everything would clog my pores and cause breakouts on my neck, chest and upper stomach, this hasn’t caused any break outs on my body. I will say this absorbs SUPER fast so you have to be quick to rub it in or it can streak a little.
Love this serum! I love the fact that it’s hydrating with Hyaluronic but still a facial tan. It gives your skin a nice glow after one use.
Made me glowy like any hylauronic acid does but didn’t really tan! My tan comes out better when I use a hylauronic acid and the original! :)

For anyone fair skinned…BUY THIS! After one use, this product makes a noticeable difference in my skin color. It’s also the first self-tanning product that hasn’t made my skin break out. This stuff is amazing! If you are like me and have dry skin this will make sure skin look like butter! Also does not leave any streaks.. I just put it on once and my tan looks amazing.. one con does take a long time to dry down but I think it’s worth it not to look dry, streaky and orange

I just used this for the very first time. This is the BEST self tanning product in the market. Absolutely IN LOVE! I am a huge proponent of using a hyaluronic serum to hydrate and soothe my acne prone so this is a miracle in a jar! Very pricey but I love this stuff. it stays on after multiple washes and looks very natural. the scent is good, but you can notice the dreaded self-tanner smell linger after some hours.
Just ok. I felt it made me more orange than other self tanners and it doesn’t wear very nicely. The only thing I liked was there was a minimal fake tan “stink” when having it on.

I wanted to love this and was so excited to try but it doesn’t work. I wanted to use it on my face only since I don’t tan my face but this pilled off after a day. I kept trying it but after one day I would have to exfoliate to get it off.
this is the most amazing product.  looks natural and I had several compliments on my tan.

So I went on vacation and I already was tannish but it was starting to fade to my already pale skin tone so I used this product. Life saverrrr I get tan in the summer from the sun but I’m so pale in winter which I hate so this is such a great product for me I’m obsessed it looks so natural but still gives me that tan glow

Unfortunately contains ingredients that will clog your pores.  Made me break out with deep cyst pimples.  However, the cream does work.  I just enjoy the drops a lot more.

I’ve always loved Tula products. Using these products my face plumped up hiding the creases that come with age. I received this product complimentary from Influenster. Another fact is I love that Tula is a woman owned business.

This moisturizer is absolutely incredible. It smells great too. It feels really lightweight and doesn’t have a greasy feel to it. It lasts all day and I love the pump to dispense the product! I highly recommend.

When I first started using this product I didn’t like the texture too much as it was a bit thick for me. I can’t say for sure that this caused irritation or breakouts, but I would assume these fine bits could be pore clogging. The formulation itself is plenty glowy and rich, there is no need to include shimmer in a night cream. It is moisturizing, but I am not comfortable using for my breakout-prone skin.

I got this product for to test out from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. This product is nice but I was shocked to find out it’s worth nearly 100$. I I tried the product from Tula for the first time and I really liked it ..  I like the consistency and smell.. I recommend to try

Got this from Influenster to test out, first impressions, its definitely great for a dewy healthy glow! Unfortunately for oily skin it makes your skin look a bit more oily than usual. But I’m sure it’ll be a great product for those with dry skin!
Meh doesn’t really exfoliate, found no difference in blackheads

I have been having a hard time with acne, and Tulsa’s products have been helping me a ton over the past few months clearing my skin. I was extremely excited to use the Tula sunscreen for my face in hopes that it also wouldn’t cause any breakouts. So far I like using it and it goes on smoothly

I have pretty tough combo skin, so the scents of these products didn’t negatively affect me, but I can’t imagine they wouldn’t for some people with sensitive, acne prone skin.The sugar scrub definitely needs to be shaken and squeezed with the cap on before use or else a nice pile of oil will be the first thing to hit those hands of yours. I can also see the oil in this product being an issue for some sensitive skinned people. One thing is for sure, it smells good.I used the vitamin c serum on targeted dark spots since the package is so small. I didn’t notice any improvement, which was a bummer.The moisturizer at first has a plain ole cream scent, but then it hits you with “bar of soap” smell. Irish spring type, maybe - not sure. This left a nice glow on me and left my skin feeling very soft. If I accidentally overdid it, it took so long to fully absorb and I’m not down for that, but that’s also my doing for using too much.The face wash has the same scent as the moisturizer, in my opinion, just stronger. My felt didn’t feel stripped after use and it did feel clean.The sizes of these products are great for the on the go. You may only get a few uses out of some, but still decent. Overall, the products are pretty average and, again, not really for many people with sensitive or acne prone skin, in my opinion.
