I have been using facial razors for a while now, and these must be the worst I have used. I usually buy the Sephora ones, but they are sold out. These are cheap, not sharp, very short handle. I was unable to do a proper job of removal of fuzz. Dissapointed.
A bit big but works well on your face and is easier to use since it’s big enough
Too short and too thick. I bought something similar at the dollar store and they work better. Waste of money since you can find better option for cheaper.
These do the trick and I have a decent amount of peach fuzz! Definitely buying again

I honestly don’t understand the poor reviews. If you prep your face properly for slippage (I use hemp oil) and use short strokes, holding the blade at a close angle (like how the blades on a leg razor are angled to your skin) it works great. I had no issues with it. And I appreciate the short fat handle and casing around the blade because I like to hold it really close to the blade and you can’t do that on most razors without compromising the angle. Took off peach fuzz and a lot of dry skin. Worked great for me. I love that you can remove the blade to clean it thoroughly, plus that’s better for recycling.
Overall, this product is okay, but I would not purchase it again. It does the job, but I can find better and cheaper options from other trustworthy brands.
Do yourself a favor and don’t buy these, amazon has better ones. These did absolutely nothing, waste of $$$$.
Works amazing - very easy to use and great results - the employees had no idea there’s were even in the store and told me they didn’t have any.

This made my vellus hair fall out in clumps! It scared me at first because it doesn’t feel nice, but it works like a charm! I circled all my lil hairs in the photo for proof lol these lil razors rock!
Head of blade is too small for my face. Very hard to get around the nose and moustache area due to the pink plastic bookends that encase the dull razor.
These are the first facial razors I’ve found that actually work. I love them and will definitely continue buying!!
Very dull blades and barely remove any peach fuzz.

These were meh. They didn’t remove all the peachfuzz the first time so i had to pass over the same area more than once, by then my face was irritated. This has never happened with other derma-planing razors.

I’ve been curious about dermaplanning for about a year and decided before buying an electric device or spending a fortune on a medical esthetician, I’d try a manual blade. I read reviews here carefully and have always found Tweezerman products excellent quality. I followed suggestions from the people who gave this five stars and tried it on clean skin with some facial oil. The blade seemed to work fine and did exactly what it was supposed to do. Since I haven’t seen next morning results yet and don’t know how this compares to others I gave it four stars.
These razors were not good at all. The blade was very dull.

Honestly not sure why there are so many bad reviews on this product. I found that it worked fine as long as I watched the angle I was going at it. You cant hold it straight out you have to tilt it the way it would be angled if you were using a razor to shave your legs. Use an oil as well. Great buy!
I would give Zero stars if it were an option. These do not work at all. Do not buy.
The blade is too short, the handle is too short and it’s just very awkward to use. Plus it doesn’t do a good job. Definitely don’t recommend. I’m sticking to the Sephora collection ones

I tried these instead of the sephora collection I normally get and I was very disappointed.  It was dull and tiny it did the bare minimum and it wasn’t very good. Im sticking to what I know works well, Sephora collection!

These things are garbage. The blade is not sharp at all and even after pulling skin taught and going over the same spot several times, does not do the job. Add to it that the “blade” is too short and the handle is too so it’s awkward to use. If the razor actually did it’s job it would be less of an issue. All in all a waste of $10. Not sure how they could’ve got it this wrong.
Extremely difficult to use. It pulls rather than shave.

Personally didn’t like these one bit. They were extremely difficult to use and didn’t even remove hair. The blade is shorter than the pink edges so you’d have to push down really hard to even get the blade to surface your face. Save your money.
This was terrible,I usually buy mine off amazon but tweezerman has some great quality products, so i was curious to try these. This product is so poorly made, such a disappointment.

I think the negative reviews are potentially because of user error. I would recommend cleaning skin well and put either a facial oil or heavy cream to help it glide and you need to use short strokes. In certain areas I’d recommend pulling (gently) the skin taught. Blades are sharp, work great, easy to use! I didn’t give a 5 star because they aren’t perfect but they aren’t going to sell surgical blades to the public with zero experience or training in microdermabrasion. Absolutely will purchase again!
Works great!! And love the price. My suggestion is to prep your skin with a facial oil to help it glide.

I was a bit hesitant to SHAVE MY FACE... but had heard that removing ’peach fuzz’ helps your makeup to better adhere to your skin and to just have an overall better look.  After taking the plunge, I was actually quite pleased with the results!  These Tweezerman razors are the first I have ever used, so I don’t have anything to compare them to, but I was happy with the ease of using them and the results!  Of course, I was worried about ’cutting’ my skin, but there were no issues like that, at all!  I simply lathered up one of my facial cleaners and applied nice, gentle, downward strokes with the razor, against my face.  I didn’t experience any ’irritation’ or even redness...  I wasn’t even sure if it really ’DID ANYTHING’... however, I could very much tell that it DID, after I put on my foundation!  :)  DEFINITELY HAPPY with the results!  This seems like something that will last for some time, as I am imagining that I will probably have to do this again in about a month, or so.  The one thing that I would very strongly recommend is to wipe the razor down with alcohol, before and after each use.

Used each one one time and became dull and useless, and I don’t have that much hair to remove in the first place. I really don’t recommend these poor quality facial razors. The thing I did like about them is they don’t cut or scratch like other facial razors I have used before. Disappointing product from Tweezerman.

I will start out with “I never write reviews” but, I saw the poor reviews and just had to write one. I found that these were excellent facial razors! They are big so your not in the mirror all day trying to remove facial fuzz. They were very sharp! So them saying they aren’t sharp is shocking to me. I had to go o we everything one time!  The BEST PART IS..... whoever packaged my shipment! Thank you! They must not of realized what they sent me was the packaging for the store to unpack and shelf! Heehee they sent me the manufacturer package which had 3 packs of 3 razors! Thank you!

YEP these suck! The blade is not sharp at all, the shape with the plastic on each side of the blade makes it super hard to reach narrow places and all and all, it’s just doesn’t work well. Half of my peach fuzz is still there even after going back and forth. Not worth the money!! The Sephora collection ones are waaaaay better (and they’re not the best).
blade was NOT sharp enough for me, has to go over my face OVER and OVER again
not sharp at all, took a long time to remove my peach fuzz, would not recommend

Seriously adore this set! Anytime I use it my husband tells me that my skin looks beautiful. It does not make me break out or cause irritation like other skincare does. Glad I tried it! I am going to purchase the large sizes now.

I agree with another commenter--this product is more like a serum than a moisturizer. Since the consistency is so serum-like, I needed almost 3 squirts to cover my whole face/neck. I also still found my face dry (and I don’t naturally have dry skin). Both my boyfriend and I did not like the smell. I would say this is overpriced for my results.

First of all I have to admire absolutely beautiful glass packaging! Formula is for sensitive skin and is very gentle. I love how mild and creamy this cleanser is! My skin feels super soft and comforted.

I really like the way this product feels, removes all makeup and leaves nothing behind. No film. But the pump and the hefty price tag will prevent me from repurchasing. I love it but there are no ingredients to justify the price. It was a one time splurge.

I️ honestly only have a small size of this but I’ve been using it recently so I️ figured I’d leave a review. It feels nice on the skin and is very thin in consistency, and although I️ didn’t have any really bad effects the scent of the moisturizer is extremely overpowering. It’s kind of a floral almost tea scent but it’s so incredibly strong I️ found myself not even wanting to keep trying it out. If you’re into strong smelling skincare maybe you should try it out, but otherwise I️ would skip it. I’m not usually really turned off by events either, so this surprised me.

This is not your every day toner.  This is an essence, so it’s designed to help your products absorb better, and also functions to boost moisture. It mists nicely and use it after I apply moisturizer and in between serum/moisturizer.  Backwards method but it works.  I took one star off because Sephora doesn’t offer the larger size that’s is the better deal (4.1 oz for $89).  The product itself works well!
This set introduces me to the brand Tata Harper well. I loved every product in this set.

I LOVE THIS. This was recommended by someone at the Disney Springs Sephora; I was in a hurry and bought it without reading reviews, which I wouldn’t normally do, but I’m SO glad I did. I would describe my skin as aging, combination, and sometimes dehydrated. I’m not sure I agree with marketing this as a dry skin moisturizer, and I think that’s where a lot of the negative reviews come from. For me it is PERFECT. I don’t ever want to be without it. But if you’re used to a heavier moisturizer for dry skin, that to me would feel very greasy, you’re not going to like this.

I used this recently on my 2 daughters (ages 9 and 12) after dance dress-rehearsals and performances to remove waterproof eye-make up and cheek and lip stains.  They did not complain of stinging in eyes (as with other waterproof make-up removers).  Worked well with a couple of pumps, shower, and use of cotton pads to remove final residue.  My only complaint is that darn pump - it is difficult to use and almost caused me to return the product.  I am not sure if this is a design flaw or if it was just my luck, but the bottle must be placed on a stable surface before I am able to retrieve the oil from the pump!

I first want to start by saying how impressed I am that this product is vegan, gluten-free, cruelty-free and hypoallergenic. This is important to me because I have super sensitive skin and get rashes easily. I also suffer from fragrance allergies. I can’t tolerate too many scent. Thankfully, this awesome product is fragrance-free. Love that it removes all over my makeup and leaves my skin feeling clean, hydrated, soft and not dry. In addition their packaging is recyclable. I’m all about helping our environment.

I always prefer to go the less toxic route for my skincare and was really hoping to love something from this line. There was not one product I was impressed with. I found most of the products kind of harsh. I think these products are geared for younger women.

Very moisturizing! Don’t use this before you apply makeup. My fave was an oil slick and I have dry/normal skin. I use this before bed and wake up with the softest skin ever. Probably wouldn’t buy again but it definitely works.

Miracle oil! I have used this oil on burns and it has healed with no scarring I also used it on a mystery rash that I had for ages around my chin area consisting of little red bumps it has healed it within a week. I saw results within a few days of using it on my face it is worth every penny!

This moisturizer is my holy grail! I mix it with a few drops of Josie Maran argan oil and OMG, the texture, the smell, the results are incredible - I feel like I am at a spa each time I use it! It has transformed my skin and I actually look forward to washing my face so I can use it.
This cleanser is best used on a makeup-free asking or as a second cleanse, as its very luxurious and nourishing that you don’t want to waste it on removing makeup. And it smells amazing.

This doesn’t give my skin enough moisturization on its own-and my skin is combo to oily. I don’t mind the smell-it’s rosy mixed with other essential/herbal oil smells-but my husband hates it. There are several other lux and lower priced moisturizers that do a better job on my face that don’t send my husband running from the bathroom.

I don’t know how so many people love this and am wondering if I’m the issue. This leaves the feeling of a layer of oil left on your skin that can’t be removed. After thoroughly double cleansing and using a cotton pad with my Fresh black tea toner, I notice a huge amount of dirt and makeup come off on the cotton pad. Seriously disappointed with this, especially after an employee pushed this on me and now it’s too late to return.

This is a wonderfully refreshing and hydrating toner. The natural floral scent is like an instant hit of springtime! It lifts my mood and soothes my senses. I have a travel size version that I keep in my purse to spritz throughout the day. Does wonders for my skin and senses.The toner cleans, softens and soothes when used on bare skin before moisturizer. It’s one of the most hydrating toners I’ve ever used. It also sets my makeup when sprayed as a last step. Gives a noticeable, complexion enhancing glow when spritzed as a pick-me-up late in the day and since the scent is so uplifting, it instantly smoothes out signs of stress and fatigue. Worry lines be gone! I would love to have one of these toners in my purse, another in my bathroom cabinet, another in my car, another on my desk… Great product, beautifully packaged. Difficult for me to pick my favorite Tata Harper product but this is a top contender. I have sensitive, combination skin and this has improved the look and feel of my skin, without a doubt. I love that it does wonders with only good-for-you ingredients!

Got this as a sample and definitely buying full size!! This is a little thick but not heavy (if that makes sense!) and layers on beautifully. I have dry patches and so only apply on my cheeks and gave totally noticed a difference. This smells wonderful, slight floral, and that was enough to transport me to a blissful spa (even though I was crammed in my tiny apartment) the results just sealed the deal

Very concentrated! Used less than 1/2 a bottle in a year. I use peels, rentinoids, topicals to avoid clogged pores that lead to breakouts. All moisturizer I’ve tried is overly oily & or gives breakouts until this. Don’t use this expecting it to treat acne but as a moisturizer that can be used to avoid dry peeling skin from treatments. Skin drinks this up working well under SPF & makeup.

Like the others here have posted—unfortunately, I really like it a lot and the price for me was worth it. It is very soothing to my super dry and fussy skin.  The floral scent works for me, but is definitely not for everyone.  It’s a small jar, but a little goes a long wat!

I was looking for a serious eye cream because my skin was so dry and thought this balm would be it, but I find that I need to use another eye cream under it. I warm this balm with my fingers and put on top. It has a sort of gritty texture even after warming it. I shouldn’t have to use a second eye cream and still feel meh about a $200+ eye cream. I have not noticed any difference in the fine lines and wrinkles. Will not repurchase.
Love this cleanser! Something about the texture that is really comforting and luxurious. It’s my new favorite.

I was gifted this product by Tata Harper Skincare in exchange for my honest review. I like that this product goes on easy and smooth. I am not bothered by smells so it is different to have a fragrance free product. I actually still smell a slight scent. It soaks right in to your skin and doesn’t leave a film. So far it seems to make me break out some. I notice it does make my skin look smoother and a slight difference in fine lines. I will have to use it a lot longer to notice anything more then that.

Smells heavenly, making it a pleasure to use every day and night. Removes everything without leaving skin dry or tight. My favorite cleansing oil. Concentrated and does a beautiful job, safe for eyes as well.

This mask detoxify, clears skin. If U want a detoxifying mask and you need a clay mask. This is both in steroids! Sad the price keep increasing but not the ounces. That is quite disappointing! But the mask is a staple!

This moisturizer exceeds my expectations in every way, it is specifically formulated for my sensitive dry skin, it is improving the redness of my cheeks, the texture of my skin and the most important is that it always feels moisturized and hydrated.It has no fragrance, it has a lightweight texture, non greasy, it is absorbed very quickly and it lasts all day.  It also can be used under make up.

I have fairly oily skin in the spring/summer and somewhat dry skin in the winter. This amazing toner deeply hydrates my skin and does not make me look greasy. I love how refreshed and clean my skin feels. I normally use this right after I wash my face and throughout the day. Love this stuff!!!

I received this in a Sephora favorites set so full disclosure I didn’t pay the full price. I’m glad I didn’t though. Im 24, I have normal skin with rare breakouts. It was too oily & stinks. When I first tried this product the smell got to me before anything else. Not sure if it’s the oils or something else with the formula but the smell isn’t pleasant to me at all. It’s very overwhelming and doesn’t fade for a few hours after applying (I mist with a rose facial spray to off set the smell and it helps a bit). The texture is nice though and it absorbs quick into the skin, a pump and a half does my full face and neck to the chest. Overall it’s okay but I don’t think it suits my skin nor my preference. I’ve tried cheaper products that provide the same if not better results. The formula/finish on the skin reminds me of the Clinique dramatically different moisturizing lotion. I only recommend if you’re: rich/like to spend a lot on skincare, have dry skin or are combination and need a thicker winter moisturizer, those who don’t mind overwhelming smells (it might not smell bad to you but it is still strong nonetheless).

Smells of chamomile and other flowers. My skin is noticeably different. No more redness or irritation. I exfoliate less now since my skin feels fresh, smooth, and moisturized because of this product. It goes a long way, one to two little pumps covers the neck and face. I’m hesitant to buy anything else now! I really love this and plan on investing in another bottle. I may try the cleanser, too!

I love this product. Genuinely. The Tata Harper Resurfacing Mask may be my favorite product ever but this one is a close second. The name is apt: it really does seem to replenish the skin, feeding it nutrients topically - and extremely efficiently. I see the difference the next morning, as though the nutrients have penetrated the deepest layer of my skin and infused it with vitality and resilience. Dark shadows are less prominent, blemishes rescind, red marks disappear, dry patches are smoothed over and my color is even and youthful.The Complex is an oil that spreads easily, absorbs quickly and smells heavenly (and is somehow very grounding as well - a deep breath of this scent instantly makes me feel calm, centered and happy). It’s a serum and moisturizer in-one, as far as I’m concerned. I use it at night, on it’s own, after cleansing and toning and the results the following morning are measurable. My skin is plumper, firmer, clearer, more even toned, and just generally looks healthier as though my circulation and oxygen intake improved overnight. I noticed the difference the first time I used it, which was a couple of summers ago. The roller ball on mine didn’t roll so I contacted the company and they kindly sent me a roller ball replacement. The combination of the cool metal roller and the silky oil as it heats up on the skin is amazingly soothing. I found that I liked applying it without the roller though, which I’d started doing while waiting for the replacement part. I’d just snap off the top, pour a (very) little bit into my palm, warm it up and gently massage it into my skin. Saves a bit of time. I wound up giving that bottle to my mother who had a terrible sun burn and it healed her skin miraculously. Not only did her sunburn seem to evaporate in record time but her skin actually looked better after using this for only a few days than before her burn (and lifetime of sun worshipping).I’ve used it summer and winter, on breakouts and dry skin and each time it delivers and rebalances my skin. The more consistently I use it, the better (and less in need of balancing) my skin looks and feels. Even when I don’t have much to complain about, one night with the Replenishing Nutrient Complex on will make me look so much better. As if my skin was missing something and I didn’t even know it. It’s a phenomenal product. Functional and results driven yet a luxurious treat to use.As with the other Tata Harper products, I love that all the ingredients are natural and free of any chemical nasties that cause me to stress over what they may be doing to my body. I also love the reusable, recyclable and sturdy glass packaging. It’s a very thoughtful line with truly beautiful and beautifying products.

I am gutted that this is so expensive, because it absolutely did NOT work for my oily, acne-prone skin. This is the only moistuizer I’ve ever used that makes my skin look wet- as in, so greasy it looks moist. It doesn’t matter what skincare products I use underneath (or even if I skip them entirely and go right from cleansing to this), this moisturizer always makes my skin look like an oil slick, and any makeup I try to put overtop breaks down by midday. I’ve tried about a third of the bottle and won’t continue to use the rest- it is THAT bad. If you have oily skin, skip this product and go for something else.

I have been a tata Harper fan for awhile and I have been using the products for about 3-4 years. I hadn’t ever bought the flora essence until now. I noticed a big difference in my skin texture and appearance after using it a few times a day. Definitely worth the price. I spray it on my face after cleansing and then again over my makeup or tinted moisturizer. I also spray throughout day to freshen my face. I use again at night after cleansing. Love the scent too!
My face needs a lot of moisture but my nose tends to get a buildup of oil as a result.  This mask is my go-to for treating the skin on my nose and keeping the pores tight and small.
Makes my skin glow and smells fantastic!!!

I feel that this moisturizer hydrates my skin and has helped my acne! It is like a treatment and moisturizer in one formula! I have struggled with teen acne for the past 7 years and I finally found a moisturizer that treats, hydrates, and does not irritate my skin. I love the smell of this product and its natural ingredients. My only complaint is the price. Nonetheless, thank you Tata!

This is a wonderful moisturizer but in my opinion, only with the serum.  By itself it doesn’t cover enough or glide well.  The two of them together are wonderful!  The smell is nice and my face feels great!  I will be purchasing both together or not at all.

As with all Tata Harper products, they are lovely, but really don’t justify the cost. I can spend half as much and get the same results elsewhere, so I will. If they would drop their prices by 30% they would def be worth buying. At these prices though, they’re nothing special.

This set is a great way to try out all the Tata Harper products. You can tell her products are very high quality. The only problem is that you’ll want to purchase them all once you run out. There wasn’t one product I didn’t love.

I have had a perpetual dry patch under my nose from allergies to infections. This has completely renewed and repaired that extremely chapped skin! I now use it to cushion and condition skin after my weekly peels and exfoliators. Skin is radiant the next morning. I also use it to heal blemishes, while I still have the dark spot from the blemish the skin did heal faster and flatter. So I have a multivitamin in an oil form for my skin. I also have no problem with the application method. I can easily roll what I need directly onto face, but I do prefer rolling onto finger tips and pressing into skin!!! Love love love. The fragrance does not bother me because I know that it is not artifical. Quality, transparent, effective, organic, and natural worth every penny! Will keep as a year round staple!

I can never say enough amazing this about Tara Harper. From the fresh ingredients to being 100% clean, this is a must have! I use mine almost like a toner, but can be sprayed on at any point of the day.

I cannot be without it! My skin loves this soothing, hydrating repairative moisturizer. My makeup goes on smoothly over this and I no longer have uncomfortably dry skin. I use it day and night. I put it over serum and let it dry while I drink my coffee. than it’s primer and makeup, perfectly silky. No more patches. love it.

Love this product! This was the first face oil I ever used. I have acne prone skin and combination skin as well. This product helps with break outs (it totally drys them out and within like 2 days, they are gone!) My face feels so soft and moisturized without being oily. With all those green ingredients inside this oil, I feel like it really helps to perfect skin. I use it once or twice a week, and a little goes a long way.
This has made my skin look so fresh and smooth! I’ve had loads of compliments recently & I’ve put it down to this face oil. I use it at night and I love it

Amazing face wash. Great for all skin types. Worth the price tag. Feel like I am using a luxury facial produce every time I wash my face. Removes makeup and debris well. Great consistency, and beautiful and quality packaging.
I’m in love with smell and texture. Great makeup remover or as first cleanse. No eye irritation at all. Pump squirts too hard though so I am losing some of the product.
I know this is pricy for a little, but it really works for oily and combination skin, it doesn’t cause breakouts or anything. Skin is so smooth and bright after using. Love Tata products!
I really wanted to love this but it didn’t absorb very well :( it just kind of pilled up! I tried adjusting my other products but no luck. I love this brand though their other stuff is great!

I’ve tried this kit a couple of times while trying to decide if I wanted to invest in the full sizes of the products.  It’s a good travel kit, my skin reacted well for the most part but I wasn’t a fan of the hydrosol and also found the moisturizer wasn’t “enough“ although everything does smell wonderful.

I’ll start with the positive—the oil itself is awesome.  It’s thick and really moisturizing.  I purchased the smaller size to try this out. It’s not a dropper bottle as pictured!  It’s a roller bottle, which is the absolute worst possible idea for a face oil!  To get the product out, I have to roll repeatedly on my hand. Only other option would be to roll directly on your face which sounds a little gross to me.  Also, I travel frequently and roller bottles always leak.  Even though this would be the perfect travel size, you can’t travel with it which is frustrating.  As of now, not sure I’ll purchase again because of the packaging. I really need something I can travel with.  If I notice really awesome results I’ll try the larger size and see how that packaging works.  At this price point I expect perfection, and this isn’t.
I love this product so so much. This gets rid of all my under eye wrinkles! Is very pricy though.

This product was absolutely amazing. I’ve used moisturizers before but nothing I guess you can say this high end. It made my skin feeling very smooth and did not leave it sticky. I liked that it wasn’t scented because when it comes to my face specifically I prefer things to be as clean as possible. My skin can be somewhat sensitive at times and this didn’t affect my skin sensitivities at all.

Not a fan. The oil itself feels nice going on, smooth, softening, just nice all around - one star here. Trying to get it off though .. that was a nightmare. Like other reviewers stated, it left a film on my skin no matter how much water I used. Had to wipe it off with a towel and double cleanse. The second star is because it did soften and moisturize however trying to get it off isn’t worth the end results. Especially since I have used other oil cleansers that rinse/emulsify more easily. Dry skin folks might love this but not for me, and never again. I like other stuff from Tata Harper but this was a bust imo.

Really disliked this product. The roller hardly allows any oil to come out, and eventually I took it off and put a few drops in my hands to massage onto my face, much like I have for other oils. I didn’t find it moisturizing, and it did nothing for my skin (except make it smells like cologne...not a huge deal, but certainly didn’t help). No radiance or hydration. Probably one of the worst beauty products I have ever purchased.

This is worth the cost if it works for you. This clears up my acne breakouts, helps smooth my skin, and makes my face so soft. I would use this everyday if I could, but use it once or twice a week. You don’t need a lot in order for it to work. I hope this works for you too, good luck!

This kit is at fault for my love of Tata Harper, since buying this I have repurchase the moisturizer and the mask. If I could I would buy it all! But the high price in the products just made me pick favorites !I recommend this if you are interested on trying out the brand, as the products will last you about 3-4 weeks.

I absolutely love beautiful glass packaging of this serum and that it’s absolutely fragrance free. Great for those with sensitive skin. Serum has very lightweight texture and absorbs very quickly yet hydrating.
I give 4 stars because it is so expensive but it works! Nice hydrating spray. I use it as a toner, setting spray and over the floral essence mask.
This product is a game changer for my skin. I’m thirty with dry and red patches of skin. This evened my skin and gave me a soft glow.

I am quite young (in my early 20s), My skin is very normal, not overly oily and not dry. My skin care goals are to to prevent against aging as best I can. A sephora employee recommended this mask to me and at first I was a unsure because I had never heard of the brand and it is a very high price tag for a small amount. However, It really is an amazing mask, very hydrating. My skin is so soft and plump after using the mask, which is pretty impressive that even I was even able to notice a difference because of how healthy my skin is to begin with. My only downside is the the price, if you are someone with more mature skin, and can afford this product I highly recommend it! It’s not something I will repurchase right away but as a treat once and awhile I will definitely do so!

I received this product from Tata Harper in exchange for my honest review. I have heard a lot about serums, but have not used one in the past. I was definitely excited to try this serum out. The first thing I noticed when I received this product was the packaging. The box is a calming green Which listed, very clearly, the name of the product and what it does. The bottle is also green with a gold top and it appears to hold a good amount of product. The serum itself is very soft and smooth and best of all, not greasy feeling. When I applied it to my face, It was easy to rub in and it absorbed quickly. It is fragrance free which is a huge plus for me since often times a fragrance on my face will cause a migraine. I’ve only been using this product for a short time so I can’t say that I’ve seen a difference yet, but I do like how my skin feels after using it. I plan on continuing to use this serum and feel good that I will see positive results soon.

I don’t normally feel compelled to write reviews unless a product really blows me away, and this really blew me away. I waited about 10 minutes after applying my retinol and then applied this as a sleeping mask. I woke up to dewy, plumped, smooth, deeply HYDRATED skin - free of all redness and texture. The two blemishes I had diminished greatly. Throughout the next day, my skin was just radiant and glowing, even beneath my CC cream. Truly post-facial skin. I can’t praise this product enough. Highly underrated! I recommend it if you’re using a retinol, experience any type of dryness, redness, or dehydration, and/or live in an extremely dry climate! LOVE.

I have oily and acne-prone skin. I use a lot of natural products to keep my skin acne free. I was experiencing some bad breakouts, and I splurged and bought this face mask. It helped so much. Using it weekly, I saw a reduction in breakouts and redness. It also helped some of my bad breakouts go down in size when I used it as a spot treatment. I would say the downside is the price. This is a very expensive luxury item.

The product itself is good, but these samples went really quickly! I tried to use only a little bit, but a pump hardly covered my face. I DO recommend the face scrub and will definitely be buying that again in full size.

This product smells lovely, but my skin reacted strongly to it. I used this in combination with the serum, and (after 3 days of using it) my skin broke out terribly. I have rosacea, and my skin is very sensitive, and it finally has calmed down now 3 weeks after abandoning this product.

I watched the video & made up my mind to love these products & that they would be my “holy grail“ products. I guess maybe my expectations were too high, but I thought everything was just ok. 

For the cost of the kit, they amounts are product are inconsistent. I had maybe a few days of eye cream, but I’ve been using the toner for a month. I like the cleaner ok, but I don’t like that you apply it dry as I usually wash my face in the shower after I wash my hair. This was fine on the days I don’t shampoo. Just a little hang up, but enough that it bothered me. I won’t be trying any full sized products. 

There are a lot of negative comments about the smell, but I like the scent.

For the price, I wouldn’t repurchase. I feel this mask is okay, but not great. It didn’t really help me with my pores at all or improve blackheads. There are much better products like the Dennis gross clarifying mask that do a better job. This is about as impactful as the boscia pore pudding mask.

After having a bad couple of years (brain surgery, 2 devastating miscarriages) I decided to change some things in my life--including ridding my cosmetics and skin care collection of anything with toxins. I figured whatever I could do to make myself healthier, I would try. I had read about Tata Harper’s non-toxic line and decided to try this kit. Immediately my skin felt great after the first day. Within 3-4 days, I noticed my rosacea had cleared up. I have been plagued with rosacea for 5 years now but a week since I started with this line it is almost completely gone. I have only been using this trial set and am 7 days in. There is really a lot of product here--you will run out of the cleanser and eye cream first. I ended up ordering some other Tata Harper cleanser (not part of this kit) and also loved it.

If you are looking to try this line, this kit is really a great price and you can see if you love the product. For me with my rosacea that hasn’t been helped by ANYTHING, this has been great.

Sephora, please start carrying more of her line!!!

Bought because Tatcha’s camellia cleansing oil was out of stock both times I tried to buy it last week. Figured I’d give this one a try. Nothing terrible, except the pump. Not a huge fan of the strong scent but it fades pretty quickly. Overall, nothing great about this either. Will not repurchase after this bottle is empty, going back to Tatcha. I just prefer it over this one.

i got that kit as a suggestion from a youtuber , i really liked the kit especially the cleanser, eye cream and the mask , the others i didn’t really like them because the scent is very strong which i can’t deal with ! but it’s smells nice! i already finished the cleanser and the eye cream and definitely I’m going to purchase the full size ! overall , i think this kit is worth buying especially because the products is very expensive so that discovery kit will help a lot!

I love this mask to cleanse!  I leave it on for about 20 minutes and then wash it off in the shower with cool water.  I use it when my skin is a little problematic, and it works wonders for breakouts.  The results are fantastic, but I took stars for two reasons... 1. Its a bit pricey for a facemask that I could take months to a year to use up (I wish they would do a smaller jar for less money so I wouldnt be as concerned about it spoiling)2. Because Tata Harper isn’t as “green“ as they claim to be - they don’t grow everything in house, and it would be a whole heck of a lot better for the environment if they would do refills rather than just tossing the packaging every time I ran out

The resurfacing mask is one of the best masks out of the at least 50 I have tried in the last few years. I have VERY sensitive oily skin that needs exfoliating often. I barely NOTICE this mask is on, and my skin has nearly no texture after. UNFREAKINFBELIEVABLE. I am splurging on the big one some day soon, that is an investment I am willing to make. The scrubbing cleanser is the same, best. I. Ever. Had. And I love the smell. Serum soaks right in, moisturizer is a tad on the greasy side but I refuse to complain, I’ll use it as a night cream. QUALITY LADIES. QUALITY!!!

I love this lotion! My skin has been acne prone (cheek and chin area) for the past year - I’ve been using this lotion, in conjunction with the Peter Thomas Roth acne face soap and Clairns  double serum for about two weeks and my skin is so much better! I haven’t broke out (I was averaging two or three spots a week) and my skin tone is evening out. If you have any kind of spots this is definitely worth a shot. It absorbs fairly quick - 3-5 minutes depending on how much serum you use.

I loved this serum. It is very gentle and I noticed right away my skin was softer. I didn’t mind that it doesn’t have a scent although I do like scented products. I would recommend to anyone, another great product by a tata harper.

This kit is a great way to sample a bunch of products from this line without commiting to the price tag of the full size versions. The standout items to me were the mask, the cleanser, and the serum. The others are nice too, but I know I’ll definitely be purchasing the full sizes of those three first. While these are smaller sample sizes of the product, there’s still enough for you to use consistently for a while so you can really decide if you want to buy more. I use these products at night and tatcha products in the morning, so this kit will probably last me at least a few weeks.

Bottom line, this stuff smells awful. At first I thought I got a bad sample, but I checked other reviews and it just really is an awful smelling product. On to the pros...this absorbs quickly and it did tingle a bit but my skin did feel hydrated for some time. Would I purchase again, absolutely not because the scent lingered.

I received a sample of this and was excited to try a Tata Harper moisturizer given the emphasis on natural ingredients. It’s not a thick moisturizer and does not not feel greasy at all when applied. It left my face feeling amazing and moisturizer throughout the day. The only downside, as others remarked, is the smell; it’s not pleasant for a face moisturizer and is quite noticeable after application. It’s not quite a chemical smell, it’s probably a combination of some of the different oils, but it just isn’t something you want to smell all day.  Unfortunately won’t be purchasing the full size because of the smell even though the moisturizer works well.

THIS IS HANDS HOW THE BEST MOISTURIZER FOR CYSTIC ACNE. I’ve been searching for a moisturizer that would lessen my acne for years. And I have full face acne and this worked so well!!! My acne isn’t totally gone but it reduced it by about 75%, which is significant. TIP: It pairs really well with the dermalogica Blemish Gel and tata resurfacing mask! Power trio!I love that it has zinc, which is helpful for our body to fight acne bacteria AND lactobacillus, a probiotic that also helps to fight the bacteria AND natural antibacterials like sage and elderberry. This combination is way better than trying other acne creams as they usually only have chemical exfoliants and lack these ESSENTIAL ingredients for fighting acne!I have been able to clear my skin up by making internal changes with diet and herbs but I still use this to maintain my skin. I don’t think I’ll ever be able to use another moisturizer. Well done Tata. All power to the plants!!
Love this product for moisture and refreshers throughout the day.  I 1st tried this as a sample and find the spray to not be as strong in the full size.

I love this product.  It smells great, isn’t drying, and makes my skin look and feel baby-soft after I use it.  I am taking away a star for the cost, because it is very pricey for the amount you get...I think I got maybe 7 or 8 uses out of my little jar.  However, I will almost certainly be buying this again (when the VIB sale comes around!).

The bottle and the mist are stunning. Unfortunately, my skin is very sensitive and this product stung when I used it. I ended up washing my face again to stop the burn. I do not recommend for sensitive skin.

I like this, it is a decent toner. It is gentle and it does what it says it will do. I personally think that it smells nice. The reason I am not giving it 5 stars is because it is not easy to justify the price for what it does. I think it works; but I also think that there are other things on the market that work just as well without breaking the bank. I would recommend this product if you have the money to spend.

I absolutely love this set! Even though they are minis, you get a lot of product for the money, except for the eye cream. There’s only enough for 2-3 uses there.. I think it’s a pretty great deal overall.So far, I like all of the products a lot. The smell is very strongly floral, which I’m not crazy about, but the results have been excellent, so I don’t want to complain too much. These products would work best either for skin over 35 or in the winter time because they’re very creamy and hydrating.

This travel kit is just perfect for everything you could need for your skincare routine and because it’s all natural you know anywhere in the world in whatever climate these products won’t harm your skin in any way. I love these because it leaves me with not having to worry about how to carry the bigger bottles and each little jar is a healthy food for my skin.

Hey y’all, first time trying this product, what can I say.. I love it. I love the way it feels and that it’s unscented. The ingredients of the product is quality. I enjoy washing my face and don’t feel like it dries it out

I love this moisturizer, it works wonderful for my combination skin.  I’ve used several different ones from Amore Pacific, La Mer, and Omorovicza.  It balances my skin so nicely and has cleared up my occasional breakouts in my T-zone.  I use this along with Tata Harper’s Hydrating Floral Essence and Clarifying Cleanser.  The thing I love most about Tata Harper products is that they’re natural and do not contain the standard silicones found in many other brands.  Silicone isn’t necessarily bad, but I’ve found products containing silicone clog my pores and actually cause my breakouts.  Since using Tata Harper, my breakouts have went away and my skin is clear.  My cheeks also aren’t nearly as dry as they used to be using even the best moisturizers.

Although pricey, this cleanser effectively gets rid of all of my makeup! You definitely need a flannel to wipe the excess off, but you get buttery smooth skin after. Definitely works well with my dry skin. Love the botanical almost herbal scent. I don’t even need to moisturize after, looove.
Loved my sample.  It felt good my skin looked fresh or after. It also doubles as an exfoliant!
Doesn’t help with black heads the bottle is tiny and paid 100 dollars I won’t re buy this product

This mask is...okay. I honestly don’t see where all the hype comes from. I’m oily and have acne. I didn’t see any difference with any aspect of my skin after using this except it was a bit softer. The tingling was nice. The smell was tolerable. Worth the price?Not in my opinion.
Great day time moisturizer. Not heavy and sinks into the skin.

The Superkind Fragrance-Free Softening Cleanser is fabulous. It is unscented with a creamy texture, so it is a bit hard to foam. Luxurious cleanser that is perfect for sensitive skin. It is worth the price- especially for those of us with sensitive skin! I have used (probably)over 50 cleansers in my lifetime, but this is it. I was using a multitude of other luxury cleansers, but since I’ve bought this Softening Cleanser, it’s the only cleanser I have used! 10/10! Must have!
This product is so gross, it leaves a very sticky and heavy layer on the skin and it smells really bad. Will NOT be purchasing.

Got this lil beauty as a deluxe sample and now I’m gonna have to buy the big bottle because this stuff is liquid gold. If you want something for moisture and if you wanna feel like a queen I highly recommend this moisturizer

For the price point this moisturizer doesn’t wow me. Despite other reviews I do think this is safe for sensitive skin and fragrance free but again there’s better options on the market.

This product actually made me love using a moisturizer. Tata Harper has gorgeous products and this is no exception.

I had high hope for this mask, considering the reviews and the price. I have used it several times and it did absolutely nothing for me (at least, it did not break out). Pure waste of money. My first review never got published.

This smells beautiful and feels luxurious during treatment. My skin is very plump, soft and dewy after using. It’s expensive but worth it. It’s too sticky to sleep in, but if I don’t put anything else on after rinsing it off I wake up with even more amazing results the next day.It’s a definite must the evening before a special day!

My favorite nighttime face oil. It’s hydrating but not heavy, smells floral, though it is strong.  It leaves my acne prone dry skin glowing and I wake up with happy skin with no breakouts. I will say I use this as a traditional facial oil and not for the “retinoic” properties as it gets it from the rose hip oil in the formula and that is just not a strong enough source of retinol for anti aging results.

My go-to moisturizer, I can use this in our dry, dry winters and summers that don’t get much if any humidity. I find it is perfect for my skin - occasional frustrating breakouts and the rest of time supplementing a regimen that cries out for moisture.

Love, love this product. I have used it daily for 4 days now. I feel it melts into your skin quickly and doesn’t leave oil. Fragrance free, which I like as I have sensitive skin. The ingredients are good for you, natural. I enjoy being able to use this product! Thank you

This has made a HUGE difference in my skin. I combine it with the Tata Harper Resurfacing Serum and it is a match made in heaven! My skin is so glowy and healthy looking and the mild redness on my cheeks has disappeared. Love the floral scent, as well.

It’s interesting to read the low reviews, I also have very, very sensitive skin with rosacea and other issues with redness and this product is actually my favorite toner I’ve ever had. I do feel it and it did not cause me to have any negative reactions at all. But we do all have different skin and I don’t think any product is great for everybody out there. Don’t forget to shake it up before use.

I was gifted this product by tata harper. This is one of the most luxurious serums I’ve ever used. Wow it’s amazing. The bottle and lift off top is so pretty. The serum is smooth and hydrating without it being too wet or thick. It smells a little like the ocean, which I love. This is a super high quality product. Tata harper does it again!
its for your face but  I used it on my body and it was fantastic!! would purchase this - love how it makes your skin feel
I really liked the glow mask and the resurfacing serum.

This is the best night cream I’ve ever used.  My skin has changed from oily to combination and Tata Harper’s creme riche makes it feel luxurious.  Although, pricey, great skin care products are important to me so I am happy to invest in a product that works.

I used this product in it’s entirety and my skin is *amazing*.  I’m 3 months post partum - always had clear skin  pre pregnancy - and this made my skin glow.  At first, I wasn’t sure it was doing anything and was quite annoyed by all the steps but after a few weeks, I could walk around bare faced and look great. Can’t use the oil as I realized it has vitamin A which is not good for breastfeeding :-\

I Love this moisturizer, I have only been using it for a couple of days, applying mornings only. This moisturizer has not made be break out at all, I have not even had any new pimples since I started using this, which is amazing. It very florally and fresh, but light.  I took off a star for the price.  I would recommend this to anyone that has acne prone skin.  It also takes away any redness and gives your skin that nice “ white“ amazing glow!

This is the best mask for hydration.  It seems thick at first and once you rinse off it is a soft milky texture and doesn’t leave any residue.  It makes my skin look and feel hydrated for days.  It also has the most delicious smell.  Two thumbs up for me.

This purchase was a huge disappointment for me because this was my first ever Tata Harper purchase and I wish i’d save my $75 and not purchased this. The only think I liked using in this purchase was the face wash and everything else was just useless

I’m so happy with this product!!! So worth the price!
Too liquidy for my taste, stung a little and didn’t leave a soft texture. I have been trying to find my ideal moisturizer, unfortunately this one isn’t for me.

This stuff is wonderful!! I have very sensitive skin and this product has managed to reduce my redness and not cause my forehead to breakout like other facial lotions. The only downside, it’s incredibly pricey.
love the smell! works beautifully. love it!

A really nice face oil, I use it as an extra anti-aging defense on top of an actual Vitamin A cream. This works so well and gives a nice cooling feeling while pulling out impurities. I just wish for the price you got more product. Great moisturizer doesn’t have that petroleum based feel - pricey but good investment

Did not work for me. The first few days were fine, then I started to break out with tons of little white heads. I ordered this kit because I liked the sample of the regenerating cleanser I tried previously. I can’t stand the smell of the serum and moisturizer so this has been a waste of money for me. I would buy the cleanser but none of the other products.

Received this product from Tata Harper. I’ve had great experiences with this brand and was excited to try this moisturizer. I use it every morning and every night. This is by far the most unique moisturizer I’ve ever used. It completely evens out my skin tone and redness. It helps with oil control as well. it will smooths, firms, and brightens to restore a comfortable skin, it’s suitable for all skin types. Best for reactive  skin. Use AM & PM.   Happy get this product, will recommend for friend and family.

this did not take off my make up. it just created a mess that i had to use a washcloth and another cleanser to get it all off. will not use again.

Smells incredible, and I have certainly found it moisturizing, and hydrating. But it is simply a blend of oils, nothing miraculous. And, honestly it is a very small amount for what it is. I probably will not repurchase, and will find something more cost effective.

This wonderful serum deserves its own spot . It’s a milky texture and soft lotion based . It doesn’t feel sticky like some other serums . I had a very bad climate and skin is broken literally . While I understand sensitive skin products often need to be unfragranced or smell a little more natural than others, this product smells rancid.  It smells as though it’s gone bad.  It also leaves a film on my face as though there’s oils in it, which I know will irritate my face within a week of use.  At this price point I shouldn’t have to hold my breath to use a product.  My face is still red after the first use.  I’ll likely go back to one of the other cleansers.  Disappointed to say the least!

Love this cleanser. I use it on dry skin, as my second cleanse. I love massaging my face with it, since it smells like an aromatherapy oil (my skin tolerates oil well). It’s a great mask & it leaves your skin feeling great after you use it. Of course this isn’t a face-lift in a tub but it’s a great product & if your expectations are reasonable, you should be more than happy with this product. Have a great day & be beautiful.

This product is an eye balm which is very thick. I had to purchase a brush to distribute the product evenly.  Not sure if it is working and it is very expensive.  I do not thing I will repurchase once this one is empty.
This cream a little pricey but is very effective.

I have normal to dry skin and this just isn’t for me. I tried the setting mist a while back and I didn’t like it because of the smell alone. I received this moisturizer in a Sephora Favorites and the smell is the exact same, smells like an old warehouse to me! It leaves my skin feeling a bit tight and sticky.

To be completely honest I am sadly very disappointed by this kit and the products. I was really looking forward to trying this kit to improve my complexion but found it very underwhelming.  For off, the $100 price for tiny sample sizes I found unreasonable. The sizes contained in this kit are the same sizes you receive when cashing in points as you checkout. I have very mild acne breakouts and I noticed the use of this product actually made me breakout more. If you have blemish prone skin I would not recommend this product. I was really rooting for this product but unfortunately disappointed not only with the product but also with the very expensive price tag.

I’ve purchased this a few times in the past. I love to use it in the summertime. However, this bottle is almost half the size it used to be, and for the same price!! Tata Harper will not be getting anymore of my money.

I love this mask. From time to time I have had problems with blackheads and this is seriously the only mask that will clear and tighten my pores. The price may seem steep, but a little goes a long way.

The cleanser is nice, as is the resurfacing mask. However, the serum and moisturizer left my skin taught and uncomfortable; the nutrient complex comes in a tiny rollerball dispenser and it’s hard to tell if anything is even coming out. Really wanted to love these products but this is just so-so.
The best facial oil I’ve tried! Smells amazing, and absorbs well into the skin. I layer it on underneath my foundation, and skin stays soft, hydrated, with a perfect glow all day long!

I truly love this product! I love everything Tata Harper! Her line seriously doesn’t compare to any other line. It’s the only natural skin care line I’ve tried that actually delivers results! This stuff is honestly very moisturizing, light weight and just beautiful ingredients for your skin! I think this has to be one of the best essences on the market. I’ve noticed a difference in my skins clarity, tone and it honestly feels like it helps my serums/eye creams soak in better. You won’t regret buying this product. You’ll see what I’m taking about. All her stuff is like this. Once you go Tata Harper, you don’t go back. Her products do smell a little like old people (I’m 21), but the smell goes away.. and who cares when you know it’s the best thing for your skin!! Doesn’t bother me at all! I’ve tried a lot of different products and do a lot of research on skincare products. Tata is my ultimate favorite beyond any other brand. I just started using her products a couple of months ago ( my 1st products was the regenerating cleanser that I cannot rave about enough! It’s the absolute best working best ingredient exfoliating cleanser) and I already have almost everything in her line. Try her out! You WON’T regret it! I hope you guys love her stuff as much as much! I’m trying to get everyone hooked on Tata Harper lol. Because we should all be using beauty products that actually work and are honestly GOOD for us!! Uh she’s the best!
Was amazing going on. Getting it off was difficult. It felt like crisco when it mixed with the water. But i double cleanse and it came off fine with double cleansing with the Mia.

OMG it feels so good to have this cream on my face! I have combo skin that gets really oily around my nose  and this cream doesn’t make it worst , it moisturize it without making it too heavy on my skin. It feels like my skin is moisturized enough not to overproduce extra oil and the cream doesn’t block my pores. Love it! I wish I could afford to buy it on the regular basis
The mask is OK but cant justifye the price/size. Only comes half full and you need to use a decent amount to cover your face. Wont be buying again.

It definitely doesn’t have the super clean effect of the glamglow supermud, which is my all-time favorite mud mask, but I like the smooth/creamy texture and the moisturizing feel it leaves on my skin. It is a purifying and moisturizing mud mask. Smell is not my favorite though.
I do not like the smell of this product and do not see any difference on my skin after misting.  Not worth the money to purchase, there are better facial mists out there.
Love everything about this mask! It hydrates my skin and gives a really nice glow! Love the smell too :)

Got a deluxe sample of this stuff & as I have skin that’s on the dry/combo side I figured I wouldn’t really need to use this. I started breaking out like crazy upon starting a sample of a Sunday Riley moisturizer I got as a sample as well, and so I started using this to try to remedy that. It did literally nothing, and also it is not very moisturizing considering it is a moisturizer. Don’t waste your money on something so pricey that literally does nothing

I could feel it tightening on my skin. The mask is not drying and does leave your skin hydrated. However, I don’t think it did a lot for my acne. I’ve used other masks that have worked better for acne. This is best suited for people with dry skin.

This was a great way to try a lot of new products at once. The only thing in this kit that I had tried before is the mask, which I love and already own in full size. I really liked the cleanser in this kit as well. The other products really didn’t do it for me. Here’s why...the serum and moisturizer were so highly frangranced that they continually made me sneeze. I don’t have sensitive skin and fragrance doesn’t usually bother me, but these did. I could smell the product on my face 4 hours later. The oil is ok, but definitely not anything special, or any better than oils I already have. I’m neutral to the toner mist. If I would have kept the kit I would’ve used the mist, but would not repurchase. I decided to return the kit since the only things I really liked were the mask (which I already own) and the cleanser.
This cleanser is okay, definitely not worth the money, I have a very sensitive skin and was hoping that my skin will improve after using Tata for a while now, unfortunately nothing has improved

This product completely eliminated my dark circles and when I say eliminated I mean GONE. The puffiness is also much better and my crows feet have improved. For reference I have used this product morning and night for 3 weeks. I really wanted to dislike this product because of the price but I honestly have tried over 10 “clean” eye creams that don’t even compare.The product itself is very thick like a lip balm. I’ve found it melts when you work your finger through it then apply. You have to be patient and pat into eye. I can see how people would get frustrated with that, however, for how well this product works I’ll gladly take the extra time to pamper my undereye. It definitely is not your typical formula for eye cream because it is so concentrated. I would say it does make your eyes water if applied too close to eye so be careful The only thing I’m regretting is not doing a before and after picture. My new holy grail.
I look forward to spraying this on my face every morning. It smells amazing and feels so refreshing!

I use this only in the summer time at night as it could still clog in the day when combined with SPF. Since Tata Harper does not yet have a SPF. This is one of her original moisturizers and the best in the line. I use it with her refreshing cleaner when I have to buy at Space NK as Sephora does not carry it. The refreshing cleanser and repairative moisturizer work well together.
Love the product but the top was faulty and didn’t stay on during my travels so I lost a lot of the product. Disappointing because of the price

I will spend anything and do anything for perfect skin. I didn’t feel this was any better than numerous other products, and for the price and the small size I just returned it. You’ll get the same if not better results with an exfoliant followed by a clay mask.

The serum has transformed my skin and I’m obsessed with this serum. Both texture and skin coloring have improved after few days. The glass container is so beautiful. But the smell is a bit too strong and stays for a long time. Overall, the serum works and gives my skin a glow and evenness.

Love this brand, their packaging and just knew I was going to love this serum! Any serum I’ve tried from tata I’ve loved. It’s great for all skin types including sensitive. Even the scent is light and will not irritate your skin!

I love the idea of all the tata Harper products, I just don’t love them all in practice on my skin. This one, however, is totally worth it. It’s refreshing throughout the day and amazing before a serum. I actually will run out soon and be repurchasing, which is impressive since it’s quite a big bottle. If you’re unsure / wait till a Sephora sale, which is what I do for all major purchases that I’m on the fence about. But get off the fence on this one.

Sad to say this broke me out. I was really excited to try this and thought the best way to see how it works was to get travel size. I’m almost out of everything after a little over two weeks and have 6 pimples. I don’t break out unless my skin doesn’t like a product. Such a bummer. Most enjoyed product would be the cleanser although I’m not sure it did anything great, it did smell like fruit loops which was fun.

I’ve used the original Radiance Mask for years and absolutely loved it. I was heartbroken when my skin started to get more sensitive so I had to hold off on using it because of rosacea. This does not cause my skin ANY irritation but still gives it the same glow as the original Radiance Mask. It goes on nicely and a little goes a long way so the pot lasts for a while. I highly recommend to anyone, whether your skin is sensitive or not!

Read many good things about the Tata Harper brand and personally love all things clean, natural, and organic when it comes to beauty. Bought this kit to try out her product line, but man oh man does this stuff’s floral perfume knock you back. Some floral scents I can handle, but this line is floral-in-a-bad-way, like the musty potpourri aisle in the back of a small town craft store. The essence spray is tolerable (and I find myself continuing to use it with other clean beauty products I’m testing out), but once you factor in the perfumed serum, moisturiser, and oil, it’s just way too much. The scent also lingers for hours, so even if I did enjoy the effect of the products, I couldn’t just “tough it out.“ Wanted to love but *Simon Cowell voice* it’s a no from me.

I first discovered this when I went into the Sephora store in Aventura, FL to get my makeup done for my birthday - one of my favourite perks of being VIB Rouge.  This product feels simply LOVELY on my skin - cooling, refreshing - and it seems very hydrating.I have extremely sensitive and somewhat dry skin that’s prone to peeling and breaking out in reaction to too many things to list.  I was a little afraid to try this, but Alexandra explained the ingredients to me, so I gave it a try.And I fell in love.It’s expensive for a face spray, and it doesn’t have SPF so I can’t use it on mornings I go to the barn, but it’s PERFECT to throw into my purse and take with me when I go out for the evening to keep my skin hydrated and my makeup looking fresh - and NO FLAKING!

I love this stuff. It’s definitely a stronger scent than most other moisturizers, but I personally don’t mind it. It’s very light feeling but does a great job. One pump is enough for my entire face   neck so the product goes a long way.
I have to say, no a big fan if it’s smell.... formula is light, maybe good for summer.

I had really high hopes for this oil, but unfortunately I won’t be using it again. I got a sample and tried it for a few days and the results were disastrous. My skin was dry, flaky, irritated, and broken out. I immediately switched back to Josie Maran’s Argan Oil light and my skin calmed down right away. The nutrient complex has a lot of good vitamins and I wanted to love it, but it just didn’t agree with my skin. On top of everything, it made my fave extremely oily during the day to the point where my makeup was settling into the lines around my mouth. And i used only a drop or two, so not much.

This mask is so hydrating. It diminishes the fine lines around my eyes. My skin tends to be a bit dry due to using retinol products and this mask weekly really counteracts the drying. I have really been blown away by just how hydrating it is and I haven’t tried it overnight. I am deducting a star for amount of product for the price. I was shocked by how small the bottle is and the floral smell is very strong to me.

I wasn’t really impressed with this product, I guess the price tag is justifiable for an organic, environmentally friendly product, but there was no noticeable change/improvement in my skin. Will not repurchase.

I really enjoyed this toner, I got a sample size in the Skincare Favorites set and used the entire bottle.  But I just can’t justify using a $70 spray when there are so many that are more affordable and will do just as good of a job (if not better).  So I’ll look elsewhere but have now added spray toners to my routine thanks to trying this.
Returned after first use. I broke out like crazy!!!! I’ve got oily skin and my skin just didn’t like the products.
This is not a very moisturizing moisturizer. It is not for dry skin. Must apply heavy serum or oil beneath it to stay moisturized throughout the day. However, it is lightweight and absorbs quickly.

I got this moisturizer in a Tata Harper kit and I’m actually happy I only have the sample size bottle. I received a deluxe sample of this in the scouted by sephora favorites kit. It’s got a strong ginger smell, which I don’t mind, and is easy to apply and leaves skin hydrated after application. I didn’t really notice any tightening, refinement, smoothing, etc. My skin looked about the same after as it did before - it was just very clean and hydrated, but no more so than if I just washed my face and applied lotion.
The smell is the brown algae working its magic to purify the skin without drying it. Worth every penny!

I love this moisturizer, it helped repair my dehydrated skin. I was skeptical at first to purchase this product because of the price but it is worth every penny. My skin was so dehydrated that it was ’’drinking’’ my foundation. As soon as I started using this product, the problem stopped and my face is now appropriately moisturized. The cream does have an odd smell but so worth it!

To all you people that thinks this smells bad you must not like flowers is general. Did you know other products take over 4000 chemicals to make a products smell like flowers. IF YOU WANT UGLY DISGUSTING CHEMICALS ON YOUR FACE BUY YOUR FACIAL PRODUCTS FROM THE 99 CENTS STORE.

Basically, this is a deluxe sample sized array of products, lasting just long enough for you to see how beautifully Tata’s line can work miracles for your skin. Seriously. My acne-prone sensitive skin loves this stuff, with my face drinking in every drop as if she’s been starved for the right attention forever. Every morning when I wake up, I cannot tell you how beautiful and HAPPY I feel when I see that, yet again, I haven’t woken up with a new zit that’s chosen to dance across my dry face! I take a breath, close my eyes and thank Tata for this blessing ... what a journey it’s been to find the right skin care line for my particular challenges, I am so happy!

Love, love, love this stuff. I have such acne prone, sensitive skin...when I was pregnant, I was breaking out like crazy and was limited in what products I could use, so I gave this moisturizer and the clarifying cleanser a whirl. It’s basically a miracle....the price is crazy, but I’m willing to splurge for what’s it done for my skin.
I love this Essence, it not only has the most amazing scent it gives my skin a dewy glow.

The bad reviews are mainly for the smell and this is a fragrant product. It smells like earthy florals which I love but if you are sensitive to smells don’t buy it. As a 30 year old who invests her money into skincare and is trying to stay away from Botox & fillers, tata harpers line is amazing. I highly recommend to someone who is starting to age and wants to invest in a great moisturizer!!
I was excited to try this organic moisturizer, however it left my skin very dry. My fine lines were more visible after using also. Would not buy this product again.

I have redness prone combination skin that leans towards oily. I use this cleanser just in the morning as it does a nice job of balancing and calming my skin. If you don’t have reactive skin I don’t think this would be worth the money but if you do have reactive skin it is worth every penny!
It’s just the best oil cleanser! It Smells unbelievably good! I highly recommend it!

After removing it, my skin was extremely soft. Like baby soft. To use, apply over the entire face and neck. Leave on for about 15-30 minutes and remove with cold water.

I enjoy this product and have been using this daily.The scent may not be a fav to most but it doesn’t bother me. The texture is a thickish moisturizer. My skin looks healthier with a nice glow. Really disappointed in this product. It smells terrible and I can deal with that if I’m getting results but this moisturizer made my skin feel sticky after applying it. It also dried out my skin.

I hate that this works so well because it’s so expensive lol. I don’t use it to remove makeup. I use it on a clean face as a treatment as I massage my skin. I finished the bottle a month or so ago, and thought I could find a cheaper alternative, but there just isn’t one. Going to bite the bullet and keep using this jar of gold. I love it that much.

This is such a nice moisturizer. I appreciate the natural scent from this farm-to-skin company without any added fragrance. My skin feels hydrated and protected without feeling oily. It is calming and non-irritating- quickly becoming a favorite of mine.
Because of the natural ingredients, I wanted to like this moisturizer. It is not moisturizing and does nothing for my dry skin. I would only recommend it to someone that has oily skin.

Was highly recommended by Dove Cameron for super dry and reactive skin. If you are on the fence, try it. Get this product.

If you’re looking for a new skin regimen, look no further! I’ve been making through the every skin care line they sell at Sephora, I’ve finally found one that might stick for the long haul. It also helps that the products smell amazing.

This stuff is amazing.If you have resilient/ non sensitive skin I can see you not being “wow-ed“...This product is amazing for people who have sensitive skin. Its non-toxic which I REALLY appreciate. So many face products are laced with harmful and junk-filler ingredients.This stuff is pure, natural, easy. It absorbs right into my skin. My dad even uses it! (Male 62 dry skin) and I LOVE it ( Female 25 very oily skin)Thats pretty universal if you ask me!

I’m giving this 2 starts because, 1. considering the price, and claiming to be a “clarifying moisturizer”: I still broke out from this product. 2. The only night cream that works for my super sensitive skin. Nordic ethnicity often means allergies to many skin care brands - even high end. Not with Tata Harper. This stuff works. Not only does it manage what it say it does for moisture, but also fills in many fine lines and plumps. So glad to have found a product that works for my skin. Worth every dollar.

This is nice but I’d recommend other products (Fresh Rose floral toner or dr jart tiger grass calming mist) over this that  are more hydrating and better price. But I do love this bottle- looks pretty on the vanity.

Wonderful serum! I’m in love with its milky texture! Being extremely lightweight it melts into the skin completely and doesn’t leave any residue. I would be hesitant to try anything from this company for fear that all their products smell like this.

This is one of the two products for Tata that I will continue to repurchase even though they are expensive. I need the smell of this to feel relax before going to sleep. It really moisturizing so if you have combo skin it a little to much to use morning and night.

I wanted to give this product  0 stars however I had to give 1 in order to write the review.  This is the # 1 all time worst moisturizer i have ever tried and I’ve tried lots. I’ve really been enjoying this moisturizer, it’s very light and does what it claims to do although I feel you could find an alternative for a lower price tag. Therefore sadly won’t be repurchasing but if you have the money to splurge it is a lovely moisturizer with amazing ingredients

I got hooked on Tata Harper after getting a mini-facial with her products. I have to say this is one of my favourite cleansers. This is such a good product. It’s amazing for sensitive and dry skin I love this but not as cleanser. So I my skin can enjoy the rich and decadent ingredients I use this as an oil. my first bottle of Tata Harper. I have a big hope with this brand, I feel comfortable when I use it, however, the smell of the essence is having a bit ’worn’, maybe the reason of its ’freshness’. I have a bit disappointed.

I really like this moisturizer because it is natural. But, it also feel really nice on my face. I have not noticed it to break me out. It also smells really nice.

I have very dry skin and this product works miracles for me. Especially for the winter and washing off of makeup this is a god send. I put It on right before I get this the shower and once I wash it off my face is soft, hydrated, and ready for the day.
I didn’t like this product on my skin. And didn’t find it worth the money for me. The smell wasn’t my favourite. Also felt heavy on my skin and made it feel greasy.

If you are sensitive, acne prone, or struggling from hormonal breakouts, this moisturizer will be a game changer for you. Absolutely no fillers to irritate and congest. Even without something to make it more occlusive on the skin, I have found my skin still retains moisture and stays hydrated over the day. I am combination in my skin, but those changes in my skin range from really dry to really oily in some places and this moisturizer has really balanced me out as well as clear my breakouts. All in all, and with price not a factor, this product has the potential to actually change the skin and do exactly what it says. No fillers means it will penetrate farther than a traditional moisturizer, giving it the power to really clear out the poor and utilize all of the natural active ingredients that this product has. AMAZING PRODUCT!

I love this oil. It leaves my skin so soft and plumped, and it smells AMAZING. I love that it is a clean beauty brand that I know I can trust, as well. The only drawback is the price. It is quite expensive, but a little goes a long way. And honestly, I’ll probably buy it again. Taking care of my skin is one of my little self-care indulgences I do for myself.

Not sure if it was just luck - but I used a sample on my cruise trip and my huge nose pores were visibly smaller!  As noted on many other reviews, it is the first clay mask that didn’t leave my face feeling dry and stripped.

OMG this is easily my favorite product from Tata Harper. The smell is ah-mazing!! Put a pump onto my fingers and rub my hands together. Place it over my nose and take a deep breath. Massage it throughout the rest of my face. Let the spa experience begin. This cleanser is very luxurious and rich. Makes my skin soft and melts away all my make-up. I usually follow it with either TH purifying or clarifying cleanser :) love all 3 cleansers -but can’t live without this one!!

I have eczema and was looking for a gentle moisturizer for my sensitive but dry skin.  This was recommended to me by someone in the store and it is the best facial moisturizer I have ever used.  My skin feels so soft and nourished after I put it on.  My only complaint is the price but I will most likely repurchase the product when I run out.
I was really disappointed I don’t know how to use two of them it like there the same thing.

I got this as a sample and it’s amazing. I’m surprised it says for oily skin, I have fairly dry skin and found it moisturized really well. My skin has been even and looking great. The only downside is the smell, and it kind of lingers on your face.

I received a sample of this and really liked it, but I’m disappointed with the cost. WAY too much! I’ll stick with Ole Henrikson Counter Balance Oil Control Hydrator. Both provide moisture and control oil, but Ole does it for about 1/3 of the cost.

I wanted to love these products so so much because I’ve only heard good things. However, within 3 days of using them, I had clogged pores, rougher skin texture, and breakouts. I’ve been pretty breakout-free for about two years now, and I’m realizing that it must be due to using products without any intense fragrances/essential oils.
