I’ve been using mostly Herbivore and Laneige products, and mixing these products in gradually sent my skin into remission from the very smooth and soft skin texture I’ve been able to improve on. I do think the resurfacing mask is great, but the other products just didn’t work for me.

I was super skeptical because I’ve been let down by pricey products before. But this serum is no joke. I have super sensitive skin and I’ve had no issues. Only 5 days in and already seeing a positive difference in texture, hydration and reduced redness. I’m absolutely in love. I hope they never stop making this.

This mask smells really good and it leaves my skin glowing and smooth! My skin is very dry and this mask doesn’t help that but if you follow with a good moisturizer it’s all good! This is definitely my favorite clay mask!

This is by far my favourite oil cleanser. It is packed with beautiful ingredients so I wouldn’t use this as a make up remover but as a second cleanser. It’s it the only oil that nourish your skin without leaving any greasy residue. It transforms into a gentle milk and it can be rinsed completely.
Light herbal scent. The only con is that it’s a bit expensive but if you can afford it, go for it!

This is an amazing mask. Probably one of the best i’ve tried. It cleans my pores and doesn’t dry out my skin leaving it refreshed. I love the tingling and cooling sensation of this mask. The only problem is the price and the fact that you do have to apply a thick layer so it is a pretty expensive product compared to the number of uses you get out of it.

I was skeptical when I first ordered this, because basically every “cleansing“ mask, especially those made with clay, leaves my skin very dry and tight. I only wanted to give this a try because of the vib sale, and thought it was very small amount for the price when I first opened it, ready to return it the next day. But I have to say I love it!!!! It’s surprisingly not drying at all, has a nice natural smell, and leaves my skin clean and soft. Not to mention it’s all natural. I still wish it’s less expensive, but its a keeper!
I have this on my face right now and I feel it working. It smells amazing and has a nice tingle. My skin is loving this!

I did like the toner initially, doesn’t cause breakouts, calming, gentle, refreshing, etc. Also, the ingredient list is not bad either. A lot of calming and gentle ingredients. But I just can’t recommend the product as a general rec, product performance/price point/quantity is just not worth it. I do love the toner but I have found much better alternatives, do your research and you will most definitely find a “gentle“ toner just as good. If not and money is not an issue, go ahead and splurge.

I love the way this oil rolls on, it’s just the right amount applied to skin.  It has made my fine lines around my eyes and forehead disappear! My sister gave me a trial size for Christmas and I loved how it changed the texture of my skin ; so I bought a full size bottle. I took it on a cruise and used it after sunning and it was rejuvenating. It has an herbal smell which I really like. I put it on in the morning after cleansing and then again at night post facial washing. I highly recommend this product.

I bought this after receiving an in-store facial by a Tata Harper rep. My skin looked glowing that day, so I went back and purchased. There are a few products in this kit that I love and a few that are just okay. I love using the cleanser and mask together. They did this during the facial and it was good. I also like the oil a lot. I have used kit for about a month and really saw no difference and it’s not moisturizing enough for my super dry skin. I have found they have another moisturizer that may be better for dry skin, but it is SO expensive. I will most likely try the cleanser/mask combo again.

It’s a great starter pack to try out the different Tata Harper products. These were much smaller than I expected but some of the pump bottles lasted me a good 2 weeks of daily use. I personally liked the regenerating cleanser and resurfacing mask; will definitely purchase the full sizes! The moisturizer and essence were okay for me. If you’re not ready to splurge on Tata Harper products, this is a great start to know what you want.

I’m surprised by how much I love this cleanser. I use it at the end of the day to take of my makeup and it gets it all - including eye makeup. It leaves behind a little bit of an oily feeling residue (I wipe it off with a towel) that freaked me out at first, but my skin has never looked better. I credit this cleanser with smoothing out my skin in general, and my crow’s feet especially, making it worth it’s weight in gold (and it costs almost as much). I have “normal“ skin, not prone to breakouts, so I can’t say if this cleanser is appropriate for everyone.
used this while on accutane and loved how hydrated and smooth my skin felt after

Doesn’t work for me... I redeemed three 10ml samples of this, and have used it solely for a long period of time. This moisturizer is hydrating and smells great. But I don’t see any other effects. Is not worth the price tag.Spend your money on a nice serum, not this.

Pricey for the size but loved the mask! I’d prefer to pay more for a larger size. Packaging seems to outweigh product, in the case. Not sure if this one will stay in the rotation but I am a huge fan of the Tata Brand. Love to support ’made in North America’ company with small batch manufacturing and sustainable products.
This cleanser is amazing! I love the glass bottle it makes for a very luxe experience! This is so soft and gentle on my skin. I would recommend this to all friends and family this product is amazing!
Way way way too perfumed.  I know this is supposed to be a clean product but it is so scented it gave me a migraine.

Such a beautiful moisturizer with dreamy milky texture! My sensitive skin absolutely loves it! It feels super lightweight and doesn’t cause any reaction. I love that it’s fragrance free and clean. The packaging looks stunning on my vanity!

I used this for about a week on my dry dehydrated skin and I didn’t notice a single difference. There are much better cheaper timers out there. The smell was pretty strong but didn’t bother me too much, what I couldn’t get passed was the spray bottle. The smaller sized bottle has a spray that doesn’t mist it just shoots streams of water at your face. It’s a waste of a very expensive product that doesn’t actually hydrate the skin. Returning it to the store.

I feel like this was a pretty good way to sample these products, although there wasn’t enough of the eye product to really tell if I liked it or not. But this kit has lasted me a couple of weeks and my skin is glowing so I’m definitely happy with it. The hydrating floral mist smells a little weird, and not at all like I thought it would based on the name, but it works well and the smell goes away.

Thanks to this kit, I became a Tata Harper fanatic. This kit changed my entire skin regime. It makes my face glow. I have spent over 8000 on skin products and skincare and this brand us the best I have ever used. I have the entire line thanks to this kit. Definitely recommend it. It will change your skin.

Nothing has helped clarify my skin like beginning a double-cleansing routine. This oil cleanser from Tata Harper  fits the bill for step one of a double cleanse. (I like Tarte Deep Dive gel cleanser for step two.) It’s very gentle, smells heavenly and rinses cleanly.  My skin has its redness level toned down (I have sensitive skin with rosacea) by this oil cleanser. A win-win all around.
I was disappointed because on the description it says that includes an eye cream and the package came with no eye cream.

To start with the good, the green glass packaging is gorgeous. The product is lightweight - disturbingly so, for someone who loves thick creams - yet actually surprisingly (just) sufficient for my dry, sensitive skin, even during these colder months. It applies evenly, skin feels moisturized (not hydrated) with a good layer or two on, and it sat well over other products and under makeup for me. The problem is that I saw no actual benefit to my skin, no lasting hydration or brightness or firmness etc, just dry skin again after a few hours. It is finicky enough to not be an easy sort of moisturizer you just slather on willy nilly, but then also, for me, not special enough to really have a place in my regimen, not even during warmer months. Personally, I didn’t notice an added scent (aside from those of natural, non-fragranced ingredients).

I recently started using this product and it does work - my only hesitation in giving it 5 stars is I’m not sure it’s worth the price. I appreciate how sustainable Tata is as a brand so I understand it makes it more expensive but if you had to choose which Tata product to purchase I’d recommend the water cream over this.

Great product for getting rid of tricky blackheads! I ordered this product a few weeks ago and when it arrived, I discovered it was dried out. I called Sephora’s customer help line immediately and they gave me to option of a refund or they’d ship me another. The second mask arrived in perfect condition. I’ve read a couple complaints from others saying that their product also arrived dried out, so there must have been a bad batch. No harm done in the end since the company just sent me a new, undamaged product.
This is the perfect oil makeup remover. Honestly I can’t use oils for my skin, but this is just amazing. I will repurchase.

I adore practically everything in Tata Harper’s lineup, and this all-natural oil cleanser is no exception. It dissolves dirt, pollution, makeup, and other icky impurities, plus so much more. It leaves skin baby soft, heals chapped lips, and keeps your moisture barrier intact. In summary? It is effective, gentle, and smells divine. I love the packaging too. It is the prettiest bottle and has a handy pump dispenser. For a great double cleanse, start with this (massage it onto dry skin – you can even apply it to your lips and eyelids – and rinse with warm water) and follow up with Tata Harper’s Regenerating Cleanser. This Nourishing Oil Cleanser is a new fave. I don’t know how I lived without it!

Tata Tata...

As much as I love this product ( because it smells sooo good) you have completely missed out on its main purpose: MOISTURIZE!  I think you got so carried away with its floral smells that you forgot to deliver its primary purpose. I don’t think people are buying it so they can smell like flowers. If I want to smell them I ll go to the garden but instead i need to moisturize my skin and I went ahead and bought the kit. Next day my skin was untouched. Even though I tried all the moisturizers none of them did anything. Absolutely dry skin and not even a little softness to it. You need to reformulate it so it does what a typical cream is supposed to do, especially for the price you have given it. Once again- I need to hydrate my skin I don’t need to smell like flowers without chemicals...I can get that anywhere. Sorry but unless this product is  reformulated it is useless and an absolute waste of money.

Love this moisturizer! I have recently added some anti aging skincare to my routine. I needed a clean, simple, no scent moisturizer... this is the best. I was unsure about cost I’ve never spent this much on a moisturizer, but I tried a sample and ordered the large size after a few uses. My skin feels sooo good, Curious to try more Tata products.

I am not sure what this is supposed to do because I don’t feel it does anything! Nothing positive but also nothing negative. The smell is a bit off putting and when you spritz, the liquid also drips down the nozzle leaving your hand wet. Overall definitely not worth the price. I feel that this is just a cash grab for Tara Harper.

I read all the rave reviews and decided to give this line a try.  Not a fan.  The smell is very powerful (I didn’t mind it so much but I could see how others would find it overwhelming).  The moisturizer was useless on my dry skin and the serum did nothing.  Only product I liked was the cleanser as it’s exfoliating but still not worth the price tag for me.

So this smells amazing, and the spray nozzle distributes the product evenly. It soaks quickly into the skin.It is lightly moisturizing.

I do think this product is moisturizing, but not especially so. I could see using it as a pick me up, but if you religiously use toner I think this product might disappoint you,
Your skin will thank you for this. It smells good and gives you the instant result! I tried this at the in-store facial service, and I brought it right away.

I have never tried a face mask that made my skin feel this good. My skin is super dry so a lot of them end up drying it out, but this made it SO moisturized in the most gentle way. The texture is incredible and the ingredients are amazing- I really can’t say enough good things. I also love how you don’t have to wash it off and you can use a towel to gently wipe it. It’s definitely pricey but 100% worth it to me now! A little goes a long way too.

I’ve been trying this off and on for a few weeks now and I notice that it breaks me out every single use. Although it leaves my skin beautifully hydrated and glowing, it’s just not worth the blemishes. It also gets tacky when it dries. Aside from that, I quite enjoy its earthy scent. I’ll still be returning due to the breakout situation.

I rarely have skin issues but I bought several products from Tata and my skin broke out every time I used it.  I continued to use it because it was so expensive.  There is too much fragrance in these products, my skin was soft but looked like I had hives.  Just be aware before you spend the money.

Once again I’m in love with another Tata Harper product!!!!I know some reviewers dislike the rollerball packaging that this comes in but I personally don’t hate it. It’s not my favourite way to put an oil on my face but I find it works well and distributes the product pretty well.The scent is heavenly as with all the other products in this line it has the strong floral scent which I love. You only smell it until the product is absorbed I find...I have combination skin that is SUPER sensitive and have been loving layering this over my moisturizer usually at night but also during the day when I need some extra hydration! It sinks into my skin and feels light while being super hydrating which I love. I love. I also use on my lips as another review mentioned. It’s a beautiful product!Next I need to invest in a moisturizer from this line!!

This moisturizer is amazing! I’m only 2 days in from using the Clarifying Cleanser & this moisturizer & omg. The difference in my skin in those short couple of uses is amazing. It’s a light moisturizer. I think this could replace my primer as well.

First and foremost- I have tried everything for sensitive skin. Tata Harper has become my absolute go-to. But this mask soothes, hydrates, and leaves my skin feeling amazing! This mask goes on smooth and feels gentle and silky. There is no tightening or pulling and my skin feels gentle and plump under this mask. Although it is a small amount- I can’t say enough about how worthwhile this product is. And yes- even for the price tag. My mom sent me this after I moved from the east coast to Colorado. The deadly dry air was troubling my skin and as someone with super sensitive skin and Rosacea, I struggle to keep my skin moisturized because I always have a bad reaction to products - even ones I use daily. Because of this, I am super careful shelling out $$$. This mask has been a godsend. I am truly excited to share this product with friends because I’m 29, and I’ve always looked young- but the dry air was making my skin age quickly. This is the secret we have all been looking for!  I cannot stress this enough- try this product if you have sensitive skin or want clean beauty!

I have the clay & the resurfacing mask and I use them without any results... I didn’t return them since there isn’t many options for organic/ natural products safe during pregnancy and lactation... OVERPRICED PRODUCTS, I just make myself believe that works enough just to keep them

I bought this set to take on vacation with me and while I enjoyed it quite a bit, the sizes of everything are SO small, I simply can’t justify that it’s worth the steep price. There is a decent amount of all of the products except for the cleanser which was used up almost immediately while I still had plenty of the other ones. Felt kind of jipped to be honest!

I am very impressed by all the ingredients but in reality this is average moisturizer at best.After few weeks of using it did I not see any improvements .I have dry,mature skin and is not rich enough for my skin type

I am pretty familiar with Tata Harper Products but this is was a new one for me… recently, I spent a decent amount of money purchasing masks and samples of masks because I am trying to find the best products for my skin care type. I think this is a very premium, luxurious mask. This is investment in your face because Tata is not cheap. I have used this mask twice in a week and the results were noticeable, yet I would need more time to see if it makes a long-term difference. First off, the smell is amazing - as always. When you put it on, and let it dry - it makes your face nice and tight and actually feels so good (to me),  because to me tightness = product doing its job. One tip I’ve learned over the years when applying masks that are tightening - is to keep any and all facial movements to a minimum. The more pristine the mask is on your face, and the longer you can go without touching any muscles or talking… For me, (personally) just makes it work better. I liked it overall… I had a nice, natural glow to my face. Because I used it at night I did not notice it the next day but it does do a good job of clearing out all of the little blemishes you may have on your face. My skin type is combinations and I have occasional hormonal breakouts. Since I’ve started using a nightly regimen that has decreased. So with my focus solely being on masks, the Tata Harper mask is one that I would definitely recommend to try/test/observe it - and the longer you can do this, the better chances you have of making and accurate decision on whether this is worthy investment for you! In conclusion, this is truly one product I am going to add to my “products to consider “list. I simply just need more time to experiment and document my results to see if I want to invest and not just this mask, but the Tata Harper line in general...;)

I HIGHLY recommend this kit! Like HIGHLY!!! This is a great kit. And believe me when I say a little goes a long way. I first started out with a sample of the mask. Absolutely LOVED it! So I thought well I want to get the full size, then I saw this kit was only $2 more and it has the full size. At first you think THIS is the size?! But you serious do not need a lot! So not only does it feel amazing on your skin, but I have VERY sensitive skin and it does not irritate it whatsoever. I haven’t had a product I was this happy with in a while. There were dramatic results for me overnight! A little story about my sensitive skin for you - this past weekend my mom got a new laundry detergent and when she hugged me I could tell it was different. That very day my face started breaking out. I had about 20 teeny tiny zits on my cheeks. Made my cheeks extremely red. I got the kit on Monday, by the way, Monday morning I woke up and my face was so red it looked like I just put blush all over my cheeks. So that night I got home from work, washed my face, put the mast on, cleaned it off then used the moisturizer. Tuesday - Not only did I only have THREE zits but ALL the redness was gone. This has been like a miracle kit for my sensitive skin! It feels great, it doesn’t burn, and the mask doesn’t get so hard it hurts your face. I definitely recommend this to someone with highly sensitive skin. I don’t know if it’s supposed to help with breakouts too but it definitely worked for that too!

The item arrived mid-May 2020 and it was a bit dried out when I opened it. I wrote to customer service and have not heard back yet. I did not check the reviews before purchasing  because I’ve used this product before but now I see this is an issue that has been happening A LOT. I looked into the batch number (Tata Harper’s official site has a section that makes it easy for you to track) and the bottle sent to me was produced Dec 4, 2017. It’s near the end of it’s shelf life and from the reviews I’m assuming the bottle I have may have been returned and resold before since this item does not have a seal. I’ve learned my lesson now. I will always check the batch number before putting anything on my face.

I put on base makeup almost every day, so I’ve been switching makeup remover since I was a teenager. I believe in oil because it is the most efficient cleanser to remove makeup. But they all make me worry that either my pore will be clogged, or my skin will be extremely dehydrated because of the emulsifier. But this Tata Harper oil cleanser is not the case. It smells like heaven and contains really great ingredients. It won’t be emusified super quickly once you splash some water, but it is definitely not greasy. You can only feel your skin left very fresh and hydrating after using it. I even use it sometimes in the winter mornings, just to make my skin more nourished. I will never reach to any other cleansing oil ever again!

I like a lot of the Tata Harper lines, but this is the WORST oil cleanser I have ever used. It doesn’t remove makeup. At all. All it does is create an oily film on your face that doesn’t dissolve at all. No matter how many times I splashed my skin with this it just sat there on my face. I have used drugstore oil cleansers that are far superior to this. Do not waste your time or money with this one.
It is just okay. It does not clarify definitely.

I can not stress enough how much I love this cleanser.  I’m 37, combo skin, definitely aging. I get Botox and filler maintenance etc..  I’m on my second bottle of this stuff and TBH I was hesitant because it’s an oil and a bit scared that it would make me oilily and, this sounds silly but, get on my hairline and make my hair greasy. Ha. It has done none of that! I will forever use this cleanser. After using it, I wipe my face with a Beauty Chef probiotic toner (stinky, pricey, but WORTH it) and my cotton round has zero makeup on it. Meaning this Harper cleanser took off all of my makeup. Claims it doesn’t strip off natural oils and very true. It’s actually made my face much clearer and plump! The price is up there for sure but trust me, you HAVE TO TRY it! I now use 6 other products in her line.  The Hydrating spray and body oil is to die for.

Good value for money overall.Scent is okay, more herbal than floral.Moisturizer could be a bit more moisturizing - would recommend it for summer rather than fall/winter/spring.Unpleasant surprise the eye cream sample that is listed in the description of this kit was >NOT< included.Does not make he weather, given that the sample was so small, but the advertisement should be corrected.

I was looking forward to using this product, but have been disappointed from the get go.The packaging was mediocre, and for a company which promotes eco-friendliness, there was certainly a lot of paper/card packaging.The directions suggested a one pump use for the face, I needed three to four for my face, neck and décolleté. The spread of the product is not very good at all, hence the need to use a couple more pumps than is suggested. Moreover, the product does not absorb at all. It just sort of sits on my skin. I realize this is a natural product, but the ingredients don’t seem to read that way. Having said that, the product absolutely stinks. I haven’t figured it out, but it smells something like a gas station, or some sort of bleach or something, just bad. The smell just lingers. On top of that, this moisturizer has just caused my skin to be nothing but itchy, I have seen red patches and tiny white bumps. I am returning this product asap, because as soon as I stopped using it and reverted back to my regular routine, my complexion came back.

Best. Toner. Ever. They call it an essence, but im not picky about titles. Clean ingredients,  just the right amount of scent, helps treatments absorb most efficiently, easy on my sensitive (with rosacea) skin.

I was excited to use the superkind line from Tata Harper. I’m usually not sensitive to scent but I do enjoy products that are fragrance free for my skin care routine. I also like that it helps calming sensitive skin and helps build up the skin barrier.

This serum definitely lives up to its clean, natural and nontoxicconcept! I really love this item because it helped hydrate my dry skin and made it less dull! I felt my skin feeling hydrated and glowing after using this a few times. I highly recommend this product to anyone and will be purchasing it in the future! This was gifted by Tata Harper.
I have been using this line for a little over a year. and my skin has never looked or felt better! Makeup goes on great. Skin looks so radiant and fresh!
One of the only Vit A products that it Palm Oil and palm oil derivatives free.

Absolute fave! I have the caudalie spray and caudalie hydrating toner as well at tarts rainforest of the sea spray and they don’t come anywhere near this one. Works amazingly to help absorb moisturizer and serum and as a finishing spray or hydration boost. The caudalie spray has to much essential oil or something it drys my skin and gives a weird texture incase you were trying to pick between the two. I wish I never bought that one. This is a win!! Love Tata and LOVE this mist!!

I’ll have to admit, it is a pretty pricey item but it does an amazing job with keeping my skin super hydrated throughout the day. Haven’t found a spray that keeps my skin hydrated till now.I first started using the essence when I was pregnant. Before pregnancy, my skin was normal to dry. During pregnancy, my skin became dry to extra dry with flakiness on my chin, around my mouth and nose. My regimen would consist of using the spray before a serum and moisturizer. If I am wearing makeup I also set it with the essence which helps make my foundation look more like skin considering the textured areas I have on my face.
Excellent product! My skin is combination in summer and in winter very dry. Living in Canada I was struggling what to use and this product worked and my skin felt rehydrated!

I really wanted to like this product since I’m transitioning to clean, non-toxic products, but after testing the product for about a month, I would not repurchase.My main issue was the pump. I had to push down at just the right spot in order to pump out any product. And you can forget about having any control over the amount that comes out.While I enjoyed massaging my face with the thicker, more luxurious feeling oil, it took significantly longer to remove all traces of makeup compared to any cleansing oil I’ve used in the past.The process of washing off the product was not super pleasant either. I found the oil a bit slimy upon removal. I will say that It left my face smooth and glowy afterwards, but I think I can find a similar product without the negatives I listed above.
Would totally be 5star..... but the serum an moisturizer smells awful when I use this with my skin routine but I guess I can get used to it lol but I love the mask soooo much
This is a GREAT purifying mask--my husband and I have both used it and it really works well

As with all of Tata Harper’s products this scented moisturizer is not for those who are scent sensitive. It’s exactly what I was looking for: a clean line (1-2 on EWG scale), cruelty free, and has hyaluronic acid. I’ve read that hyaluronic acid is good for dry and dehydrated skin (which I have) and one pump over the serum does the trick. It’s moisturizing without being greasy and leaves a somewhat matte finish once it has absorbed. Very pleased.

I love the smell of this product, I wanted to love it. I didn’t. The eye creme was way too small of a sample to really notice if it had any impact, 2x use max. The rest of the products were average and the moisturizer was not much of a moisturizer. I needed to use the oil on top of it for any benefit.

Love to layer between Vitamin C and Serum in the AM as well as a little refreshing throughout the day. Dropped one star due to the nozzle,it sprays everywhere... and I mean everywhere! Heard this was an issue with earlier releases and perhaps I got an old batch but for the price I would hope this will be resolved soon. To counter, I now have a daily habit of pushing back my robe so that when I do spray, the essence reaches my face, neck, shoulders, and other body parts instead of hydrating my clothes... I want the product on me! =)

I was really excited for the release of this serum because my skin is super sensitive and I have to use fragrance free products or I’ll break out. They are hard to find, especially from clean brands. I absolutely love the feel of this and my skin drinks it up and looks more hydrated and smooth in the morning.
Got this sample and I’m in love with it. Going to have to purchase it soon. Very moisturizing and makes my makeup better. The smell is strong but it smells like roses.
Love the scent, has a pleasant oil-like balm consistency. Have never had my skin look dewier (and have even used it as a night mask for extra hydration in the AM). Worth the splurge.

This is by far the best mask I’ve tried from Sephora. I didn’t know my skin could ever feel as soft as it did after just the first time using it. The ingredients are phenomenal too - even though it’s purifying it still nourishes with ingredients like aloe, arnica and calendula. I don’t think it’s necessary to apply a thick layer. The difference in results was marginal. With it.

Love this product and it made me want to buy more however there are some issues with this kit. It shows 6 products but you only get 5, no resurfacing mask is included. Also, the serum only comes half full so just use small amounts.

This serum is amazing. I only use it at night and the results are amazing. It soaks and softens my skin. It even smells incredible too. It is the best serum that I have ever used for my face. Love everything about this product.

tried this in a sample box. Was really excited to try a Tata Harper product as i have always heard great things. I was very disappointed in this product. The smell is terrible. The lotion is very thin, which i dont mind, but did nothing to moisturize my dry skin.
I am so disappointed in this kit.  The scents are so overpowering and it makes me break out.  I really wanted to love this brand.  They seem to have a great mission, but it’s just not for me.
The smell is awesome , the texture on top of the serum is awesome In all just an awesome product
I am a huge fan of tata, and i got this sample box for my bestie and she absolutely loved it!!!!!

Ladies, STOP giving this company your money.  This product has absolutely NO notable ingredients so you can expect NO EFFECTS from using this product.  I suggest you look at the ingredients next time you buy a product!

Not worth it. This was my first mask from Tata Harper and it barely stayed on my face when applied. I wasn’t really sure if I was using it correctly, until I read other reviews. Even though, this was not a super recent purchase, I haven’t had it for long and it’s already completely dried out and unusable. Really disappointing as I was looking forward to a deep pore cleanse today. Fortunately, I have the glow mask from Tata and used that instead (review to come). Don’t waste your $$$ with this product though.

i’ve been using Tata products religiously for about a year and a half and will never use anything else again! i’ve tried them all if not almost all.. Bobbi Brown, Clinique, Dior, Lancome, Lauder, ole henrikson, origins etc... and nothing compares to this line.. it is pricy but you only need a pea size a bottle lasts me 6 mos or so.. i use this am and josie maran argan in the pm.. i have normal/dry skin and this works wonders!

Mask is quite thick and mud like. Easy to apply but boy does is harden after 20 minutes. Takes a lot of negotiating with warm water to remove it all (and the clay stained my face cloths). I will say.... MY SKIN WAS SO SMOOTH AFTERWARDS. WOW.

I don’t understand some of these negative reviews. I am 25 years old and undergoing some of the harshest acne treatments on the market and this moisturizer is a DREAM for me. When writing this, it is summertime, so I cannot speak to how this will hold up in the winter (i’ll probably have to switch to their creme riche formula). I use 2 pumps of this for my whole face and neck - you really don’t need a lot. When you apply the moisturizer you might be thinking “wow, this sank into my skin really fast and doesn’t feel like I moisturized“ but that’s because the formula enters the skin quickly and keeps your skin moisturized all day without leaving a thick greasy film on your face - if that’s what you’re after, don’t get this product. It is moisturizing enough for someone who is undergoing harsh acne treatments and has perpetually dry skin. This absorbs quickly, smells fresh and clean, and leaves my skin looking like a porcelain doll.

I first bought a bottle during one of the vib sales last year and I grew to love it greatly. The smell doesn’t bother me because it is a natural plant or aromatherapy type of smell. I like the aromatherapy smell and find it uplifting.  To me, the scent is not unpleasant and goes away immediately. There is inconsistency in the manufacturing process with some bottles coming with a better nozzle and others not. I bought 2 bottles during the last vib sale and I had to go back and switch the first bottle that I broke open because 1) I discovered the formulation has changed since last year. Not sure it may be the same ingredients but something about the recipe has changed. Not as moisturizing and more drying. 2)I handle all of my cosmetics carefully making sure they are kept in cool dry place and I discovered this strangle cloudy wispy white matter floating around in the bottle 1 month later like some contaminant had gotten into it. I still have 1 brand new unopened 2nd bottle that I’m thinking of returning. I had such nice memories of the previous formulation so it’s a tough decision.

This mask is amazing. It smells subtlety of real, fresh ginger and gives a cooling sensation to my skin while it’s on. The texture is almost clay-like but does not dry out your skin. It did not irritate my eyes and left my skin feeling fresh and awake.

This is how I can afford to use Tata Harper.  I LOVER HER PRODUCTS, but they are expensive.  So I buy kits, buy when stores have gifts with purchase, get samples, and twice a year Tata sells travel sizes of her products on her website and I stock up.  I LOVE, LOVE, LOVE the Regenerating Cleanser and won’t be without it.  Another product that I love is the Retinoic Nutrient Face Oil which I also won’t be without.  I love everything in this kit.  Love the fact that the products are natural, love the scents and my 67 year old skin loves them.  The kits lasts me because I alternate my skincare with ARCONA and Sunday Riley.

I’ve only been using this moisturizer for a few days but wow! This has already made a big difference in my skin. I noticed the next morning how much better my makeup lasted and looked with this on underneath. It’s a bit pricey but I think it’s worth it! The smell is a little funky but it goes away after a while. Would still recommend!

I like the feel of this mask. While it doesn’t clear your pores or get rid of your blackheads, it makes them much easier to extract. That said, there is very little product. Container is not close to being filled to the top and I finished it in a little under 3 weeks only using it 3 times a week..

I recently started using the Tata Harper line and it has changed my skin and the way I think about treating my skin. This is a different kind of cleanser. It’s 100% natural, it’s gentle, removes makeup, and doesn’t strip the natural oils from your skin. Your skin never feels dry afterwards. And it will thank you for it.

Mine was not dried out or anything, but for the price I was expecting more product. The product felt cool and silky and made my skin feel fresh afterwards, but the small size of the jar made it not worth the price. Unfortunately, I probably will buy again because it is nickel and thimerosal  free and there are not very many products that commit to that.

It seems to work well at freshening up my oil slicked face, but I wouldn’t repurchase. I either got a defective jar, a returned jar, or... this is just how it is??? I’d say the jar was only ⅔ of the way full and it’s not a large jar to begin with. It was also super dry and cakey which made it challenging to apply. I ended up having to gob a bit on my face and then add water so I could spread it around. Not an enjoyable experience. Because of all this I only got three uses out of it. THREE!If you plan to buy I’d do so in store and check the product first.
Received a Gwp sample.  It smells like a barnyard!  Horrid.  I had to wipe it off right away.  Not sure if it was spoiled or if it usually smells like a dog’s chew hoof!

It smells incredible, feels incredible, and is natural! I am a newly obsessed fan of Tata Harper. I can’t get enough! My skin feels incredible. I use a toner (100% pure), then Tata Harper Rejuvenating Serum, Josie Maran Argan Oil, then this Replenishing Nutrient Complex, and my skin has never felt or looked better!

I received this moisturizer as a free sample size with another purchase I made from sephora and OH MY GOD I finally got what I was looking for so long. I tried so many different moisturizers, expensive, not expensive, organic and regular and none of them came even close to what this product does. Most of them would deliver good effect for a short period of time but then would start to make the skin look very dull. Not with this one. I’ve been using it for a while now and the skin gets better the more I use it. The minute I applied it to my face, the skin immediately felt so nourished and moisturized (and I live in a very dry environment). After about 10 minutes you start to see the clarifying effect. My skin looks so much lighter, radiant and even toned. It gives you this look of supple, dewy natural skin. I read some other comments saying that it has unpleasant scent that lingers which is absolutely not true, I’m pretty sure those are just competitors trying to advertise other products. The moisturizer does have a strong scent as you first smell it (which I actually like cause it has this very natural smell) but it doesn’t linger for long. I just tested it on my hand and the scent goes away in like 10 mins to the point where you can barely smell it. Please don’t change the formula just cause of some people’s complains on scent. I love this product and will stick with this company for a long time. Worth every penny.

Compared to other moisturizers, this is quite light.  I almost always find myself applying another moisturizer over it because my face still feels dry.  I think it would be wonderful for teens or people who do not need a lot of hydration.  I can understand why some might dislike the smell because it’s different; it’s fresh and it reminds me of the outdoors.  I received a small bottle in the “Scouted by Sephora“ box and I was shocked when I saw the price of the full-size bottle.  Personally, I do not think it’s worth it.

A treat for sure. Smells great and hydrates well. No burning or redness on my sensitive face. I personally think the best results happen after 15 min when mask sort of melts with the warmth of the skin. So light and moisturizing. It just feels like a quality product and the glass bottle is a plus.

This was given to me first as a gift and I immediately fell in love. Not only did I buy the full sized bottles, I reordered this kit again to use for traveling. My skin has never looked so good, my oil is under control and all the products smell amazing!!

Something seems different about this mask, I haven’t even read the ingredients but I love it & how my skin feels and looks after using it. I got the small sample & have been trying not to use it up too quickly.  It does seem to go a long way. The hefty price tag has been holding me back but I don’t normally skimp on skincare so I won’t start now, not for this mask anyway!

Agree with the other reviews. I bought this 23 months after manufacturing according to the Tata batch number. I didn’t check it and did have to leave my stuff for a few months due to COVID. Completely unusable, dried out, half empty, won’t stay on my face. A very expensive mistake to not have checked it right when I purchased as it was likely already dried out by that time. Too bad as I had heard great things about it’s powers!

This moisturizer is good! It is first time to try it, and I like it it so much. It helps my skin feel smooth. I have an sensitive skin, and it works well for me! One thing i would like to mention it is fragrance free, and I enjoyed it so much. I would like to try different products from this brand.

This mask left my skin feeling very soft, reduced the appearance of blemishes and did not dry out my skin. I am very prone to break outs when using new products and did not have that problem at all with this mask. I love it! I gave it 4 stars because it is quite a small amount for the price tag.

I got a deluxe sample of this from an online order and I like it, but I’mnot sure if I love it. The smell kind of threw me, it doesn’t smell awful, but it also doesn’t smell that great... the colour is the exact same as the bottle too, and was also not expecting that lol. I was able to get 2 uses out of the sample bottle and each time I used it I did not see a big difference in my skin. It may have helped with my pores a bit, but did not help with the bit of acne I had both times, or my oily tzone. It did make my skin soft though, but for the price you pay, I don’t think I will be purchasing this.

Was gifted by Tata Harper Skincare. This serum is has a silky texture which is very lightweight. After use the serum gives my skin such a lovely glow. The serum feels amazing on my skin, it soothes it and gives me great hydration. Highly recommend!

I never ever break out after using this cleansers. If I go away and use a different cleanser I always regret it because my skin just isn’t the same. I immediately come home and use this cleanser and my skin is cleared up. I used to swear by the eve lom cleanser but I switched to this because it works just as great and it’s cheaper and lasts just as long.

I am a fan of this moisturizer. I love natural Jasmine, which is the essential oil in this, and love that it is 100% natural and free from silicone which seems to cause breakouts for me. I spray a rose floral water, then apply this while my face is still moist and it absorbs really well.
so expensive but I think it may be worth it. It’s like botox is a balm. LOVE

Be prepared to completely change your skincare routine because this kit is incredible! I used every product and had about a month of use of the main ones (moisturizer, serum etc). I have since purchased most of them in full size. The mask transformed my skin and the essence is just a treat for the senses. Can’t say enough good things about this brand and the effective and natural products!

I tried the sample of this and this was amazing! as soon as I took it off I saw a difference and it made my skin glow Ive been wanting to get the full product but its so expensive but I’m starting to think that it would be worth every penny

I bought the mini kit that includes this moisturizer. I love the scent of it. It’s a perfect ending to a night skincare routine. It’s very moisturizing and sinks into my skin beautifully. It does not irritate my skin nor cause any breakouts. I will be purchasing a full size in the future.

This moisturizer has a lightweight texture, and I didn’t expect it to be so moisturizing. My skin feels extremely soft and supple after using it. I love the packaging, it’s worth every cent - high quality glass with a pump, comes in thick carton box. Looks luxurious, it’s just so pleasant to use. I have sensitive skin and this moisturizer didn’t cause any bad reaction. A good moisturizer on the pricier side. Get it if you can afford. Otherwise there are many great cheaper options on the market.

I did not like this moisturizer at all. It didn’t feel like it fully absorbed into my skin, and somehow it made my pores look even bigger! My skin felt so gross I had to wash it off after a while, I just couldn’t take how greasy my skin felt.

This product is so luxurious. From the glass packaging and look of it, to the way it feels on my skin. It’s a great clean beauty moisturizer. I’m a fan, but with this kind of luxury, comes with a huge luxurious price tag. $120 is super expensive, but I’m glad I got to test it out.

I bought the mask a few months ago and really loved it so I decided to try the moisturizer. I’ve been using it every night for about 2 weeks and really like it! Worth the price because I don’t need a lot. It might be a bit rich for me as a morning moisturizer but perfect for the night!

I don’t know why they advertised this product for sensitive skin when the first thing that hits your nose is a heavily scented floral smell. This is going back to Sephora. I recommend Tara Harper Waterlock moisturizer instead.

I’ve been searching for a heavy duty moisturizer for a while. I live in Chicago and the winter skin is brutal. Pros:  All natural. Generous amount in jar (and you don’t need much per use). Hydrates the skin very well. Scent is pleasant not over powering (smells mostly of lavender and essential oils). Cons: Pricey. I wonder if it’ll expire quickly because of the all natural ingredients and I worry that I won’t finish the jar in time because you don’t need much per use. Has a few ingredients that are comedogenic - so it might break you out.  Ingredients seem to separate in the jar a bit (think the active bacteria in yogurt how it ends up at the top). I found since using this cream my skin has been truly well hydrated even in the bitter Chicago winter. My dry spots have almost all disappeared. I advise to use the cream as it says on the box for the best results: use a spatula to scoop out a small amount, warm it in your hands until it turns a white color, then press it into the skin. While my skin has been very well hydrated, the pores around my nose and cheeks have gotten clogged by this product. I do deeply wish someone could find a way to create a intense moisturizer that doesn’t have any comedogenic ingredients. That said, it isn’t so bad that I don’t want to use it more. It just means I have to adjust my routine a bit to try and counteract the blackheads. I particularly enjoy using this cream at night as the lavender scent is relaxing and the cream really gets time to sink into the skin as you sleep. I think I will use the jar in full but I can’t say it’s something I’d rebuy just due to the price and the comedogenic ingredients that aren’t meshing well with my skin.

I first tried this by using the trial size set - thought it was refreshing and didn’t see. So I decided to buy full bottle. When I received it, I forgot to shake the bottle like it suggested so after I sprayed it on my face, I wondered why do I smell like urine? I have no other way to describe it. SO I shook it the next time and it seemed okay, except weeks go by and it’s back again. I just can’t stomach the smell. It’s unfortunate because I really do like this product, but not enough due to the smell. I can only give 3 stars.

Got as a sample.  Made my skin soft and seems to be moisturizing but the smell. omg. its VERY strong. I’ve had the moisturizer on for over an hour and I can still smell it. if it was good smelling i wouldn’t mind but it smells strange to me..  smells like chemicals or something. not a fan of the smell at all. maybe if they could fix that it would be a better review but I just can’t over look that.
Good product but way overpriced.  There are a lot of other superior oil cleansers at Sephora for 1/2 the price of this.

I’m always in search of clean products. I had gotten a facial and was recommended this product and absolutely love it. Since ive tried other Tata Harper products and this one leaves my skin feeling great, not oily at all!  Im also getting ready to use the essence spray for that glow!

This moisturizer is fine. It does nothing it claims when it comes to pore reduction or clarifying. I’m never one to complain about strong smells, sometimes it’s what you sign up for in exchange for a good product, but this is not that and the smell is heinous - like burnt pine needles and it LINGERS. So not worth the high price tag.
I’m 46 years old and  have rosacea that flares up regularly, leaving redness that lasts for weeks - after using just a drop of serum

The good- it is a decent moisturizer, if you have normal, not dry skin. Worked fine for me in warm weather, but way too light weight for my winter skin. The bad- the smell (horrible), and the price (!!). For 100  dollars, I would have expected more. Does no better of a job than my $15 drugstore moisturizer, and certainly did not change the appearance of my skin. Wouldn’t recommend unless you don’t need a lot of hydration and have lots of money or blow. Disclaimer: I only had a sample, but I used it for a full week.

This is the best oil cleanser I have ever used!! It will take off waterproof mascara and long wear lipstick. I have really dry eye and very sensitive skin and it  doesn’t burn or dry them out. I love this cleanser. It leaves my skin so slow and clean. The smell is so divine.

this is definitely the best moisturizer I ever tried. This is a super silky texture  that cocoons my sensitive skin with moisture-retentive polysaccharides. There are a lot of ingredients I like. The hydraulic acid really have a good improvement my skin

I love this moisturizer! I’m acne prone and dehydrated and this keeps me hydrated throughout the day and not oily. And I’m obsessed with how good it smells!!! I grew up on natural products so very used to earthy scents, to me it smells like a spa.

I am a mask junkie.  That being said I am very picky about what I put on my face.  I use Tata Harper for my skin care so when this mask came out I jumped at the chance to try it.  And let me tell you it is amazing.

The texture is a mousse- cool to the touch and feels very luxurious when put on.  I use this mask whenever I feel my skin needs a little TLC.

This cleanser is so creamy and milky and gentle on my skin. It gives me a nice gentle clean without leaving my skin feeling stripped. I like that there is no fragrance added to irritate my skin. My skin can be reactive and I have no issues using this cleanser.

I am a HUGE fan of Tata Harper. I sample a wide variety of skincare products, just about everything under the sun. It takes quite a bit to impress me. I love the gentle formula of this moisturizer so much. It absorbs wonderfully, does not leave a greasy feel laying on top of your skin. It’s the gold standard for what a top tier moisturizer should be.

I have never in my life had a cleanser make such a difference in my skin. I have mature, dry skin and am very prone to dehydration. I usually have to layer a ton of skincare no matter what I cleanse with, and even then I’m left feeling dry in a few hours some days. After using this cleanser one time, my skin looked better overall. The crepiness from dehydration was almost totally gone, and my face felt smooth, and there was no tight/dry feeling whatsoever (which is something I’ve always had no matter what I used to cleanse). Within a week of daily use, I began to notice my fine lines looked softer and there was no more crepiness at all. I am a believer, I never imagined that finding the perfect cleanser would have such a monumental effect on my skincare and my overall complexion. I don’t have to layer tons of moisturizer anymore...just my nightly/morning face oil and serum! So, really, in the long run, even though it’s pricey I am saving money because I’ve been able to use much less moisturizer since I started cleansing with this Tata Harper oil! A HUGE win for me...I highly recommend!

Pros: natural ingredients, nice texture, takes off makeup effectively. Cons: difficult to rinse off (though not as much of an issue if you double cleanse) and expensive. I found an ECOCERT certified oil-based cleanser that works better for less than half the price.

I have facial redness/mild rosacea and spent close to a year searching for a moisturizer to help. This is THE BEST I have found. I use this at night and my face is noticeably less red in the morning, when used consistently. It only took a few days using a store sample to notice this effect. I bought the full bottle in the VIB sale to help with the cost. I’ve been using for 4 months and the bottle is close to halfway gone and I’m still loving it. If you have facial redness like me I highly recommend you try this. Dont let negative reviews from people with other needs deter you. I’m actually kind of sad to see this reviewed so poorly because its changed my appearance so much and I wish more people with my same problems were aware of how this could help them. I don’t mind the smell at all. Smell is a personal preference and this doesn’t deserve negative reviews because of that. It does have a thin consistency but I find it to be just as or more hydrating than some other thicker moisturizers. For me it is all about quality ingredients that affect the skin positively, and this delivers that in a way unlike any other for me. I am so happy I found this and will keep buying!

I’ve been a a Tata user when i starter using the pore detox oil cleanser and what can i say??I used to break out a lot and since the cleanser i have not. For moisturizer i used coconut oil but sometimes i feel like my skin would need more but im scared of putting more oil onto my skin since its already oily itself. Well i bought this oil and wow the next morning my skin was smooth like baby’s tush. Also the fact that Tata is clean at sephore makes me feel safe on not putting chemicals in face mostly bc im prone to acne at my age (21 yrs.)!The scent it not pleasant, but yet it works. Instead of drops, now it comes with a rollerball which makes it very easy to apply. Im

My new favorite product for this season is this Superkind Fortifying Moisturizer from Tata Harper Skincare for face and neck. It is very nurturing for the skin, you can immediately feel the hydration and healing of dry skin. It truly seems calmer and protected. Formula feels silky, I don’t think this would be ideal in hot weather because it is oily, but in the fall/winter season, it’s a must. I love that it’s hypoallergenic and fragrance free, although it has a natural leafy smell. I would definitely be purchasing and recommending this.
I’ve loved the TH products I had tried in the past. But this kit came with mystery products and no instructions for use. Also disappointed that the eye cream was basically a free single sample.

I have been buying this kit for several months. It lasts about a month, although the nutrient complex lasts longer for me. My skin is combination, doesn’t break out too often unless it’s from a product that my skin doesn’t like, and is blotchy. With this the oiliness is gone. I don’t break out. I still have blotchiness (mostly redness that I think is from food allergies) but it covers with makeup. The smells are unlike an natural products I’ve used and I’ve used many lines. I have purchased a full sized Floral Hydrating Essence because I run out of that first. It’s addicting. My only complaint is the price. It’s so hard to afford. The kit I can do and I’m trying to purchase one full size a month. But I feel after years I’ve finally found a line I love. And I recommend sticking to one line of products. I had never done that until a couple years ago and it makes a huge difference, in my opinion!

It took me a while to find something like this mainly because I have combination-normal skin with cystic acne. That’s right, I don’t have “dry“ skin and I don’t live by the parameters set by what a product is generally geared for. No it didn’t clog my pores, no it didn’t feel heavy on the skin and yes it was good under make up. I think for what I’m using it for it’s great but for anyone with true dry skin all over this won’t be enough. Keep an eye out for the new tata cream that comes in a tub in that case - I know I will. It’s on the website but I’m hoping sephora will carry it. Until then I love that this comes in a pump versus most moisturizers that are more hydrating but come in a not so travel friendly tub. I also have DE lala retro that I love but I hate the packaging on that one since the pump clogs once in a while when this one doesn’t. The smell isn’t the best but keep in mind there is no artificial fragrance to mask any of the ingredients which I greatly appreciate. It is on an the expensive side which is why I removed one star and I’m on the edge of whether or not to repurchase if you’re curious as a gauge of how much I love this product.
The smell is horrible and so overwhelming it’s pretty much unbearable!!!

Beautiful Green Beauty! Ohhhh its lovely! This oil cleanser is light and refreshing. The clean essential oil aroma is a welcoming calm after a long day in the office and I can honestly say that I look forward to my skincare ritual every single night thanks to this cleanser! Its pricey so I wouldn’t  be using this to remove makeup. no no! You want this on your skin for a good minute or two and then use a soft cloth to drape over your face to open up those pores. Follow up with your fave toner and a good serum/moisturizer and you’re done. Simply beautiful cleanser if you wish to splurge a little.. and why not? You’re worth it! ;)

This is the most luxurious, spa-like, and results driven skincare brand that I have ever used, including medical grade. My skin looks and feels amazing but the sensorial experience and immediate glow after sing this kit was better than the spa facials I’ve dropped $100+ for and for $75, I have several more uses/experiences. I thought surely my sensitive/reactive skin (because I use prescription Tretinoin) would likely experience some redness and irritation, but to my absolute joy, this kit actually calmed and reduced existing redness. The exfoliation is effective but gentle. I can no longer use TLC Framboos, Good Genes, etc. because they are too aggressive for my skin now that I use Tretinoin. The mask gave the glow without the irritation (only left on for 5 min.). I actually ordered full size products of a few from the Tata website because I love it all that much. I’ve tried enough skincare and am familiar enough with my skin and it will let me know almost immediately if something isn’t compatible. I’ve hesitated on this line for over a year given the price point, but it is well worth it. My husband even let me give him a facial for the first time ever because I was like, “Dude, you have to try this!” I don’t intend to sound obnoxious because this is just skincare after all, but seriously, I’m kind of bummed at all the coin I wasted on other brands. I’ve been doing the whole clean and fragrance-free for 2 years and this was my last attempt at skincare before a basic moisturizer and cleanser and investing in Dermatologist treatments instead. I will use it for the glow and Zen-inducing experience alone. Got me feeling fancy, darling. Tretinoin will do the bulk of anti-aging if the serum doesn’t - definitely too soon to tell. On a separate note, a deluxe sample of the Water-Lock moisturizer that I chose with this order caused my face to immediately flush when I applied it a few hours later. That’s likely a no-go, but everything in this particular kit was heavenly.

this is advertised as 7 step regimen, but the box you get is 6, and marked as 6, the eye cream is missing. Fix your images and correct the listing please. The products seem nice so far, I do not mind the earthy fields of grass smell.

I love Tata Harper’s makeup so I figured I try this. Not impressed at all, other than that it’s all natural.  I didn’t find this any better than most less expensive skin care lines and it doesn’t even come close to what I currently use. 

Regenerating Cleanser - This is an exfoliator. The granules are way to harsh for exfoliation. It feels like sandpaper on my face, which would definitely cause damage to my skin rather than fixing it. I didn’t have any brightening or smoothing to my skin, it just felt dry and was very red after. 

Resurfacing Mask -  This is a gel mask. It dries very quickly on the skin, so I don’t think there is long enough time for the ingredients to really have a benefit. I did not have any improved brightness or softness. 

Replenishing Nutrient Complex - This is a moisturising oil. This one seemed to be the best thing out of the whole box. But the product is applied by a roller ball - not my favourite way to apply anything. You have to roll it on to your finger then dab it on because using the rollerball directly on your eye would cause to much pressure to that area. The one good thing about this packaging is it is travel friendly, so it would be good to have in your purse to apply throughout the day if you feel dry. I don’t think this is good enough to replace the oils I already use though as I did not find it very moisturising. 

Hydrating Floral Essence - There are so many moisturising sprays and I don’t think this one is any better than less expensive options. Plus it seems to defeat the purpose of the oil - both are meant to be used as on the go moisturisers that you take with you, so I don’t see the purpose of having both. It can be used as a setting spray, but I actually found my makeup wore off faster when I used this. 

I didn’t bother with the other 3 items in this kit because I didn’t like the 4 I did try so that was enough for me to return this. All 7 items would have to be great for the cost to be worth it.
Products had the most awful smell and gave me a serious breakout. Not pleased at all.

This is truly one of the best thing I have ever used on my face!!! I am normal to dry and this seriously works wonders on my skin!!! EVERY time I wear it people ask me “oh my god your skin looks amazing you’re glowing what makes your skin look like that?!“ I tell them SKINCARE is the first step to GORGEOUS, HEALTHY, GLOWING skin!!!!! If you’re more oily you can just use this on the high points of your face like the cheekbones. Ever since I started using this I never get one pimple. I even put it on a bug bite and it was almost completely gone the next day!! I am so beyond obsessed with this product I will continue to purchase it over and over again! I LOVE TATA HARPER!!!!!
I absolutely HATE the smell of the serum . It is kind of grandmotherly smelling . I don’t want my face smelling like that.

I have repurchased this many times over the year - my trick is that I always repurchase when Sephora is having a VIB sale, even if I don’t need to replace my current bottle immediately. I have combo skin that gets dry during the winter, so I use this year round in the morning with a Vitamin C serum under and sunscreen on top, and in the evening with a serum under and a cream on top. I haven’t noticed a major change since using this product, but I do think it contributes to keeping my skin softer and moisturized - doesn’t trigger anything, which is great for me. It does have a smell, but it reminds me of a spa, I don’t mind it.

Everything TATA is amazing.  I’ve been using her products for about 1 year. The compliments I receive on my skin (given my mature age of 59) is wonderful.  This mask leaves your skin feeling soft and free of any dead skin.  Your skin will glow after just one use of this mask. Hope you enjoy as much as I have.

I don’t really get the hype about this line. the regenerating cleanser smells great and is a good gentle scrubbing cleanser but the rest is just ok for the price. glad I bought this instead of full priced products!
Like the brand like the smells but not really any results for me.. will return it.. hoped to kept it.. aww..

I was hesitant to try this because some of the other Tata Harper products irritated my super sensitive skin. But, I decided to take the plunge and see if this would be a good, lightweight moisturizer for the summer. The clarifying mask is also my favourite over every one I’ve tried (I’ve tried too many to count over the years).First off, it smells glorious. Like a wildflower patch deep in an earthy forest with undertones of citrus and black pepper. The aromatic qualities alone are lovely. If you’re looking for nasty, chemically-derived synthetic smells, you will NOT find that in this bottle!I have sensitive, highly reactive combination skin prone to rosacea, and angry-red patches of rosacea acne. This didn’t bother my skin whatsoever. No pimples, no itching, no irritation. Whew! And I love that it goes on so smoothly with very little needed, but doesn’t dry out to nothing like other lightweight creams I’ve tried.Yes, it’s expensive. If you have the cash to afford it, and want to give your skin a treat, I say go for it. Now if only Sephora would be bring back Tata Harper’s “Be True“ lip balm, I’d be in Tata heaven!

I don’t need a clay type masque as my skin needs moisture (not to be dried out), so this product sample stayed in my cosmetic drawer for a few months before I got to it!! After two uses, I’d say it’s decent but not for me. I’m sure if you need a clay type product for your skin, you’d enjoy this. It smells good to me (contrary to other reviews on here), but personally I didn’t find that this product changed or did anything worthy to my skin to make me want to repurchase. Not sure what all the hype is about & I will stick to my hydrating masques from Kiehls & Glamglow.

I really dislike the scent of this. I’ve tried other facial sprays and toners and none of them take my breath away the way this does. It’s just so strong, long after I’m done spraying it. I don’t find it’s anything special in terms of hydration or toning.

As a consumer, I was curious about the hype.  I thought the “hard tiny balls“ was a fluke but, lo and behold, no matter what I did, I had tiny hard balls as well for the entirety it took me to finish this tiny jar.  As a cosmetic chemist, I wanted to give this a benefit of a doubt and personally wanted to see what the hype was about.  It’s a HARD PASS.  The ingredients listing is very fooling. That’s all I gotta say.
Good product but not worth $72.  I personally would not purchase.

I have had trouble skin since having my second son 6 years ago. I’ve tried everything and finally stopped treating my skin like an acne prone condition and started just treating it like skin. This Nourishing Oil Cleanser is the perfect makeup remover at the end of the day and the gentlest cleanser in the morning. It leaves my skin so soft and moisturized, a second lotion is not necessary half the time. At night, I use the Oil Cleanser to remove my makeup and follow up with the Regenerating Cleanser to exfoliate and then finish with Sunday Riley’s Good Genes. Twice a week I use the Resurfacing Mask. I cannot remember my skin being so clear and healthy before this combination.
Smells great and feels refreshing. Expensive, but all the Tata Harper products I’ve used have been worth the splurge.

I am prone to acne and this moisturizer is a miracle worker! Unfortunately it is very pricey but I keep buying this because it keeps my skin clear and moisturized. Smell isn’t amazing but it’s not bad and goes away a few mins after application.
I absolutly love this product! It’s the best mask for both hydration and glow. My skin felt refreshed and pure sized reduced immediately.

I’m a huge fan of this moisturizer. I purchased it as a recommendation and I’m in love with the results. My skin is soft, supple, clear and overall even-toned. I have combination skin and use this moisturizer day and night. Though the initial scent of this moisturizer is heavy, it dissipates quickly and doesn’t linger on the skin. All of her products have a very natural floral smell that doesn’t bother me at all, especially since they work. I use this moisturizer in conjunction with the Purifying Cleanser (PM) and Regenerating Cleanser (AM). My skin looks and feels phenomenal ever since. Definitely recommend this moisturizer. It’s AMAZING!

Holy lord, this stuff smells dreadful. I saw it in my local Sephora and was giddy (I love skincare), whipped it off the shelf and doused my face in it.What a mistake. I immediately was overcome with this horrible scent that left me literally wrinkling my nose the rest of the time it sat on my face--I actually removed it with a toner. Maybe it did “tone“ my skin, but I could not get past the smell. There are far more innocuous-smelling face mists that do a great job. Buy one of those without smelling them first.

Yes, this oil is good for my oily skin. I’ve finally figured out that, while heavy creams are not good for my oily skin, OILS are. This one has really helped my skin’s tone even out, which has been sadly lacking thanks to a medication I have to take. That medication makes me create more oil in my skin (which I didn’t need) and has created quite a bit of acne.I love how this smells and how safe it is for my skin as well. I wish it came in a bigger size. I may start ordering it directly from the website, as you can sign up for subscription service and receive 10% off.Love it!

I’m not one for toners or hydrating sprays but this is amazing... it’s light, smells amazing and makes my skin feel so hydrated. Perfect for using before applying a serum or cream as it makes it go on way smoother.  Wish it were bigger for the price but this is a new staple in my repertoire.

This is an amazing mask although I did have to get my product replaced the first one came dried out. But the new one was great. It was smaller than expected for the price. Made my acne prone skin look better in one use. Not to drying on this dry skin.

Super gentle and all natural, this purifying mask is so light yet powerful on my combination-sensitive-acne prone skin. I use it once a week and get compliments on it the very next day (thinking of using this 2x a week soon). It doesn’t dry out my skin, keeps my acne in check by minimizing any current acne and actually brings a nice glow. Was super stingy on the price but after receiving a nice sample in store from a Sephora representative that swore by it, I am hooked; it is worth every penny!! One of the most excellent purifying and acne preventative mask on the market!

This is one of my favorite products! I get so many compliments on my skin when I’m using it. I actually love using it before makeup primer! You only need a small amount of using this way. It’s great as an overnight mask as well!!! I’m surprised at the negative reviews but skincare is obviously subjective.

I was gifted this product by the brand, and even though I’ve only been using it for a week I am so excited to keep it in rotation. I’ve only recently starting using products specifically aimed at strengthening the skin barrier. I’ve always considered them to be most necessary for sensitive, reactive, or damaged skin. What I’ve discovered over the last couple of years is that age has made my skin much drier than it used to be. The addition of a barrier serum has dramatically helped maintain moisture. This is the third such product I have tried, and is thicker and creamier than the other two. The formula uses a post biotic complex to rebalance the micro biome, and algae and ceramides to keep skin healthy. I’m pleased with the ingredients list (what is there and what isn’t), the consistency (lightweight, spreadable, and not sticky), and the finish (somehow kind of matte but still dewy). I also love that it is fragrance-free! I am often sensitive to perfume, so I appreciate the lack of it but also liked the slight natural scent.

Can’t give it negative stars...made be break out in pustules!I woke up each morning with a new huge pustule on my face. I normally don’t break out at all. 3 days and I hipped it back. Smells bad, too.

I received a deluxe size of this in a Sephora Favorites set. I’ve never really loved a moisturizer so much that I use it every day...I usually rotate between different ones. But this one I used daily until the very last drop!! I usually have dry patches and now I don’t see any...my skin is smooth!! I’m sad I used it all up because it is pretty pricey, but after I use up the rest of my moisturizers I will bite the bullet and repurchase this.

I love this lotion! It smells so so good and feels great on my skin. I have fairly dry skin and live in a dry climate. If anything, I wish it was a bit heavier and a bit thicker for the winter months, but it is awesome during the summer.Its expensive, but keep in mind that it is made of completely natural ingredients, all grown on TATA’s own farm. I can’t stress how important this is to be using real plant extracts on your skin rather than chemicals. I love

This is truly a treat to use in the morning before applying my moisturizer. The price is a little outta control, yet again there is something about that is so nice it makes you want more. Am knocking off a star as I think its overpriced, yet it still ha me kept. The mister is amazing.

I’m so happy with the TH brand. This was the first of Tara’s product I invested in and I’m a huge fan. It’s gentle yet unlike other other mist toners - leaves a dewy, not dry, feel. I use it daily, morning and night, following cleanser and before serum. Pricey but given ingredients and small batch process, happy to support made in North America companies with ethical and sustainable products and manufacturing practices. Will absolutely purchase again and again.
The pump always leaks. Period.I have started keeping a tissue roll underneath. Never buying this again.

My pregnancy skin could be to blame, but this just didn’t work for me. I wanted so badly to love it, because I love the fact that Tata is completely non-toxic and green. It smells amazing, but I find it’s just not moisturizing enough for my skin right now using the directed amount. I also broke out on my forehead (again, pregnancy hormones are likely the culprit), but it could also be from my skin not being moisturized enough with this.

Finally a line that is as natural as it gets. This is the first moisturizer I’ve tried in a long time that has not burned my skin when I apply it. It is a little pricey but my priority is to keep as many chemicals as possible off my skin so the investment is worth it.

I initially bought this off recommendation from Caroline Hirons...this is the fifth time I’ve repurchased. There is nothing bad you could say about this product other than it’s pricey...but once you try it the price is justified. Simply amazing. Will be a staple in my routine for as long as they sell it.
This cleanser is effective and gentle. I love that the oil traps dirt while leaving my skin hydrated and nourished. Will repurchase again and again!
This facial moisturizer is nothing special. It smells ok. It dries quickly. Doesn’t leave any visual or tangible residue. My skin felt a little tight afterwards, but nothing uncomfortable.

This is moisturing and works for me but the smell is awful. I’m not somebody that is usually bothered by smells but the scent is so strong.  I got this product in a Sephora favorites set and relieved I don’t have to go through a whole bottle of that smell.

I seem to be on a skincare brigade recently (maybe it’s because I’m turning 36 next month). I got a sample of this and the smell is overwhelming and it’s an average moisturizer at best. Definitely not worth the full price point in my opinion!!

This set is a steal!! Just their eye restorative cream is $126! But for $93 its a great little set to try out. The bottles are also re-fillable so great for travel time! I have gotten the set for my mom who is 59 and I have been using the samples and I LOVE the oil, cleanser, cream and eye cream! I know a lot of people may not like the scent but I like natural smells and this smells straight out of a garden. I am 28 years old, have dry olive tan skin. I especially love the cleanser - leaves my skin hydrated, bright and SOFT!

If you write a review saying “there are better products out there for cheaper” you should then list your examples. This is not a cream. It’s truly a balm. A pea sized amount split between each ring finger, for each eye, is all you need. In the 5 weeks approx that I’ve been using this my under eyes are less puffy and brighter. I apply this all the way around my eyes and my 42 year old eyelids are much more lifted, crows feet significantly diminished. It melts in to your skin and the finish is very nice. Not sticky, but a bit tacky. Is it expensive? Yes! Try to buy it in the sale. Every once in awhile you find a product that you know has become a permanent fixture in your skin routine. This is one of those for me.

Received my bio-barrier serum gifted by tats harper skincare and I love this product! It’s my favorite thus far! No product left my skin as soft and glue as this product! The smell is amazing too. This is definitely part of my skin routine now.

This brand in general is super compatible with my skin. But this product really blew me away. I use it once a week, and for the first 2 days after using it, my crow’s feet (which are not deep wrinkles) are invisible. For me it’s been almost comparable to botox, and I’m saying that without exaggerating. I use it in combination with other tata harper products, which may add to the benefits.

The Superkind Fragrance-Free Fortifying Moisturizer is so nice for my dry skin. I love the ingredients and that they improve the skin barrier. I am a big fan of calendula and hyaluronic acid. I use this twice daily and and it keeps my skin moisturized. This is my first Tata Harper product. I was warned by a friend that they have a strong earthy scent (not in a bad way, but unexpected if unfamiliar with the brand) this one is fragrance-free, which I appreciate there not being added fragrance as an unnecessary ingredient. This is also vegan and cruelty-free, which make it even better.
The worst breakout acne ever!

An absolutely magical little concoction. It smells as though an alchemist put it together in a hut hidden in a bark of a gigantic tree in the forest. From use #1 I saw results. It helps with my aging, acne prone skin, little bumps to bigger pimples. Also helped balanced my skin tone & discoloration, dark spots are slowly disappearing.I can’t believe I hadn’t tried this before, I’m buying a new one as soon as it’s done! Also love the AHA BHA serum, together they’re just...magic.Thanks Tata!

Got this as a sample--I love the ingredient list and although the scent is overpowering, it is not irritating at all. Seems pricey for what it is but I’ll finish my current moisturizer while thinking about getting this one...or wait for something better value to come along.
Terrible product. Does nothing for the skin. And the price on top of everything. Complete waist of money. Have no idea why this brand is so popular.
