Let me start off by saying when I don’t wear any makeup and cleanse my face with this oil cleanser, it is really nice and feels great. My skins looks fresh afterwards. However, to call this a makeup removing oil cleanser is just false. When I wear makeup and use only this cleanser to remove it, I have makeup left all over my eyes and face. For this reason, I had to give it 3 stars. I don’t wear makeup often, so I will continue to use it, but anytime I do wear makeup I will take a makeup removing wipe to my face first before I use this.

This was my second product try from tata harper. Love the lip balm from this brand but this moisturizer had to be returned. Its very pricey but i over looked that to try her moisturizer this winter because my skin definitely needs hydration. love the fact that she uses natural ingredients but the moisturizer goes on thick and balls up leaving a gross appearance like your skin is peeling off and falling off in sections.  Definitely dont try to wear make up over it.  hope they figure out how to remedy this problem .
This offers light coverage with real moisturizing. Don’t need to use much. 2 pumps is more than enough for face and neck. I have rosacea and this doesn’t irritate my skin
Again a huge thanks to both Stephanie Nicole and Caroline Hirons these products are superb. Thank you ladies!!!
I received this a sample and like it ALOT so I ordered the full product. What came was half full and it’s as hard as a stone. Is Sephora sending us products that was returned by customers now? Shame.

I’ve been using TATCHA’s cleansing oil and have loved the smell, the way it removes makeup, and how it rinses off nicely - without leaving residue or affecting my eyes.  I was excited to try TATA HARPER after seeing It highlighted on Goop.  I had the highest expectations, and am so sad to have this gorgeous green bottle sitting on my bathroom counter - that I dread using. The pump gets clogged and sticks, so you have to force it down (at the same time trying to not let it squirt everywhere.)  The smell reminds me of bug spray, and it leaves a residue, so my skin feels filmy while I rinse.  Forcing myself through the rest of the bottle with each frustrating pump.

I love a good sensitive skin product, especially a cleanser. In addition to sensitive skin I have some rosacea. Have used this product a few times and I am not impressed. I’ve found this product to be very drying and with an $86 price tag, it should be an amazing product. Can’t recommend this product, I’ll stick with my Korres.

Absolutely worth EVERY penny! Hydrates, diminishes redness and leaves my skin hydrated.  I use this as a sleep mask and I’ve never been happier or had better results with a product reducing redness.  Will repurchase absolutely.

This is a good oil for the face, but definitely not the best. It is moisturizing, but it also has a strong floral smell to it, which I personally don’t mind, but I’m sure many will. The packaging for this product is also ok. I know that Tata Harper created a new bottle for this oil on her website, but this rollerball packaging is pretty bad because it doesn’t allow any product to come out. So overall, it is just a good product.
my skin felt dry after I used the product. i love the smell and i love tata harper products but this one was not great for dryish middle aged skin. i wanted the product to feel richer going on.

I wanted to love this, but for me the oil just doesn’t come off unless I do a double cleanse with my water base cleanser.  It just becomes a milky, sticky mess on my face that won’t come off!  Luckily, I bought it specifically for my double cleanse.  The oil itself has a lovely texture and it feels great on the skin.  Also, after a few weeks or more of using this at night, I’ve haven’t noticed any change.  I won’t be rebuying, though I love Tata’s other items in her line.
Love this mask! Worth every penny. This is my favourite mask when I’m having no skin concerns and just helps my skin feel cleaner, fresher, and more radiant. Love how it feels when it’s on.

Pretty bottle with an ok cleansing oil in it. This cleanser didn’t do anything special, for the high price tag that came with it. I have several Cleansing balms/oils that smells better, and pretty much cleanse the same if not better with a cheaper price tag. Other than the pretty bottle that came with a dysfunctional top, there isn’t anything special about this cleanser. I returned it.
Scent smells terrible and it’s way too strong. I couldn’t get passed the smell so I’m not too sure how well the product works. Sorry.

I have been using this serum for over one week. This serum is fragrance-free with slightly smell when apply it, but gone away quickly. Although I’m not allergic to most scents, I personally don’t like too much scented products on my skin, so I recommended. After applying it, I felt my skin was hydrated and not greasy, the serum was absorbed easily by gently massaging. In general, I like how it goes on my face. Even though I haven’t seen obvious changes in smoothing wrinkles or firming the skin, I felt skin condition is very healthy and protected. I will keep using it to see the aging prevention effect.

This is my first time using Tata Harper facial cleanser, it has creamy texture and not scented, the smell is a little bit strong but is acceptable. This cleanser is somehow difficult to foam, much harder than I thought, maybe I haven’t found a good way to apply it. After cleaning, I felt it cleaned very well and not dried at all, also my skin was soft and comforting. Normally I’m not particularly looking for scented-free cleanser, but I will definitely recommend this one if your skin is sensitive to scents. The overall experience is good as expected.

I followed the instructions and used it 3 times in consecutive days and then lower it down to 2 times per week. I have relatively small face and it lasted for 1 and half month. And I don’t always apply full face. It feels cool, smells pleasant, and I can see that it does clear my skin. But that’s about it. Would not repurchase it again.

I love this oil cleanser. I’ve used several other oil cleansers at different price points (Boscia, Tatcha) and this is by far the best. I use this as the first step in my cleansing routine at night and love how clean it helps me get, especially after wearing makeup all day.

I tried the Tata Harper Skincare the SUPERKIND Bio-Barrier Serum and I absolutely love it. The fragrance free aspect is wonderful and the texture is very light and not sticky. I’m usually restricted on what I can put on my face because it is so sensitive but this did not irritate me at all!

I have used another moisturizer from this brand. It works very well, but it doesn’t smell good. I have been expecting it to produce a fragrance-free moisturizer. This time I received it. It is enough moisturizing ability for dry skin, the texture is light and not greasy, and the point is that there is no unpleasant scent, love it!

Love this cleanser. This is my first Tata Harper product, I’ve generally stayed away because of the price and also never knew which product to splurge on. I have sensitive, red prone skin with very little acne. I absolutely love this cleanser. It is gentle but clears makeup and dirt effectively and leaves me feeling “squeaky clean” (i find some cleansers dont do this). I use this and Caudalie foaming cleanser interchangeably - I find them very similar but this bottle is just so luxurious and I think it may reduce my redness a bit better.
I just started using the products yesterday and I have to say so far they are fabulous! The all natural scents will simply blow your mind!

First off, Tata Harper products = holy grail of skin care.

This mask 100% lived up to my expectations, as does the Resurfacing mask. Regardless of a hefty price tag, these products are definitely worth it for acne-prone skin and people who struggle with very reactive skin upon trying new products.

Product itself it a dusty rose, opaque mask. A little goes a long way, feels minty upon application and wears off slowly. Warning that the smell of this mask is incredibly pungent, I can’t quite put my finger on what the scent is... the closest I’ve gotten is “spiced ginger“ which I personally am not a fan of, but the mask works well enough that I can look past that.

I’ve been in the middle of an acne flare up due to another product my skin didn’t like, and this mask calmed it right down... visibly after each application. I left the mask on for about 20-25 minutes, there is no tingling sensation or anything of the sort that I’ve found. I’ve read reviews of others leaving this mask on for up to an hour, might try that next time.

Overall love this product and definitely recommend it, will purchase again for sure.

Smells awesome! I live at high altitude and deal with severe dry and dehydrated skin. This has made a huge difference in plumping and smoothing my face and neck. Feels wonderful and smells even better! Will definitely purchase again.
I loved how moisturizing this kit was, but the formula was a bit too heavy for daytime use. Blotting sheets were my best friends. However, this kit was divine for nighttime use!

Honestly I didn’t think there was much of a difference in different moisturizer but WOW! I have sensitive skin that is prone to breaking out but this moisturizer makes my skin feel amazing! I’m absolutely in love with it. It was a bit pricey but it was definitely worth it.
The results and price aren’t worth even trying to get past the smell.

Received this only as a sample so, I dont know what the longer term effects are. But, overall, it is very moisturizing and my skin seems to love it to the point that Im considering getting the full size product. Not sure why there’s reviews about the smell but, mine smelled liked grapefruit! If it smells bad, then its possible that you did not get it from a fresh batch.
This work ok but I’m not sure what they were thinking about the price. There are great eye creams out there equally good and a fraction of the price.

Just have to agree with some other people that for the price it is a very small amount. That being said, it works miracles. I have acne prone skin and are constantly exposed to pollution (city life) and have not broken out since using this 2a week. Worth the splurge!!!

I was skeptical about trying this since essences I’ve tried in the past broke me out.  This one is perfect!  It feels nice on the face and has calmed my acne prone skin!  I will continue to use this product

First off: Tata Harper products do have a strong fresh, floral smell. You either love it or hate it. Personally, I find the scent adds to the product’s appeal, and if I could buy a perfume that smells like this, I would. The scent dissipates in five minutes or so.I suffer severe dryness around my eyes that markedly worsens the look of fine lines and can even lead to peeling. Used twice daily, this product eliminates that problem. It’s not a miracle wrinkle cream, but it’s the most effective moisturizer I’ve tried, and works well under makeup. Plus: NO NASTY CHEMICALS.

Okay so I’m going to be brutally honest here. Whether you love this oil or hate it, the ingredient list does not justify this price. Period. I’m honestly shocked at the price being charged for such common and inexpensive ingredients. First of all, calling it a “retinoic“ face oil is a bit misleading and gives consumers the impression that this contains some type of retinoid. It’s not totally wrong, just misleading, because the only retinoic ingredient in this is just plain old rosehip seed oil. And guess how much it costs for a good bottle of 100% organic cold-pressed rosehip seed oil? A few dollars. I have to call this out because the rosehip seed oil and its retinoic properties is the highlighted, or “star“ ingredient in this product. But what really ruins this product is the sheer amount of essential oils they added to it for fragrance. You literally should not be putting essential oils on your face at this high of a concentration. Essential oils belong in my diffuser, not on my face. Fragrance, regardless of whether synthetic or essential oil, poses a risk of causing skin sensitivity with prolonged use.If the concept of this product interests you, then I highly recommend just going out and getting a bottle of organic cold-pressed rosehip seed oil. It’s very inexpensive, and is actually much better for your skin health than using this ridiculously overpriced perfume oil on your face. Then you’ll get to experience the benefits of rosehip without having to risk damage to your skin.

This stuff right here. I have enjoyed the unicorn skin of my late 30’s for the last several years- dry and prone to flaking while also constantly breaking out in huge painful cysts and bumps that never even form a “zit“ head.  I went searching for something that would moisturize AND help control the breakouts, because my idiot dermatologist insists on treating my adult skin like a 14 year old’s with harsh antibiotic gels and Retin-A which manages to make my skin flake off dry while also maintaining an oil slick that BP itself would envy.  5 days into using this stuff, my skin is CLEAR and my flaky dry patches are greatly diminished.  It doesn’t dry out my skin the way teenager acne stuff does.  It doesn’t smell divine, but I don’t care what it smells like if it WORKS.  I don’t care that it cost a small fortune and isn’t carried in my local Sephora- I am converted and my skin is saved, so I can face my 40’s with much better skin. If I could meet Tata Harper and personally thank whoever formulated this stuff, I would do it in a heartbeat.  Thank you for acknowledging that 35  adult acne prone skin is a very different beast from teen or 20’s skin.

Doesn’t clog my pores like other oil cleansers I have tried. Great for oily skin, somehow seems to clear my pores. Removes the most stubborn make-up. I even got oil based stain from staining the banisters on my hands and this was the only thing that got it off!

I’ll hit the downside to this product first: it’s really pricey for its size. That being said, I’ve gotten a couple of months’ use out of it, as I only use it once a week, and apply it with a brush. I LOVE how it feels as it dries on my skin - it’s got a tingly, soothing feel, almost like you get when you eat a mint. It did break me out the first few times I used it, which I expected since it has the word “purifying“ in it, and my skin is acne prone. Now that I’ve been using it for a couple of months, though, I don’t notice any further breakouts, and I love the way it makes my skin feel. I have combination skin, and this doesn’t dry me out, even on my drier areas like my cheeks. I will continue to purchase this as my go-to weekly mask, and am so pleased I took the plunge on it!

Tried a sample of this when my skin was clogged and oily, and it worked great!  My skin felt smooth and the bumps were gone.  The only downsides are the strong herbal smell (makes me think of nettles for some reason) , which you can get used to, and the high price.  For me, this would be an occasional splurge, but even then I don’t think I would use it up very fast.  So, do I want to spend on something I might use a few times a year?  Maybe not.  Wish it came in a smaller, less expensive size.  Worth it if you need it, though.

Enneagram 4... buy this. buy two. I’ve never seen a bottle this beautiful. I’ve never smelled anything this perfect. My skin is as velvet as the voice of Lianne La Havas. I glow like Christina Ricci in Sleepy Hollow. This is the most bougie organic scientifically botanicalized hippy skin care you will ever want and they make it in Vermont! I could bathe newborn sheep in this and they would grow up to be silk worms. 6/5 stars.

I had the chance to finally get my hands on this... this is unlike ANY hydrating mask I’ve ever used. You have to use this as a treatment like once or twice a week. The 6 different types of HA’s , the squalene and the rose just makes your skin feel incredible. My skin is so soft, happy and plump! Look forward to continue to use this!Would recommend for any skin type !

I have been a fan of the oil cleanser so I wanted to try some other items. I must admit that I used up every last drop of everything and purchased almost all in full size as a result. I especially love the exfoliating cleaner, rejuvenating serum, resurfacing mask, and face oil. I didn’t think I would love the scent of the items, because it’s much more scented than I normally use, but I have to admit they’ve grown on me especially since they dissipate after a bit. I’m still not sure if there is any difference with the floral essence other than a lovely scent. Will try the routine without and see how it goes. Otherwise, I am very happy to have this kit to try the items before making the cost commitment with the full size products.

looooooooooove this. It feels wonderful on, mists really finely, and feels hydrating. I use this after my exfoliating toner and my skin always feels refreshed. I have a jurlique spray but this one just feels tooooooons better. I took off a star for the price but OMG if I had the money I would buy bottles of this stuff and spray it errrrrday and all the time. It feels great! But sadly, I’d rather spend more $$$ on serums and toners than a mist. I also use it to ’set’ makeup and it doesn’t budge my makeup.

Excellent product, yes it has a strong scent but I find it quiet pleasant also its filled with certified organic ingredients so Im more than happy to enjoy these natural scents. I use this as the last product in my routine and it keeps my face moisturized for the entire day.

This in conjunction with the Tata Harper Resurfacing Mask is like the VIP pass to quick, effortless, flawless skin. Yes it is pricey, but on those days when you really need that extra oomph.... this delivers. Will smooth out texture, draw out toxins, flatten breakouts, and leave your skin refreshed and radiant in one treatment. I also love that its a mask that wont dry out and threaten wrinkles if you leave it on longer than recommended. I leave this on for up to 40 minutes without a problem. I prefer Tata’s products over Glamglow’s. Yes, that good.

 I was so hesitant to try this for over a year just because of the price tag, but honestly if thats the only thing thats keeping you from it, bite the bullet and try it out. It has changed my life.

This is a lighter moisturizer so I apply in the morning or after the gym. It smells fresh, sort of like herbal garden. Hasn’t aggravated my redness. I’m in my late 30s so I appreciate a product like this. Love the glass bottle packaging.

These products are amazing! My skin is glowing since starting to use these products. The moisturizer, serum and toner go a long way. Eye cream ran out after a few days. The serum has a pretty heavy scent to it that bothered me initially, now I don’t even notice it. Highly recommended!!

Hands down, the BEST mask I EVER used to clear those pesky “dots“ on the nose.  And it doesn’t dry my skin!  It’s a teeny tiny pot & it’s very pricey, but it WORKS.  I’ve tried EVERYTHING, & this is the real deal--it’s a beautiful, highly effective product, totally worth the splurge!
I love this stuff it helps calm redness and helps clear breakouts the only problem is it stinks and its super expensive

I love this cleanser so much. After using this face cleanser my face felt more fresh and clean. I love how light it feels and how clean my face feels after it’s been washed. The scent is very light and pleasing. Highly recommend!

I normally love all things Tata Harper, but this was not for me. Pros: lovely scent, eco-friendly packaging, and TH has perfect customer service (let me return even after I’d used some product). Con: balm is very firm so has to be scraped out and warmed between your fingertips, and even then it does not apply easily. My delicate (50 year old) eye area needs product that glides on easily.

I was really prepared to love this based on reviews that described the smell as “floral“. In my experience, it smells really terrible, and the first thing that comes to mind when I smell this is dog urine. I’m sorry to be so blunt, but that is exactly what it reminds me of. I can’t tell you if it’s moisturizing or refreshing, because I used it only one time and hated it.

I rarely write reviews, but this is one product worth writing about. It helps to talk about my skin type. I used to have pretty oily skin, but I’ve been on myorison (generic for accutane). It’s cleared up my skin, but done a number on my skin as well. I know have extremely dry skin. I’ve tried several products and nothing has cured the dryness. I decided to try this kit, I figured I had nothing to lose. I have to say every single product has worked. My skin is not only hydrated, but looks amazing. I’m so happy to have found Tata Harper. Yes it’s pricey, but the way it makes my skin feel is totally worth it to me. I say give this kit a try!!!
very calming on the skin

I saw this on the Tata Harper website and was checking Sephora daily to see when they’d finally get it in, and ordered it first chance. I don’t love all of the Tata Harper products, but I do love all of the cleansers so far, and this is no exception. I love that it foams up nicely, can be used around the eyes, and does a gentle, yet effective clean. It also rinses really easily without leaving any weird sticky or oily residue that a lot of sensitive skin cleansers seem to leave behind. My super sensitive skin isn’t stripped dry or red and angry with this (believe me when I say I have tried almost every so-called sensitive skin cleanser out there!). It also leaves the perfect canvas to do a double-cleanse followed with the Regenerating Cleanser (which I only use once or twice per week after a regular cleanse).
This is a very good product to wash your face if you have sensitive and dry skin during winter. It properly cleans your skin and hydrates it. This is my second bottle.

My Tata Harper routine is a pleasing way to start and end my days. I use the regenerating or detoxing cleanser (I change it up), then this, the serum and moisturizer. This is one of my favorite parts - I love the fragrance, so fresh, and the product is really hydrating and refreshing. Great for a midday pick-me-up as well.

I got a sample of this with a primer I ordered online. The smell IS strong but I really liked it. Reminds me of lush. I waited until the next day to write this review to see what my skin would feel like. And I must say it feels great. Super smooth, acne is definitely toned down sown a little and no breakouts to be seen. I took away a star for the price. I’m going to go to Sephora and see if they can recommend something similar at a better price point before I consider buying this one even though I really liked it.

The sticker shock is real, I get it.  But if you can afford this moisturizer, trust me, it’s worth it.  After falling in love with the clarifying cleanser I decided to take the plunge with this moisturizer.  It is clearing up my hormonal, cystic acne while calming my skin.  Invest in your face, and try it out.

This product is currently collecting dust in my shelf. I’m really bummed about this product. When I did use it, it would just sit on my face. I would be spending a few good minutes trying to get it off but it felt like there was a layer of oil that would just be there. I had to use my foaming cleanser to get it off and make sure my face felt fully clean.

This mask was recommended to me by an associate at Sephora, and I went out an purchased it after a week of trying it at home. IT WAS AMAZING! I used it in combination with the FAB Radiance Peel pads on an area of my face that is prone to break outs. I applied the mask as a spot treatment, in a very thin layer, for about 20 minutes. I then washed it off, moisturized, and went to bed. When I woke up, any pimples were GONE and the area looked so bright and smooth. AMAZING AMAZING AMAZING!

The smell is so so terrible i wanted to rip my face off it smelled ALL DAY. On top of that it dried out my oily skin and made my skin flakey!! This is not a good product. Thank god it was only a sample because I had to throw it away before finishing it. Not worth the value, not worth your time.
I loved the sample size of this product, smells amazing and hydrates you skin.The price its not something I can bring myself to spend on a hydrating mist, that is why I only gave it 4 stars.

This moisturizer works incredibly on my ’clogged’ skin. I don’t get major breakouts but mostly clogged pores and little bumps and I haven’t had any bumps since I have added this to my routine! It’s expensive which is why I rate it a four star product, but this is truly worth it.

I have repurchased the second bottle of it, and will repurchase again and again. Here are my thoughts:1. It calms my skin and keeps my skin hydrated. Suitable for all season.2. It reduces the redness of acne, my acne has been eliminated 3. It even helps with acne SCAR. This bottle is not a booster,  but it changes the condition beyond my expectations. My acne scars are disappearing.4. It has a herbal scent, but you won`t smell it for long5. very good for sensitive skin, it smooths out my skin and maintains a good barrier 6. no harmful ingredients, very gentle and effective on skin7. if you need a booster, try spot treatment from Tata Harper too. The best spot treatment I have received.8. This is a life changer for me. My skin condition has been improved so much.

I received this cleanser complimentary in exchange of my honest reviews . I am really obsessed with this awesome softening cleanser as it is very gentle and soothing with my sensitive skin. It nourish my skin deeply and makes it calm and hydrating.

First, as another reviewer stated, this does NOT include the eye cream. I complained to Sephora about that and they sent me another kit AND refunded my money. Excellent customer service!I’ve been using this product for a few months now and have visible results. I was using Tatcha faithfully and while it was a good regimen, it wasn’t fantastic. I’m 50 and have been moisturizing since I was 17 (thanks for the advice Grandma!) so I have very little lines but hey nature is catching up :) I’m very fair and have a mild case of rosacea so have very sensitive skin too. These products caused no irritation aside from a minor acne breakout which always happens when I change skin products. My skin is brighter, smoother and my pores have virtually disappeared. My friends comment that my face always looks freshly washed and I’ve had complete strangers ask me what I use. It’s not break the bank expensive and I really love the “green” smell of the repairitive serum. Wonderful products, thanks!

This mask is amazing.  But the price is obscene for the amount you receive, it’s very small.  They need to start offering this mask in a much larger size, like triple the size, because otherwise, I would be buying this stuff every two weeks.  I have very difficult skin, and at 47 years old, I’m fighting wrinkles and acne at the same time, this product really does the trick and I love the smell.  Does not over dry, my oily skin felt soft and smooth afterwards.

As soon as I received it, I couldn’t wait to unpack it. It is a full size Fortifying Moisturizer. There are green beauty engineers, creating formulas with the highest-powered ingredients. Natural ingredients! I usually get reactive and sensitive of this weather changing season but I enjoy the lack of this scent, because of there fragrance free aspect of formula! My skin feel protected after first appiled, feels calmed and comforted after using it! This moisturizer is super silky to cocoons dry skin. Very gentle! Very hydrating and moisturizing!

This is lightweight yet packs a punch.  I am 53 and need more now.  But heavy and greasy isn’t the solution either.  This is a beautiful consistency I feel that it helps me to keep my skin   H  hydrated nicely hydrated no visible dryness and yet I’m not greasy￼

Love this cleanser, leaves the skin perfectly clean and balanced, super soft and it will work great on dry skin. However this is more that what I am willing to spend on cleanser, I will continue to but the full size bareminerals oil cleanser that works as well and for $35 a bottle. Tata has amazing products with great ingredients, just wish it was a little more affordable!
The smell of this takes some getting used to. It is more expensive than most of the products I typically use, but is 100% worth it. The results are amazing! This is the only fave oil I will use.
When I opened my product (and I ordered 2 of these masks) it was completely dried out and unusable. Both of them! I love this mask but for all that trouble to return I might not order this again.

I tried the sample size from the Glow set. I’m not sure why this is marketed for dry skin. I am combo and my skin drinks this formula, making it feel like it’s stripped of moisture. I have to layer another moisturizer on top just to replenish. This moisturizer is lotion like consistency. It is scented due to all the oils in it. For people who are scent averse, I’d get a sample of this before buying the whole product.Sample size packaging is sleek and dispenses the formula quite well.

I bought this cleanser because I love the product line, not worth the price, does not “dissolve“ anything. It makes a filmy mess when trying to remove ANY type of make-up. I have a vast array of foundations and tried this cleanser multiple times. Does not remove any of them. You will need to use another cleanser and a scrub to remove the mess this cleanser makes. If you have extremely dry skin and want to create a barrier on your face, using this cleanser on clean skin may work for that. I rarely return products but this one had to go back.

I’ll start my saying I am a huge fan of this Face Oil.  5 starts for the Face oil.   Negative 5 stars for the awful dropper in this packaging.  It spurts out product and gets everywhere -- super wasteful considering how expensive this product is.  I am considering refilling an old Tata Harper roller so I don’t have to use this dropper.  I noticed another review that alluded to this same issue -- so I’m glad it wasn’t just the unit that I received.  Other than that, this oil is magic.  Absorbs quickly and makes my face radiate.

This is great for my combo skin. Yes it smells. But it’s the type of smell that people who get facials appreciate. It smells like it works if that makes sense. Also the smell goes away. After 10-15 mins it goes away anyway. My skin is more even. I get less break outs and black heads since using this. Also it’s not oily which I love. I do two pumps and that’s enough for my face and neck. I will be repurchasing.

Pro: It was heavily scented, but it did not irritate my skin. My face felt great when I used the mask before doing the rest of the steps. It made me feel rich.  It lasted 4 weeks for me with just nightly use. The first day I thought my skin looked amazingCon: it was just okay. I think this set works better for people closer to oily skin. The cleanser has a physical exfoliant, and I started to hate using everyday. The moisturizer is very thin and watery. I noticed that my skin started flaking on my forehead even after doing all those steps. But my skin did great once I used the oil ALL over my face as well. I’m also not sure if the essence really did anything for me. I think i wasted a lot of it since it is a spray and I kept missing my face because I had to close my eyes. All in all, I don’t regret trying it, but I will not repurchase or get the full size items. I will just go back to using Fresh and only having to do 3 steps max

I got a deluxe size of this in a set. I don’t know what else it’s supposed to do but it does not moisturize. I don’t even have dry skin, just normal skin that almost never feels dry or tight. I get away with rich toner or serum only, but this product was drying even for me. Won’t purchase a full size.

This is by far at the the top of all oil based cleansers. I’m especially pleased that it is infused with plant based products making it gentle on the skin and less of an irritant and the aroma is to die for!Moreover, it’s use and practicality are wonderful, at night I use it to take off my eye makeup,lipstick and even waterproof mascara gently massaging it into my skin and activating it with a little bit of water and then using a washcloth or damp cotton pads (as they suggest you do) to gently remove it. It comes off easily leaving little to no residue and my skin is baby smooth.  It is a little pricey but definitely worth it.
Use this stuff when I have bad breakouts, clears them up in 2-3 days. WORTH EVERY PENNY.
LOVE this spray. Goes on with a full heavy spritz without soaking your face, drys perfectly and face feels soft.  It IS part of my everyday skin routine

I received a sample of this from Sephora and was hooked once I tried it.  Smells fresh and feels luxurious on skin.  Even though it’s expensive, I caved and bought a jar.  I’ve tried a lot of different masks and this is the only one I’ve found made a huge difference in getting rid of white heads and making my skin feel smooth after only 4 uses.  I wish the jar wasn’t so small but it’s worth every penny IMO if it actually makes a difference I can see and feel.  It makes me want to try Tata’s other products.  Will definitely purchase this again.

Great products! However, I was disappointed that the eye cream was not included as part of the kit as mentioned on the description. I did contact customer service and they sent me a new kit but same problem. Sephora needs to update the misleading information on what’s included in this kit !

Maybe it’s just me, but I find this product quite potent. I get a tingle and sometimes even a sting upon use, something that has never happened to me with the original Radiance Mask (nor the Purifying Mask, only ever also with the Clarifying Mask - I’m a huge Tata Fan). The glow it delivers is mild, nothing to write home about, but I do appreciate the gentle exfoliation, and more so, the addition of kaolin that acts as a delicate pore refiner. My personal favorite of the Superkind line, and certainly the most active and effective of the bunch, but not necessarily as advertised and perhaps not for the most sensitive among us. Personally, I find this product scentless.

This moisturizer saved me when my skin was going through a crisis! I never really had problematic skin or any serious acne, just the odd breakout. Out of no where I had this HUGE breakout on my forehead (most definitely from stress from university) but everything I was doing nothing was working. One of the Sephora girls recommended this line so I tried a few of the products. I slowly got off the other ones I was using just because it was really expensive and I thought I would just go back to my basics but keep this moisturizer! The smallest bit goes such a long way! It gives you such a deep hydration, it’s not oily or heavy at all. My skin tends to go very oily throughout the day, but this moisturizer really helped balance that. I have super sensitive skin and it’s just completely calmed it. GREAT PRODUCT.
Love Love LOVE this!!!!❤❤❤❤

Here I go again Tata! Sticky paradise coupled with stale smell that made my boyfriend choose kissing the dog instead of me. Top this with the price tag and it equals a return. I want to love this brand and every time is another let down. Not sure how there are so many 5-star reviews but this is just a hard no for me.

This moisturizer is not only SAFE AND HEALTHY to use but it does its job!!! There is no need for carcinogenic ingredients in any makeup or skincare products and Tata Harper proves it. Yes, it is expensive and I was reluctant to buy at first, but you only need one squirt of it and it lasted me 6 months! Try it out for 2 weeks and let your skin get used to having natural organic ingredients on it and you will not regret the purchase!

This is an incredible find for irritated or over exfoliated skin. I recently had a peel that left my skin hyper sensitive to anything I would try to put on it, and this was the only product that was actually soothing and calming. 100/10 would recommend. I received this as a gift from Tata Harper
This product really didn’t do much for my skin. It wasn’t terrible, but didn’t hydrate it either. The smell isn’t the greatest, but personally I don’t like florally type products.

Really wanted to love this product. First of all, it releases so much product that it feels someone splashed my face with water (and of course that’s gonna feel hydrating at first). But it evaporates/dries out very fast, in the matter of minutes. My skin personally doesn’t feel hydrated and I have oily combination skin. I won’t be buying again.

Sephora sent me a jar made nearly a year ago! Old product for an outrageous price. Nice. At least it isn’t as old as the serum they tried to pawn off on me. That was made in June of 2019! Yeah, I just threw a bunch of pricey stuff away that was fresher than this. Never again.

I had a terrible allergic reaction to a product and needed a moisturizer that wouldn’t cause any additional damage. A salesperson recommended this to me and I still use it every night! It makes my skin feel soft, and makes me feel like my face is still clean when I wake up.The only downside for me is that it has a very vibrant fruity scent which isn’t the most relaxing thing to put on right before going to sleep.
Lovely scent. Smells kind of limes, I think? I chose this brand because I appreciate how they use all natural ingredients. Although it is pricey, I find that a little goes a long way with this one.

I’ve been reading all the hype about Tata Harper and cleansing oils, so I finally gave in. I’ve used it alone and as a second cleanser, as other reviewers have suggested (after a Kiehl’s product I love) and like it either way. I don’t think I’d use it as a primary makeup remover, because it’s pretty expensive. And I like other eye makeup removers just fine - Kiehl’s, Sephora, even Almay - to remove Benefit mascara.The container is pretty too! I am excited to try other Tata Harper products as a result of this purchase.

LOVE this product. Been using this for almost 10 years and it just never fails me. The luxurious spa smell is everything! The oil does not feel heavy and sticky at all, my skin just loves it. It keeps my face hydrated at night and adds glow to my face during the day. I have tried other oil but I just always come back to this.

I TRIED to find a moisturizer I liked as well as this, because it IS a little pricey, but I ended up coming back to Tata because it is SO GOOD. I have very dry skin, and I needed something extremely hydrating but light and fast-absorbing enough to wear under full makeup. I tone with a floral hydrosol like helichrysum or rose, apply Tata Harper’s Beautifying Oil, then this. It is NOT a night cream if you have dry skin - you’ll want something heavier - but I absolutely glow when I’m wearing it and when I take my makeup off at the end of the day it looks better that it did in the morning.

I made a purchase and chose this as my little sample and boy did I make the best decision! Literally within 24 hours I’ve noticed such a difference in my skin and blemishes. It’s definitely reduced my redness, helped control my oil and helped demolish my acne. My skin is so silky smooth and I personally love the smell (I am not sensitive to smells). I would 100% recommend the money spent on this product. Once my sample runs out I will most definitely be buying this! Worth every cent!

I received this SUPERKIND Bio-Barrier Serum complimentary from Tata Harper Skincare, and I’m giving my honest feedback. I love the packaging, which is nice and high-end looking. It has 26 high-performance ingredients so it claims to be an all-in-one serum. The texture is water-like. Suitable for all skin types. I’m not a big fan of the smell though.

There is a distinctive fragrance to these products, and if you don’t like it, then you’re out of luck. I happen to like it, and it does fade pretty quickly, so this was a winner for me. I really thought almost everything in here was decent, and I will buy full size of several. A surprise win for me was the cleanser. I am not too interested in most cleansers, and will use water, Cetaphil, or even baking soda (for exfoliation). But Tata’s cleanser has got such a great texture and is not drying, so I think I will definitely add it to my repertoire. I also personally loved the serum and moisturizer. I have dry-ish skin, which is oily in spots, and this seemed to work pretty well for me. Actually, I would consider buying all of the products in this kit. Seemed like quality stuff.
I like the mask and cleanser but the the smell on the rest of the products is so strong, it’s almost unbearable. I can’t use them bc the scent is so intense.
This is not moisturizer. More like a serum! you have to put on moisturizer after using this. Not good for dry skin. The smell also is very strong. Totally overpriced!!

I tried this collection to see which products I might want to invest in for the full size product. I ended up loving a few--the cleanser, moisturizer, rejuvenating serum, and eye cream. I noticed after using these products every day that my skin felt more moisturized but not greasy, and looked more youthful and smooth.

since I have purchased Tata Harper Clarifying mask and fell in love with it, I bought Tata’s Purifying Mask thinking it would also be a home run, I was sadly disappointed. Not that it’s a horrible product but the amount you get for what it’s worth just didn’t measure up for me. It’s a good smelling mask and even feels relaxing on the skin, but I have other masks that were cheaper and do exactly the same. Sadly It’s a pass for me.

I love Tara Harper but started to only use oil free products for my skincare. I love the texture. Has a great grainy feeling that feels amazing. First time using, the next morning my skin was glowing. Perfect cleanser.

As a longtime Tata Harper fan with sensitive skin, I really wanted to love this cleanser - but with the exception of the mask, this and all the other Superkind products fell flat for me. There is nothing wrong with it per se, but aside from gorgeous packaging, there is nothing particularly special about it either. I find it an average mild cleanser, not harsh nor gentle. I do get a good foam by adding more water, and skin feels clean, not stripped, but also not hydrated either. It’s unscented, so no added fragrance, but yes, the ingredients to have a “natural” scent, though to me it’s not at all bothersome.I tend to dislike when people bring price into the equation when it comes to products, but this is one product that I must say is, to me, simply not worth it. By all means, get it for the pretty bottle, get it to round out your Tata Harper collection, but if you’re looking for a good, gentle cleanser, there are sooo many better options. In short, even if this was a quarter of the price, to me, it would unfortunately still only be average.

I adore this product. I always get the smaller size that comes with the roller ball dispenser so I can swipe it across my cheeks, forehead, cuticles, even bug bites! This lightweight face oil not only hydrates skin but also delivers a mega dose of goodies that balance, soothe and brighten. Layered over a moisturizer, it eliminates dullness for a seriously radiant complexion. It also smells amazing and is 100% natural. It’s a miracle worker. Plus, the tidy packaging eliminates any chance of spillage. (As the clumsiest person I know, if it’s possible to spill something, I will inevitably spill it.) A must-have for every skincare arsenal.

I purchased this mask because I have combination to oily skin that has large pores and sometimes get little pimples, especially when I expose my skin to new environments. Since I already use the Tata Harper Purifying Cleanser, I decided to get this mask and try it out and so glad I did!
I used it today for the first time around 10am EDT because I had a little breakout happening on my chin and put a thicker layer on, more than I usually would with my other favorite masks. I left it on for an hour actually instead of 30 minutes and I feel that helped out. After I removed the mask, I promise you the surface bumps (pustules and comedones) were smoothed out, not irritated, but almost healed. If I use this mask in two days or so, I can guarantee I will have clear skin! I love this mask, it really does what it says it does!
It’s been 4 hours since the mask and I swear I am not oily at the least. Within 4 hours after I’ve cleansed my skin in the morning, I should be an oily slick right now, but I really believe this mask helped my oily skin. That’s the reason why I’m writing this review on the day I used this mask. It’s truly amazing for a mask!

I love the oil. It smells wonderful and cleans off my makeup beautifully. I use a washcloth to rinse it off as Caroline Hirons suggests. The only issue I have is the majority of the time the pump won’t pump. It’s very annoying that a product that costs this much has such a horrible pump. I’m seriously considering not buying it again because of the pump. I shouldn’t have to fight with it so much to get product out.

This has been the biggest disappointment in my skin care purchases ever. I was looking for an oil based retinol and got a sample of this at the store. At first, the smell was amazing. Like jasmine flowers. I was obsessed to have it, I decided to splurge on it. When I got it, the product smelled more like sandalwood and would stay with that smell on my face for hours. I also got a mini of this in a different kit and it smelled more like lavender. Which also tells me their recipe has little consistency in formula if the smell can’t even stay the same. I hated it. Upon further research, I realized that the “pro-retinol” is only rose hip oil. It doesn’t contain retinol which is the worse part. The Ordinary has inexpensive retinol that doesn’t have a horrible smell that I would recommend anyone to try over this. Tata Harper is hit and miss for me, in terms of product quality, effectiveness and smell. This was a huge let down.
Good way to sample all the products. I really enjoyed the mist, serum,  moisturizer and oil. The mask were alright... I have these for travel mostly.

I purchased this during my search for a new skin care line. This set seemed to have everything but overall left much to be desired. The eye cream only lasted two uses, the cleanser is basically an apricot scrub that shouldn’t be used 2x day, the essence smelt awful, and the mask didn’t do anything for my skin. The search continues...

LOVE this moisturizer. It is rich which is perfect for Chicago winters.  My skin is combo but can dry out a bit during the winter. I am trying to only buy clean skincare so i thought i would splurge on this. I have used for a wrek and really like so far. I take a little rub in my fingertips and massage in my skin.  At night i will use facial oil before applying cream. I noticed applying the oil before cream works best.  Its a great makeup base as well.  I just wish their prices werent so high but good quality.

I was going through one of the worst stress related breakouts I’ve ever had and this came to the rescue! I’ve been using it twice a week and can see a noticeable difference. It helps clear out blackheads, reduce pores, and bring deep painful pimples to the surface. It also brightens and smooths my skin! The day after I used it for the first time I had some peeling but my skin felt way better and in all honesty the peeling was probably a good thing!

I was really appealed to this lotion because it’s all natural. My initial impression was that it smelled nice and felt nice on my skin. I live in Denver, where it’s very dry. After about a week I started noticing my skin feeling really dry later in the day. I took a trip to the mountains and this lotion just did not hold up. It provided no protective barrier for my skin and it ended up cracking. I plan on returning it. I think if you live in a humid climate it would be quite nice, but if you live in a dry climate or are dealing with harsh winters definitely don’t get this! It just won’t protect your skin from even moderately harsh conditions

I got this as a gift by Tata Harper Skincare.  As someone who loves a thick moisturizer, it took some adjusting to use something more lightweight. That said, my skin still felt cared for in that moisture-blanket type of way. It has a clean scent, absorbs quickly, and is a perfect swap for the warmer months.
I guess as a moisturizer it’s ok.  Light and non greasy.  But the smell is so overwhelming I just can not use.  Glad it was just a sample I tried.

I have atopic dermatitis and I am very cautious about what I put on my skin. I bought the kit because it is free of toxins and to my surprise I love every product in it. Unlike some other reviews, I love the smell of the products. I feel like I am at the spa every night. I only use the product once a day, rather than two, to keep my skin from being overly dry or washed and instead I use a make up removing towelette in the morning to gently wipe my face. I’ve learned that it is so important to be mindful of what we are putting on our skin and ultimately in our bodies. The Face Wash is gentle enough to keep me from breaking out excessively, the toner is a must if you want to restore the ph balance in your skin (keeps me from being too oily) and the moisturizer and serum are added bonuses to nourish the skin. The face mask is great, you can feel it tighten without cracking and it leaves a cool breeze feeling. When I use these products I don’t want to wear my makeup, it leaves me feeling brand new :).  Everyone’s skin is different, if this product doesn’t work for you, I’ve heard great things about Tatcha. Remember, how you care for your skin is more important than the makeup you cover it up with.

If you have any sort of tight dry skin, or just want an extra boost of radiance, glow and hydration this mask will be your skin savour! I’ve tried a lot of different hydrating masks at Sephora and nothing has lived up to my expectations like this. Everything I’ve tried from Tara Harper hasn’t disappointed me. A little goes an extremely long way, so the price point is totally bearable! The texture goes from being a light weight cream to a hydration oil the more you rub the mask in, but without leaving a greasy film after you remove the mask with water. It turns into a milk and is super calming and soothing after you remove it. Leaves the skin super refreshed, plumped and hydrated. Would recommend this mask to anyone!!

Overly obsessed. My product wasn’t dried out at all! After applying it smelt like I was in a spa and I immediately felt my face being cooled. My problem is large pores - pores already feel clear / smaller!

I really like this product and the results have been great. I can’t believe how nice my skin is. I was hesitant to use an oil cleanser but I am believer. The only reason I didn’t give this 5 stars, is the pump for the bottle. The pump doesn’t work. I will literally put all my weight on the pump and it won’t budge like it is either clogged or locked. When it does work it will shoot the product across the room. I will need to exchange my bottle as I think I may have gotten a bad one.

I love this oil cleanser.  I think it does an amazing job at not stripping the skin, but removing makeup/build up from the day.  The price is high but you are getting quality ingredients and glass vs plastic packaging.  To me that is worth it.

So yeah-this product can have 3 different ratings:-for jar size-absolutely zero stars-the quantity is offensive and smaller than most eye creams-for actual size-product contained a huge air bubble which happens when the product is dispensed with a machine and can be easily controlled for if one cared to control it. It was very disappointing to see Tata religiously advertise her products as NASA high standards yet the jar was not even filled. So the bad reviews below are definitely true. -the quality of the mask-very thick mask-almost like Vaseline. It is soothing and smells very nicely-I actually would consider buying if they obviously change the quantity and the bubble problem. Overall there are a lot of luxury masks that are better than this not to mention I am not ok with a cosmetic brand that has a double standard and just does not deliver.

I needed a kit for an extended stay away from home and I wanted to try Tata. It turns out Tata Harper is not for me. I don’t enjoy the strong fragrances nor the grit in the cleanser. I didn’t like the finish of the Serum and Moisturizer. The Spray is lighter with a more pleasant fragrance but did not have a significant effect.  The Resurfacing Mask was the only product I enjoyed.

i cannot recommend this product.  the stench is just appalling.    no matter how well it works, the smell is just terrible.  it reminds me of vomit!  i kept wondering all day if someone is going to figure out the stink comes from my face.  now and again i would get a whiff of it, and i just had to stop myself from rinsing it off my face.  surely there’s an anti-aging moisturizer out there that smells better than this does!

It’s really a good moisturizer. It’s very light so it’s good to use during the day and night. It’s also very moisture which my skin feels very comfortable after using it. I also like it since it’s fragrance free. So you don’t have to worry about anything strong weird smell.
I get REALLY dry in the Fall, this is the first moisturizer that can keep up. It is rich, thick, feels great going on. I think it smells like a margarita, yummy.

First, this lotion is truly fragrance free. It is  a light cream that spreads easily and absorbs quickly. After application, my skin feels incredibly soft. They describe this lotion as “cocooning,“ and as strange as it sounds, that’s actually what it feels like. My skin feels protected, like it has a shield over it. I really like the ingredients -- lots of great things in it, but nothing harmful.

I LOVE this oil cleanser - it is the absolute best on the market. I’m 32 with normal/combo skin and I wear a full face of makeup everyday (most days). I use this as step one in my night routine and it gets EVERYTHING off. I love the scent - which is minimal but fresh - and it makes my skin feel so good. I have tried so many other kinds of oil cleanser and this is my all time favorite.

This is an average toner and overpriced.  My biggest problem is that the spray bottle on the smaller size is very inaccurate in direction and wastes a lot of product.  I went through this in 2 months with everyday use- I can usually get away with 4-6 months with a toner.

I really wanted to love this product since other reviews sounded promising for people with similar skincare concerns as I have, but it’s been HORRIBLE. I kept all other aspects of my skincare routine the same and broke out in cystic acne all over my face after using this for a week. I pushed through for 3 weeks to see if it was just temporary “cleansing” but I’m still hiding behind concealer covering all of these cystic pimples.
That smell! At this price point they should have figured out a “natural” ingredient that will make it smell less like a rotten egg. Had to return it.

I really disliked this product. I have oily and sometimes dry skin. I read other reviews that this was hydrating and make acne go away almost instantly. I do not get very many pimples and this made me break out everywhere and also made my skin very dry and red. I would not recommend.

I had heard everyone raving about this mask, and now I understand the hype! It leaves your skin feeling so clean and smooth. After applying the mask, I felt some tingling, but more of a cooling effect on the skin, even after I’ve washed it all off. The smell, like others described, is on the stronger side and smells like ginger. Personally, I don’t mind, but if you’re sensitive to fragrance in skincare products, I recommend getting a sample first or smelling it in stores before purchasing. I can’t really speak to its effects on acne, as I only had a few tiny bumps on my face. The biggest difference I noticed was how smooth my skin was afterwards. It was literally baby soft, and I can’t remember the last time it felt that way. My skin was also very radiant and glowy, like I had just gotten a facial! Yes, the price is a bit steep, but a bottle should give you 15-20 uses, bringing the cost per use much lower than the cost of a facial.
I was given a sample and was beyond impressed with how my face felt that I bought the full size!  My skin now looks plump and healthy with the rest of my skin care I love this stuff so much!

I am so happy that Tata Harper came developed a line of products for sensitive skin. I was relieved to see that there wasn’t any essential oil or added fragrance in this moisturizer. I do smell a slight pleasant scent from the natural ingredients & I’m thankful that they didn’t add a scent masking ingredient to this formula.   My skin loves this moisturizer- I feel hydrated and  plumped up. I’m left with a slight dewy feeling which works great for days when I’m wearing foundation. I’m really looking forward to using this at night during the winter. The cocooning effect that I get from this moisturizer is going to be perfect over my serums in the winter.

I LOVE this product! I use as directed as the last step in my routine, but only at night. I’ll use it during the day only if I’m not wearing any makeup and just bumming around. It hydrates and gives me such a glow. I love the smell of tata harpers products...very natural and you’ll either love it or hate it. At first, I didn’t like that it was a rollerball applicator, but now after using it, I do...I think it helps to only use a little instead of a lot...a little is all you need!

Really nice cleanser with 18 high-performance ingredients! Easy to apply and work with. After one wash it gave my skin a refreshing feeling; makes your skin feel clean and healthy. Definitely worth trying!

I purchased this masked months ago from my local Sephora.  I enjoyed it, but I have a ton of other masks so this one kinda sat on my shelf after the initial use.  Recently, I’ve been battling some texture on my cheeks, chin, and jawline.  I decided to give this one a try again.  Not expecting much, I applied it at night (according to directions) and followed with my usual routine.  When I woke up in the morning, not only were my pores “sneaky clean”, but the tiny bumps I was experiencing were almost completely gone.  I know products from this brand are expensive, however this is the 3rd product I have used from them that is exceptional (I also use the Clarify mask and cleanser).  If it’s in your budget, give it a try.
Strong flowery scent. Used it for two weeks straight and no noticeable results. Overhyped

I use the hydrating floral essence twice a day every day as a boost to my moisturizer. My favorite use for the hydrating floral essence is as a light moisturizer if I needed a little extra refreshing once I already put my makeup on. Two or three sprays easily cover my whole face, so even though the bottle is pretty expensive it lasts a very long time. I do wish it was less expensive, but the fact that it is made in America with eco-friendly materials makes up for the higher cost.

This is a very nice light serum. I find it to be very hydrating and I love the milky texture. It is gentle on my skin and I like that it is fragrance free. The glass bottle and pump are very beautiful and easy to use. I received this serum complimentary from Tata Harper Skincare.

I don’t know but the scent reminds of trees, and not really good smelling trees. I didn’t buy a full size thank goodness but I just got a sample. It also didn’t do much for my dry skin. I guess it’s a bit unfortunate for the full sized product to be so expensive. The only thing I really like about this is that there are no harsh chemicals and it’s clean other than that it’s just meh to me. It’s hard to say it won’t work for anyone because everyone has different skin types so what doesn’t work for me might work for someone else. It’s just not my cup of tea.

I’ve been looking for skin products that are made with natural ingredients and I think I’ve finally found the moisturizer that I’ve been looking for! I tried this product out along with the rejuvenating serum and I’m really impressed with how well & long it moisturized my skin despite not feeling really ’rich’ compared with other products I’ve used in the past. It’s really light and absorbs very nicely. I have small pores in areas of my face so I tend to get clogged pores resulting in little bumps but this product doesn’t seem to cause any issues after about 5 days of use. It has a really lovely lavender/spa-like smell that I love. It’s like aroma therapy! I only held back from the 5th star because I haven’t used it for that long so hopefully all of this works out long term.

Beyond impressed with this skincare line! The price tag is high but it is worth every penny. My skin has never felt softer or looked more radiant without makeup. And a little product goes a long way. The best part is the scent! Its a fresh, floral scent without it being overpowering or artificial (yay clean ingredients!) Save your money and purchase some Tata Harper products, your skin will love you for it.

This mask is the HOLY GRAIL. I’ve tried everything from Bliss to Dr. Brandt to drugstore brand masks, and I’ve never ever noticed a major difference in my skin. I only ever saw results from professional spa facials. I typically have pretty good skin - combination, sensitive to dairy and toxins, prone to breakouts on the chin only. But lately, my skin has been awful, dull and dry with acne all over my chin (thanks wedding stress, travel, hormones) - and I ordered this mask on a whim. IT IS AMAZING. It’s truly a professional facial in a jar - and all natural. I left it on for 15 minutes before bed, and IMMEDIATELY my skin was brighter and clearer. My blemishes had reduced and were not as red, and my skin felt super clean but soft and hydrated, not tight or irritated. The next day, my skin still looked great and when I washed my face in the morning, I could feel the hydration. This mask is seriously worth the money. And, the best part is it’s all natural - the ginger smells and feels amazing! I’m a mask convert and will keep a jar in my home bathroom as well as my suitcase, and I’m now ordering other Tata Harper products. BUY IT!

Yes, it’s expensive but worth it. I love the earthly smell of it. I love how it takes away any dryness in my face. My skin is combination-oily but in the winter my face tends to peel and is really dry. This gives me the moisture I need without having to reapply or find dry patches on my face which tends to happen with other moisturizers that are cheaper such as cliniques. My skin is also prone to breakouts but I had no issues with the use of this product. This moisturizer isn’t greasy at all and doesn’t clog my pores. I already finished a whole bottle and repurchased my second because I see a difference in my skin. My face has this glow and breakouts are kept to a minimal.
I REALLY like this. Feels great and the company overall is awesome. Only issue is it’s really quite expensive. It’s just not very accessible for most people unfortunately.
Superbe pour les peaux seches

I really had high hopes for this product, as I’ve read rave reviews about all things Tata Harper. This is my first TH purchase and not cheap, so I expected great results. I would classify this as a very light moisturizer with a fresh scent. It’s very thin and not super moisturizing - not what I’d expect for “dry, mature skin“. My skin feels dry after I apply this lotion, and I see no improvement at all - it’s been about 3 weeks. Disappointing.
I have mild severe acne, clears up my face like 50%, helps with little bumps on my skin and doesn’t dry me out, best moisturizer I have tried

I got this mask because I wanted a natural cleansing mask that didn’t irritate my pores (bye glam glow). It smells amazing. It is very expensive you don’t get much product, but I only apply this mask to target areas. You have to apply it for 3 days straight and from there once a week. I noticed more fresh and clean skin in my T zone area after using this product.

Absolutely love this kit as it is luxury ingredients at a relatively affordable price. Each piece in this kit works wonderfully at exfoliating, but also nourishing and moisturizing the skin; my oily-normal skin loves it. Best part: it doesn’t break me out. Here’s a quick review of each piece in this kit: 1- eye cream: being in my mid-20’s, eye cream is just eye cream. This wasn’t anything overtly special, but I was not able to get a good opinion on this product due to the fact that I could only get 2-3 uses out of it. 2- Cleanser: good physical and chemical exfoliate. Most physical exfoliants break me out due to their abrasive nature, but this has the right amount of grit. I use a peanut sized amount on my whole face after my first cleanse and my skin is left feeling like it can breathe (after wearing makeup all day).3- essense: probably the “smelliest“ of product in this kit. it’s very refreshing and make the rest of the products glide on evenly. Would not use over makeup due to it’s smell and moisturizing effect. 4- Serum: beautiful rich and creamy serum that sinks into the skin. 5- Moisturizer: a creamy yet liquidly moisturizer that smooths out skin and leaves the face looking and feeling plump and supple. 6- Oil: the best product in this kit. Maximum impact with minimal effort. Leaves skin feeling exfoliated yet balanced. 7- Mask: not beginner friendly. Thankfully I’ve used this product before so I know that it really packs a punch. For me my skin is so exfoliated that it often takes a day or two for it to become calm and even (for about a day my face is a bit puffy and red). Afterwards though...omg...my makeup sits beautifully, plus my pores are smaller. Any breakouts also dimish. Overall: amazing. 10/10 recommend

I bought this oil for myself as well as my mother (in her 50’s) to try out. We have been using it for two weeks now and we both like it.This oil has a very light and absorbs fast. I use it at night only as I do not like to put my foundation on top of it (it is still an oil). My mother uses it both day and night, it seems to work good under powder foundation.Over all I fell like it helped moisturize my skin and give it a glow.There are a few things I would improve- PACKAGING: I do not like the idea of roller ball applicator. In the instructions it actually said to apply oil on top of the moisturizer. I do not like the idea of using this application method after you just applied lotion to your face and neck. I wish it had a dropper instead.- SMELL: the smell of this oil is strong and pretty bad. Smells like a bad herbal medicine. Makes my dogs sneeze if my face is in close proximity to them after application of this oil. My boyfriend and my mother husband also find it very unpleasant. It does go away with in 30 min or so.-PRICE: I find it to be very pricey for the size of it.OVER ALL: I think this product works well and I will most likely repurchase.

Aw man, I didn’t want to like this cleanser because of how expensive it is, but it’s SO GOOD. The texture is soft on my face without the pulling or tugging associated with some cleansers, but it also actually feels like it’s cleaning at the same time. This product is fragrance free but it does have a soft soap or glycerine scent, which is likely the natural scent of the product. When I’m done using it, my face is soft, clean, and smooth. I love it so much, and the packaging is so luxe. One SORTA con but not really IMO: The glass may not be good if you have kids or cats who will knock it over and potentially shatter it in your bathroom.

This product is great! It smells amazing and it smooths out your skin. This is perfect to put on a dry spot and it will add moisture to your dry spots. Perfect for when a pimple is healing and has that dry skin on top of where the pimple is. Overall this product works very well and adds a glowy smooth skin look when used
This is super greasy and sits on top of my face. I have used other lipid based fortification moisturizers like MBR and this is not right for people with normal skin.

I used the other moisturizer for dry skin and if I use it during the day it makes my combination skin greasy, this one solves that problem. The scent is different that the dry skin moisturizer which is sad for me since I love that scent before going to sleep. I will stick to the other moisturizer for now since I can bring my self to spend so much for 2 moisturizes !
Does this make anyone sneeze like crazy!?Although this did hydrate really well, definitely going to pass because it caused me to sneeze a lot.

It has been less than 2 weeks since I started using and I could already notice my under eye puffiness and wrinkles diminishing. The texture is very rich. A tiny bit goes a long way. Although expensive this  balm could well last  me a year and my eyes are worth it.

I LOVE this Moisturizer. I have very dry, sensitive skin and this moisturizer provided me with the perfect amount of hydration that I did not need to touch up throughout the day. My skin gets red from almost everything and anything, especially around the outer portion of my chin and my cheeks, my skin did not turn red/become irritated with this product, it actually kept it at bay. It didn’t cause any flare ups/small whiteheads. Everything about this product is great. The only reason I gave it 4 stars was because of the price. I totally understand the price, it’s worth every penny but it still breaks my heart a little to buy it. I do recommend the set that sephora offers to test out all tata products because most of them are great.

All-in-one serum has 26 High-performance ingredients to help repair, hydrate and brighten your skin. Paired with Tata Harper Resurfacing Mask, I have seen results instantly. Healthy youthful skin if used as directed.

I stupidly didn’t read these reviews before ordering -- but like others, my purifying mask came dried out and not usable. I instantly called to get it replaced (because these things happen) but they sent me a second one DRIED OUT and from the same batch number. Clearly zero quality control on Sephora’s behalf... I have a few other Tata Harper products and love them! You would think after a handful of replacements and returns for this product, Sephora would take more responsibility to check them all before continuing to ship -_-

Love how it smells thanks to all the floral/botanical ingredients TINY bottle but rollerball application is nice and i thought i would hate itSave your coins and buy some rosehip oil Its nothing special The line has better offerings wouldnt buy it again

I bought this product in a Sephora store on Lincoln road, Miami Beach, during my vacations. I was very disappointed when I got home in Chile (thousands of kilometres away!), and found out that the mask I purchased few days ago was totally dried and full of mold! The product was brand new, with no apparent signs of use/manipulation. So, my advice is for Sephora, not its customers, to really make greater efforts on quality controls.

Definitely one of my favorite moisturizers.  I have purchased it multiple times.  With its heavy price tag I tried other products but always ended up with this one since it showed the best results and the skin always looked radiant.

Smells wonderful but made me cough for some reason. The pump is also very nice. I’m giving three stars because aside from the lovely smell, I didn’t feel it did much and the price point is quite high.
This moisturizer changed my skin in about 1 week! I highly recommend it!
Nice velvety texture. I used it at night and my skin felt nice in the am, not greasy, but i can’t say i saw a major difference though.. On the fence about this one.

This is the first time trying a luxury cleanser. I like that it was fragrance free because I don’t like strong scent. It feels very clean and soft on the skin, especially for sensitive skin. I’m going to continue using this product.

I love this product.  It really works, softens and tones skin. I also love to use it to set my make up, makes it look really natural. Unfortunately I use it quickly, it goes really fast, and is expensive so I’m now switching between this and Cauldie’s Beauty Elixer.
C’est le meilleur de tous en moin d’une semaine j’ai vue grande difference
fantastic hydrating mist with amazing light floral scent!

This was a great set to try out Tata Harper’s essentials. While the fragrance is strong, it’s herbal, which I don’t mind. All the fragrances of products seem to work well and balance each other out. I loved the serum. I was happy to have tried it before committing to it.

The product had a nice smell to it which wasn’t overpowering and I loved how easily it soaked into my skin and dried. It left no greasy residue which I hate in other moisturizers and I did not break out from it. I would consider trying other products from this line due to the clean ingredients

only got 3 uses out of it but I love the smell and how it leaves my skin so soft afterwards.  I did notice some breakouts today so maybe it’s from the mask unclogging my pores.  I can’t testify to any long term effects but I would look for this product again.

i really love and respect Tata Harper and her products but for some reason her moisturizers are not hydrating enough for my skin- i used this in the summer as well so i thought a lighter moisturizer would work for me.

I tried out the  Tata Harper moisturizer .    It was refreshing to have a scent free moisturizer sometimes scents can be to strong for me. It absorbed easily into my skin.   I could apply my makeup over it.

i like the package and the glass bottle but it doesn’t do as a good job as the lancome one.
the oil is very thick and not as effective when removing the eye liner which i draw on my upper waterline. 
will finish this and wont’ purchase again.

It’s miracle potion! It just worked magic on my tired, stressed, parched 60 year old skin. My skin is so stressed after dealing with seriously a ill family member for the past 11 years. I have a big wedding coming up and needed fast results to bring my “A“ game! This did it! It was initially pricey to me but after seeing how it only takes a very small amount the price is no factor whatsoever ! It might be way too heavy for youthful skin but if you need the clock reversed this is your ticket!!!
If you want to try the Tata Harper line, this is a great value and gives you all the basics. You will be hooked!

I absolutely love the way this feels on my face. I like to put some on my face and just relax with my eyes closed because it has the most amazing tingling cold feeling that makes me feel like I’m at a spa. However it is so expensive!!  Big downside for me. My rating is based on the overall product including price.

I’ve tried all of her moisturizers and this one is the most drying one. I’m oily and it tightened my skin and as a result I’m less oily. However, my skin is beginning to crack on my forehead. I will use up the sample size but would not repurchase. This is not worth $110. Absolutely not! If you’re dry, try her rebuilding moisturizer. Would not recommend this for dry skin.

This product is definitely thick and a bit greasy, but that’s what i like for a night cream so it works well for me. I take my time rubbing it in, and have also found its greatly helped my “boob lines” since adding the nightly treatment to my décolleté. If you have fair, dry skin like me and are looking for a product to help with sealing in moisture + anti-aging, then this is for you. A little bit goes a long way so it lasts a while.
The set gave me luminous radiant skin but I couldn’t stand the smell. I tried it a couple days. Had to return it. I am 32 and have combination skin leaning toward dry.

I was looking for a new eye makeup remover and a cleanser at the same time-found it all in one bottle! I have chronically dry skin, my forehead feels like sandpaper so I always used milk cleansers, never considered oil as I thought it would be too much. My go-to eye makeup remover is Clinique take off the day, better than anything else I’ve used including shiseido but was looking for something that would be nourishing around the eyes. I tested this on my eyes to see if if stung-it had a slight sensation but nothing compared to others including Chanel. This cleanser removes all traces of face and eye makeup, softens my dry skin to the point where I don’t need to exfoliate as often to get the same result. Final verdict-almost perfect except it can make my eyes water after rinsing

Amazing night cream for dry skin.  With winter being so harsh and dry I needed something to help with hydration that wouldn’t be greasy. This cream is magic. It soaks in but leaves your skin feeling light and not greasy at all. I use it at night then use it on my neck and décolletage in the day. Highly recommend this cream

Tata harper is the best. I always have great results so I was very excited to try this softening cleanser. The packaging is beautiful and I love how well it lathers into a foam that washing away the day without striping my skin. This has no scent which is fine but I am not bothered by scents, I actually tend to enjoy the experience of a great scent. My skin is fair so it can get sensitive, this cleanser makes my skin feel calmed and clean. I love this and I would recommend to anyone.
Absorbs nicely, but just can’t get past the smell. Much too medicinal
This is my favourite mask! I love how my skin looks after I use it.  I have very oily skin and my makeup lasts much longer after I use this.

This cleanser is so great! It removes perfectly the make up and makes the skin more hydrated. It’s fragrance-free, I personally , like when there is a bit of aroma, so from this point of you, not my type. BUT, I really love the effect and I will continue trying it! Also worth mentioning the package and the bottle - so luxury. It’s pleasure just to hold it.

This product is good for sensitive skin. I have sensitive skin and tend to feel uncomfortable after using a lot of products. But this one does its job for sensitive skin. It is gentle and does not leave the face dry after using it. It does not have a lot of foam (which I do not mind). The only thing is the smell. I cannot say I like or I’m used to the smell. It’s very heavily fragranced - I would sneeze every time I used this. Otherwise it’s a nice refreshing spray. I didn’t notice a huge difference with my skin though.

My skin drank this up! This is my favorite moisturizer ever. I put mine in a skincare fridge so when I put it on it’s nice and refreshing. Love this and you have to try it out.

I have yet to find a sheet mask I love more than this one. I don’t have acne, so that’s one of the few fix-alls I’m not sure this mask solves - but boy does it make your skin GLOW! I’ve used 2/4 of the masks and the first I used on a 10  hour flight home for Christmas.
